    function editQuestion(bankId, qId){
        const bank = banks.find(b => b.id === bankId);
        const q = bank.questions.find(x => x.id === qId);
        if(!q) return; // load into form for editing
        qType.value = q.type;
        qPrompt.value = q.prompt;
        clearChoicesInForm();
        if(q.type === 'single' || q.type === 'multiple'){
            q.choices.forEach(c => {
                choiceList.appendChild(createChoiceItem((c.text + (c.correct ? '| correct' : ''))));
            });
        }
        else if(q.type === 'fill'){
            qFillAnswer.value = (q.answers || []).join(', ');
        }
        else if(q.type === 'short'){
            qFillAnswer.value = q.model || '';
        }
        if(q.file){
            currentFileData = q.file;
            renderFilePreview();
        }
        // remove original and let user save as new or re-add
        if(confirm('已將題目載入編輯表單，儲存後會保留原題或請先刪除原題。要刪除原題嗎?')){
            bank.questions = bank.questions.filter(x => x.id !== qId);
            persist();
            renderBankPanel();
        }
    }
    function clearChoicesInForm(){
        while(choiceList.firstChild){
            choiceList.removeChild(choiceList.firstChild);
        }
    }
        // preview quiz simple navigation
        startQuiz.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const bank = banks.find(b => b.id === currentBankId);
            if(!bank || bank.questions.length === 0){
                return alert('題庫無題目可預覽');
            }
                previewBankIndex = 0;
                showPreviewQuestion();
        });
        prevQ.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const bank = banks.find(b => b.id === currentBankId);
            if(!bank) return;
            previewBankIndex = Math.max(0, previewBankIndex - 1);
            showPreviewQuestion();
        });
        nextQ.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const bank = banks.find(b => b.id === currentBankId);
            if(!bank) return;
            previewBankIndex = Math.min(bank.questions.length - 1, previewBankIndex + 1);
            showPreviewQuestion();
        });
        playAudio.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const bank = banks.find(b => b.id === currentBankId);
            if(!bank) return;
            const q = bank.questions[previewBankIndex];
            if(!q) return;
            if(q.audio){
                const a = new Audio(q.audio.dataUrl);
                a.play();
            }else if(q.file && q.file.type.startsWith('audio/')){
                const a = new Audio(q.file.dataUrl);
                a.play();
            }else alert('此題無音檔');
        });

    function showPreviewQuestion(){
        const bank = banks.find(b => b.id === currentBankId);
        if(!bank || bank.questions.length === 0) return;
        const q = bank.questions[previewBankIndex];
        const typeLabel = {single: '單選', multiple: '多選', fill: '填充', listening: '聽力', reading: '閱讀', short: '簡答'}[q.type] || q.type;
        let html = `<div style=\"padding: 12px\"><div style=\"font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px\">${escapeHtml(q.prompt)}</div><div style=\"margin-top: 6px\">類型: ${typeLabel}</div>`;
        if(q.type === 'single' || q.type === 'multiple'){
            html += '<div style="margin-top: 8px;">';
            q.choices.forEach((c, idx) => {
                html += `<div><label><input type=\"${q.type === 'single' ? 'radio' : 'checkbox'}\" name=\"pchoice\"> ${String.fromCharCode( 65 + idx)}. ${escapeHtml(c.text)}</label></div>`;
            });
            html += '</div>';
        }
        else if(q.type === 'fill'){
            html += `<div style=" margin-top: 8px;">填空: <input type=\"text\" placeholder=\"輸入答案\"></div>`;
        }
        else if(q.type === 'listening'){
            html += `<div style="margin-top: 8px">聽力: 按下播放鍵收聽</div>`;
        }
        else if(q.type === 'reading'){
            html += `<div style="margin-top: 8px">段落: ${escapeHtml(q.prompt)}</div>`;
        }
        else if(q.type === 'short'){
            html += `<div style="margin-top: 8px">簡答: <textarea placeholder=\"請輸入答案\"></textarea></div>`;
        }
        if(q.file && q.file.type.startsWith('image/')) html += `<div style="margin-top: 8px"><img src=\"${q.file.dataUrl}\" style=\"max-width: 100%; max-height: 160px; object-fit: contain\"></div>`;
        html += '</div>';
        previewArea.innerHTML = html;
        }

        // export current bank to Word (as HTML wrapped in .doc) -- embeds images using data URLs
        exportBankBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const bank = banks.find(b => b.id === currentBankId);
            if(!bank) return alert('請先選擇題庫');
            const html = bankToHTML(bank);
            const blob = new Blob([html], {type: 'application/msword'});
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            a.download = `${bank.name}.doc`;
            a.click();
            URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
        });

        // export current bank to Excel (.xlsx) using SheetJS
        exportExcelBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const bank = banks.find(b => b.id === currentBankId);
            if(!bank) return alert('請先選擇題庫');
            const rows = [['Index', 'Type', 'Prompt', 'Choices', 'Answer', 'HasImage', 'FileDataURL']];
            bank.questions.forEach((q, i) => {
                const type = q.type;
                const prompt = q.prompt;
                let choices = '';
                let answer = '';
                if(q.choices){
                    choices = q.choices.map(c => c.text + (c.correct ? '(正)' : '')).join(' | ');
                }
                if(q.choice){
                    answer = q.answers.filter(c => c.correct).map(c => c.text).join(', ');
                }
                if(q.answers){
                    answer = q.answers.join(', ');
                }
                if(q.model){
                    answer = q.model;
                }
                const hasImage = q.file && q.file.type.startsWith('image/') ? 'Y' : '';
                const fileData = q.file ? q.file.dataUrl : '';
                rows.push([i + 1, type, prompt, choices, answer, hasImage, fileData]);
            });
            const ws = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(rows);
            const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
            const wbout = XLSX.write(wb, {bookType: 'xlsx', type: 'array'});
            XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, 'Questions');
            const blob = new Blob([wbout], {type: 'application/octet-stream'});
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            a.download = `${bank.name}.xlsx`;
            a.click();
            URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
        });
        
        function bankToHTML(bank){
            // Build a simple HTML document that Word can open. Images embedded as data URLs.
            let html = `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>${escapeHtml(bank.name)}</title></head><body>`;
            html += `<span>${escapeHtml(bank.name)}</span>`;
            bank.questions.forEach((q, i) => {
                html += `<span>${i + 1}. [${escapeHtml(q.type)}] ${escapeHtml(q.prompt)}</span>`;
                if(q.choices){
                    html += '<ul>';
                    q.choices.forEach((c) => {
                        html += `<li>${escapeHtml(c.text)} ${c.correct ? '<strong>(正確)</strong>' : ''}</li>`;
                    });
                    html += '</ul>';
                }
                if(q.answers){
                    html += `<div><strong>答案:</strong>${escapeHtml((q.answers || []).join(', '))}</div>`;
                }
                if(q.model){
                    html += `<div><strong>參考答案:</strong>${escapeHtml(q.model)}</div>`;
                }
                if(q.file && q.file.type.startsWith('image/')){
                    html += `<div><img src="${q.file.dataUrl}" style="max-width: 400px"></div>`;
                }
                if(q.file && q.file.type.startsWith('audio/')){
                    html += `<div>(含音檔)</div>`;
                }
            });
            html += '</body></html>';
            return html;
        }
        // helper: escape html
        function escapeHtml(str){
            if(!str) return '';
            return str.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
        }
        // delete bank button
        deleteBankBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if(!currentBankId) return;
            if(!confirm('確定刪除此題庫?')) return;
            banks = banks.filter(b => b.id !== currentBankId);
            currentBankId = null;
            persist();
            renderBanks();
            renderBankPanel();
        });
        // edit question (simple placeholder) - already implemented earlier as editQuestion

        // keyboard nav for preview
        window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
            if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft'){
                prevQ.click();
            }
            if(e.key === 'ArrowRight'){
                nextQ.click();
            }
        });
        // initial render
        renderBanks();
        renderBankPanel();
})();

// test-system-online/font-size.js
function changeFontSize() {
    const fontSize = document.getElementById('fontSizeSelect').value;
    document.getElementById('question').style.fontSize = `${fontSize}px`;
    document.querySelectorAll('label[for^="option"]').forEach((label) => {
        label.style.fontSize = `${fontSize}px`;
    });
}

// test-system-online/general-subject.js
let excelData = null;

	//當選擇 Excel 檔案時觸發
	document.getElementById('excelFileInput').addEventListener('change', function(e){
		const file = e.target.files[0];
		const reader = new FileReader();
		reader.onload = function(event){
			const data = new Uint8Array(event.target.result);
			const workbook = XLSX.read(Data, { type: 'array'});

			const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[workbook.SheetNames[0]];
			excelData = XLSX.sheet_to_json(worksheet, {Headers :1});

			matchFileNameWithJobType(selectedJobType);
		};
		reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
	});

	function onJobTypeChange(selectedJobType){
		// 顯示 Excel 題目到表格裡
		const tableBody = document.querySelector("#questionTable tbody");
		tableBody.innerHTML = ""; // 清空表格內容
		
		for(let i = 2; i < excelData.length; i++){ //假設題目從第三行開始
			const row = excelData[i];
			if(row){
				const tr = document.createElement("tr");
				const tdNumber = document.createElement("td");
				const tdQuestion = document.createElement("td");
				const tdOptions = document.createElement("td");

				tdNumber.textContent = i - 1; //題號
				tdQuestion.textContent = row[1] || "無內容"; // 題目內容(假設題目在第二欄)
				const optionHtml = `
					<input type="radio" name="question_${i}" value="${row[2]}"> ${row[2]}
					<input type="radio" name="question_${i}" value="${row[3]}"> ${row[3]}
					<input type="radio" name="question_${i}" value="${row[4]}"> ${row[4]}
					<input type="radio" name="question_${i}" value="${row[5]}"> ${row[5]}
					`;
					tdOptions.innerHTML = optionHtml;
				
				tr.appendChild(tdNumber);
				tr.appendChild(tdQuestion);
				tr.appendChild(tdOptions);
				tableBody.appendChild(tr);
			}
		}
	}

// test-system-online/index.js
function openFashionWinow(){
    const selectedOption = document.querySelector('input[name="fashion"]:checked');

    if(!selectedOption){
        alert("請選擇一個選項!");
        return;
    }

    // 根據選擇打開對應的視窗
    if(selectedOption.nextSibling.textContent.includes("檢定測驗")){
        window.open("test.html",'_blank');
    }
    if(selectedOption.nextSibling.textContent.includes("職業安全與衛生共同科目")){
        window.open("general-subject.html",'_blank');
    }
}

// 設備維護時間
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
    checkMaintenanceTime();
});

function checkMaintenanceTime(){
    const now = new Date();
    const hours = now.getHours();
    if(hours >= 1 && hours < 6){
        document.body.innerHTML = 
        `<div style="display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; height: 100vh; flex-direction: column; background: #1d1d1d; color: #fff; text-align: center;">
	<header style="position: absolute; top: 0; width: 100%; background-color: #333; color: #fff; padding: 10px 0 ; text-align: center;">系統維護中</header>
	<p>系統維護時間: 01:00(A.M.) - 06:00(A.M.)</p>
	<p>目前時間為系統正在維護中，造成您的不便，敬請見諒</p>
</div>`;
    }
}

// test-system-online/queTotal.js
function queTotal(event){
    event.preventDefault();
    const queTotal = document.getElementById("que-total");
    const queTable = document.getElementById("que-table");
    const isTrue = queTotal.style.display === "block";

    if(isTrue){
        queTotal.style.display = "none";
        queTable.style.display = "table";
    }else{
        queTotal.style.display = "block";
        queTable.style.display = "none";
    }
}

let questions = [];
let currentIndex = 0;
// 根據職類名稱正確載入
function loadExam(){
    const category = document.getElementById("JobCategory").value;

    fetch(`question/${category}.json`)
    .then(res => res.json())
    .then(data => {
        /*
        questions = data;
        renderQuestion(currentIndex);
        */
       console.log("載入前:", data.length);
       console.log("題庫長度:", data.length);
       questions = Random(data, 80);
       console.log("隨機後 question 長度:", questions.length);
       console.log("抽題後:", selected.length);
    //    currentIndex = 0;
       loadExam();
    })
    .catch(err => {
        console.error("讀到 JSON 但顯示失敗:", err);
    });
}

// 載入題目
function renderQuestion(index){
    const q = questions[currentIndex];
    document.getElementById("question").textContent = q.question;
    document.getElementById("label1").textContent = q.option[0];

    // 顯示圖片 (如果有)
    const imgEl = document.getElementById("que-img");
    if(q.image){
        imgEl.src = q.image;
        imgEl.style.display = "block";
    }else{
        imgEl.style.display = "none";
    }
    // 顯示選項
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const option = q.options[i];
    const radio = document.getElementById(`option${i + 1}`);
    const label = document.getElementById(`label${i + 1}`);

    if (!radio || !label) continue;

    radio.value = option;

        if (/\.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif)$/i.test(option.trim())) {
            // 如果是圖片選項
            label.innerHTML = `<img src="${option}" alt="選項${i + 1}" style="max-width: 250px; vertical-align: middle;">`;
        } else {
            // 如果是文字選項
            label.textContent = option;
        }
    }
}
// 亂數出題
function shuffleArray(array){
    // 
    for(let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--){
        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
        [array[i], array[j] = [array[j], array[i]]];
    }
    return array;
}

function Random(allQuestions, count = 80){
    const shuffled = shuffleArray([...allQuestions]);
    return shuffled.slice(0, count);
}
// 下一題
function Next(){
    if(currentIndex < questions.length - 1){
        currentIndex++;
        loadExam();
    }
}
// 上一題
function Previous(){
        if(currentIndex > 0){
        currentIndex--;
        loadExam();
    }
}
// 取消作答
function clear(){
    const options = document.getElementById("options");
    options.innerText = 0;
}
let userAnswers = new Array(80).fill(""); //記錄用戶答題，共計 80 題
// 儲存答案
function saveAnswer(){
    userAnswers[index] = value;
    renderQueTotal();
}
// 答題紀錄
function renderQueTotal(){
    const table = document.getElementById("que-total");
    table.innerHTML = "";
    let index = 0;

    for(let i = 0; i < 8; i++){
        const row = document.createElement("tr");
        for(let j = 0; j < 10; j++){
            const cell = document.createElement("td");
            const btn = document.createElement("button");
            btn.textContent = String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0');
            btn.onclick = function(){
                loadExam();
                queTotal();
            };
            
            const ansDiv = document.createElement("div");
            ansDiv.className = "user-answer";
            ansDiv.style.fontSize = "18px";
            ansDiv.style.color = "#666";
            ansDiv.textContent = userAnswers[index] || "";

            cell.appendChild(btn);
            cell.appendChild(ansDiv);
            row.appendChild(cell);
            index++;
        }
        table.appendChild(row);
    }
}
document.querySelectorAll("input[name='options']").forEach((radio, i) => {
    radio.onclick = () => {
        const selectedValue = radio.value;
        saveAnswer(currentIndex, selectedValue);
    };
});
// 顯示作答總覽
function queTotal(event){
    event.preventDefault();
    const queTotal = document.getElementById("que-total");
    const queTable = document.getElementById("que-table");
    const isTrue = queTotal.style.display === "block";

    if(isTrue){
        queTotal.style.display = "none";
        queTable.style.display = "table";
    }else{
        queTotal.style.display = "block";
        queTable.style.display = "none";
        renderQueTotal();
    }
}
// 確定按鈕
function ok(){
    const clear = document.getElementById("right-click-msg");
    clear.style.display = "none";
}
// 定義兩個倒計時
let cdEnd1, cdEnd2, timer1, timer2;
// 
document.getElementById('JobCategory').addEventListener('change', function(){
    const selected = this.value;

    if(selected != ""){
        // 設定 1 小時 40 分鐘倒計時總秒數
        const cd1 = 100 * 60 * 1000;
        // 計時倒計時結束時間
        cdEnd1 = Date.now() + cd1;
        if(timer1) clearInterval(timer1);
        timer1 = setInterval(updatecd1, 1000);
        updatecd1();
        // 設定 15 分鐘倒計時總秒數
        const cd2 = 15 * 60 * 1000;
        cdEnd2 = Date.now() + cd2;
        if(timer2) clearInterval(timer2);
        timer2 = setInterval(updatecd2, 1000);
        updatecd2();
    }else{
        document.getElementById('countdown').innerText = "請選擇測試職類級別以開始倒計時";
        document.getElementById('countdownBtn').innerText = "請選擇測試職類級別以開始倒計時";
    }
});
// 顯示倒計時 1 小時 40 分鐘
function updatecd1(){
    const now = Date.now();
    const remaining = cdEnd1 - now;

    if(remaining <= 0){
        document.getElementById('countdown').innerText = "時間到!系統自動收卷評分!";
        document.getElementById('time-msg').textContent = "時間到!系統自動收卷評分!";
        clearInterval(timer1);
        return;
    }
    const h = Math.floor((remaining / 1000 / 60 / 60) % 24);
    const m = Math.floor((remaining / 1000 / 60) % 60);
    const s = Math.floor((remaining / 1000) % 60);

    // 更新倒計時顯示
    document.getElementById('countdown').innerText = `${String(h).padStart(2, '0')} : ${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}: ${String(s).padStart(2, '0')} `;
}
// 顯示倒計時 15 分鐘
function updatecd2(){
    const now = Date.now();
    const remaining = cdEnd2 - now;

    if(remaining <= 0){
        document.getElementById('countdownBtn').innerText = "提前結束測試";
        clearInterval(timer2);
        return;
    }

    const m = Math.floor((remaining / 1000 / 60) % 60);
    const s = Math.floor((remaining / 1000) % 60);

    document.getElementById('countdownBtn').innerText = `${String(m).padStart(2, '0')} : ${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

// test-system-online/test v1.js
function onJobTypeChange() {
    const select = document.getElementById('jobTypeSelect');
    const selectedFile = select.value;

    // 如果未選擇檔案，清空表格
    if (!selectedFile) {
        const table = document.getElementById('question table');
        table.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5">請選擇上方選單以載入資料</td></tr>';
        return;
    }

    // 調用函數讀取選定的 Excel 檔案
    fetchExcelFile(selectedFile);
}

function fetchExcelFile(fileName) {
    // 使用 Fetch API 加載本地 Excel 文件
    fetch(fileName)
        .then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(`無法加載檔案：${fileName}`);
            }
            return response.arrayBuffer();
        })
        .then(data => {
            // 使用 SheetJS 解析 Excel 數據
            const workbook = XLSX.read(data, { type: 'array' });
            const sheetName = workbook.SheetNames[0]; // 取得第一個工作表名稱
            const sheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];

            // 將數據轉換為 JSON 格式
            const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { header: 1 });
            displayData(jsonData);
        })
        .catch(error => {
            console.error(error);
            alert('讀取 Excel 檔案失敗');
        });
}

function displayData(data) {
    const table = document.getElementById('question table');
    table.innerHTML = ''; // 清空表格內容

    // 如果沒有數據，顯示提示
    if (data.length === 0) {
        table.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5">無數據可顯示</td></tr>';
        return;
    }
    
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(e) {
        const data = e.target.result;
    const question = jsonData[1].B;
    const option1 = jsonData[1].C;
    const option2 = jsonData[1].D;
    const option3 = jsonData[1].E;
    const option4 = jsonData[1].F;

    document.getElementById('question').innerHTML = question;
    document.getElementById('option1').nextElementSibling.textContent = option1;
    document.getElementById('option2').nextElementSibling.textContent = option2;
    document.getElementById('option3').nextElementSibling.textContent = option3;
    document.getElementById('option4').nextElementSibling.textContent = option4;
    };
}

// test-system-online/test.js
function onJobTypeChange() {
    const select = document.getElementById('jobTypeSelect');
    const selectedFile = select.value;

    // 如果未選擇檔案，清空表格
    if (!selectedFile) {
        const table = document.getElementById('question table');
        table.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5">請選擇上方選單以載入資料</td></tr>';
        return;
    }

    // 調用函數讀取選定的 Excel 檔案
    fetchExcelFile(selectedFile);
}

function fetchExcelFile(fileName) {
    // 使用 Fetch API 加載本地 Excel 文件
    fetch(fileName)
        .then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(`無法加載檔案：${fileName}`);
            }
            return response.arrayBuffer();
        })
        .then(data => {
            // 使用 SheetJS 解析 Excel 數據
            const workbook = XLSX.read(data, { type: 'array' });
            const sheetName = workbook.SheetNames[0]; // 取得第一個工作表名稱
            const sheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];

            // 將數據轉換為 JSON 格式
            const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { header: 1 });
            displayData(jsonData);
        })
        .catch(error => {
            console.error(error);
            alert('讀取 Excel 檔案失敗');
        });
}

function displayData(data) {
    const table = document.getElementById('question table');
    table.innerHTML = ''; // 清空表格內容

    // 如果沒有數據，顯示提示
    if (data.length === 0) {
        table.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5">無數據可顯示</td></tr>';
        return;
    }

    // 遍歷數據並填充表格
    data.forEach((row, index) => {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        row.forEach(cell => {
            const td = document.createElement('td');
            td.textContent = cell || ''; // 防止空值
            tr.appendChild(td);
        });
        table.appendChild(tr);
    });

}

        return;
    }
    fetchExcel(`test/${selectedFile}`);
}

// The-Unified-Entrance-Exam-Countdown-Clock/script.js
function startCountdown(targetDate) {
    const target = new Date(targetDate).getTime();

    function updateCountdown() {
        const now = new Date().getTime();
        const difference = target - now;

        if (difference <= 0) {
            document.getElementById("countdown").innerText = "時間已到！";
            clearInterval(interval);
            return;
        }

        const days = Math.floor(difference / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        const hours = Math.floor((difference % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
        const minutes = Math.floor((difference % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
        const seconds = Math.floor((difference % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);

        document.getElementById("countdown").innerText =
            `${days} Day ${hours} : ${minutes} : ${seconds} `;
    }

    const interval = setInterval(updateCountdown, 1000);
    updateCountdown(); // 立即更新一次
}

// Time Calculator/script.js
function parseTime(timeStr){
    const parts = timeStr.split(":").map(Number);
    if(parts.length !== 3) return null;
    const [h, m, s] = parts;
    return h * 3600 + m * 60 + s;
}

function formatTime(totalSeconds){
    const h = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
    const m = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
    const s = totalSeconds % 60;
    return [h, m, s].map(n => String(n).padStart(2, "0")).join(":");
}

function calculateTime(){
    const start = document.getElementById("startTime").value.trim();
    const end = document.getElementById("endTime").value.trim();

    const startSec = parseTime(start);
    const endSec = parseTime(end);

    if(startSec === null || endSec === null){
        document.getElementById("result").textContent = "請輸入正確的時間格式。 (HH:MM:SS)";
        return;
    }

    const totalSec = endSec - startSec;
    const resultTime = formatTime(totalSec % 86400); // 超過一天會重設
    document.getElementById("result").textContent = `計算結果: ${resultTime}`;
}

# Vaultix-NAS/command.py
import os, subprocess, threading, time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import scrolledtext, messagebox
from typing import Optional

path = r"C:\Users\Roy\Documents\GitHub\Vaultix-NAS\websites\frontend"

NAS_HOST = ["192.168.0.181", "100.109.33.81", "192.168.0.1", "100.70.0.99"]

BUILD_CMD = "npm run build"
DEPLOY_CMD = "npx firebase deploy --only hosting"
PING_CMD = "ping -n 1 {}"


class DeployGUI:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        self.root.title("Vaultix NAS 部署工具")
        self.root.geometry("720x480")
        self.running = False

        path_frame = tk.Frame(root)
        path_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=10, pady=(10, 5))
        tk.Label(path_frame, text="目錄:").pack(side=tk.LEFT)
        self.path_var = tk.StringVar(value=path)
        tk.Entry(path_frame, textvariable=self.path_var).pack(
            side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.X, expand=True, padx=5)

        ip_frame = tk.Frame(root)
        ip_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=10, pady=5)
        tk.Label(ip_frame, text="IP 位址:").pack(side=tk.LEFT)
        self.ip_var = tk.StringVar(value=NAS_HOST[0])
        self.ip_menu = tk.OptionMenu(ip_frame, self.ip_var, *NAS_HOST)
        self.ip_menu.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

        btn_frame = tk.Frame(root)
        btn_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=10, pady=5)
        self.ping_btn = tk.Button(
            btn_frame, text=f"Ping NAS\n({NAS_HOST[0]})",
            command=lambda: self.start("ping"), width=14)
        self.ping_btn.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)
        self.ip_var.trace_add(
            "write", lambda *a: self.ping_btn.configure(
                text=f"Ping NAS\n({self.ip_var.get()})"))
        self.build_btn = tk.Button(
            btn_frame, text="Build", command=lambda: self.start("build"), width=12)
        self.build_btn.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)
        self.deploy_btn = tk.Button(
            btn_frame, text="Deploy", command=lambda: self.start("deploy"), width=12)
        self.deploy_btn.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)
        self.all_btn = tk.Button(
            btn_frame, text="Build + Deploy",
            command=lambda: self.start("all"), width=14)
        self.all_btn.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)
        self.stop_btn = tk.Button(
            btn_frame, text="停止", command=self.stop, width=8, state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.stop_btn.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, padx=5)

        self.log = scrolledtext.ScrolledText(root, state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.log.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True, padx=10, pady=(5, 10))

        self.proc: Optional[subprocess.Popen] = None

    def log_write(self, text):
        if isinstance(text, bytes):
            text = text.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        self.log.configure(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.log.insert(tk.END, text)
        self.log.see(tk.END)
        self.log.configure(state=tk.DISABLED)

    def set_running(self, state):
        self.running = state
        for btn in (self.ping_btn, self.build_btn, self.deploy_btn, self.all_btn):
            btn.configure(state=tk.DISABLED if state else tk.NORMAL)
        self.ip_menu.configure(state=tk.DISABLED if state else tk.NORMAL)
        self.stop_btn.configure(state=tk.NORMAL if state else tk.DISABLED)

    def run_cmd(self, cmd, use_cwd=True):
        self.log_write(f"\n$ {cmd}\n")
        self.proc = subprocess.Popen(
            cmd, cwd=self.path_var.get() if use_cwd else None, shell=True,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        if self.proc.stdout is None:
            self.root.after(0, self.log_write,
                            "[錯誤] 無法取得命令輸出\n".encode('utf-8'))
            return -1
        for line in self.proc.stdout:
            self.root.after(0, self.log_write, line)
        self.proc.wait()
        code = self.proc.returncode
        self.root.after(0, self.log_write,
                        f"\n[exit code: {code}]\n")
        return code

    def worker(self, mode):
        try:
            if mode == "ping":
                self.run_cmd(PING_CMD.format(self.ip_var.get()), use_cwd=False)
            else:
                if not os.path.isdir(self.path_var.get()):
                    self.root.after(0, messagebox.showerror,
                                    "錯誤",
                                    ("目錄不存在:\n" + self.path_var.get()).encode('utf-8'))
                    return
                if mode in ("build", "all"):
                    self.run_cmd(BUILD_CMD)
                    self.root.after(0, self.log_write,
                                    "\n睡眠 0.5 秒...\n".encode('utf-8'))
                    time.sleep(0.5)
                if mode in ("deploy", "all"):
                    self.run_cmd(DEPLOY_CMD)
            self.root.after(0, self.log_write,
                            "\n===== 完成 =====\n".encode('utf-8'))
        except Exception as e:
            self.root.after(0, messagebox.showerror,
                            "錯誤", str(e).encode('utf-8'))
        finally:
            self.root.after(0, self.set_running, False)

    def start(self, mode):
        if self.running:
            return
        self.set_running(True)
        threading.Thread(target=self.worker, args=(mode,), daemon=True).start()

    def stop(self):
        if self.proc and self.proc.poll() is None:
            self.proc.kill()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    root = tk.Tk()
    DeployGUI(root)
    root.mainloop()

# Vaultix-NAS/file_deliever.py
import os, sys, subprocess, threading, tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, filedialog, scrolledtext

# ---- 預設值（可在 GUI 上修改）----

username = "roy"   # <--- 目標主機的使用者帳號
goal_location = "/home/roy/casaos-nas/"  # <--- 目標資料夾（Linux 路徑）

# ---- CLI 模式（保留原本的指令邏輯）----
def cli_upload(file_path, host, user, goal):

# ---- GUI 介面 ----
class FileDeliverGUI:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        root.title("File Deliver — scp 上傳工具")

        frm_file = tk.Frame(root)
        frm_file.grid(row=0, column=1, columnspan=2, sticky="ew", padx=10, pady=8)
        frm_file.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        tk.Entry(frm_file, textvariable=self.file_var).grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew")
        tk.Button(frm_file, text="瀏覽…", command=self.browse_file).grid(row=0, column=1, padx=(6, 0))

        # 目標 IP
        tk.Label(root, text="目標位置 (IP):").grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w", padx=10, pady=8)
        self.ip_var = tk.StringVar(value=location[0])
        self.ip_combo = ttk.Combobox(root, textvariable=self.ip_var, values=location, state="normal")
        self.ip_combo.grid(row=1, column=1, columnspan=2, sticky="ew", padx=10, pady=8)

        # 使用者帳號
        tk.Label(root, text="使用者帳號:").grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="w", padx=10, pady=8)
        self.user_var = tk.StringVar(value=username)
        tk.Entry(root, textvariable=self.user_var).grid(row=2, column=1, columnspan=2, sticky="ew", padx=10, pady=8)

        # 目標資料夾
        tk.Label(root, text="目標資料夾 (Linux 路徑):").grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="w", padx=10, pady=8)
        self.goal_var = tk.StringVar(value=goal_location)
        tk.Entry(root, textvariable=self.goal_var).grid(row=3, column=1, columnspan=2, sticky="ew", padx=10, pady=8)

        # 上傳按鈕
        self.upload_btn = tk.Button(root, text="開始上傳", command=self.start_upload, bg="#4CAF50", fg="white",
                                    font=("Microsoft JhengHei", 12, "bold"))
        self.upload_btn.grid(row=4, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="ew", padx=10, pady=12)

        # 進度條
        self.progress = ttk.Progressbar(root, mode="indeterminate")
        self.progress.grid(row=5, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="ew", padx=10, pady=4)
        self.status_var = tk.StringVar(value="就緒")
        tk.Label(root, textvariable=self.status_var, anchor="w", fg="#555").grid(row=6, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="ew", padx=10, pady=(0, 4))

        # 輸出區
        self.log = scrolledtext.ScrolledText(root, height=14, state="disabled", wrap="word")
        self.log.grid(row=7, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="nsew", padx=10, pady=8)
        root.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        root.rowconfigure(7, weight=1)

    def browse_file(self):
        path = filedialog.askopenfilename(initialdir=os.path.dirname(self.file_var.get()))
        if path:
            self.file_var.set(path)

    def log_msg(self, msg):
        self.log.config(state="normal")
        self.log.insert("end", msg + "\n")
        self.log.see("end")
        self.log.config(state="disabled")

    def start_upload(self):
        file_path = self.file_var.get()
        host = self.ip_var.get().strip()
        user = self.user_var.get().strip()
        goal = self.goal_var.get().strip()

        if not file_path or not os.path.isfile(file_path):
            self.log_msg(f"❌ 來源檔案不存在: {file_path}")
            return
        if not host or not user or not goal:
            self.log_msg("❌ IP、使用者帳號、目標資料夾皆不可為空白")
            return

        self.upload_btn.config(state="disabled")
        self.progress.start(15)
        self.status_var.set(f"上傳中: {os.path.basename(file_path)} ({self._fmt_size(os.path.getsize(file_path))})")
        self.log_msg(f"⬆️ 開始上傳: {os.path.basename(file_path)} → {user}@{host}:{goal}")
        threading.Thread(target=self._do_upload, args=(file_path, host, user, goal), daemon=True).start()

    @staticmethod
    def _fmt_size(n):
        for unit in ("B", "KB", "MB", "GB"):
            if n < 1024:
                return f"{n:.1f}{unit}"
            n /= 1024
        return f"{n:.1f}TB"

    def _do_upload(self, file_path, host, user, goal):
        cmd = ["scp", file_path, f"{user}@{host}:{goal}"]
        self.log_msg("執行指令: " + " ".join(cmd))
        try:
            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
            out = proc.stdout.strip()
            err = proc.stderr.strip()
            if out:
                self.log_msg(out)
            if err:
                self.log_msg(err)
            if proc.returncode == 0:
                self.log_msg("✅ 上傳完成")
                self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("上傳完成"))
            else:
                self.log_msg(f"❌ 上傳失敗 (exit code {proc.returncode})")
                self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("上傳失敗"))
        except FileNotFoundError:
            self.log_msg("❌ 找不到 scp 指令，請確認已安裝 OpenSSH")
        except Exception as e:
            self.log_msg(f"❌ 發生錯誤: {e}")
        finally:
            self.root.after(0, self._upload_done)

    def _upload_done(self):
        self.progress.stop()
        self.progress["value"] = 0
        self.upload_btn.config(state="normal")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "--cli":
        choice = input(f"選擇目標位置 (輸入序號 0-{len(location)-1}): {location}\n> ")
        host = location[int(choice)]
        cli_upload(file, host, username, goal_location)
    else:
        root = tk.Tk()
        FileDeliverGUI(root)
        root.mainloop()

# Vaultix-NAS/SimpleExample/login_example.py
"""
login_example.py — Web login example with password hashing (FastAPI + bcrypt + SQLite)

Usage:
    pip install fastapi uvicorn jinja2 bcrypt PyJWT
    python login_example.py          # starts at http://127.0.0.1:8000

Features:
    - Password hashing with bcrypt (not plaintext)
    - JWT-based session (HttpOnly cookie)
    - User registration
    - SQLite storage (zero config)
    - Modern responsive web UI
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import bcrypt
import jwt
from fastapi import FastAPI, Form, Request, Response
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, RedirectResponse
from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates

BASE = Path(__file__).parent
DB_PATH = BASE / "login_example.db"
JWT_SECRET = "CHANGE_ME_TO_A_RANDOM_SECRET"
JWT_ALGO = "HS256"
JWT_DAYS = 7
COOKIE_NAME = "nas_jwt"

app = FastAPI(title="Login Example (Web + Hashing)")

# ── helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
def _db():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users ("
        "  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,"
        "  username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,"
        "  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,"
        "  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP"
        ")"
    )
    conn.commit()
    return conn

def _verify_password(plain: str, hashed: str) -> bool:
    return bcrypt.checkpw(plain.encode(), hashed.encode())

def _hash_password(plain: str) -> str:
    return bcrypt.hashpw(plain.encode(), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode()

def _create_jwt(username: str) -> str:
    exp = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=JWT_DAYS)
    return jwt.encode({"username": username, "exp": exp}, JWT_SECRET, algorithm=JWT_ALGO)

def _decode_jwt(token: str) -> str | None:
    try:
        return jwt.decode(token, JWT_SECRET, algorithms=[JWT_ALGO]).get("username")
    except Exception:
        return None

def _current_user(request: Request) -> str | None:
    token = request.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)
    return _decode_jwt(token) if token else None

# ── pages ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
@app.get("/", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def root():
    return RedirectResponse("/login")

@app.get("/login", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def login_page(request: Request):
    user = _current_user(request)
    if user:
        return RedirectResponse("/home")
    return HTMLResponse(_LOGIN_HTML)

@app.get("/register", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def register_page():
    return HTMLResponse(_REGISTER_HTML)

@app.get("/home", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def home_page(request: Request):
    user = _current_user(request)
    if not user:
        return RedirectResponse("/login")
    return HTMLResponse(_HOME_HTML.format(username=user))

@app.post("/api/register")
async def api_register(username: str = Form(...), password: str = Form(...)):
    username = username.strip()
    if len(username) < 2 or len(password) < 4:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "帳號至少 2 碼，密碼至少 4 碼"}, status_code=400)
    with _db() as db:
        try:
            db.execute("INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash) VALUES (?, ?)",
                       (username, _hash_password(password)))
            db.commit()
        except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
            return JSONResponse({"error": "帳號已存在"}, status_code=409)
    return JSONResponse({"ok": True})

@app.post("/api/login")
async def api_login(response: Response, username: str = Form(...), password: str = Form(...)):
    with _db() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?", (username.strip(),)).fetchone()
    if not row or not _verify_password(password, row["password_hash"]):
        return JSONResponse({"error": "帳號或密碼錯誤"}, status_code=401)
    response.set_cookie(
        COOKIE_NAME, _create_jwt(row["username"]),
        max_age=JWT_DAYS * 86400, httponly=True, samesite="lax", path="/",
    )
    return JSONResponse({"ok": True, "next": "/home"})

@app.post("/api/logout")
async def api_logout(response: Response):
    response.delete_cookie(COOKIE_NAME, path="/")
    return JSONResponse({"ok": True})

-- Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/data/local_mailboxes.sql
-- Self-hosted mail accounts (Postfix/Dovecot virtual mailboxes), opt-in per NAS user.
-- One row = one local_part@domain mailbox. Postfix's virtual_mailbox_maps and
-- Dovecot's passdb/userdb both read this table directly (mysql: map), so the
-- password_hash must stay in a format Dovecot understands (SHA512-CRYPT).
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS local_mailboxes (
    id            INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    username      VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    local_part    VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    domain        VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    created_at    DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    enabled       TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
);

-- Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/data/users.sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
    id       INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    username VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    role     ENUM('admin', 'user') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
    disabled TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

-- Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/data/VaultixID.sql
-- Vaultix ID table
-- Each user can claim one unique Vaultix ID (like a @handle)
-- Apply on Pi: mysql -u nas_user -p casaos_nas < VaultixID.sql

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vaultix_ids (
  user_id         INT          NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  vaultix_id      VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL,
  vaultix_id_hash VARCHAR(64)  DEFAULT NULL,
  created_at      DATETIME     NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at      DATETIME     NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT uq_vaultix_id UNIQUE (vaultix_id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_vaultix_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/patch_waitfordb.py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
修復 Pi 上 server.js 的三個問題：
  1. waitForDB retries 10×3s → 30×5s（最多等 150 秒，足夠 MariaDB 升級後重啟）
  2. apt-get upgrade 後加 mysqladmin ping 等待，避免 pm2 restart 搶在 MariaDB 就緒前發生
  3. pm2 update 用 detached spawn 延後 3 秒執行，讓 server.js 先完成回應再被 pm2 daemon 重啟殺掉

用法（從本機執行）：
  ssh roy@192.168.0.181 python3 - < patch_waitfordb.py
  或
  ssh roy@raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net python3 - < patch_waitfordb.py
"""

import sys

PATH = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js'

PATCHES = [
    # ── Fix 1: waitForDB 容忍度 ──────────────────────────────
    (
        'async function waitForDB(retries = 10, delay = 3000) {',
        'async function waitForDB(retries = 30, delay = 5000) {',
    ),
    # ── Fix 3: pm2 update 用 detached spawn，避免殺掉自己 ───
    # pm2 update 會重啟 pm2 daemon → 殺掉正在執行的 server.js
    # 改用 spawn detached + 3 秒延遲，讓任務結果先回報後才重啟
    (
        "      parts.push('[pm2] ' + await run('npm install -g pm2@latest 2>&1 && pm2 update 2>&1', 120_000))",

        "      await run('npm install -g pm2@latest 2>&1', 60_000)\n"
        "      // pm2 update restarts the pm2 daemon which kills this process.\n"
        "      // Detach it with a delay so the task result can be saved first.\n"
        "      spawn('bash', ['-c', 'sleep 3 && pm2 update'], { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' }).unref()\n"
        "      parts.push('[pm2] 升級完成，pm2 daemon 將在 3 秒後重啟（伺服器短暫離線屬正常）')",
    ),
    # ── Fix 2: apt 升級後等 MariaDB 就緒 ────────────────────
    (
        "      parts.push('[系統套件] ' + await run('sudo -n apt-get update -qq && sudo -n apt-get upgrade -y 2>&1', 300_000))\n"
        "    } catch (e) { parts.push('[系統套件] 失敗：' + String(e.message).slice(-200)) }",

        "      parts.push('[系統套件] ' + await run('sudo -n apt-get update -qq && sudo -n DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get upgrade -y 2>&1', 300_000))\n"
        "      await run('until sudo -n mysqladmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 --silent 2>/dev/null; do sleep 3; done', 120_000).catch(() => {})\n"
        "    } catch (e) { parts.push('[系統套件] 失敗：' + String(e.message).slice(-200)) }",
    ),
]

with open(PATH, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    src = f.read()

original = src
for old, new in PATCHES:
    count = src.count(old)
    if count == 0:
        print(f'[SKIP] 找不到目標字串（可能已修過）：\n  {old[:80]!r}')
        continue
    if count > 1:
        print(f'[ERROR] 目標字串出現 {count} 次，無法安全替換：\n  {old[:80]!r}')
        sys.exit(1)
    src = src.replace(old, new)
    print(f'[OK] 已套用修補：{old[:60]!r} ...')

if src == original:
    print('[INFO] 無任何修改（所有 patch 均已套用或找不到目標）')
    sys.exit(0)

with open(PATH, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(src)
print('[OK] server.js 已儲存')

import subprocess
r = subprocess.run(['node', '--check', PATH], capture_output=True, text=True)
if r.returncode != 0:
    print('[ERROR] 語法檢查失敗，正在還原！')
    with open(PATH, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(original)
    print(r.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
print('[OK] 語法檢查通過')

subprocess.run(['pm2', 'restart', 'casaos-nas', '--update-env'], check=False)
print('[OK] pm2 已重啟')

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/player.py
"""
Vaultix NAS — playback progress tracking core.

Shared by both the video player (frontend/src/components/viewers/VideoPlayer.tsx)
and the music player (frontend/src/components/music.tsx) — both hit the same
/api/player/progress endpoints, keyed by (user, file path), so "resume where
I left off" works the same way for audio and video and survives across
devices/browsers. Before this, VideoPlayer.tsx only saved position to
localStorage (nas_vp_<path> key) and music.tsx had no resume feature at all.

Self-contained on purpose (own DB_CONFIG/db()/uid_of(), duplicated from
server.py rather than imported) so this file can be dropped into server.py's
directory and wired in with a two-line import + include_router() without
risking a circular import.

Auth: identical pattern to server.py's /api/todos routes — reads
X-User-Uid, which server.py's _IdentityMiddleware guarantees is either a
verified value (from the caller's JWT) or absent; never trust it beyond
that boundary.
"""
import os
from typing import Optional

import pymysql.cursors
from fastapi import APIRouter, Header, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel

try:
    from dotenv import load_dotenv
    load_dotenv('/home/roy/casaos-nas/.env')
except ImportError:
    pass

DB_CONFIG = dict(
    host        = os.getenv('DB_HOST', 'localhost'),
    port        = int(os.getenv('DB_PORT', 3306)),
    user        = os.getenv('DB_USER', 'nas_user'),
    password    = os.getenv('DB_PASSWORD', ''),
    database    = os.getenv('DB_NAME', 'casaos_nas'),
    cursorclass = pymysql.cursors.DictCursor,
    autocommit  = True,
)


def db():
    return pymysql.connect(**DB_CONFIG)


def uid_of(x_user_uid: Optional[str]) -> int:
    if not x_user_uid:
        raise HTTPException(401, '請先登入')
    return int(x_user_uid)


def ensure_table(cur) -> None:
    """Call with an open cursor from server.py's own _init_db(), same as the
    existing todos/login_webauthn_credentials tables — keeps table creation
    in one startup transaction instead of opening a second connection."""
    cur.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS playback_progress (
            id               INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
            user_id          INT NOT NULL,
            media_type       ENUM('video','audio') NOT NULL,
            file_path        VARCHAR(750) NOT NULL,
            position_seconds DOUBLE NOT NULL,
            duration_seconds DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL,
            updated_at       DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            UNIQUE KEY uniq_playback_progress (user_id, file_path(500)),
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )
    """)


router = APIRouter()


class ProgressSave(BaseModel):
    path: str
    mediaType: str  # 'video' | 'audio'
    position: float
    duration: Optional[float] = None


@router.get('/api/player/progress')
def get_progress(path: str, x_user_uid: Optional[str] = Header(None)):
    uid = uid_of(x_user_uid)
    if not path:
        raise HTTPException(400, '缺少 path')
    conn = db()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                'SELECT position_seconds, duration_seconds, updated_at FROM playback_progress '
                'WHERE user_id = %s AND file_path = %s',
                (uid, path),
            )
            row = cur.fetchone()
        if not row:
            return {'position': None, 'duration': None, 'updatedAt': None}
        return {
            'position': row['position_seconds'],
            'duration': row['duration_seconds'],
            'updatedAt': row['updated_at'].isoformat() if row['updated_at'] else None,
        }
    finally:
        conn.close()


@router.put('/api/player/progress')
def save_progress(body: ProgressSave, x_user_uid: Optional[str] = Header(None)):
    uid = uid_of(x_user_uid)
    path = body.path.strip()
    if not path:
        raise HTTPException(400, '缺少 path')
    if body.mediaType not in ('video', 'audio'):
        raise HTTPException(400, '無效的 mediaType')
    if body.position < 0:
        raise HTTPException(400, '無效的 position')
    conn = db()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                'INSERT INTO playback_progress (user_id, media_type, file_path, position_seconds, duration_seconds) '
                'VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s) '
                'ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE position_seconds = VALUES(position_seconds), '
                'duration_seconds = COALESCE(VALUES(duration_seconds), duration_seconds), '
                'media_type = VALUES(media_type)',
                (uid, body.mediaType, path, body.position, body.duration),
            )
        return {'ok': True}
    finally:
        conn.close()


@router.delete('/api/player/progress')
def clear_progress(path: str, x_user_uid: Optional[str] = Header(None)):
    uid = uid_of(x_user_uid)
    if not path:
        raise HTTPException(400, '缺少 path')
    conn = db()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute('DELETE FROM playback_progress WHERE user_id = %s AND file_path = %s', (uid, path))
        return {'ok': True}
    finally:
        conn.close()

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/_lsblk_exclude_loop.remote.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys

# Usage: python3 lsblk_fix.py [path-to-server.js]
# Defaults to raspberrypi's layout; royhomenas needs the path passed explicitly
# (its backend lives at ~/royhomenas-nas/server.js, not ~/casaos-nas/server.js).
path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js'
with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    src = f.read()

changed = []
skipped = []
failed = []

def apply_fix(name, old, new):
    global src
    if new in src:
        skipped.append(name + ' (already patched)')
        return
    if src.count(old) != 1:
        failed.append(name + f' (anchor found {src.count(old)} times, expected 1)')
        return
    src = src.replace(old, new, 1)
    changed.append(name)

apply_fix(
    'exclude loop devices in /api/system/disks lsblk',
    "lsblk -J -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT,FSTYPE,LABEL,UUID",
    "lsblk -J -e7 -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT,FSTYPE,LABEL,UUID",
)

apply_fix(
    'exclude loop devices in mount fstype-detection lsblk',
    'lsblk -no FSTYPE "${device}"',
    'lsblk -e7 -no FSTYPE "${device}"',
)

apply_fix(
    'exclude loop devices in RAID status lsblk',
    "lsblk -J -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT,MODEL 2>/dev/null",
    "lsblk -J -e7 -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT,MODEL 2>/dev/null",
)

for c in changed:
    print(f'[lsblk-exclude-loop] patched -- {c}')
for s in skipped:
    print(f'[lsblk-exclude-loop] skipped -- {s}')
for fmsg in failed:
    print(f'[lsblk-exclude-loop] ERROR -- {fmsg}')

if failed:
    sys.exit(1)

if changed:
    with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(src)
    print(f'[lsblk-exclude-loop] {len(changed)} fix(es) applied, server.js saved')
else:
    print('[lsblk-exclude-loop] no changes were needed')

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_add_proxy.py
"""
Adds proxy routes to Pi's server.js so Express forwards
/api/todos and /api/system/disks/rename-folder to the Python sidecar on port 3001.

Run: python backend/scripts/patch_add_proxy.py | ssh roy@192.168.0.181 python3
"""
import sys

CODE = r"""
import sys

path = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js'
with open(path, 'r') as f:
    src = f.read()

MARKER = '// ── Python sidecar proxy'
FAIL2BAN_MARKER = 'app.post(\'/api/system/disks/rename-folder\''

if MARKER in src:
    if FAIL2BAN_MARKER not in src:
        print('[proxy] patched but missing fail2ban routes, appending')
        F2B_BLOCK = '''
app.get('/api/system/fail2ban',     authenticate, requireAdmin, _pyProxy)
app.get('/api/system/fail2ban/log', authenticate, requireAdmin, _pyProxy)
app.post('/api/system/fail2ban/unban', authenticate, requireAdmin, _pyProxy)

'''
        anchor = src.find('app.post(\'/api/system/disks/rename-folder\'')
        if anchor != -1:
            eol = src.find('\n', anchor)
            src = src[:eol+1] + F2B_BLOCK + src[eol+1:]
            with open(path, 'w') as f:
                f.write(src)
            print('[proxy] appended fail2ban proxy routes')
        else:
            print('[proxy] ERROR: rename-folder anchor not found')
    else:
        print('[proxy] already patched, skipping')
    sys.exit(0)

PROXY_BLOCK = '''
// ── Python sidecar proxy ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function _pyProxy(req, res) {
  const u = req.user ?? {}
  const opts = {
    hostname: '127.0.0.1', port: 3001,
    path: req.originalUrl, method: req.method,
    headers: {
      ...req.headers,
      host: '127.0.0.1:3001',
      'x-user-uid':      String(u.uid      ?? ''),
      'x-user-username': String(u.username  ?? ''),
      'x-user-role':     String(u.role      ?? ''),
    }
  }
  const pr = http.request(opts, r => {
    res.writeHead(r.statusCode, r.headers)
    r.pipe(res, { end: true })
  })
  pr.on('error', () => res.status(502).json({ error: 'Python sidecar unavailable' }))
  req.pipe(pr, { end: true })
}

app.all('/api/todos',     authenticate, _pyProxy)
app.all('/api/todos/:id', authenticate, _pyProxy)
app.post('/api/system/disks/rename-folder', authenticate, requireAdmin, _pyProxy)
app.get('/api/system/fail2ban',     authenticate, requireAdmin, _pyProxy)
app.get('/api/system/fail2ban/log', authenticate, requireAdmin, _pyProxy)
app.post('/api/system/fail2ban/unban', authenticate, requireAdmin, _pyProxy)

'''

anchor = src.rfind('server.listen')
if anchor == -1:
    anchor = src.rfind('app.listen')
if anchor == -1:
    print('[proxy] ERROR: server.listen anchor not found')
    sys.exit(1)

src = src[:anchor] + PROXY_BLOCK + src[anchor:]
with open(path, 'w') as f:
    f.write(src)
print('[proxy] inserted Python sidecar proxy routes')
"""

sys.stdout.write(CODE)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_album_backup.py
"""
Adds the two backend endpoints the Flutter "相簿備份" (album backup) feature
needs — see Flutter需求/flutter 需求.md 需求 02/05/06.

Unlike the desktop App's existing backup (whole-folder zip to a fixed path),
album backup uploads one photo/video at a time so the timeline can show
per-item progress and retry individual failures. It deliberately does NOT
add a new timeline endpoint — /api/files/timeline already exists on this Pi
(used by the web Photo app's Timeline button) and already recursively scans
FILES_DIR/{username}/ grouping by mtime, so anything landed here by the new
upload endpoint shows up there automatically once its mtime is set to the
photo/video's capture time instead of upload time.

New endpoints:
- POST /api/media/album-upload — multer single-file upload into
  FILES_DIR/{username}/backup/phone (mobile) or backup/desktop (desktop),
  Flutter always sends an explicit ?path= so the 'backup/phone' fallback
  below is only hit if a caller omits it. Skips re-copying a file that
  already exists on disk with the same name+size (defense in depth — the
  Flutter app itself tracks what it already uploaded locally).
- GET  /api/media/exif — per-file detail (aperture/lens/ISO/pixel size for
  images via the exifr npm package; duration/resolution for videos via the
  ffprobe CLI, which already ships alongside the ffmpeg this Pi uses
  elsewhere for video export/subtitles).

Run: python backend/scripts/patch_album_backup.py | ssh vaultix-pi python3
Then (installs the new exifr dependency — nothing else here needs npm install,
ffprobe ships with the ffmpeg already required by other features):
  ssh vaultix-pi "cd /home/roy/casaos-nas && npm install exifr"
  ssh vaultix-pi "node --check /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js && pm2 restart casaos-nas --update-env"
"""
import sys

CODE = r'''
import sys

server_path = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js'

with open(server_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    src = f.read()

changed = False

# ── 1. import exifr ──────────────────────────────────────────────
if "import exifr from 'exifr'" in src:
    print('[album-backup] import already patched')
else:
    OLD_IMPORT = "import nodemailer from 'nodemailer'"
    if OLD_IMPORT not in src:
        print('[album-backup] ERROR: nodemailer import anchor not found')
        sys.exit(1)
    src = src.replace(OLD_IMPORT, OLD_IMPORT + "\nimport exifr from 'exifr'", 1)
    changed = True
    print('[album-backup] import patched')

# ── 2. new endpoints, inserted right before /api/files/download ──
if "/api/media/album-upload" in src:
    print('[album-backup] endpoints already patched')
else:
    OLD_ANCHOR = "app.get('/api/files/download', authenticate, async (req, res) => {"
    if OLD_ANCHOR not in src:
        print('[album-backup] ERROR: /api/files/download anchor not found')
        sys.exit(1)

    ENDPOINTS = r"""// -- 相簿備份（Flutter App 逐檔上傳）--------------------------------
// 與桌面 App 的整包 zip 備份（見 flutter/CLAUDE.md，落在 backup/desktop）不同：
// 這裡逐張／逐支上傳到使用者自己的 FILES_DIR 底下（沿用 safePath 沙盒，預設
// backup/phone 手機來源、backup/desktop 桌面來源，App 端會明確帶 ?path=），
// 所以會自動出現在上面既有的 /api/files/timeline 裡；這裡只額外做「同名同
// 大小已存在就跳過」的去重（保險機制，App 端本來就會先在本機記錄已上傳過的項目）。
app.post('/api/media/album-upload', authenticate, upload.single('file'), async (req, res) => {
  const tempFile = req.file
  if (!tempFile) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'file required' })
  try {
    const subPath = typeof req.query.path === 'string' && req.query.path ? req.query.path : 'backup/phone'
    const dir = safePath(req.user.username, subPath)
    await fs.mkdir(dir, { recursive: true })
    const name = fixEncoding(req.body.filename || tempFile.originalname)
    const dest = path.join(dir, name)
    const relPath = path.relative(safePath(req.user.username, ''), dest).replace(/\\/g, '/')

    try {
      const existing = await fs.stat(dest)
      if (existing.isFile() && existing.size === tempFile.size) {
        await fs.unlink(tempFile.path)
        return res.json({ ok: true, duplicate: true, path: relPath })
      }
    } catch { /* not on disk yet, continue */ }

    await fs.copyFile(tempFile.path, dest)
    await fs.unlink(tempFile.path)

    // Preserve capture time (not upload time) so /api/files/timeline groups it correctly.
    const capturedAtMs = Number(req.body.capturedAt)
    if (capturedAtMs > 0) {
      const d = new Date(capturedAtMs)
      await fs.utimes(dest, d, d).catch(() => {})
    }

    res.json({ ok: true, duplicate: false, path: relPath })
  } catch (err) {
    if (tempFile) await fs.unlink(tempFile.path).catch(() => {})
    res.status(400).json({ error: err.message })
  }
})

const ALBUM_VIDEO_EXTS = new Set(['mp4','mkv','avi','mov','wmv','webm','m4v','flv','ts'])

// 詳細規格（EXIF）檢視：光圈／鏡頭／像素／檔案大小等，相簿時間軸的詳細面板用。
app.get('/api/media/exif', authenticate, async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { path: userPath } = req.query
    if (!userPath) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'path required' })
    const fullPath = safePath(req.user.username, userPath)
    const stat = await fs.stat(fullPath)
    if (!stat.isFile()) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'not a file' })

    const ext = path.extname(fullPath).slice(1).toLowerCase()
    const isVideo = ALBUM_VIDEO_EXTS.has(ext)

    const info = {
      size: stat.size,
      modified: stat.mtime.toISOString(),
      type: isVideo ? 'video' : 'image',
      width: null, height: null,
      dateTimeOriginal: null,
      aperture: null, lensModel: null, iso: null, shutterSpeed: null,
      focalLength: null, cameraModel: null,
      durationSec: null,
    }

    if (isVideo) {
      try {
        const { stdout } = await execFileAsync('ffprobe', [
          '-v', 'quiet', '-print_format', 'json', '-show_format', '-show_streams', fullPath,
        ], { timeout: 10000 })
        const probe = JSON.parse(stdout)
        const vStream = (probe.streams || []).find(s => s.codec_type === 'video')
        if (vStream) { info.width = vStream.width ?? null; info.height = vStream.height ?? null }
        const duration = Number(probe.format?.duration ?? vStream?.duration)
        if (duration > 0) info.durationSec = duration
      } catch { /* ffprobe missing or unreadable -- leave video fields null */ }
    } else {
      try {
        const tags = await exifr.parse(fullPath, { tiff: true, exif: true, gps: false })
        if (tags) {
          info.width = tags.ExifImageWidth ?? tags.ImageWidth ?? null
          info.height = tags.ExifImageHeight ?? tags.ImageHeight ?? null
          info.dateTimeOriginal = tags.DateTimeOriginal ? new Date(tags.DateTimeOriginal).toISOString() : null
          info.aperture = tags.FNumber ?? null
          info.lensModel = tags.LensModel ?? null
          info.iso = tags.ISO ?? null
          info.shutterSpeed = tags.ExposureTime ?? null
          info.focalLength = tags.FocalLength ?? null
          info.cameraModel = [tags.Make, tags.Model].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || null
        }
      } catch { /* no EXIF data / unsupported format -- leave fields null */ }
    }

    res.json(info)
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: err.message })
  }
})

"""
    src = src.replace(OLD_ANCHOR, ENDPOINTS + OLD_ANCHOR, 1)
    changed = True
    print('[album-backup] endpoints patched')

if changed:
    with open(server_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(src)
    print('[album-backup] server.js written OK')
else:
    print('[album-backup] nothing to do, already fully patched')
'''

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
sys.stdout.write(CODE)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_bootstrap_missing_tables.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
server.js -> server.py migration Phase 6a left _init_db() only bootstrapping
4 tables (todos, mounted_disks, disk_access, login_webauthn_credentials).
Node's server.js (last full snapshot before it was retired,
server.js.bak-predup-2026-07-31) used to CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS 18
tables total on startup. Node has since been fully retired (no server.js
process in pm2 anymore, only nas-python) -- server.py is now the sole
backend, but its startup hook never picked up the other 14 tables Node used
to bootstrap. The live DB on raspberrypi already has all 21 tables (Node
created them years ago before retiring), so this is not an active outage --
but a fresh deploy (new Pi, restored DB) would come up 14 tables short.

This patch adds CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for the 14 missing tables to
_init_db(), sourced from `SHOW CREATE TABLE` against the live raspberrypi
DB (not from the old Node source, which per its own inline comment at the
time -- "login_events 可能是這次改動前就已存在的舊表(沒有 lat/lon 欄位)" --
was already known to lag behind the real schema in places):

  locker_webauthn, two_factor, two_factor_apps, shares, scheduled_tasks,
  schedule_logs, collab_tasks, collab_notes, login_events, active_sessions,
  app_settings, system_alerts, fcm_tokens, vaultix_ids

Not included: `users`, `media_favorites`, `media_likes` -- these have no
CREATE TABLE in either server.js or server.py history (grep against both
came up empty), meaning they were created by a one-off manual SQL step,
not app-level bootstrap. Out of scope for this patch.

Run: python websites/backend/scripts/patch_bootstrap_missing_tables.py | ssh roy@100.109.33.81 python3
Then: ssh roy@100.109.33.81 "python3 -m py_compile /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.py && pm2 restart nas-python --update-env"
"""
import sys
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
except Exception:
    pass

CODE = r'''# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys

path = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.py'
with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    src = f.read()

changed = []
skipped = []
failed = []

def apply_fix(name, old, new):
    global src
    if new in src:
        skipped.append(name + ' (already patched)')
        return
    if src.count(old) != 1:
        failed.append(name + f' (anchor found {src.count(old)} times, expected 1)')
        return
    src = src.replace(old, new, 1)
    changed.append(name)

OLD = """            cur.execute(\"\"\"
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS login_webauthn_credentials (
                    id            INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                    user_id       INT NOT NULL,
                    credential_id VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
                    public_key    TEXT NOT NULL,
                    sign_count    BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    device_name   VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
                    created_at    DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    UNIQUE KEY uniq_login_webauthn_credential_id (credential_id),
                    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
                )
            \"\"\")
    finally:
        conn.close()"""

NEW = """            cur.execute(\"\"\"
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS login_webauthn_credentials (
                    id            INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                    user_id       INT NOT NULL,
                    credential_id VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
                    public_key    TEXT NOT NULL,
                    sign_count    BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    device_name   VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
                    created_at    DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    UNIQUE KEY uniq_login_webauthn_credential_id (credential_id),
                    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
                )
            \"\"\")
            # Phase 6a follow-up: the 14 tables below were bootstrapped by
            # Node's server.js (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS on every startup)
            # before Node was fully retired. server.py's _init_db() never
            # picked them up -- harmless on this Pi (the DB already has
            # them from Node's era) but a fresh deploy would come up short.
            # Column defs pulled from SHOW CREATE TABLE against the live DB.
            cur.execute(\"\"\"
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS locker_webauthn (
                    id            INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                    user_id       INT NOT NULL,
                    credential_id VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
                    public_key    TEXT NOT NULL,
                    counter       BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    device_name   VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
                    created_at    DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    UNIQUE KEY uniq_locker_webauthn_credential_id (credential_id),
                    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
                )
            \"\"\")
            cur.execute(\"\"\"
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS two_factor (
                    user_id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                    secret  VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                    enabled TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
                )
            \"\"\")
            cur.execute(\"\"\"
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS two_factor_apps (
                    user_id    INT NOT NULL,
                    app        VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
                    secret     VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, app),
                    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
                )
            \"\"\")
            cur.execute(\"\"\"
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shares (
                    id         INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                    token      VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                    owner_id   INT NOT NULL,
                    file_path  VARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL,
                    is_folder  TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    permission ENUM('edit','view','download') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'view',
                    password   VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
                    one_time   TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    used       TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    expires_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL,
                    UNIQUE KEY uniq_shares_token (token),
                    FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
                )
            \"\"\")
            cur.execute(\"\"\"
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scheduled_tasks (
                    id          VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
                    name        VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
                    type        ENUM('backup','update','service') NOT NULL,
                    enabled     TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                    cron_expr   VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
                    source_path VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL,

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_csrf_scan_check.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
2026-07-28 CSRF audit follow-up: adds a `check_frontend_py_csrf` scan to the
Python sidecar's Security Dashboard (server.py), matching the existing
check_cors_origin pattern. The Python/FastAPI frontend (frontend-py/app.py) is
the only part of this stack that authenticates via a cookie instead of a
Bearer header, which makes it the only place a CSRF regression could actually
matter. This check reads the deployed app.py (if present on this host — the
Python frontend has its own scp-based deploy flow, separate from casaos-nas,
so it may not exist here) and verifies three things are still in place:
  - the global middleware requiring an X-CSRF header on unsafe methods
  - the JWT cookie has SameSite=Strict
  - the JWT cookie has HttpOnly
Missing app.py -> 'info' (not alarming, just not deployed on this host).
Present but missing any of the three -> 'fail' (high severity).

No corresponding server.js change needed — this only touches the Python
sidecar (server.py); the Node backend's CSRF-relevant surface (CORS_ORIGIN)
is already covered by the existing check_cors_origin.

Both raspberrypi and royhomenas run this sidecar under different absolute
paths (/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.py vs /home/roy/royhomenas-nas/server.py),
so the generated script tries both candidates and patches whichever exists —
the same script works unmodified on either host.

Run:  python backend/scripts/patch_csrf_scan_check.py | ssh vaultix-pi python3
Then: ssh vaultix-pi "python3 -m py_compile /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.py && pm2 restart nas-python --update-env"

Or:   python backend/scripts/patch_csrf_scan_check.py | ssh royhomenas python3
Then: ssh royhomenas "python3 -m py_compile /home/roy/royhomenas-nas/server.py && /home/roy/.npm-global/bin/pm2 restart nas-python --update-env"
"""
import sys
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
except Exception:
    pass

CODE = r'''# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys, os

_candidates = ['/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.py', '/home/roy/royhomenas-nas/server.py']
path = next((p for p in _candidates if os.path.isfile(p)), None)
if not path:
    print('[csrf-scan-check] ERROR -- none of these exist on this host: ' + ', '.join(_candidates))
    sys.exit(1)

with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    src = f.read()

changed = []
skipped = []
failed = []

def apply_fix(name, old, new):
    global src
    if new in src:
        skipped.append(name + ' (already patched)')
        return
    if src.count(old) != 1:
        failed.append(name + f' (anchor found {src.count(old)} times, expected 1)')
        return
    src = src.replace(old, new, 1)
    changed.append(name)

# --- 1. check_frontend_py_csrf function, right before check_sidecar_exposure ---
OLD1 = "def check_sidecar_exposure():"
NEW1 = """def check_frontend_py_csrf():
    # The Python/FastAPI frontend (frontend-py/app.py) is the only part of this
    # stack that authenticates via a cookie instead of a Bearer header -- that
    # makes it the only place a CSRF regression could actually matter (see
    # 2026-07-28 CSRF audit). Check the deployed app.py still has the guard
    # rails: a mandatory X-CSRF header on unsafe methods, plus SameSite=Strict
    # + HttpOnly on the JWT cookie itself.
    candidates = [
        os.path.join(os.path.dirname(CASAOS_DIR), 'vaultix-nas-frontend', 'app.py'),
        os.path.join(os.path.dirname(CASAOS_DIR), 'frontend-py', 'app.py'),
        os.path.expanduser('~/vaultix-nas-frontend/app.py'),
        os.path.expanduser('~/frontend-py/app.py'),
    ]
    app_py = next((p for p in candidates if os.path.isfile(p)), None)
    if not app_py:
        return _sec_check('frontend_py_csrf', 'application', 'Python 前端 CSRF 防護', 'medium', 'info',
            '找不到 Python 前端(frontend-py)的 app.py，此主機可能尚未部署，略過檢查', '')
    try:
        with open(app_py, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            src = f.read()
    except Exception as e:
        return _sec_check('frontend_py_csrf', 'application', 'Python 前端 CSRF 防護', 'medium', 'info',
            f'讀取 {app_py} 失敗：{e}', '')

    src_lower = src.lower().replace(' ', '')
    has_csrf_header_check = 'x-csrf' in src.lower() and '_unsafe_methods' in src.lower()
    has_samesite_strict = 'samesite="strict"' in src_lower or "samesite='strict'" in src_lower
    has_httponly = 'httponly=true' in src_lower

    missing = []
    if not has_csrf_header_check:
        missing.append('缺少狀態變更請求(POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE)的 X-CSRF 標頭檢查')
    if not has_samesite_strict:
        missing.append('Cookie 未設定 SameSite=Strict')
    if not has_httponly:
        missing.append('Cookie 未設定 HttpOnly')

    if missing:
        return _sec_check('frontend_py_csrf', 'application', 'Python 前端 CSRF 防護', 'high', 'fail',
            f'{app_py}：' + '；'.join(missing),
            '恢復 security_middleware 的 X-CSRF 標頭檢查，並確認 Cookie 設定 SameSite=Strict + HttpOnly')
    return _sec_check('frontend_py_csrf', 'application', 'Python 前端 CSRF 防護', 'high', 'pass',
        f'{app_py}：X-CSRF 標頭檢查與 Cookie SameSite=Strict/HttpOnly 皆存在', '')


def check_sidecar_exposure():"""
apply_fix('check_frontend_py_csrf function', OLD1, NEW1)

# --- 2. register it in SECURITY_CHECKS ---
OLD2 = """SECURITY_CHECKS = [
    check_ufw, check_fail2ban, check_ssh_root_login, check_ssh_password_auth,
    check_pending_updates, check_npm_audit, check_2fa_adoption, check_jwt_secret,
    check_cors_origin, check_sidecar_exposure, check_env_permissions, check_temp_accounts,
]"""
NEW2 = """SECURITY_CHECKS = [
    check_ufw, check_fail2ban, check_ssh_root_login, check_ssh_password_auth,
    check_pending_updates, check_npm_audit, check_2fa_adoption, check_jwt_secret,
    check_cors_origin, check_frontend_py_csrf, check_sidecar_exposure, check_env_permissions,
    check_temp_accounts,
]"""
apply_fix('register check_frontend_py_csrf in SECURITY_CHECKS', OLD2, NEW2)

for c in changed:
    print(f'[csrf-scan-check] patched -- {c}')
for s in skipped:
    print(f'[csrf-scan-check] skipped -- {s}')
for fmsg in failed:
    print(f'[csrf-scan-check] ERROR -- {fmsg}')

if failed:
    sys.exit(1)

if changed:
    with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(src)
    print(f'[csrf-scan-check] {len(changed)} fix(es) applied, server.py saved')
else:
    print('[csrf-scan-check] no changes were needed')

sys.stdout.write(CODE)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_device_session_limit.py
"""
Device login manager: lets a user see how many devices are currently logged in
(browser/OS, IP, geo location via the existing ip-api.com lookup) and lets an
admin set a per-account max-device limit so old devices get kicked instead of
piling up unboundedly.

Builds on the login_events / describeDevice / geoLookupBatch / isPrivateIp
infra added by patch_fail2ban_geo_login_notify.py — REQUIRES that patch to be
applied first (this script aborts loudly if its anchors aren't found).

Adds:
  - `active_sessions` table: one row per currently-valid JWT (has a `jti`),
    revocable independently from the append-only `login_events` log.
  - `app_settings` key/value table, seeded with max_devices_per_user=5.
  - login_events gains lat/lon columns (GPS-ish coords from the IP geo lookup,
    previously computed but discarded).
  - authenticate() now checks payload.jti against active_sessions; tokens
    issued before this patch have no jti and skip the check (no forced logout
    on deploy). A missing/revoked session -> 401 "此裝置已被登出，請重新登入".
  - /api/login and /api/2fa/verify now mint a jti and register a session;
    recordSession() kicks the oldest session(s) once count > max devices.
  - GET/DELETE /api/sessions(+/:id) — list / revoke devices for the caller.
  - GET/PUT /api/admin/settings/max-devices — admin-only device-limit control.

Run (file-based transfer - required on Windows PowerShell 5.1, whose pipe
between python.exe and ssh.exe mangles the emoji in the anchor text):
  python backend/scripts/patch_device_session_limit.py apply_device_session.py
  scp apply_device_session.py roy@raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net:/tmp/apply_device_session.py
  ssh roy@raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net "python3 /tmp/apply_device_session.py; rm -f /tmp/apply_device_session.py"
  ssh roy@raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net "node --check /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js && pm2 restart casaos-nas --update-env"

Run (pipe - fine on Linux/macOS, or Windows terminals that pass UTF-8 through):
  python backend/scripts/patch_device_session_limit.py | ssh vaultix-pi python3
  ssh vaultix-pi "node --check /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js && pm2 restart casaos-nas --update-env"
"""
import sys

CODE = r'''
import sys

path = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js'

with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    src = f.read()

if 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS active_sessions' in src:
    print('[device-session-limit] already patched')
    sys.exit(0)

if 'async function geoLookupBatch' not in src or 'async function recordLoginEvent' not in src:
    print('[device-session-limit] ERROR: prerequisite patch_fail2ban_geo_login_notify.py not applied yet, skipped')
    sys.exit(1)

# 1) login_events gains lat/lon + new active_sessions / app_settings tables

`)"""

if OLD_TABLE not in src:
    print('[device-session-limit] ERROR: login_events table anchor not found, skipped')
