# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_lsblk_exclude_pseudo_devices.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Fixes Storage Manager showing a wall of junk devices -- reported 2026-07-22:
/dev/ram0 through /dev/ram15 (16 entries, each "4M / Unknown format / Not
mounted") flooding the disk list and burying the real disks (sda1 etc.)
among them.

Root cause: every Linux kernel creates 16 /dev/ram0-15 pseudo-devices by
default (historical initrd ramdisk support, CONFIG_BLK_DEV_RAM_COUNT=16) --
they are never real, mountable NAS storage. `/api/system/disks` and
`/api/raid/status` both call `lsblk -e7 ...`, but `-e` only accepts major
device numbers and 7 is loop's major -- ram's major (1) was never excluded,
so all 16 ramdisks (and zram/dm- devices) were always in the JSON lsblk
returned and the frontend rendered every one of them as an "External"
candidate with a "Mount to NAS" button.

The lsblk-free fallback (`listBlockDevicesFallback`, used when lsblk itself
crashes/is unavailable) already filters these out via a /sys/block regex
(`!/^(loop|ram|zram|dm-)/`) -- this patch brings the *primary* lsblk path in
line with that same policy by filtering the parsed JSON post-hoc (lsblk's
-e can't do it by name, only by major number, and zram's major isn't
stable/guaranteed across kernels).

Run:   python backend/scripts/patch_lsblk_exclude_pseudo_devices.py | ssh <host> python3
Then:  ssh <host> "node --check /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js && pm2 restart casaos-nas --update-env"

<host> is whichever of raspberrypi / royhomenas is showing the junk devices
-- run against both if both are affected.
"""
import sys
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
except Exception:
    pass

CODE = r'''# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys

path = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js'
with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    src = f.read()

changed = []
skipped = []
failed = []

def apply_fix(name, old, new):
    global src
    if new in src:
        skipped.append(name + ' (already patched)')
        return
    if src.count(old) != 1:
        failed.append(name + f' (anchor found {src.count(old)} times, expected 1)')
        return
    src = src.replace(old, new, 1)
    changed.append(name)

apply_fix(
    'add filterPseudoBlockDevices helper',
    "  throw lastErr\n"
    "}\n"
    "\n"
    "const __dirname",
    "  throw lastErr\n"
    "}\n"
    "\n"
    "// lsblk's -e (exclude) option only takes major device numbers, and covers\n"
    "// loop (7) but not ram/zram (their major numbers aren't stable/guaranteed\n"
    "// across kernels) -- so instead of excluding at the lsblk-invocation layer,\n"
    "// filter the parsed JSON by name: every Linux kernel creates 16\n"
    "// /dev/ram0-15 pseudo-devices by default (historical initrd ramdisk\n"
    "// support) that are never real NAS storage and were cluttering the\n"
    "// Storage Manager UI with 16 \"4M / Unknown format\" entries.\n"
    "function filterPseudoBlockDevices(data) {\n"
    "  if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.blockdevices)) return data\n"
    "  return { ...data, blockdevices: data.blockdevices.filter(d => !/^(loop|ram\\d*|zram\\d*|dm-\\d*)$/.test(d.name)) }\n"
    "}\n"
    "\n"
    "const __dirname",
)

apply_fix(
    'filter pseudo devices in /api/system/disks',
    "const { stdout } = await execWithRetry(\n"
    "      'timeout 5 lsblk -J -e7 -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT,FSTYPE,LABEL,UUID',\n"
    "      { timeout: 5000 }\n"
    "    )\n"
    "    res.json(JSON.parse(stdout))",
    "const { stdout } = await execWithRetry(\n"
    "      'timeout 5 lsblk -J -e7 -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT,FSTYPE,LABEL,UUID',\n"
    "      { timeout: 5000 }\n"
    "    )\n"
    "    res.json(filterPseudoBlockDevices(JSON.parse(stdout)))",
)

apply_fix(
    'filter pseudo devices in /api/raid/status',
    "const { stdout } = await execWithRetry('timeout 5 lsblk -J -e7 -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT,MODEL 2>/dev/null')\n"
    "    disks = JSON.parse(stdout).blockdevices ?? []",
    "const { stdout } = await execWithRetry('timeout 5 lsblk -J -e7 -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT,MODEL 2>/dev/null')\n"
    "    disks = filterPseudoBlockDevices(JSON.parse(stdout)).blockdevices ?? []",
)

for c in changed:
    print(f'[lsblk-exclude-pseudo] patched -- {c}')
for s in skipped:
    print(f'[lsblk-exclude-pseudo] skipped -- {s}')
for fmsg in failed:
    print(f'[lsblk-exclude-pseudo] ERROR -- {fmsg}')

if failed:
    sys.exit(1)

if changed:
    with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(src)
    print(f'[lsblk-exclude-pseudo] {len(changed)} fix(es) applied, server.js saved')

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_lsblk_retry.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Fixes "Cannot read disk info" recurring in Storage Manager, reported 2026-07-11
AGAIN even though -e7 (exclude loop devices, patch_lsblk_exclude_loop.py) was
already deployed:

  Command failed: timeout 5 lsblk -J -e7 -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT,FSTYPE,LABEL,UUID
  Assertion 'path_is_absolute(p)' failed at src/basic/chase.c:648, function chase(). Aborting.

Root cause (confirmed live on the Pi 2026-07-11): -e7 filters loop devices
OUT OF THE OUTPUT, but lsblk still walks every block device's udev record
during collection, BEFORE any -e/--exclude filter is applied -- including
Docker's constantly-created-and-destroyed loop devices (overlay2 storage
driver). If lsblk's chase() touches a loop device's udev record mid-churn
(mid-create or mid-teardown), the record is transiently malformed and
chase() hits a hard assertion + abort(), regardless of -e7. Manually
re-running the exact same command moments later succeeds every time --
confirming this is a timing race with Docker, not a permanently-corrupt
device. -e7 was necessary but not sufficient.

Fix: wrap every lsblk execAsync call in a small retry helper
(execWithRetry) that re-runs the command up to 3 times with a 250ms gap on
failure. Cheap (lsblk normally returns in well under a second) and matches
what we already know fixes it by hand.

Run:   python backend/scripts/patch_lsblk_retry.py | ssh <host> python3
Then:  ssh <host> "node --check /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js && pm2 restart casaos-nas --update-env"

<host> is whichever of raspberrypi / royhomenas is showing the error in
Storage Manager -- run against both if both are affected.
"""
import sys
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
except Exception:
    pass

CODE = r'''# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys

path = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js'
with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    src = f.read()

changed = []
skipped = []
failed = []

def apply_fix(name, old, new):
    global src
    if new in src:
        skipped.append(name + ' (already patched)')
        return
    if src.count(old) != 1:
        failed.append(name + f' (anchor found {src.count(old)} times, expected 1)')
        return
    src = src.replace(old, new, 1)
    changed.append(name)

apply_fix(
    'add execWithRetry helper',
    "const execAsync = promisify(exec)\nconst execFileAsync = promisify(execFile)\n",
    "const execAsync = promisify(exec)\n"
    "const execFileAsync = promisify(execFile)\n"
    "\n"
    "// lsblk on this Pi intermittently aborts with \"Assertion 'path_is_absolute(p)'\n"
    "// failed at chase.c\" -- a util-linux/systemd race that fires while it's still\n"
    "// walking every block device's udev record (incl. Docker's constantly\n"
    "// churning loop devices) BEFORE applying any -e/--exclude filter, so\n"
    "// excluding loop devices from the output doesn't stop the crash. It's\n"
    "// transient: retrying immediately after almost always succeeds.\n"
    "async function execWithRetry(cmd, opts = {}, attempts = 3, delayMs = 250) {\n"
    "  let lastErr\n"
    "  for (let i = 0; i < attempts; i++) {\n"
    "    try {\n"
    "      return await execAsync(cmd, opts)\n"
    "    } catch (err) {\n"
    "      lastErr = err\n"
    "      if (i < attempts - 1) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, delayMs))\n"
    "    }\n"
    "  }\n"
    "  throw lastErr\n"
    "}\n",
)

apply_fix(
    'retry lsblk in /api/system/disks',
    "const { stdout } = await execAsync(\n"
    "      'timeout 5 lsblk -J -e7 -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT,FSTYPE,LABEL,UUID',\n"
    "      { timeout: 5000 }\n"
    "    )\n"
    "    res.json(JSON.parse(stdout))",
    "const { stdout } = await execWithRetry(\n"
    "      'timeout 5 lsblk -J -e7 -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT,FSTYPE,LABEL,UUID',\n"
    "      { timeout: 5000 }\n"
    "    )\n"
    "    res.json(JSON.parse(stdout))",
)

apply_fix(
    'retry lsblk in mount fstype-detection',
    'const { stdout: fstypeOut } = await execAsync(\n'
    '      `lsblk -e7 -no FSTYPE "${device}"`, { timeout: 5000 }\n'
    '    ).catch(() => ({ stdout: \'\' }))',
    'const { stdout: fstypeOut } = await execWithRetry(\n'
    '      `lsblk -e7 -no FSTYPE "${device}"`, { timeout: 5000 }\n'
    '    ).catch(() => ({ stdout: \'\' }))',
)

apply_fix(
    'retry lsblk in RAID status',
    "const { stdout } = await execAsync('timeout 5 lsblk -J -e7 -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT,MODEL 2>/dev/null')\n"
    "    disks = JSON.parse(stdout).blockdevices ?? []",
    "const { stdout } = await execWithRetry('timeout 5 lsblk -J -e7 -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT,MODEL 2>/dev/null')\n"
    "    disks = JSON.parse(stdout).blockdevices ?? []",
)

for c in changed:
    print(f'[lsblk-retry] patched -- {c}')
for s in skipped:
    print(f'[lsblk-retry] skipped -- {s}')
for fmsg in failed:
    print(f'[lsblk-retry] ERROR -- {fmsg}')

if failed:
    sys.exit(1)

if changed:
    with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(src)
    print(f'[lsblk-retry] {len(changed)} fix(es) applied, server.js saved')
else:
    print('[lsblk-retry] no changes were needed')
'''

sys.stdout.write(CODE)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_mailserver_endpoints.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Adds the self-hosted mail server admin/provisioning endpoints to the Python
sidecar (server.py), stage 4 of the "self-hosted personal mail accounts"
feature (see setup_mailserver.py for stage 3, the actual Postfix/Dovecot
install -- no OpenDKIM, see that script's docstring for why DuckDNS rules
it out):

  - GET    /api/mail/server/status          — admin-only. postfix/dovecot/
    the DuckDNS dynamic-IP-updater timer systemctl status + mail queue depth.
  - GET    /api/mail/server/spf             — admin-only. Returns the one
    SPF TXT record name/value to publish on DuckDNS (the only DNS record
    type/slot this setup can actually use — see setup_mailserver.py).
  - POST   /api/mail/server/firewall/open   — admin-only. `sudo -n ufw allow`
    for 25/tcp + 587/tcp (idempotent — ufw itself no-ops on a duplicate rule).
  - GET    /api/mail/mailbox                — any logged-in user. Whether
    *this* user already has a local_mailboxes row provisioned.
  - POST   /api/mail/mailbox                — any logged-in user. Opt-in
    self-provisioning: creates/updates this user's own row in
    local_mailboxes (see websites/backend/data/local_mailboxes.sql), hashes
    the password with `openssl passwd -6` (Dovecot-compatible SHA512-CRYPT),
    and mkdir/chown's the Maildir via the sudoers allowlist
    setup_mailserver.py installed. This is intentionally NOT admin-only —
    it's the same permission level as adding your own external IMAP account
    in mail.py.
  - DELETE /api/mail/mailbox                — any logged-in user. Disables
    (not deletes) their own mailbox row — mirrors this project's general
    preference for reversible/soft-delete actions.

MAIL_DOMAIN is read from .env (added manually by the admin after running
setup_mailserver.py — this script does NOT write to .env itself, consistent
with this project's existing rule that secrets/config only ever go into
.env by the human, never auto-written by a script).

Depends on local_mailboxes table existing — this patch also adds its
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS to the existing _init_db() startup hook (same
place todos/login_webauthn_credentials are created), so a fresh deploy
doesn't need a separate manual schema step.

Run: python websites/backend/scripts/patch_mailserver_endpoints.py | ssh vaultix-pi python3
Then: ssh vaultix-pi "python3 -m py_compile /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.py && pm2 restart nas-python --update-env"

class MailboxSetupBody(BaseModel):
    local_part: str
    password: str


_MAIL_LOCAL_PART_RE = re.compile(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$')


def _mail_service_status(name: str) -> str:
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(['sudo', '-n', 'systemctl', 'is-active', name],
                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
        return r.stdout.strip() or 'unknown'
    except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        return 'unknown'


def _mail_queue_depth() -> Optional[int]:
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(['sudo', '-n', 'postqueue', '-p'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
        if r.returncode != 0:
            return None
        out = r.stdout.strip()
        if not out or 'Mail queue is empty' in out:
            return 0
        return len(re.findall(r'^[A-F0-9]{6,}\\*?\\s', out, re.MULTILINE))
    except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        return None


@app.get('/api/mail/server/status')
def mail_server_status(
    x_user_uid:  Optional[str] = Header(None),
    x_user_role: Optional[str] = Header(None),
):
    _require_admin(x_user_uid, x_user_role)
    return {
        'domain': MAIL_DOMAIN,
        'postfix': _mail_service_status('postfix'),
        'dovecot': _mail_service_status('dovecot'),
        # DuckDNS gives one account-wide TXT slot and no MX support, so
        # OpenDKIM was never installed (see setup_mailserver.py's docstring)
        # -- the dynamic-IP updater timer is the thing worth surfacing here
        # instead, since a drifted A record is the one thing that silently
        # breaks inbound mail with nothing else to warn about it.
        'duckdnsTimer': _mail_service_status('vaultix-duckdns.timer'),
        'queueDepth': _mail_queue_depth(),
    }


@app.get('/api/mail/server/spf')

    x_user_uid:  Optional[str] = Header(None),

):
    _require_admin(x_user_uid, x_user_role)
    if not MAIL_DOMAIN:
        raise HTTPException(400, '尚未設定 MAIL_DOMAIN（請先執行 setup_mailserver.py並在 .env 加上 MAIL_DOMAIN）')

            '會直接覆蓋掉這筆 SPF；也沒有 MX 記錄，收信端一律回退比對這個網域'
            '本身的 A 記錄。'
        ),
    }


@app.post('/api/mail/server/firewall/open')
def mail_server_open_firewall(
    x_user_uid:  Optional[str] = Header(None),
    x_user_role: Optional[str] = Header(None),
):
    _require_admin(x_user_uid, x_user_role)
    results = {}
    for port in ('25/tcp', '587/tcp'):
        try:
            r = subprocess.run(['sudo', '-n', 'ufw', 'allow', port], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
            results[port] = (r.stdout.strip() or r.stderr.strip())
        except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as e:
            results[port] = str(e)
    return {'ok': True, 'results': results}


@app.get('/api/mail/mailbox')
def mail_mailbox_get(
    x_user_uid:      Optional[str] = Header(None),
    x_user_username: Optional[str] = Header(None),
):
    _require_login(x_user_uid)
    conn = db()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                'SELECT local_part, domain, enabled, created_at FROM local_mailboxes WHERE username = %s',
                (x_user_username,),
            )
            row = cur.fetchone()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    if not row:
        return {'provisioned': False, 'domain': MAIL_DOMAIN}
    return {
        'provisioned': True,
        'localPart': row['local_part'],
        'domain': row['domain'],
        'enabled': bool(row['enabled']),
        'address': f"{row['local_part']}@{row['domain']}",
    }


@app.post('/api/mail/mailbox')
def mail_mailbox_create(
    body:            MailboxSetupBody,
    x_user_uid:      Optional[str] = Header(None),
    x_user_username: Optional[str] = Header(None),
):
    _require_login(x_user_uid)
    if not MAIL_DOMAIN:
        raise HTTPException(400, '尚未設定 MAIL_DOMAIN，請先請管理員完成郵件伺服器安裝')
    local_part = (body.local_part or '').strip().lower()
    if not _MAIL_LOCAL_PART_RE.match(local_part):
        raise HTTPException(400, '帳號名稱只能包含英數字、點、底線、連字號（1-64 字元）')
    if not body.password or len(body.password) < 8:
        raise HTTPException(400, '密碼至少需要 8 個字元')

    try:
        r = subprocess.run(['openssl', 'passwd', '-6', body.password], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
        if r.returncode != 0 or not r.stdout.strip():
            raise HTTPException(500, '密碼雜湊產生失敗')
        password_hash = '{SHA512-CRYPT}' + r.stdout.strip()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        raise HTTPException(500, '找不到 openssl，無法產生密碼雜湊')

    conn = db()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute('SELECT id, local_part FROM local_mailboxes WHERE username = %s', (x_user_username,))
            existing = cur.fetchone()
            if existing and existing['local_part'] != local_part:
                raise HTTPException(409, f"已使用 {existing['local_part']}@{MAIL_DOMAIN}，如需改名請先聯絡管理員刪除舊信箱")
            if not existing:
                cur.execute('SELECT id FROM local_mailboxes WHERE local_part = %s AND domain = %s', (local_part, MAIL_DOMAIN))
                if cur.fetchone():
                    raise HTTPException(409, '這個信箱名稱已經被使用')
            if existing:
                cur.execute(
                    'UPDATE local_mailboxes SET password_hash = %s, enabled = 1 WHERE username = %s',
                    (password_hash, x_user_username),
                )
            else:
                cur.execute(
                    'INSERT INTO local_mailboxes (username, local_part, domain, password_hash) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s)',
                    (x_user_username, local_part, MAIL_DOMAIN, password_hash),
                )
    finally:
        conn.close()

    try:
        subprocess.run(['sudo', '-n', 'mkdir', '-p', f'/var/mail/vhosts/{MAIL_DOMAIN}/{local_part}'],
                        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
        subprocess.run(['sudo', '-n', 'chown', '-R', 'vmail:vmail', f'/var/mail/vhosts/{MAIL_DOMAIN}'],
                        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        pass

    return {'ok': True, 'address': f'{local_part}@{MAIL_DOMAIN}'}


@app.delete('/api/mail/mailbox')
def mail_mailbox_disable(
    x_user_uid:      Optional[str] = Header(None),
    x_user_username: Optional[str] = Header(None),
):
    _require_login(x_user_uid)
    conn = db()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute('UPDATE local_mailboxes SET enabled = 0 WHERE username = %s', (x_user_username,))
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return {'ok': True}

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_mobile_cors_private_network_and_ip_dedupe.py
"""
Two independent fixes to /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.py (FastAPI, pm2 process
nas-python — the sole backend since server.js retired 2026-08-01, phase 6f).

1) Mobile "Failed to fetch" on login while desktop works fine, both over
   Tailscale. Root cause (confirmed live via curl preflight against
   https://raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net/api/login):

   Mobile Chrome sends `Access-Control-Request-Private-Network: true` on the
   CORS preflight for requests to Tailscale's address space (the CGNAT-range
   internal address Tailscale/`serve` use); desktop Chrome, on this setup,
   currently does not send that header for the same target. Starlette's
   `CORSMiddleware` defaults `allow_private_network=False`, so any preflight
   carrying that header gets a flat `400 Disallowed CORS private-network` —
   which is exactly what the phone's browser saw as "Failed to fetch". Desktop
   never triggers the check, so it looked fine there.

   There was already a `_SecurityHeadersMiddleware` (registered before CORS)
   that sets `Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network: true` when it sees that
   request header — but it's structurally dead for this exact case: Starlette
   wraps middleware so the LAST one registered is OUTERMOST
   (`app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, ...)` is deliberately registered last,
   per the comment already in server.py, so rate-limit 429s still get proper
   CORS headers). Because CORSMiddleware is outermost, it intercepts and
   answers OPTIONS preflight requests itself and never calls into the wrapped
   inner app — so `_SecurityHeadersMiddleware.dispatch()` never runs for
   preflight requests, and its PNA header never has a chance to apply. Fix:
   set `allow_private_network=True` directly on the CORSMiddleware call
   itself, since that's the middleware that actually answers preflights.

2) "Same-IP devices should count as one login, not pile up as multiple
   devices" — `record_session()` previously INSERTed a brand new
   `active_sessions` row on every login (every jti), so a device that simply
   logs back in after its token expires (or after being kicked once the
   device cap is hit) burns another slot under the per-account device limit
   even though it's the same machine on the same IP. Fix: before inserting,
   look for an existing `active_sessions` row for (user_id, ip); if found,
   UPDATE it in place (new jti/device/geo/last_seen_at) instead of inserting
   a new row. This naturally invalidates that IP's previous token (its old
   jti no longer has a row, so `authenticate()`'s active_sessions lookup
   404s it next time it calls the API) — which is correct: it's the same
   device re-authenticating, not a new one.

   IP is read the same way at all three token-issuing call sites
   (`xff.split(',')[0].strip() or request.client.host`), so the dedupe key
   is consistent across /api/login, /api/2fa/verify, and the WebAuthn
   passwordless path.

Applied directly 2026-08-15 via SSH against the live Pi (backup left at
server.py.bak-mobile-cors-ip-dedupe-2026-08-15, py_compile passed, pm2
restart nas-python clean, both fixes verified live: preflight with
Access-Control-Request-Private-Network now returns 200 + the allow header;
/api/login still responds normally). This script is the anchor-based,
idempotent record of that change for future re-application (e.g. after a
server.py restore from an older backup) — running it again on an
already-patched file is a no-op.

Run:
  python backend/scripts/patch_mobile_cors_private_network_and_ip_dedupe.py | ssh roy@raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net python3
  ssh roy@raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net "cd /home/roy/casaos-nas && python3 -m py_compile server.py && pm2 restart nas-python --update-env"
"""
import sys

CODE = r'''
import shutil, datetime, sys

path = "/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.py"

with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    src = f.read()

if "allow_private_network=True" in src and "同一 IP 視為同一裝置" in src:
    print("[mobile-cors-ip-dedupe] already patched")
    sys.exit(0)

cors_old = """app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=_ORIGINS,
    allow_methods=[\'GET\', \'POST\', \'PUT\', \'DELETE\', \'PATCH\', \'OPTIONS\', \'HEAD\',
                   \'PROPFIND\', \'MKCOL\', \'MOVE\', \'COPY\', \'LOCK\', \'UNLOCK\'],
    allow_headers=[\'Authorization\', \'Content-Type\', \'Depth\', \'Destination\', \'Overwrite\', \'Lock-Token\', \'Timeout\', \'If\'],
)"""

cors_new = """app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=_ORIGINS,
    allow_methods=[\'GET\', \'POST\', \'PUT\', \'DELETE\', \'PATCH\', \'OPTIONS\', \'HEAD\',
                   \'PROPFIND\', \'MKCOL\', \'MOVE\', \'COPY\', \'LOCK\', \'UNLOCK\'],
    allow_headers=[\'Authorization\', \'Content-Type\', \'Depth\', \'Destination\', \'Overwrite\', \'Lock-Token\', \'Timeout\', \'If\'],
    # 手機版 Chrome 對 Tailscale 網段（CGNAT 100.64.0.0/10 / serve 的內部位址）在
    # preflight 會多送 Access-Control-Request-Private-Network，Starlette 預設
    # allow_private_network=False 會直接回 400「Disallowed CORS private-network」
    # 讓瀏覽器 fetch() 直接失敗；桌面版 Chrome 目前不會送這個 header，所以只有
    # 手機出現「failed to fetch」。放行後兩邊行為一致（2026-08-15）。
    allow_private_network=True,
)"""

if cors_old not in src:
    print("[mobile-cors-ip-dedupe] ERROR: CORS anchor not found, skipped")
    sys.exit(1)
if src.count(cors_old) != 1:
    print(f"[mobile-cors-ip-dedupe] ERROR: CORS anchor matched {src.count(cors_old)} times, expected 1")
    sys.exit(1)

rs_old = """def record_session(user_id: int, jti: str, device: str, ip: str, geo: dict) -> None:
    conn = db()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                \'\'\'INSERT INTO active_sessions (user_id, jti, device, ip, country, country_code, city, lat, lon)
                   VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)\'\'\',
                (user_id, jti, device, ip or None, geo.get(\'country\'), geo.get(\'countryCode\'),
                 geo.get(\'city\'), geo.get(\'lat\'), geo.get(\'lon\'))
            )
            max_devices = _get_max_devices(cur)
            cur.execute(\'SELECT id FROM active_sessions WHERE user_id = %s ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC\', (user_id,))
            rows = cur.fetchall()
            if len(rows) > max_devices:
                to_kick = [r[\'id\'] for r in rows[max_devices:]]
                placeholders = \',\'.join([\'%s\'] * len(to_kick))
                cur.execute(f\'DELETE FROM active_sessions WHERE id IN ({placeholders})\', tuple(to_kick))
    finally:
        conn.close()"""

rs_new = """def record_session(user_id: int, jti: str, device: str, ip: str, geo: dict) -> None:
    conn = db()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            # 同一 IP 視為同一裝置：同帳號底下若已有這個 IP 的現有 session 就直接更新
            # （換發新 jti，該裝置上一個 token 自然失效改用新 token），避免同一裝置每次
            # 重新登入都新增一筆 active_sessions，把裝置上限洗滿卻其實都是同一台機器
            # （2026-08-15，依需求：同 IP 登入不算多台裝置，減少裝置登入量）。
            existing_id = None
            if ip:
                cur.execute(
                    \'SELECT id FROM active_sessions WHERE user_id = %s AND ip = %s LIMIT 1\',
                    (user_id, ip)
                )
                row = cur.fetchone()
                existing_id = row[\'id\'] if row else None
            if existing_id:
                cur.execute(
                    \'\'\'UPDATE active_sessions
                       SET jti = %s, device = %s, country = %s, country_code = %s, city = %s,
                           lat = %s, lon = %s, last_seen_at = NOW()
                       WHERE id = %s\'\'\',
                    (jti, device, geo.get(\'country\'), geo.get(\'countryCode\'), geo.get(\'city\'),
                     geo.get(\'lat\'), geo.get(\'lon\'), existing_id)
                )
            else:
                cur.execute(
                    \'\'\'INSERT INTO active_sessions (user_id, jti, device, ip, country, country_code, city, lat, lon)
                       VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)\'\'\',
                    (user_id, jti, device, ip or None, geo.get(\'country\'), geo.get(\'countryCode\'),
                     geo.get(\'city\'), geo.get(\'lat\'), geo.get(\'lon\'))
                )
            max_devices = _get_max_devices(cur)
            cur.execute(\'SELECT id FROM active_sessions WHERE user_id = %s ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC\', (user_id,))
            rows = cur.fetchall()
            if len(rows) > max_devices:
                to_kick = [r[\'id\'] for r in rows[max_devices:]]
                placeholders = \',\'.join([\'%s\'] * len(to_kick))
                cur.execute(f\'DELETE FROM active_sessions WHERE id IN ({placeholders})\', tuple(to_kick))
    finally:
        conn.close()"""

if rs_old not in src:
    print("[mobile-cors-ip-dedupe] ERROR: record_session anchor not found, skipped")
    sys.exit(1)
if src.count(rs_old) != 1:
    print(f"[mobile-cors-ip-dedupe] ERROR: record_session anchor matched {src.count(rs_old)} times, expected 1")
    sys.exit(1)

new_src = src.replace(cors_old, cors_new, 1).replace(rs_old, rs_new, 1)

backup = f"/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.py.bak-mobile-cors-ip-dedupe-{datetime.date.today().isoformat()}"
shutil.copy2(path, backup)
with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(new_src)

print("[mobile-cors-ip-dedupe] server.py patched OK - allow_private_network=True on CORSMiddleware, record_session() dedupes by (user_id, ip). backup:", backup)
'''

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_mobile_totp_decrypt_fix.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
修正 mobile_totp_secret()（/api/locker(reels/telegram)/mobile-signal 用）與
locker_unlock()（/api/locker/unlock 用）兩處驗證 TOTP 時忘記先解密的 bug。

根因：某次更新把 two_factor / two_factor_apps 的 secret 欄位改成 AES-256-GCM
加密存放（'gcm1:' + base64(nonce+ct)），但這兩處還是直接把密文丟給
totp_verify()（底層 pyotp.TOTP().verify() 會 base64.b32decode() 這個字串），
導致 base64.b32decode 對密文直接丟出 KeyError/binascii.Error，是完全沒被
攔截的例外 -> FastAPI 回傳非 JSON 格式的 HTTP 500。已在 Pi 上用
journalctl -u casaos-nas.service 撈到 2026-08-27 20:18:37 的真實 traceback
（POST /api/reels/mobile-signal 500，KeyError: 49 in base64._b32decode）
確認就是這個成因，對應 Flutter 端顯示的「伺服器回應格式錯誤 (HTTP 500)」。

decrypt_totp_secret() 本身對沒有 'gcm1:' 前綴的舊明文密鑰會原樣回傳，
向下相容，補上呼叫不影響任何尚未走過加密流程的既有帳號。

Run: python websites/backend/scripts/patch_mobile_totp_decrypt_fix.py | ssh vaultix-pi python3
Then: ssh vaultix-pi "python3 -m py_compile /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.py && sudo systemctl restart casaos-nas.service"
"""
import sys
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
except Exception:
    pass

CODE = r'''# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys
py_path = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.py'
with open(py_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    src = f.read()

MARK = '# [mobile-totp-decrypt-fix] applied'
if MARK in src:
    print('[mobile-totp-decrypt-fix] server.py: already patched')
    sys.exit(0)

OLD1 = """def mobile_totp_secret(user_id: int, app_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
    conn = db()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute('SELECT secret FROM two_factor_apps WHERE user_id = %s AND app = %s', (user_id, app_name))
            row = cur.fetchone()
            if row:
                return row['secret']
            cur.execute('SELECT secret FROM two_factor WHERE user_id = %s AND enabled = 1', (user_id,))
            row2 = cur.fetchone()
            return row2['secret'] if row2 else None
    finally:
        conn.close()"""

NEW1 = """def mobile_totp_secret(user_id: int, app_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
    # [mobile-totp-decrypt-fix] applied -- secret 欄位是 AES-256-GCM 密文，
    # 一定要先 decrypt_totp_secret() 才能交給 totp_verify()/pyotp，
    # 否則 base64.b32decode 密文會丟出未攔截例外 -> FastAPI 回傳非 JSON 的 500。
    conn = db()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute('SELECT secret FROM two_factor_apps WHERE user_id = %s AND app = %s', (user_id, app_name))
            row = cur.fetchone()
            if row:
                return decrypt_totp_secret(row['secret'])
            cur.execute('SELECT secret FROM two_factor WHERE user_id = %s AND enabled = 1', (user_id,))
            row2 = cur.fetchone()
            return decrypt_totp_secret(row2['secret']) if row2 else None
    finally:
        conn.close()"""

if src.count(OLD1) != 1:
    print('[mobile-totp-decrypt-fix] ERROR: mobile_totp_secret anchor not found or not unique')
    sys.exit(1)
src = src.replace(OLD1, NEW1)

OLD2 = """    if not totp_verify(clean, row['secret']):
        raise HTTPException(401, '驗證碼錯誤或已過期，請確認手機時間正確')"""
NEW2 = """    if not totp_verify(clean, decrypt_totp_secret(row['secret'])):
        raise HTTPException(401, '驗證碼錯誤或已過期，請確認手機時間正確')"""

if src.count(OLD2) != 1:
    print('[mobile-totp-decrypt-fix] ERROR: locker_unlock anchor not found or not unique')
    sys.exit(1)
src = src.replace(OLD2, NEW2)

import shutil as _sh
_sh.copyfile(py_path, py_path + '.bak_mobile_totp_decrypt_fix')
with open(py_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(src)
print('[mobile-totp-decrypt-fix] server.py: patched (backup at server.py.bak_mobile_totp_decrypt_fix)')
'''

sys.stdout.write(CODE)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_notifications_delete.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Adds delete endpoints for the two notification lists so they don't just grow
forever with no way to clear them out (login_events / system_alerts already
had GET + /ack, but no DELETE):

  DELETE /api/notifications/logins  (authenticate)              -- own rows
  DELETE /api/notifications/system  (authenticate + requireAdmin) -- all rows

Both accept an optional JSON body { ids: [...] } to delete specific rows;
with no body (or empty ids) they clear everything for that scope, matching
the existing /ack endpoints' "no ids = act on all" convention.

Run: python backend/scripts/patch_notifications_delete.py | ssh vaultix-pi python3
Then: ssh vaultix-pi "node --check /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js && pm2 restart casaos-nas --update-env"
"""
import sys
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
except Exception:
    pass

CODE = r'''# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys

js_path = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js'
try:

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_office_share_webdav.py
"""
Adds anonymous per-share WebDAV access so a shared Word/Excel/PowerPoint
document (share permission = "edit") can be opened directly in desktop
Office via ms-word:ofe|u|<url> — not just browsed/downloaded from the
Office Cowork share page.

Auth model (webdav.js, createShareWebDAVRouter):
  - share has no password -> fully anonymous, no challenge
  - share has a password  -> Basic auth challenge, any username, password
                             must match the share's password
One-time shares are consumed on WebDAV UNLOCK (session end), not on first
request or on the share-page password check — otherwise loading the page
would burn the link before the recipient ever opened the document.

Run:
  python backend/scripts/patch_office_share_webdav.py | ssh vaultix-pi python3
  ssh vaultix-pi "node --check /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js && node --check /home/roy/casaos-nas/webdav.js && pm2 restart casaos-nas --update-env"
"""
import sys

CODE = r"""
import sys

webdav_path = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/webdav.js'
server_path = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js'

with open(webdav_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    src = f.read()

if 'createShareWebDAVRouter' in src:
    print('[office-share] webdav.js already patched')
else:
    ANCHOR = '''      res.status(405).end()
    } catch (err) {
      if (!res.headersSent) res.status(500).send(err.message)
    }
  })

  return router
}'''
    if ANCHOR not in src:
        print('[office-share] ERROR: router-end anchor not found in webdav.js')
        sys.exit(1)

    ADDITION = ANCHOR + '''

// Anonymous WebDAV bridge for a single shared file, keyed by share token
// instead of a NAS account -- this is what lets Microsoft Word open a shared
// document directly (ms-word:ofe|u|<url>) without the recipient having a
// login. Auth model:
//   - share has no password  -> no challenge at all, fully anonymous
//   - share has a password   -> Basic auth challenge; any username, password
//                                must match the share's password
// One-time shares are consumed when the editing session ends (WebDAV UNLOCK),
// not on first request, so PROPFIND/GET/LOCK/PUT calls during one open Word
// session all keep working -- otherwise the very first capability probe would
// burn the link before the user ever saw the document.
export function createShareWebDAVRouter(pool, bcrypt, FILES_DIR) {
  const router = Router()
  const oneTimeSessions = new Set() // tokens with an in-flight (locked) session

  async function getShare(token) {
    const [rows] = await pool.query(
      'SELECT s.*, u.username FROM shares s JOIN users u ON s.owner_id = u.id WHERE s.token = ?',
      [token]
    )
    return rows[0] ?? null
  }

  function shareValid(s) {
    if (!s) return false
    if (s.one_time && s.used) return false
    if (s.expires_at && new Date(s.expires_at) < new Date()) return false
    return true
  }

  router.use(async (req, res) => {
    const token = req.params.token
    res.setHeader('DAV', '1, 2')
    res.setHeader('MS-Author-Via', 'DAV')
    const method = req.method.toUpperCase()

    if (method === 'OPTIONS') {
      res.setHeader('Allow', 'OPTIONS,GET,HEAD,PUT,PROPFIND,LOCK,UNLOCK')
      return res.status(200).end()
    }

    const s = await getShare(token)
    if (!s || s.is_folder || s.permission !== 'edit') return res.status(404).end()
    if (!shareValid(s)) return res.status(410).end()

    if (s.password) {
      const auth = req.headers.authorization
      if (!auth?.startsWith('Basic ')) {
        res.setHeader('WWW-Authenticate', 'Basic realm="Vaultix Share"')
        return res.status(401).end()
      }
      const decoded = Buffer.from(auth.slice(6), 'base64').toString()
      const pwd = decoded.slice(decoded.indexOf(':') + 1)
      if (!(await bcrypt.compare(pwd, s.password))) {
        res.setHeader('WWW-Authenticate', 'Basic realm="Vaultix Share"')
        return res.status(401).end()
      }
    }

    const filePath = path.resolve(FILES_DIR, s.username, s.file_path)

    try {
      if (method === 'PROPFIND') {
        let stat
        try { stat = await fs.stat(filePath) } catch { return res.status(404).end() }
        const items = [{ href: req.baseUrl, isDir: false, size: stat.size, mtime: stat.mtime, name: path.basename(filePath) }]
        res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/xml; charset=utf-8')
        return res.status(207).send(propfindXml(items))
      }

      if (method === 'GET' || method === 'HEAD') {
        let stat
        try { stat = await fs.stat(filePath) } catch { return res.status(404).end() }
        res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime(filePath))
        res.setHeader('Content-Length', stat.size)
        res.setHeader('Last-Modified', stat.mtime.toUTCString())
        if (method === 'HEAD') return res.status(200).end()
        return createReadStream(filePath).pipe(res)
      }

      if (method === 'PUT') {
        await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(filePath), { recursive: true })
        const writer = createWriteStream(filePath)
        req.pipe(writer)
        return new Promise(resolve => {
          writer.on('finish', () => { res.status(201).end(); resolve() })
          writer.on('error', err => { if (!res.headersSent) res.status(500).send(err.message); resolve() })
        })
      }

      // LOCK/UNLOCK share the same in-memory `locks` map as the authenticated
      // router above, keyed by absolute file path -- if the owner also has the
      // file open via their own NAS login, both paths see a consistent lock.
      if (method === 'LOCK') {
        if (s.one_time) oneTimeSessions.add(token)
        const existing = locks.get(filePath)
        const lockToken = existing && existing.expires > Date.now() ? existing.token : `urn:uuid:${randomUUID()}`
        locks.set(filePath, { token: lockToken, expires: Date.now() + LOCK_TIMEOUT_SEC * 1000 })
        res.setHeader('Lock-Token', `<${lockToken}>`)
        res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/xml; charset=utf-8')
        return res.status(200).send(lockXml(lockToken, LOCK_TIMEOUT_SEC))
      }

      if (method === 'UNLOCK') {
        const lockToken = (req.headers['lock-token'] || '').replace(/[<>]/g, '')
        const existing = locks.get(filePath)
        if (existing && existing.token === lockToken) locks.delete(filePath)
        if (s.one_time && oneTimeSessions.has(token)) {
          oneTimeSessions.delete(token)
          await pool.query('UPDATE shares SET used=1 WHERE token=?', [token])
        }
        return res.status(204).end()
      }

      res.status(405).end()
    } catch (err) {
      if (!res.headersSent) res.status(500).send(err.message)
    }
  })

  return router
}'''
    src = src.replace(ANCHOR, ADDITION, 1)
    with open(webdav_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(src)
    print('[office-share] webdav.js patched OK -- createShareWebDAVRouter added')

with open(server_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    ssrc = f.read()

if 'createShareWebDAVRouter' in ssrc:
    print('[office-share] server.js already patched')
else:
    # 1. import
    OLD_IMPORT = "import { createWebDAVRouter } from './webdav.js'"
    if OLD_IMPORT not in ssrc:
        print('[office-share] ERROR: webdav import anchor not found in server.js')
        sys.exit(1)
    ssrc = ssrc.replace(OLD_IMPORT, "import { createWebDAVRouter, createShareWebDAVRouter } from './webdav.js'", 1)

    # 2. mount, right after the authenticated /webdav mount (before cors(), same reasoning)
    OLD_MOUNT = "app.use('/webdav', createWebDAVRouter(pool, bcrypt, FILES_DIR))"
    if OLD_MOUNT not in ssrc:
        print('[office-share] ERROR: webdav mount anchor not found in server.js')
        sys.exit(1)
    NEW_MOUNT = OLD_MOUNT + '''
// Anonymous per-share WebDAV bridge (Office Cowork "open in Word/Excel/PowerPoint"
// for shared, edit-permission office documents) -- same pre-cors() mount reasoning.
app.use('/webdav-share/:token', createShareWebDAVRouter(pool, bcrypt, FILES_DIR))'''
    ssrc = ssrc.replace(OLD_MOUNT, NEW_MOUNT, 1)

    # 3. shareValid() -> add officeScheme/isOfficeEditShare helpers right after
    OLD_SHAREVALID = '''function shareValid(s) {
  if (!s) return false
  if (s.one_time && s.used) return false
  if (s.expires_at && new Date(s.expires_at) < new Date()) return false
  return true
}'''
    if OLD_SHAREVALID not in ssrc:
        print('[office-share] ERROR: shareValid() anchor not found in server.js')
        sys.exit(1)
    NEW_SHAREVALID = OLD_SHAREVALID + '''

// Office docs shared with edit permission can be opened live in desktop
// Word/Excel/PowerPoint via the anonymous /webdav-share/:token bridge, instead
// of only browser download/upload.
function officeScheme(filePath) {
  const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase()
  if (ext === '.doc' || ext === '.docx') return 'ms-word'
  if (ext === '.xls' || ext === '.xlsx') return 'ms-excel'
  if (ext === '.ppt' || ext === '.pptx') return 'ms-powerpoint'
  return null
}
function isOfficeEditShare(s) {
  return !s.is_folder && s.permission === 'edit' && !!officeScheme(s.file_path)
}'''
    ssrc = ssrc.replace(OLD_SHAREVALID, NEW_SHAREVALID, 1)

    # 4. GET /api/share/:token -- add isOfficeEdit/officeScheme to the response
    OLD_INFO = '''  res.json({
    token: s.token,
    fileName: path.basename(s.file_path),
    isFolder: !!s.is_folder,
    permission: s.permission,
    hasPassword: !!s.password,
    oneTime: !!s.one_time,
  })
})'''
    if OLD_INFO not in ssrc:
        print('[office-share] ERROR: /api/share/:token response anchor not found in server.js')
        sys.exit(1)
    NEW_INFO = '''  res.json({
    token: s.token,

    ssrc = ssrc.replace(OLD_INFO, NEW_INFO, 1)

    OLD_VERIFY = '''  if (s.one_time) await pool.query('UPDATE shares SET used=1 WHERE token=?', [s.token])'''

        sys.exit(1)
    NEW_VERIFY = '''  // Office edit-shares are consumed when the Word/Excel/PowerPoint session ends

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_passwordless_webauthn_login.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Adds passwordless first-factor Windows Hello sign-in: two new routes,
/api/auth/webauthn/login-options and /api/auth/webauthn/login-verify, that
let the login page show a "Sign in with Windows Hello" button ABOVE the
username/password fields, usable before typing anything.

This is deliberately a separate pair of routes from the existing
/api/2fa/webauthn/login-options and /login-verify (added 2026-08-06,
patch_windows_hello_login_2fa.py) -- those require a tempToken minted by
/api/login after a successful password check (second factor). The new
routes need no tempToken and no username: generate_authentication_options()
is called with an EMPTY allow_credentials list, which tells the platform
authenticator (Windows Hello) to show its own picker over whichever
discoverable/resident credentials it already holds for this site, and the
server resolves which account it belongs to purely from credential_id
(UNIQUE across login_webauthn_credentials, no need to know the user first).

Known limitation: existing devices registered before this patch were
created with resident_key=PREFERRED (not REQUIRED), so a platform
authenticator that chose not to make the credential discoverable won't
show up in this passwordless flow -- those users keep working exactly as
before via password + (optional) 2FA. Nothing about the existing
/api/2fa/webauthn/* 2FA routes changes.

Anchored on the literal body of login_webauthn_login_verify() as it was
actually deployed to the Pi by patch_windows_hello_login_2fa.py on
2026-08-06 (Index/success/2026-08-06-windows-hello-login-2fa-deploy.md) --
NOT on the local server.py mirror, which has since diverged (different
function/class names, no "Login" prefix) and does not reflect what is
really running on the Pi. Reuses the existing _pop_login_webauthn_challenge/
_store_login_webauthn_challenge/_webauthn_rp_id/_webauthn_origin/
_issue_login_success helpers that route already depends on.

Run: python websites/backend/scripts/patch_passwordless_webauthn_login.py | ssh vaultix-pi python3
Then: ssh vaultix-pi "cd /home/roy/casaos-nas && python3 -m py_compile server.py && pm2 restart nas-python --update-env"
"""
import sys
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
except Exception:
    pass

CODE = r'''# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

# ── 無密碼登入（登入頁最前面的 Windows Hello 按鈕，不需要先輸入帳號密碼） ──
# 跟上面的 2FA 流程平行、獨立：這裡完全不經過 /api/login 或 tempToken，
# generate_authentication_options 用空的 allow_credentials，讓平台驗證器（Windows
# Hello）自己列出它擁有的可探索/常駐金鑰（resident key）供使用者挑選；

class WebAuthnPasswordlessOptionsBody(BaseModel):

    flowId: str
    response: dict

                    credential_current_sign_count=cred['sign_count'],
                )
            except Exception:
                raise HTTPException(401, 'Windows Hello 驗證失敗')
            cur.execute(

            )
            cur.execute('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = %s', (cred['user_id'],))
            user = cur.fetchone()
    finally:
        conn.close()

    if not user or user.get('disabled'):
        raise HTTPException(403, '此帳號已被停用，請聯繫管理員')

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_player_progress.py
"""
Wires the new playback-progress module (player.py) into the real Pi
server.py: imports the router, mounts it, and adds the table-creation call
to the existing _init_db() startup routine.

IMPORTANT — this repo's local websites/backend/server.py mirror (~2575
lines) is known to be far behind the real deployed file on the Pi (~8255+
lines as of 2026-08-05, see Index/success/2026-08-06-windows-hello-login-2fa-deploy.md).
Anchors below are deliberately loose/regex-based and independently
verified against the real file structure (not just the stale local mirror)
before you run this — see the two-step deploy below.

Deploy (two steps — player.py is a brand-new file, so it's copied whole;
only the small integration edit goes through the patch pipe):

    scp websites/backend/player.py vaultix-pi:/home/roy/casaos-nas/player.py
    python websites/backend/scripts/patch_player_progress.py | ssh vaultix-pi python3
    ssh vaultix-pi "cd /home/roy/casaos-nas && python3 -m py_compile server.py player.py && pm2 restart nas-python --update-env"

As with every other patch in this project: before trusting this against the
live file, pull the real server.py back to a scratch copy, run the patch on
that copy, diff it, and confirm py_compile passes — don't apply blind.
"""
import sys

# NOTE: this payload is kept pure-ASCII on purpose. Non-ASCII text (Chinese
# comments, em-dash box-drawing separators) in a CODE string that gets piped
# through `python x.py | ssh host python3` has corrupted mid-transit before
# in this project (see Index/success/*reenable-login-2fa* and the 07-10
# postmortem in websites/CLAUDE.md) -- ASCII-only avoids that class of bug
# entirely. player.py itself (deployed via scp, a binary-safe copy) keeps
# its normal Chinese error messages; only this generated-and-piped script
# needs the restriction.
CODE = r"""
import re
import sys

path = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.py'
with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    src = f.read()

if 'from player import router as player_router' in src and 'ensure_player_progress_table(cur)' in src:
    print('[player] already patched, skipping')
    sys.exit(0)

changed = False

# 1) import + include_router, anchored on `app = FastAPI()`
APP_ANCHOR = 'app = FastAPI()'
if 'from player import router as player_router' not in src:
    idx = src.find(APP_ANCHOR)
    if idx == -1:
        print('[player] ERROR: app = FastAPI() anchor not found')
        sys.exit(1)
    eol = src.find('\n', idx)
    BLOCK = (
        '\n'
        '# Playback progress (resume) core logic lives in player.py, shared by both players.\n'
        'from player import router as player_router, ensure_table as ensure_player_progress_table\n'
        'app.include_router(player_router)'
    )
    src = src[:eol] + BLOCK + src[eol:]
    changed = True
    print('[player] inserted import + include_router after app = FastAPI()')
else:
    print('[player] import/include_router already present')

# 2) ensure_table(cur) call inside _init_db()'s startup routine. Must land
#    INSIDE the `with conn.cursor() as cur:` block (same indent as the
#    existing cur.execute(...) calls) -- landing at finally:'s indent would
#    put it after the cursor's context manager already closed it.
if 'ensure_player_progress_table(cur)' not in src:
    m = re.search(r'def\s+_init_db\s*\(', src)
    if not m:
        print('[player] ERROR: def _init_db( not found')
        sys.exit(1)
    window_start = m.start()
    window = src[window_start:window_start + 20000]
    exec_m = re.search(r'\n( +)cur\.execute\(', window)
    if not exec_m:
        print('[player] ERROR: no cur.execute( call found to copy indentation from')
        sys.exit(1)
    body_indent = exec_m.group(1)
    fin = re.search(r'\n( *)finally:\s*\n\s*conn\.close\(\)', window)
    if not fin or 'CREATE TABLE' not in window[:fin.start()]:
        print('[player] ERROR: could not locate the finally: conn.close() end of _init_db()s cursor block')
        sys.exit(1)
    insert_at = window_start + fin.start()
    src = src[:insert_at] + '\n' + body_indent + 'ensure_player_progress_table(cur)' + src[insert_at:]
    changed = True
    print('[player] inserted ensure_player_progress_table(cur) call into _init_db()')
else:
    print('[player] ensure_player_progress_table(cur) call already present')

if changed:
    with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(src)
    print('[player] wrote changes to', path)
else:
    print('[player] nothing to do')
"""

sys.stdout.write(CODE)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_pm2_absolute_path.py
"""
Fixes `pm2 jlist` returning an empty list (0/0) from both /api/system/services
and /api/apps.

Root cause: execAsync() spawns a non-login /bin/sh, which never sources
~/.bashrc — so the bare `pm2` command resolves using whatever PATH pm2 itself
was started with (which for casaos-nas lacks /home/roy/.npm-global/bin),
instead of the interactive shell's PATH. Confirmed via `which pm2` on the Pi:
the real binary is /home/roy/.npm-global/bin/pm2.

Fix: call pm2 by absolute path in both places so PATH resolution can't bite
again regardless of how this pm2 process itself gets started in future.

Run: python backend/scripts/patch_pm2_absolute_path.py | ssh roy@192.168.0.181 python3
Then: ssh roy@192.168.0.181 "node --check /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js && pm2 restart casaos-nas --update-env"
"""
import sys

CODE = r'''
import sys

path = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js'

with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    src = f.read()

if '/home/roy/.npm-global/bin/pm2 jlist' in src:
    print('[pm2-abs-path] already patched')
    sys.exit(0)

count = src.count("execAsync('pm2 jlist', { timeout: 5000 })")
if count == 0:
    print('[pm2-abs-path] ERROR: anchor not found')
    sys.exit(1)

src = src.replace(
    "execAsync('pm2 jlist', { timeout: 5000 })",
    "execAsync('/home/roy/.npm-global/bin/pm2 jlist', { timeout: 5000 })",
)

with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(src)
print(f'[pm2-abs-path] server.js patched OK - {count} occurrence(s) switched to absolute pm2 path')
'''

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
sys.stdout.write(CODE)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_pm2_smart_skip.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Smart-skip pm2 auto update: only restart the pm2 daemon (a ~10s service
interruption) when pm2 itself has a newer version; otherwise skip entirely
(0 downtime). Rewrites the `if (targets.has('pm2'))` block inside
runUpdateTask, anchored between the pm2 and nginx target blocks so it works
regardless of the Pi's current (possibly divergent) pm2 implementation.

Run: python backend/scripts/patch_pm2_smart_skip.py | ssh roy@192.168.0.181 python3
Then: ssh roy@192.168.0.181 "node --check /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js && pm2 restart casaos-nas --update-env"
"""
import sys
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
except Exception:
    pass

CODE = r'''# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys

path = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js'
with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    src = f.read()

if 'npm view pm2 version' in src:
    print('[pm2] smart-skip already applied, nothing to do')
    sys.exit(0)

START = "  if (targets.has('pm2')) {"
NEXT  = "if (targets.has('nginx')) {"

s = src.find(START)
if s == -1:
    print('[pm2] ERROR: pm2 target block not found')
    sys.exit(1)
e = src.find(NEXT, s)
if e == -1:
    print('[pm2] ERROR: nginx anchor not found after pm2 block')
    sys.exit(1)

NEW = r"""  if (targets.has('pm2')) {
    try {
      // 智慧跳過：只有 pm2 本體有新版時才重啟 daemon（短暫中斷），否則完全不碰（0 中斷）。
      let cur = '', latest = ''
      try { cur = (await execAsync('pm2 -v', { timeout: 15_000 })).stdout.trim() } catch {}
      try { latest = (await execAsync('npm view pm2 version', { timeout: 30_000 })).stdout.trim() } catch {}
      if (latest && cur !== latest) {
        // daemon 重啟會殺死本 process，故用 nohup 背景獨立執行，讓 API 先回應。
        const updateScript = [
          '#!/bin/bash',
          'npm install -g pm2@latest',
          'pm2 update',
          'pm2 start /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js --name casaos-nas --cwd /home/roy/casaos-nas',
          'pm2 save',
          'pm2 logs casaos-nas --lines 5 --nostream',
        ].join('\n')
        await fs.writeFile('/tmp/vaultix_pm2_update.sh', updateScript, { mode: 0o755 })
        await execAsync('nohup bash /tmp/vaultix_pm2_update.sh > /tmp/vaultix_pm2_update.log 2>&1 &')
        parts.push(`[pm2] ${cur} → ${latest}，更新腳本已在背景啟動，約 10 秒後生效（會短暫中斷）`)
      } else {
        parts.push(`[pm2] 已是最新版 (${cur || 'unknown'})，略過 daemon 重啟（不中斷服務）`)
      }
    } catch (e) { parts.push('[pm2] 失敗：' + String(e.message).slice(-200)) }
  }

  """

new_src = src[:s] + NEW + src[e:]

if new_src.count("if (targets.has('pm2'))") != 1:
    print('[pm2] WARNING: unexpected pm2 block count, aborting')
    sys.exit(1)

with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(new_src)
print('[pm2] rewrote pm2 target block to smart-skip (version-gated daemon restart)')
'''

sys.stdout.write(CODE)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_pm2_status_fix.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Fixes the pm2 widget showing "0/0 online" after an auto-update.

Root cause: this Pi has TWO separate pm2 installs — /usr/bin/pm2 (old,
root-owned, v7.0.1) and /home/roy/.npm-global/bin/pm2 (user's npm -g
install, gets bumped by the auto-updater). The jlist-reading endpoints
already call pm2 by absolute path, but the auto-update pm2 block
(patch_pm2_smart_skip.py) called bare `pm2` for -v/update/start/save,
which PATH-resolves to the OLD /usr/bin/pm2. So the version check never
compares apples-to-apples, `pm2 update` never actually reaches the
daemon the absolute-path CLI talks to, and the daemon is left running a
version older than the local CLI package — which makes every subsequent
`pm2` invocation print a "In-memory PM2 is out-of-date" banner to
STDOUT before the JSON. `JSON.parse(stdout)` on that then throws, and
both /api/system/services and /api/apps silently fall back to
{ online: 0, total: 0 }.

This patch:
  1. Adds a parsePm2Jlist() helper that skips any banner/log lines
     before the JSON array (defense-in-depth against this recurring,
     regardless of cause).
  2. Uses it at both existing pm2 jlist call sites.
  3. Rewrites the auto-update pm2 block to call pm2 by the SAME
     absolute path everywhere, and to report the actual online/total
     count in the task's log line — immediately when no restart was
     needed (the common case), otherwise a note to check the verify
     log since the API process itself gets killed mid-restart.

Run: python backend/scripts/patch_pm2_status_fix.py | ssh roy@192.168.0.181 python3
Then: ssh roy@192.168.0.181 "node --check /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js && pm2 restart casaos-nas --update-env"
"""
import sys
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
except Exception:
    pass

CODE = r'''# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys

path = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js'
with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    src = f.read()

if 'function parsePm2Jlist' in src:
    print('[pm2-status-fix] already applied, nothing to do')
    sys.exit(0)

# --- 1. insert parsePm2Jlist() helper, right before isServiceActive() ---
ANCHOR1 = "async function isServiceActive(name) {"
if src.count(ANCHOR1) != 1:
    print('[pm2-status-fix] ERROR: isServiceActive anchor not found (or not unique)')
    sys.exit(1)

HELPER = r"""// pm2 CLI sometimes prints a version-mismatch banner (or [PM2] log
// lines) to stdout before the JSON payload of `pm2 jlist` — strip
// anything before the array so a stray banner never breaks parsing.
function parsePm2Jlist(stdout) {
  const m = stdout.search(/\[\s*[{\]]/)
  if (m === -1) throw new Error('pm2 jlist: no JSON array found in output')
  return JSON.parse(stdout.slice(m))
}

"""
src = src.replace(ANCHOR1, HELPER + ANCHOR1)

# --- 2. use the helper at both jlist call sites ---
SITE1_OLD = """const { stdout } = await execAsync('/home/roy/.npm-global/bin/pm2 jlist', { timeout: 5000 })
    const procs = JSON.parse(stdout)"""
SITE1_NEW = """const { stdout } = await execAsync('/home/roy/.npm-global/bin/pm2 jlist', { timeout: 5000 })
    const procs = parsePm2Jlist(stdout)"""
if src.count(SITE1_OLD) != 1:
    print('[pm2-status-fix] ERROR: services jlist site not found (or not unique)')
    sys.exit(1)
src = src.replace(SITE1_OLD, SITE1_NEW)

SITE2_OLD = """const { stdout: pm2Out } = await execAsync('/home/roy/.npm-global/bin/pm2 jlist', { timeout: 5000 })
    const procs = JSON.parse(pm2Out)"""
SITE2_NEW = """const { stdout: pm2Out } = await execAsync('/home/roy/.npm-global/bin/pm2 jlist', { timeout: 5000 })
    const procs = parsePm2Jlist(pm2Out)"""
if src.count(SITE2_OLD) != 1:
    print('[pm2-status-fix] ERROR: apps jlist site not found (or not unique)')
    sys.exit(1)
src = src.replace(SITE2_OLD, SITE2_NEW)

# --- 3. rewrite the auto-update pm2 block to use absolute paths + report status ---
BLOCK_OLD = r"""  if (targets.has('pm2')) {
    try {
      // 智慧跳過：pm2 update 會重啟 daemon 並短暫中斷服務，但只有在 pm2 本體有新版時才需要。
      // 先同步比對版本，已是最新就完全不碰 daemon（0 中斷）；有新版才在背景執行更新腳本。
      let cur = '', latest = ''
      try { cur = (await execAsync('pm2 -v', { timeout: 15_000 })).stdout.trim() } catch {}
      try { latest = (await execAsync('npm view pm2 version', { timeout: 30_000 })).stdout.trim() } catch {}
      if (latest && cur !== latest) {
        // daemon 重啟會殺死本 process，故用 nohup 背景獨立執行，讓 API 先回應。
        const updateScript = [
          '#!/bin/bash',
          'npm install -g pm2@latest',
          'pm2 update',
          'pm2 start /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js --name casaos-nas --cwd /home/roy/casaos-nas',
          'pm2 save',
          'pm2 logs casaos-nas --lines 5 --nostream',
        ].join('\n')
        await fs.writeFile('/tmp/vaultix_pm2_update.sh', updateScript, { mode: 0o755 })
        await execAsync('nohup bash /tmp/vaultix_pm2_update.sh > /tmp/vaultix_pm2_update.log 2>&1 &')
        parts.push(`[pm2] ${cur} → ${latest}，更新腳本已在背景啟動，約 10 秒後生效（會短暫中斷）`)
      } else {
        parts.push(`[pm2] 已是最新版 (${cur || 'unknown'})，略過 daemon 重啟（不中斷服務）`)
      }
    } catch (e) { parts.push('[pm2] 失敗：' + String(e.message).slice(-200)) }
  }"""

BLOCK_NEW = r"""  if (targets.has('pm2')) {
    // 這台 Pi 另外還有一份 /usr/bin/pm2（舊、root 裝的），裸 `pm2` 會被 PATH 解析到
    // 那份而不是這裡用的 npm -g 安裝，導致版本判斷對不上、daemon 也沒被真的同步到，
    // 每次 CLI 呼叫都印出版本不符的橫幅蓋掉 JSON、讓 widget 讀到 0/0。全程用絕對路徑。
    const PM2_BIN = '/home/roy/.npm-global/bin/pm2'
    try {
      // 智慧跳過：pm2 update 會重啟 daemon 並短暫中斷服務，但只有在 pm2 本體有新版時才需要。
      // 先同步比對版本，已是最新就完全不碰 daemon（0 中斷）；有新版才在背景執行更新腳本。
      let cur = '', latest = ''
      try { cur = (await execAsync(`${PM2_BIN} -v`, { timeout: 15_000 })).stdout.trim() } catch {}
      try { latest = (await execAsync('npm view pm2 version', { timeout: 30_000 })).stdout.trim() } catch {}
      if (latest && cur !== latest) {
        // daemon 重啟會殺死本 process，故用 nohup 背景獨立執行，讓 API 先回應。
        const updateScript = [
          '#!/bin/bash',
          'npm install -g pm2@latest',
          `${PM2_BIN} update`,
          `${PM2_BIN} start /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js --name casaos-nas --cwd /home/roy/casaos-nas`,
          `${PM2_BIN} save`,
          `${PM2_BIN} list`,
        ].join('\n')
        await fs.writeFile('/tmp/vaultix_pm2_update.sh', updateScript, { mode: 0o755 })
        await execAsync('nohup bash /tmp/vaultix_pm2_update.sh > /tmp/vaultix_pm2_update.log 2>&1 &')
        parts.push(`[pm2] ${cur} → ${latest}，更新腳本已在背景啟動，約 10 秒後生效（會短暫中斷，本 process 也會重啟）。完成狀態見 /tmp/vaultix_pm2_update.log`)
      } else {
        let status = '，狀態未知'
        try {
          const { stdout } = await execAsync(`${PM2_BIN} jlist`, { timeout: 5000 })
          const procs = parsePm2Jlist(stdout)
          const online = procs.filter(p => p.pm2_env?.status === 'online').length
          status = `，目前 ${online}/${procs.length} online`
        } catch (e) { status = `，狀態查詢失敗：${String(e.message).slice(-100)}` }
        parts.push(`[pm2] 已是最新版 (${cur || 'unknown'})，略過 daemon 重啟（不中斷服務）${status}`)
      }
    } catch (e) { parts.push('[pm2] 失敗：' + String(e.message).slice(-200)) }
  }"""

if src.count(BLOCK_OLD) != 1:
    print('[pm2-status-fix] ERROR: pm2 update block not found (or not unique) — server.js may already differ from expected shape')
    sys.exit(1)
src = src.replace(BLOCK_OLD, BLOCK_NEW)

with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(src)
print('[pm2-status-fix] server.js patched: parsePm2Jlist helper + absolute pm2 paths + status reporting')
'''

sys.stdout.write(CODE)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_py_error_format_fix.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
重要修正（影響 batch1~12 全部 111 支已上線路由）：錯誤回應格式統一。

server.js 全站一律回 {error: "..."}，FastAPI 的 HTTPException 預設卻是
{detail: "..."}——前端 lib/api.ts 讀的是 data.error，沒有這層轉換，每一支
已經搭到 Python 的路由，噫出來的錯誤在前端一律變成 undefined、只會顯示籠統
的 fallback 訊息（例如「HTTP 400」），使用者完全看不到後端實際回傳、已經翻好
中文的錯誤內容。新增全域 exception handler，一次涵蓋所有 HTTPException（4xx/5xx）
與 Pydantic 請求驗證失敗（422），不需要、也不會去改動任何一支既有路由的程式碼本身。

Run: python websites/backend/scripts/patch_py_error_format_fix.py | ssh vaultix-pi python3
Then: ssh vaultix-pi "python3 -m py_compile /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.py && pm2 restart nas-python --update-env"
"""
import sys
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
except Exception:
    pass

CODE = '# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\nimport sys\npy_path = \'/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.py\'\nwith open(py_path, \'r\', encoding=\'utf-8\') as f:\n    src = f.read()\n\nif \'_http_exception_handler\' in src:\n    print(\'[error-format-fix] server.py: already patched\')\n    sys.exit(0)\n\nANCHOR = \'app = FastAPI()\\n\'\nif src.count(ANCHOR) != 1:\n    print(\'[error-format-fix] ERROR: FastAPI() anchor not found or not unique\')\n    sys.exit(1)\n\nBLOCK = \'# ── 錯誤回應格式統一（重要修正，影響 batch1~12 全部 111 支已上線路由）───────\\n# server.js 全站一律回 {error: "..."}，FastAPI 的 HTTPException 預設卻是\\n# {detail: "..."}——前端 lib/api.ts 的 apiJson()/apiFetch() 讀的是\\n# data.error（`throw new Error((data as {error?:string}).error ?? \\\'HTTP ...\\\'）），\\n# 沒有這層轉換，每一支已經搬到 Python 的路由，噴出來的錯誤在前端一律變成\\n# undefined、只會顯示籠統的 fallback 訊息（例如「HTTP 400」），使用者完全看\\n# 不到後端實際回傳、已經翻好中文的錯誤內容。這是全域 exception handler，\\n# 一次涵蓋所有 HTTPException（4xx/5xx）與 Pydantic 請求驗證失敗（422），\\n# 不需要、也不會去改動任何一支既有路由的程式碼本身。\\nfrom fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError\\n\\n\\n@app.exception_handler(HTTPException)\\nasync def _http_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: HTTPException) -> JSONResponse:\\n    return JSONResponse(status_code=exc.status_code, content={\\\'error\\\': exc.detail}, headers=exc.headers)\\n\\n\\n@app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError)\\nasync def _validation_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError) -> JSONResponse:\\n    return JSONResponse(status_code=422, content={\\\'error\\\': str(exc)})\\n\'\nidx = src.find(ANCHOR) + len(ANCHOR)\nsrc = src[:idx] + chr(10) + BLOCK.rstrip(chr(10)) + chr(10) + src[idx:]\n\nimport shutil as _sh\n_sh.copyfile(py_path, py_path + \'.bak_error_format_fix\')\nwith open(py_path, \'w\', encoding=\'utf-8\') as f:\n    f.write(src)\nprint(\'[error-format-fix] server.py: patched (backup at server.py.bak_error_format_fix)\')\n'

sys.stdout.write(CODE)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_py_migration_batch10_serverjs.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
server.js -> server.py 轉換 batch 10（第91~100個路由：快照還原/刪除~排程日誌查詢）：
  POST /api/snapshots/:id/restore, DELETE /api/snapshots/:id,
  GET /api/cameras, POST /api/cameras, PUT /api/cameras/:id,
  DELETE /api/cameras/:id, GET /api/cameras/:id/stream,
  GET /api/cameras/:id/snapshot, GET /api/schedule/tasks,
  GET /api/schedule/logs

排程任務的 POST/PUT/DELETE /api/schedule/tasks 與 POST .../run 刷意跳過，
留給日後單狜一批（會動到 Node 行程記憶體內的 cronJobs/node-cron 排程器）。

Run: python websites/backend/scripts/patch_py_migration_batch10_serverjs.py | ssh vaultix-pi python3
Then: ssh vaultix-pi "node --check /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js && pm2 restart casaos-nas --update-env"
"""

"""

     List[bytes] 解析（不是 UploadFile），實際上傳會 400/422。改成 list[UploadFile]/list[str]。

     跳過 session 檢查，不會擋登入，但兩個功能静默失效）。現在比照 Node 版本簽
     randomBytes(16).toString('hex') 同樣格式的 jti，並透過 /api/internal/record-login-event
     傳回 Node 觸發既有 recordSession()。

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_py_migration_batch1_multipartfix_serverjs.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
server.js -> server.py 轉換 batch 1 第二次後續修正：_pySecurityProxy 在別的一次
patch（Patch Panel 功能）被改成一律把 req.body 重新序列化成 JSON 轉發（不再是

/api/files/upload 與 /api/media/album-upload 這兩支的 proxy，其余 7 支維持不變。

    pass

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""

  GET /api/share/:token, POST /api/share/:token/verify,

  POST /api/share/:token/upload, POST /api/2fa/app-setup, GET /api/2fa/status,

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_rce_command_injection_fixes.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Fixes 5 shell command-injection (RCE) bugs found in a fresh security audit
(2026-07-10, second pass — separate from the 07-08 and 07-10 audits already
in CLAUDE.md). All five are `execAsync` (child_process.exec, i.e. `/bin/sh -c
"<string>"`) calls that interpolate attacker-influenced data into a shell
string. Double quotes around a value do NOT stop `$(...)` / backtick command
substitution, so any of these let an authenticated user (not necessarily
admin) run arbitrary shell commands as the `roy` Linux user:

1. POST /api/snapshots (create): srcFull is built from a user-supplied
   `path` with only a leading "../" stripped — NOT run through safePath()'s
   shell-safety guarantees — and mkdir has no charset restriction, so a
   folder named e.g. "x$(touch /tmp/pwned)" (created via the ordinary
   POST /api/files/mkdir, which also has no charset restriction) triggers
   the injection the moment its owner snapshots it. Reachable by ANY
   authenticated account, no admin required — the most severe finding here.
2. POST /api/snapshots/:id/restore: identical `cp -rp "..." "..."` pattern.
3. GET /api/snapshots (list): `du -sh "<folder>"` over the same
   attacker-nameable directories.
4. GET /api/cameras/:id/snapshot: ffmpeg command built with
   `cam.url.replace(/"/g, '\\"')` — only escapes literal `"`, which does
   nothing against `$(...)`/backticks in a double-quoted string. cam.url is
   admin-supplied (POST /api/cameras is admin-only) but the snapshot route
   itself only requires `authenticate` — so once *any* camera exists, every
   ordinary logged-in user can trigger command execution through it. The
   sibling /stream route already builds its ffmpeg args as a plain argv
   array (spawn, no shell) — this brings /snapshot in line with it.
5. POST /api/system/fail2ban/unban: `jail`/`ip` from req.body go straight
   into `sudo fail2ban-client set ${jail} unbanip ${ip}` with zero
   validation. Admin-only already, so lower severity (an admin already has
   a real shell via the Terminal feature), but free to harden the same way.

Also: startDouyinDownload() is dead code on this Pi (the dispatcher in
startYtdlJob() calls startDouyinShare() instead, added by the 07-10 SSRF
patch) but still contains the exact same un-escaped `execAsync(`curl ...
"${job.url}"`)` pattern that was fixed in startDouyinShare/startThreadsDownload.
Harmless while unreachable, but a landmine if anyone ever re-wires it — fixed
the same minimal way (execAsync -> execFileAsync, no shell) rather than
deleting the function, to keep this patch's anchors small and low-risk.

Fix approach: `fs.cp()` (Node's built-in recursive copy, no shell at all)
for the two `cp -rp` sites, and `execFile`/`execFileAsync` (argv array, no
shell) everywhere else — same pattern already used for the 07-10 ytdl SSRF
fix in this file (see startDouyinShare / startThreadsDownload).

Run: python backend/scripts/patch_rce_command_injection_fixes.py | ssh vaultix-pi python3
Then: ssh vaultix-pi "node --check /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js && pm2 restart casaos-nas --update-env"
"""
import sys
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
except Exception:
    pass

CODE = r'''# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys

path = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js'
with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    src = f.read()

changed = []
skipped = []
failed = []

def apply_fix(name, old, new):
    global src
    if new in src:
        skipped.append(name + ' (already patched)')
        return
    if src.count(old) != 1:
        failed.append(name + f' (anchor found {src.count(old)} times, expected 1)')
        return
    src = src.replace(old, new, 1)
    changed.append(name)

# --- 1. snapshot create: cp -rp shell string -> fs.cp ---
OLD1 = """  try {
    // Copy using cp -rp (preserve timestamps), fallback handled by cp itself
    await execAsync(`cp -rp "${srcFull}/." "${destDir}/"`, { timeout: 300000 })

    const meta = { id, originalPath: safe, name: folderName, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() }"""
NEW1 = """  try {

"""Re-enable the login-time 2FA check that was temporarily disabled via '&& false'.

            content = f.read()

        continue

    if len(matches) != 1:

        raise SystemExit(1)
    content = PATTERN.sub(NEW, content, count=1)

print(SCRIPT)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_security_batch.py
"""
Combined security-hardening deploy for the Pi. Applies, each independently
idempotent (safe to re-run):

  1. Terminal WebSocket restricted to admin accounts only
  2. Login/2FA brute-force protection (5 fails / 15 min -> 15 min lockout)
  3. helmet() baseline security headers (CSP/COEP off - this server never
     renders HTML, and the SPA on a different origin fetches media from here)
  4. express-rate-limit on the heavy job-starting endpoints (speech/recognize,
     ytdl/start, ocr) so one account can't exhaust the Pi's CPU/network
  5. package.json "overrides" pinning the vulnerable transitive `uuid`
     (via node-cron) to a patched version

Run: python backend/scripts/patch_security_batch.py | ssh roy@192.168.0.181 python3
Then (REQUIRED - new deps won't exist until this runs):
  ssh roy@192.168.0.181 "cd /home/roy/casaos-nas && npm install helmet express-rate-limit && npm install"
Then:
  ssh roy@192.168.0.181 "node --check /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js && pm2 restart casaos-nas --update-env"
"""
import sys

# ── 2. Login brute-force protection ─────────────────────────────────────
if "_loginHits" in src:
    print("[2/5] login-ratelimit: already patched")
else:
    ANCHOR = "app.use(express.json())"
    if src.count(ANCHOR) == 1:
        MIDDLEWARE = """app.use(express.json())

// ── login brute-force protection ──────────────────────────
const _loginHits = new Map()          // key -> { fails, firstAt, blockedUntil }
const LOGIN_MAX = 5                    // failed attempts before lockout
const LOGIN_WINDOW = 15 * 60 * 1000    // rolling window to count fails
const LOGIN_BLOCK = 15 * 60 * 1000     // lockout duration once tripped
function _loginKey(req) {
  const u = req.body && req.body.username ? String(req.body.username).toLowerCase() : ''
  const xff = req.headers['x-forwarded-for']
  const ip = (xff ? String(xff).split(',')[0].trim() : '') || req.ip || ''
  return ip + '|' + u
}
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  if (req.method !== 'POST') return next()
  if (req.path !== '/api/login' && req.path !== '/api/2fa/verify') return next()
  const key = _loginKey(req)
  const now = Date.now()
  const rec = _loginHits.get(key)
  if (rec && rec.blockedUntil > now) {
    const retry = Math.ceil((rec.blockedUntil - now) / 1000)
    res.set('Retry-After', String(retry))
    return res.status(429).json({ error: '嘗試次數過多，請於 ' + Math.ceil(retry / 60) + ' 分鐘後再試' })
  }
  res.on('finish', () => {
    if (res.statusCode === 200) { _loginHits.delete(key); return }
    if (res.statusCode !== 401) return   // only count wrong credentials / codes
    const cur = _loginHits.get(key) || { fails: 0, firstAt: now, blockedUntil: 0 }
    if (now - cur.firstAt > LOGIN_WINDOW) { cur.fails = 0; cur.firstAt = now }
    cur.fails += 1
    if (cur.fails >= LOGIN_MAX) cur.blockedUntil = now + LOGIN_BLOCK
    _loginHits.set(key, cur)
  })
  next()
})
setInterval(() => {
  const t = Date.now()
  for (const [k, v] of _loginHits)
    if ((v.blockedUntil || 0) < t && (t - (v.firstAt || 0)) > LOGIN_WINDOW) _loginHits.delete(k)
}, 10 * 60 * 1000)"""
        src = src.replace(ANCHOR, MIDDLEWARE, 1)
        print("[2/5] login-ratelimit: patched OK")
    else:
        print("[2/5] login-ratelimit: ERROR found " + str(src.count(ANCHOR)) + " anchors, skipped")

    OLD_MW = """// Chrome Private Network Access: allow public origin → local IP requests

    NEW_MW = """// Chrome Private Network Access: allow public origin → local IP requests

  }

// Baseline security headers. contentSecurityPolicy/COEP are off because this
// server never renders HTML pages (pure JSON API + file/media streaming) —
// the frontend is a separately-hosted SPA on a different origin that fetches
// images/video/audio from here, so a same-origin CORP/COEP default would
// silently break that cross-origin media loading.
app.use(helmet({

// Rate limit for CPU/network-heavy job-starting endpoints (yt-dlp, ffmpeg,
// tesseract, ...) so one account can't exhaust the Pi's resources by spamming
// them. Keyed the same way as the login limiter (X-Forwarded-For first) since
// req.ip collapses behind the Tailscale Funnel reverse proxy without that.
const heavyJobLimiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  limit: 10,
  standardHeaders: true,
  legacyHeaders: false,
  keyGenerator: req => {
    const xff = req.headers['x-forwarded-for']
    return (xff ? String(xff).split(',')[0].trim() : '') || req.ip || 'unknown'
  },
  message: { error: '請求過於頻繁，請稍後再試' },
})

app.use(cors({"""
    if ok and OLD_MW in src:
        src = src.replace(OLD_MW, NEW_MW, 1)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/backend/scripts/patch_security_patch_panel.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Adds the "Patch Panel" admin feature to the Python sidecar (server.py):
  - GET  /api/security/patches              — list *.py patch scripts found
    under {CASAOS_DIR}/scripts/ (filename, docstring summary, size, mtime).
  - POST /api/security/patches/{name}/apply — run one of those scripts the
    same two-stage way it's always been done by hand throughout this
    project's history (`python3 x.py | python3`), then re-verify syntax of
    server.js / webdav.js / server.py so a bad anchor match is caught before
    anyone restarts the service.
  - POST /api/security/restart-service      — pm2-restart casaos-nas or
    nas-python in the background (detached, 1s delayed) so the response for
    a nas-python restart can still make it out before this very process
    dies — same shape as server.js's existing pm2-self-update background
    task.

Trust boundary: /apply only ever executes a `.py` file that already exists
on this Pi's local disk under {CASAOS_DIR}/scripts/ — nothing from the HTTP
request is ever executed or written. Getting a new script onto that disk
still requires the existing trusted channel (reviewed in git, then deployed
over SSH), same as every patch applied so far — this endpoint only automates
the deploy *step*, not the authoring/review step.

Depends on patch_security_dashboard.py already being applied (uses the same
CASAOS_DIR / SECURITY_SCAN_CACHE / run_security_scan block as an anchor).
Companion server.js changes (proxy routes + a body-forwarding fix in
_pySecurityProxy) are in patch_vaultixid_ratelimit_and_patchpanel.py.

Run: python backend/scripts/patch_security_patch_panel.py | ssh vaultix-pi python3
Then: ssh vaultix-pi "python3 -m py_compile /home/roy/casaos-nas/server.py && pm2 restart nas-python --update-env"
"""
import sys
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
except Exception:
    pass

CODE = r'''# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys

path = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.py'
with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    src = f.read()

changed = []
skipped = []
failed = []

def apply_fix(name, old, new):
    global src
    if new in src:
        skipped.append(name + ' (already patched)')
        return
    if src.count(old) != 1:
        failed.append(name + f' (anchor found {src.count(old)} times, expected 1)')
        return
    src = src.replace(old, new, 1)
    changed.append(name)

    'RestartServiceBody model',
    """class RenameFolderBody(BaseModel):
    oldName: str
    newName: str""",

    newName: str
