// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components-tsx/WindowsHelloSettings.tsx
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react'
import toast from 'react-hot-toast'
import { startRegistration, browserSupportsWebAuthn } from '@simplewebauthn/browser'
import { useLang } from '../context/LangContext'
import { apiJson, apiFetch } from '../lib/api'

interface HelloDevice {
  id: number
  device_name: string | null
  created_at: string
}

export default function WindowsHelloSettings() {
  const { t } = useLang()
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [devices, setDevices] = useState<HelloDevice[] | null>(null)
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false)
  const [removingId, setRemovingId] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      const d = await apiJson<{ registered: boolean; devices: HelloDevice[] }>('/api/2fa/webauthn/status')
      setDevices(d.devices)
    } catch {
      setError(t.loadFailed)
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }, [t.loadFailed])

  useEffect(() => { if (open && devices === null) load() }, [open, devices, load])

  async function handleAdd() {
    if (!window.isSecureContext || !browserSupportsWebAuthn()) {
      setError(t.helloNotSupported)
      return
    }
    setAdding(true)
    setError('')
    try {
      const origin = window.location.origin
      const options = await apiJson<Parameters<typeof startRegistration>[0]['optionsJSON']>(
        `/api/2fa/webauthn/register-options?origin=${encodeURIComponent(origin)}`
      )
      const response = await startRegistration({ optionsJSON: options })
      const deviceName = window.prompt(t.helloDeviceNamePrompt, navigator.platform || 'Windows Hello') || undefined
      await apiJson('/api/2fa/webauthn/register-verify', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ response, deviceName }),
      })
      toast.success(t.helloAdded)
      await load()
    } catch (e) {
      const err = e as Error
      if (err.name !== 'NotAllowedError') {
        setError(err.message || t.helloAddFailed)
      }
    } finally {
      setAdding(false)
    }
  }

  async function handleRemove(id: number) {
    if (!window.confirm(t.helloRemoveConfirm)) return
    setRemovingId(id)
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/api/2fa/webauthn/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' })
      setDevices(ds => ds?.filter(d => d.id !== id) ?? null)
      toast.success(t.helloRemove)
    } catch {
      toast.error(t.helloRemoveFailed)
    } finally {
      setRemovingId(null)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-gray-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
      <button
        onClick={() => setOpen(v => !v)}
        className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 hover:bg-gray-700/60 transition-colors"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="font-medium">{t.helloSetting}</span>
          {devices && (
            <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium ${devices.length > 0 ? 'bg-green-500/20 text-green-400' : 'bg-gray-600 text-gray-400'}`}>
              {devices.length > 0 ? t.helloRegistered : t.helloNotRegistered}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <span className="text-gray-400 text-sm">{open ? '▲' : '▼'}</span>
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div className="px-4 pb-4 border-t border-gray-700 pt-3 space-y-3">
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">{t.helloIntro}</p>

          {loading && <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">{t.helloDevicesLoading}</p>}

          {!loading && devices && devices.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {devices.map(d => (
                <div key={d.id} className="bg-gray-900/60 rounded-lg p-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm text-white font-medium truncate">{d.device_name || 'Windows Hello'}</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-600">{new Date(d.created_at).toLocaleString()}</p>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleRemove(d.id)}
                    disabled={removingId === d.id}
                    className="shrink-0 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-red-600/80 hover:bg-red-600 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-medium"
                  >
                    {t.helloRemove}
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {error && <p className="text-red-400 text-xs">{error}</p>}

          <button
            onClick={handleAdd}
            disabled={adding}
            className="w-full py-2 rounded-lg bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors"
          >
            {adding ? t.helloAdding : t.helloAddBtn}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/admin_mailserver.py
"""Mail Server Setup — page for the self-hosted personal mail accounts
feature (stage 5b). Shaped like admin_raid.py for the admin-only pieces:
this module is UI only, all the real subprocess/Postfix/Dovecot/OpenDKIM
logic lives in the Python sidecar (websites/backend/server.py, see
patch_mailserver_endpoints.py) which this proxies to via admin_shell.py's
py_json/py_get helpers.

Two permission tiers on purpose, both served from the SAME page (so mail.py's
"Set up my mailbox" link works for every user, not just admins):
  - Install status, DKIM key display, firewall-open button: admin-only
    API routes (`require_admin_api`) — infrastructure actions for the whole
    NAS. The page itself just hides that section client-side (in
    admin_mailserver.js) if those calls come back 403.
  - "Provision my own mailbox": any logged-in user, same permission level
    as adding an external IMAP account in mail.py — a normal user should be
    able to opt in to their own @domain mailbox without needing an admin to
    do it for them each time. Page view + this action use a bare login gate
    (`_require_user_api`/`token`+`username`), same pattern as mail.py's own
    `_require_user` ("mail is a normal-user tool, not admin-only").
"""
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, RedirectResponse

from admin_shell import page_shell, require_admin_api, token, username, py_get, py_json

router = APIRouter()


def _require_user_api(request: Request) -> str | JSONResponse:
    """Same bare-login gate as mail.py's own _require_user — provisioning
    your own mailbox is a normal-user action, not admin-only."""
    tok = token(request)
    if not tok:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    return tok


@router.get("/mail/server-setup", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def mail_server_setup_page(request: Request):
    tok = token(request)
    user = username(tok) if tok else None
    if not user:
        return RedirectResponse("/login", status_code=302)
    body = """
    <div id="mailServerBody"><div class="spinner"></div></div>
    """
    html = page_shell(title="Mail Server Setup", accent="#f472b6", body=body,
                       scripts=["/static/admin_mailserver.js"])
    return HTMLResponse(html)


# ── Admin-only: install status / DKIM key / firewall ─────────────────────────
@router.get("/api/admin/mail/status")
async def api_mail_status(request: Request):
    tok = require_admin_api(request)
    if isinstance(tok, JSONResponse):
        return tok
    return await py_json("GET", "/api/mail/server/status", tok)


@router.get("/api/admin/mail/dkim")
async def api_mail_dkim(request: Request):
    tok = require_admin_api(request)
    if isinstance(tok, JSONResponse):
        return tok
    return await py_json("GET", "/api/mail/server/dkim", tok)


@router.post("/api/admin/mail/firewall/open")
async def api_mail_firewall_open(request: Request):
    tok = require_admin_api(request)
    if isinstance(tok, JSONResponse):
        return tok
    return await py_json("POST", "/api/mail/server/firewall/open", tok)


# ── Any logged-in user: self-provision their own mailbox ─────────────────────
@router.get("/api/mail/mailbox")
async def api_mailbox_get(request: Request):
    tok = _require_user_api(request)
    if isinstance(tok, JSONResponse):
        return tok
    return await py_json("GET", "/api/mail/mailbox", tok)


@router.post("/api/mail/mailbox")
async def api_mailbox_create(request: Request):

        return tok

    return await py_json("POST", "/api/mail/mailbox", tok, body)

@router.post("/api/admin/raid/action")

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/admin_shell.py
"""Shared page shell + proxy helpers for category 6 (系統管理面板) admin panels.

Every tsx file in this category renders the same shape: a full-screen dark
panel, a header with a Back button + title + Refresh, an optional tab bar,
and admin-only access (`if (user.role !== 'admin') navigate('/')`). Factored
out here once real reuse showed up (SecurityDashboard.tsx + fail2ban.tsx, the
first sub-batch) rather than guessed upfront — later sub-batches import from
this module, not from each other or app.py (one-directional, same pattern as
widgets.py/office_workspace.py).
"""
import json
import os
from urllib.parse import quote

import httpx
from fastapi import Request
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, RedirectResponse

NODE_API = os.getenv("NODE_API", "http://127.0.0.1:3000").rstrip("/")
NODE_PUBLIC_URL = os.getenv("NODE_PUBLIC_URL", "https://raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net").rstrip("/")
# The Python sidecar (server.py, port 3011, localhost-only) never sees a JWT —
# Express normally decodes it and forwards identity via X-User-* headers
# (see server.py's own docstring). Calling it directly from here (bypassing
# Express) means frontend-py has to set those headers itself, decoded from
# the same JWT `node_json`/`node_get` forward as a Bearer token to Node.
PY_API = os.getenv("PY_API", "http://127.0.0.1:3011").rstrip("/")
COOKIE_NAME = "nas_jwt"


def token(request: Request) -> str | None:
    """Cookie is the normal path (frontend-py's own page loads/navigation).
    A Bearer header is also accepted so a page served from a *different*
    origin (e.g. the React app on vaultix-nas.web.app, calling this API
    directly via fetch instead of through frontend-py's own HTML) can
    authenticate with the same JWT it already holds in localStorage,
    without needing a separate frontend-py login or fragile cross-site
    cookies. See app.py's CORSMiddleware for the matching origin allowlist."""
    auth = request.headers.get("Authorization", "")
    if auth.startswith("Bearer "):
        return auth[len("Bearer "):]
    return request.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)


def _decode(tok: str) -> dict:
    import base64
    try:
        payload_b64 = tok.split(".")[1]
        payload_b64 += "=" * (-len(payload_b64) % 4)
        return json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(payload_b64))
    except Exception:
        return {}


def username(tok: str) -> str | None:
    return _decode(tok).get("username")


def is_admin(tok: str) -> bool:
    return _decode(tok).get("role") == "admin"


def user_id(tok: str) -> int | None:
    """Decode the JWT's own user id (display-only, same caveat as username()/
    is_admin()) — used e.g. to mark "this is you" rows in a user list."""
    return _decode(tok).get("uid")


def require_admin_page(request: Request) -> tuple[str, None] | tuple[None, RedirectResponse]:
    """For HTML page routes: (username, None) if an admin is logged in,
    else (None, redirect-response) to send back."""
    tok = token(request)
    user = username(tok) if tok else None
    if not user:
        return None, RedirectResponse("/login", status_code=302)
    if not is_admin(tok):
        return None, RedirectResponse("/home", status_code=302)
    return user, None


def require_admin_api(request: Request) -> str | JSONResponse:
    """For JSON API routes: the token string if an admin is logged in,
    else a ready-to-return 403/401 JSONResponse."""
    tok = token(request)
    if not tok:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    if not is_admin(tok):
        return JSONResponse({"error": "需要管理員權限"}, status_code=403)
    return tok


async def node_get(path: str, tok: str) -> httpx.Response:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:
        return await client.get(f"{NODE_API}{path}", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}"})


async def node_json(method: str, path: str, tok: str, json_body: dict | None = None) -> JSONResponse:
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20) as client:
            r = await client.request(method, f"{NODE_API}{path}",
                                      headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}"}, json=json_body)
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)


def _py_sidecar_headers(tok: str) -> dict:
    d = _decode(tok)
    return {
        "X-User-Uid": str(d.get("uid", "") or ""),
        "X-User-Username": d.get("username", "") or "",
        "X-User-Role": d.get("role", "") or "",
    }


async def py_get(path: str, tok: str) -> httpx.Response:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:
        return await client.get(f"{PY_API}{path}", headers=_py_sidecar_headers(tok))


async def py_json(method: str, path: str, tok: str, json_body: dict | None = None) -> JSONResponse:
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20) as client:
            r = await client.request(method, f"{PY_API}{path}",
                                      headers=_py_sidecar_headers(tok), json=json_body)
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線 Python sidecar: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)


def esc(s: str) -> str:
    return (s or "").replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;").replace('"', "&quot;")


def page_shell(*, title: str, accent: str, tabs: list[tuple[str, str]] = (),
               active_tab: str = "", body: str = "", scripts: list[str] = (),
               extra_head: str = "") -> str:
    """accent: a CSS color for the title/active-tab accent (each panel in the
    original tsx uses its own accent color, e.g. emerald for security, orange
    for fail2ban) — kept as a CSS var so the shared shell doesn't flatten that."""
    tab_html = "".join(
        f'<button class="admin-tab{" active" if key == active_tab else ""}" data-tab="{key}">{label}</button>'
        for key, label in tabs
    )
    script_tags = "".join(f'<script src="{s}"></script>' for s in scripts)
    return f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-Hant">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>{esc(title)} — Vaultix NAS</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/style.css"/>
  {extra_head}
</head>
<body class="shell admin-shell" style="--accent-panel:{accent}">
  <header class="admin-header">
    <a class="link-btn" href="/home">← Back</a>
    <h1 class="admin-title">{esc(title)}</h1>
    <button class="link-btn" id="btnRefresh">Refresh</button>
  </header>
  {f'<div class="admin-tabs">{tab_html}</div>' if tabs else ""}
  <main class="admin-main" id="adminMain">{body}</main>
  <div id="toastHost" class="toast-host"></div>
  <script src="/static/admin_common.js"></script>
  {script_tags}
</body>
</html>"""

@router.post("/api/admin/userlist/{uid}/avatar")

    tok = require_admin_api(request)
    if isinstance(tok, JSONResponse):
        return tok
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20) as client:
            r = await client.post(f"{NODE_API}/api/admin/users/{uid}/avatar", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}"},
                                   files={"avatar": (avatar.filename, await avatar.read(), avatar.content_type)})
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/app.py
"""
Vaultix NAS — Python frontend (login + 2FA)

Architecture (chosen 2026-07-02):
    browser (HTML+JS) --HTTP--> FastAPI (this app) --httpx--> Node backend (/api/*) --> MariaDB

- Password check is proxied to the existing Node backend (single source of truth).
- 2FA is Python-native via pwd_2FA_check.TwoFactor (TOTP now; WebAuthn next).
  If the user has NODE 2FA enabled, we fall back to Node's 2FA flow (kept working).
- The JWT lives in an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie.
"""
# 下方庫嚴禁變更，根據現有格式規則進行應用與新增
import base64, json, os, secrets, time, httpx
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, Response, UploadFile, File
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, RedirectResponse

from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from pwd_2FA_check import TwoFactor
from file_filter import CATEGORIES, categorize, icon_for
# python 檔案庫 (同上嚴禁變更修改)
import admin_automation, admin_security, admin_storage, admin_raid, admin_todo

import builtins, camera, downloader, dev_tools, downloader, explorer, edit_video

import viewers, video_app, win_auth_login, widgets

BASE = Path(__file__).parent

# ── config (env) ─────────────────────────────────────────
NODE_API = os.getenv("NODE_API", "http://127.0.0.1:3000").rstrip("/")
# Browser-facing URL for the Node backend (downloads, WebDAV) — NODE_API is
# often a loopback address for server-to-server calls, which the user's
# browser cannot reach directly.
NODE_PUBLIC_URL = os.getenv("NODE_PUBLIC_URL", "https://raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net").rstrip("/")
FRONTEND_PORT = int(os.getenv("FRONTEND_PORT", "8001"))
COOKIE_SECURE = os.getenv("COOKIE_SECURE", "true").lower() == "true"
JWT_DAYS = int(os.getenv("JWT_DAYS", "7"))
COOKIE_NAME = "nas_jwt"

# 2FA config — RP_ID/ORIGIN must match the served domain for WebAuthn to work later.
RP_ID = os.getenv("RP_ID", "localhost")
TFA_ORIGIN = os.getenv("TFA_ORIGIN", "http://localhost:8001")
TFA_DB = os.getenv("TFA_DB", str(BASE / "2fa.db"))
tf = TwoFactor(db_path=TFA_DB, rp_id=RP_ID, rp_name="Vaultix NAS", origin=TFA_ORIGIN)

app = FastAPI(title="Vaultix NAS (Python frontend)")
app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory=BASE / "static"), name="static")
templates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(BASE / "templates"))
app.include_router(office_workspace.router)
app.include_router(admin_security.router)
app.include_router(admin_storage.router)

_UNSAFE_METHODS = {"POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"}


@app.middleware("http")
async def security_middleware(request: Request, call_next):
    # CSRF: state-changing requests must carry a custom header. Cross-site HTML
    # forms cannot set custom headers, and we don't enable permissive CORS, so a
    # cross-site attacker can't forge these — combined with SameSite=Strict cookies.
    if request.method in _UNSAFE_METHODS and request.headers.get("x-csrf") != "1":
        return JSONResponse({"error": "CSRF check failed"}, status_code=403)
    resp = await call_next(request)
    resp.headers["X-Frame-Options"] = "DENY"                       # clickjacking
    resp.headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff"            # MIME sniffing
    resp.headers["Referrer-Policy"] = "same-origin"
    resp.headers["Content-Security-Policy"] = "frame-ancestors 'none'"
    return resp


# Narrow, explicit allowlist — NOT permissive CORS. Lets the React app (a
# different origin) call specific frontend-py JSON APIs (currently: mail.py)
# directly via fetch with an `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` header (see
# admin_shell.token()) instead of embedding this app in an iframe, which
# X-Frame-Options/CSP above already forbid outright. allow_credentials is
# left False on purpose: cross-origin calls authenticate with the Bearer
# header only, never cookies, so the SameSite=Strict cookie's own CSRF
# story (see security_middleware above) is untouched for every other route.
_CORS_ORIGINS = [o for o in os.getenv(
    "CORS_ORIGINS", "https://vaultix-nas.web.app,http://localhost:5173",
).split(",") if o]
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=_CORS_ORIGINS,
    allow_credentials=False,
    allow_methods=["GET", "POST", "DELETE", "PUT"],
    allow_headers=["Authorization", "X-CSRF", "Content-Type"],
)


# ── pending 2FA logins (Node token held until 2FA passes) ─
_pending: dict[str, tuple[str, str, float]] = {}   # ticket -> (username, node_token, expiry)
_TICKET_TTL = 180   # 3 minutes to complete 2FA


def _new_ticket(username: str, token: str) -> str:
    ticket = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    _pending[ticket] = (username, token, time.time() + _TICKET_TTL)
    return ticket


def _peek_ticket(ticket: str):
    item = _pending.get(ticket)
    if not item or item[2] < time.time():
        _pending.pop(ticket, None)
        return None
    return item


# ── helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────
def _set_token_cookie(resp: Response, token: str) -> None:
    resp.set_cookie(
        COOKIE_NAME, token,
        max_age=JWT_DAYS * 86400,
        httponly=True, secure=COOKIE_SECURE, samesite="strict", path="/",
    )


def _jwt_username(token: str) -> str | None:
    """Decode the JWT payload for display only (signature NOT verified — Node enforces auth)."""
    try:
        payload_b64 = token.split(".")[1]
        payload_b64 += "=" * (-len(payload_b64) % 4)
        return json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(payload_b64)).get("username")
    except Exception:
        return None


def _current_user(request: Request) -> str | None:
    token = request.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)
    return _jwt_username(token) if token else None


def _jwt_role(token: str) -> str | None:
    """Decode the JWT payload for display only — same caveat as _jwt_username.
    Only used to decide which widgets to render; Node/server.py remains the
    authority and independently 403s admin-only endpoints for real."""
    try:
        payload_b64 = token.split(".")[1]
        payload_b64 += "=" * (-len(payload_b64) % 4)
        return json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(payload_b64)).get("role")
    except Exception:
        return None


def _current_is_admin(request: Request) -> bool:
    token = request.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)
    return _jwt_role(token) == "admin" if token else False


def _token_or_401(request: Request) -> str | JSONResponse:
    """Same 'not logged in' convention as the rest of this file — returns
    the cookie token, or a ready-to-return 401 JSONResponse."""
    token = request.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)
    return token or JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)


async def _node_json(method: str, path: str, token: str, json_body: dict | None = None) -> JSONResponse:
    """Generic proxy: call NODE_API with the caller's bearer token, relay status+JSON."""
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:
            r = await client.request(method, f"{NODE_API}{path}",
                                      headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}, json=json_body)
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)


def _tf_status(username: str) -> dict:
    return {"totp": tf.totp_status(username),
            "webauthn": tf.webauthn_status(username)["registered"]}


async def _node_post(path: str, body: dict) -> httpx.Response:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:
        return await client.post(f"{NODE_API}{path}", json=body)


async def _node_get(path: str, token: str) -> httpx.Response:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:
        return await client.get(f"{NODE_API}{path}", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})


# ── Office file browser ────────────────────────────────────
# ext -> (display label, URI scheme used for "open in desktop app")
OFFICE_EXT = {
    ".docx": ("Word", "ms-word"),
    ".xlsx": ("Excel", "ms-excel"),
    ".pptx": ("PowerPoint", "ms-powerpoint"),
}


def _breadcrumb(path: str) -> list[dict]:
    if not path:
        return []
    crumbs, acc = [], []
    for part in path.split("/"):
        acc.append(part)
        crumbs.append({"name": part, "path": "/".join(acc)})
    return crumbs

async def root(request: Request):
    return RedirectResponse("/home" if request.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME) else "/login", status_code=302)

async def login_page(request: Request):
    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, "login.html", {})


@app.get("/home", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def home_page(request: Request):
    user = _current_user(request)
    if not user:
        return RedirectResponse("/login", status_code=302)
    is_admin = _current_is_admin(request)
    token = request.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)

    display_name, avatar_url, home_bg = user, None, ""
    try:
        r = await _node_get("/api/user/me", token)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            prof = r.json()
            display_name = prof.get("displayName") or user
            if prof.get("avatarExt"):
                avatar_url = f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/api/avatars/{user}?t={int(time.time())}"
    except httpx.RequestError:
        pass
    try:
        r = await _node_get("/api/user/prefs", token)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            home_bg = r.json().get("home_bg_css") or ""
    except httpx.RequestError:
        pass

    shell = "".join([
        widgets.background_div(home_bg),
        widgets.topbar(user, display_name, is_admin, avatar_url),
        widgets.network_widget(),
        widgets.sysinfo_widget(),
        widgets.vaultix_id_widget(),
        widgets.app_launcher_modal(is_admin),
        widgets.background_picker_modal(),
        widgets.user_profile_modal(user, display_name, avatar_url, is_admin),
        widgets.install_button(),
        widgets.notify_button(),
        widgets.toast_host(),
    ])
    content = explorer.explorer_body(is_admin)
    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, "home.html", {"username": user, "shell": shell, "content": content})

@app.get("/office", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def office_page(request: Request, path: str = ""):
    user = _current_user(request)
    if not user:
        return RedirectResponse("/login", status_code=302)

    token = request.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)
    ctx = {"request": request, "username": user, "path": path,
           "breadcrumb": _breadcrumb(path), "folders": [], "files": [], "error": None}

    try:
        r = await _node_get(f"/api/files?path={quote(path)}", token)
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        ctx["error"] = f"無法連線後端: {e}"
        return templates.TemplateResponse(request, "office.html", ctx)

    if r.status_code != 200:
        ctx["error"] = f"HTTP {r.status_code}"
        return templates.TemplateResponse(request, "office.html", ctx)

    items = r.json().get("items", [])
    ctx["folders"] = [i for i in items if i.get("type") == "folder"]

    files = []
    for i in items:
        if i.get("type") != "file":
            continue
        ext = Path(i["name"]).suffix.lower()
        if ext not in OFFICE_EXT:
            continue
        label, scheme = OFFICE_EXT[ext]
        rel = f"{path}/{i['name']}" if path else i["name"]
        webdav_url = f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/webdav/{'/'.join(quote(p) for p in rel.split('/'))}"
        files.append({
            "name": i["name"],
            "label": label,
            "size": i.get("size"),
            "download_url": f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/api/files/download?path={quote(rel)}&token={token}",
            "open_url": f"{scheme}:ofe|u|{webdav_url}",
        })
    ctx["files"] = files
    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, "office.html", ctx)


@app.get("/files", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def files_page(request: Request, path: str = "", cat: str = "all", q: str = ""):
    user = _current_user(request)
    if not user:
        return RedirectResponse("/login", status_code=302)

    q = q.strip()
    token = request.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)
    ctx = {"request": request, "username": user, "path": path, "cat": cat, "q": q,
           "categories": CATEGORIES,
           "breadcrumb": _breadcrumb(path), "folders": [], "files": [], "error": None}

    try:
        r = await _node_get(f"/api/files?path={quote(path)}", token)
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        ctx["error"] = f"無法連線後端: {e}"
        return templates.TemplateResponse(request, "files.html", ctx)

    if r.status_code != 200:
        ctx["error"] = f"HTTP {r.status_code}"
        return templates.TemplateResponse(request, "files.html", ctx)

    items = r.json().get("items", [])
    ctx["folders"] = [i for i in items if i.get("type") == "folder"]

    q_lower = q.lower()
    files = []
    for i in items:
        if i.get("type") != "file":
            continue
        category = categorize(i["name"])
        if cat != "all" and category != cat:
            continue
        if q_lower and q_lower not in i["name"].lower():
            continue
        rel = f"{path}/{i['name']}" if path else i["name"]
        files.append({
            "name": i["name"],
            "path": rel,
            "category": category,
            "icon": icon_for(i["name"]),
            "size": i.get("size"),
            "download_url": f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/api/files/download?path={quote(rel)}&token={token}",
            "open_kind": viewers.open_kind(i["name"]),
        })
    ctx["files"] = files
    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, "files.html", ctx)


@app.post("/logout")
async def logout():
    # POST + the global X-CSRF header check (not GET) so a cross-site <img>/<a>
    # can't force a logout — see 2026-07-28 CSRF audit.
    resp = JSONResponse({"ok": True, "next": "/login"})
    resp.delete_cookie(COOKIE_NAME, path="/")
    return resp


# ── auth API ─────────────────────────────────────────────
@app.post("/api/login")
async def api_login(request: Request):
    body = await request.json()
    username = body.get("username", "")
    try:
        r = await _node_post("/api/login", {"username": username, "password": body.get("password", "")})
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)

    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return JSONResponse({"error": data.get("error", f"HTTP {r.status_code}")}, status_code=r.status_code)

    # Node's own 2FA (kept working for existing enrollments)
    if data.get("requiresTwoFactor"):
        return JSONResponse({"requiresTwoFactor": True, "method": "node",
                             "tempToken": data["tempToken"], "username": data.get("username")})

    token = data["token"]
    # Password OK → enforce Python-native 2FA if the user enrolled it here.
    status = _tf_status(username)
    if status["totp"] or status["webauthn"]:
        return JSONResponse({"requiresTwoFactor": True, "method": "python",
                             "ticket": _new_ticket(username, token),
                             "totp": status["totp"], "webauthn": status["webauthn"],
                             "username": username})

    resp = JSONResponse({"ok": True, "next": "/home"})
    _set_token_cookie(resp, token)
    return resp


@app.post("/api/2fa/verify")
async def api_2fa_verify(request: Request):
    """Node 2FA path (used only when Node itself required 2FA)."""
    body = await request.json()
    try:
        r = await _node_post("/api/2fa/verify", {"tempToken": body.get("tempToken", ""), "code": body.get("code", "")})
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return JSONResponse({"error": data.get("error", f"HTTP {r.status_code}")}, status_code=r.status_code)
    resp = JSONResponse({"ok": True, "next": "/home"})
    _set_token_cookie(resp, data["token"])
    return resp


@app.post("/api/2fa/totp/login")
async def api_2fa_totp_login(request: Request):
    """Python 2FA path at login: verify the TOTP code against the held ticket."""
    body = await request.json()
    ticket = body.get("ticket", "")
    item = _peek_ticket(ticket)
    if not item:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "驗證階段已過期，請重新登入"}, status_code=400)
    username, token, _ = item
    if not tf.totp_verify(username, body.get("code", "")):
        return JSONResponse({"error": "驗證碼錯誤"}, status_code=401)   # ticket stays valid for retry within TTL
    _pending.pop(ticket, None)
    resp = JSONResponse({"ok": True, "next": "/home"})
    _set_token_cookie(resp, token)
    return resp

# ── home-shell widget proxy API (category 9) ─────────────
@app.get("/api/widgets/status")
async def widgets_status(request: Request):
    token = _token_or_401(request)
    if isinstance(token, JSONResponse):
        return token

    result: dict = {}
    try:
        r = await _node_get("/api/ufw/status", token)
        d = r.json() if r.status_code == 200 else {}
        result["ufw"] = {"active": bool(d.get("active")),
                          "detail": d.get("detail") or ("UFW: Active" if d.get("active") else "UFW: Inactive")}
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        result["ufw"] = {"active": False, "detail": f"UFW: {e}"}

    async def _try(path: str):
        try:
            r = await _node_get(path, token)
            return r.json() if r.status_code == 200 else None
        except httpx.RequestError:
            return None

    fb = await _try("/api/system/fail2ban")
    if fb is not None:
        if fb.get("unavailable"):
            reason = "not installed" if fb.get("reason") == "not_installed" else "unavailable"
            result["fail2ban"] = {"ok": True, "detail": f"Fail2ban: {reason}"}
        else:
            jails = fb.get("jails", [])
            banned = sum(j.get("banned", 0) for j in jails)
            result["fail2ban"] = {"ok": True, "detail": f"Fail2ban: {len(jails)} jail(s), {banned} banned"}

    svc = await _try("/api/system/services")
    if svc is not None:
        pm2 = svc.get("pm2") or {}
        pm2_ok = pm2.get("total", 0) > 0 and pm2.get("online") == pm2.get("total")
        result["services"] = {
            "docker": bool(svc.get("docker")), "docker_detail": "Docker: running" if svc.get("docker") else "Docker: not running",
            "ftp": bool(svc.get("ftp")), "ftp_detail": "FTP: running" if svc.get("ftp") else "FTP: not running",
            "sftp": bool(svc.get("sftp")), "sftp_detail": "SFTP: available" if svc.get("sftp") else "SFTP: unavailable",
            "smb": bool(svc.get("samba")), "smb_detail": "SMB: running" if svc.get("samba") else "SMB: not running",
            "webdav": bool(svc.get("webdav")), "webdav_detail": "WebDAV: available" if svc.get("webdav") else "WebDAV: unavailable",
            "pm2_ok": pm2_ok, "pm2_detail": f"PM2: {pm2.get('online', 0)}/{pm2.get('total', 0)} online",
        }

    sec = await _try("/api/security/scan")
    if sec is not None:
        s = sec.get("summary", {})
        result["security"] = {"fail": s.get("fail", 0),
                               "detail": f"Security: score {sec.get('score')} ({s.get('pass', 0)} pass, {s.get('warn', 0)} warn, {s.get('fail', 0)} fail)"}

    return JSONResponse(result)

@app.post("/api/widgets/avatar")
async def widgets_avatar(request: Request, avatar: UploadFile = File(...)):
    token = _token_or_401(request)
    if isinstance(token, JSONResponse):
        return token
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20) as client:
            r = await client.post(f"{NODE_API}/api/user/avatar",
                                   headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
                                   files={"avatar": (avatar.filename, await avatar.read(), avatar.content_type)})
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)


@app.get("/api/widgets/browse")
async def widgets_browse(request: Request, path: str = ""):
    token = _token_or_401(request)
    if isinstance(token, JSONResponse):
        return token
    try:
        r = await _node_get(f"/api/files?path={quote(path)}", token)
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status_code=r.status_code)
    items = r.json().get("items", [])
    folders = [i["name"] for i in items if i.get("type") == "folder"]
    images = []
    for i in items:
        if i.get("type") != "file" or categorize(i["name"]) != "image":
            continue
        rel = f"{path}/{i['name']}" if path else i["name"]
        images.append({"name": i["name"], "path": rel,
                        "url": f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/api/files/download?path={quote(rel)}&token={token}"})
    return JSONResponse({"folders": folders, "images": images})

@app.post("/api/widgets/background/upload")
async def widgets_background_upload(request: Request, file: UploadFile = File(...)):
    """Uploads a wallpaper image into .vaultix/background/ (same convention as
    the React app's VaultixPrefs.bg_path) and returns its download URL, ready
    to hand straight to /api/widgets/prefs as home_bg_css."""
    token = _token_or_401(request)
    if isinstance(token, JSONResponse):
        return token
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20) as client:
            r = await client.post(
                f"{NODE_API}/api/files/upload",
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
                data={"path": ".vaultix/background"},
                files={"files": (file.filename, await file.read(), file.content_type)},
            )
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    if r.status_code not in (200, 201):
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"上傳失敗 HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status_code=r.status_code)
    rel = f".vaultix/background/{file.filename}"
    url = f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/api/files/download?path={quote(rel)}&token={token}"
    return JSONResponse({"ok": True, "url": url})

def visible_apps(is_admin: bool) -> list[dict]:
    return [a for a in BUILTIN_APPS if is_admin or not a["admin_only"]]


def icon_svg(app_id: str) -> str:
    stroke = _ICON.get(app_id, "")
    fill = next((a["fill"] for a in BUILTIN_APPS if a["id"] == app_id), False)
    attrs = 'fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"' if fill else 'fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"'
    return f'<svg class="app-icon" {attrs}>{stroke}</svg>'

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/camera.py
"""Camera system — Python port of components/Camera.tsx (445 lines, category
4 batch 4f, the last file in this category). Unlike its sibling in this
batch (FileConverter) and the two previous batches (4d's AI subtitle, 4e's
whole editor), this feature's backend is fully implemented: GET/POST
/api/cameras, PUT/DELETE /api/cameras/{id}, GET /api/cameras/{id}/stream
(ffmpeg MJPEG proxy) and /snapshot all exist and work on the real server.py.

The MJPEG stream itself is not proxied through this Python frontend — same
as every download_url elsewhere in this migration, the browser's <img> tag
points directly at NODE_PUBLIC_URL with a ?token= query param (verified
against the real backend's _IdentityMiddleware in batch 4a). This module
adds stream_url/snapshot_url fields server-side (token embedded) onto the
/api/cameras response so camera.js never handles the raw token.
"""
from urllib.parse import quote

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, RedirectResponse

from admin_shell import NODE_PUBLIC_URL, is_admin, node_get, node_json, token as _token, username as _username

router = APIRouter()


def _no_login():
    return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)


def _with_urls(cam: dict, tok: str) -> dict:
    cam = dict(cam)
    cam["stream_url"] = f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/api/cameras/{quote(str(cam['id']))}/stream?token={tok}"
    cam["snapshot_url"] = f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/api/cameras/{quote(str(cam['id']))}/snapshot?token={tok}"
    return cam


@router.get("/tools/camera", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def camera_page(request: Request):
    tok = _token(request)
    user = _username(tok) if tok else None
    if not user:
        return RedirectResponse("/login", status_code=302)
    is_admin_user = is_admin(tok)
    return f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-Hant">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>Camera System — Vaultix NAS</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/style.css"/>
</head>
<body class="shell">
  <script>window.CAMERA_IS_ADMIN = {"true" if is_admin_user else "false"};</script>
  <div id="cmRoot"></div>
  <script src="/static/camera.js"></script>
</body>
</html>"""


@router.get("/api/cameras")
async def cameras_list(request: Request):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    r = await node_get("/api/cameras", tok)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status_code=r.status_code)
    cams = r.json()
    return JSONResponse([_with_urls(c, tok) for c in cams])


@router.post("/api/cameras")
async def cameras_create(request: Request):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    body = await request.json()
    return await node_json("POST", "/api/cameras", tok, body)


@router.put("/api/cameras/{cam_id}")
async def cameras_update(request: Request, cam_id: str):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    body = await request.json()
    return await node_json("PUT", f"/api/cameras/{quote(cam_id)}", tok, body)


@router.delete("/api/cameras/{cam_id}")
async def cameras_delete(request: Request, cam_id: str):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    return await node_json("DELETE", f"/api/cameras/{quote(cam_id)}", tok)

# register: bcrypt automatic to add slate.
hashed = bcrypt.hashpw(pwd.encode(), bcrypt.gensalt(12))
# login check
bcrypt.checkpw(pwd.encode(), hashed)
if totp_secret and not verify(user_name):

# 
conn.commit()
# close the conntion
conn.close()

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/connection/pwd_2FA_check.py
"""
pwd_2FA_check.py — Unified two-factor authentication for Vaultix NAS (Python frontend).
Module name `pwd_2FA_check` is a valid identifier → `from pwd_2FA_check import TwoFactor`.

FOUR verification methods, all in this one module:
    1. TOTP code         — authenticator-app code (Google Authenticator, Authy, …)
    2. QR code           — enrollment: renders the otpauth:// URI as a scannable QR
    3. Phone fingerprint ┐  both are WebAuthn *platform* authenticators — the SAME
    4. Windows Hello     ┘  server code path; the browser performs the biometric.

Design notes
------------
- Web-oriented: NO input(). Import the `TwoFactor` class into the FastAPI frontend
  (frontend-py/app.py) and wire each method to a route. The browser does the biometric
  for methods 3/4 via `navigator.credentials`; this module only issues challenges and
  verifies responses.
- Self-contained: TOTP secrets + WebAuthn credentials live in a local SQLite DB.
- Keyed by `username` (the caller passes the logged-in user).
- Enrollment QR / secret expires after `provision_ttl` seconds (default 180 = 3 min):
  a provisioned-but-not-yet-enabled secret can't be confirmed after it lapses.
- This is a SEPARATE 2FA store from the Node backend's own 2FA (by design, per the
  "Python owns 2FA" request). Existing Node enrollments do not carry over.

Dependencies:  pip install pyotp "qrcode[pil]" webauthn
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import io
import json
import os
import sqlite3
import time

import pyotp
import qrcode
from cryptography.fernet import Fernet

from webauthn import (
    generate_registration_options,
    verify_registration_response,
    generate_authentication_options,
    verify_authentication_response,
    options_to_json,
)
from webauthn.helpers import bytes_to_base64url, base64url_to_bytes
from webauthn.helpers.structs import (
    AuthenticatorSelectionCriteria,
    AuthenticatorAttachment,
    ResidentKeyRequirement,
    UserVerificationRequirement,
    PublicKeyCredentialDescriptor,
)


class TwoFactor:
    # NOTE: the user asked for 4-digit TOTP, but standard authenticator apps only
    # display 6 digits. Change to 4 ONLY if your app supports non-standard digits.
    TOTP_DIGITS = 6

    def __init__(
        self,
        db_path: str = "2fa.db",
        rp_id: str = "localhost",
        rp_name: str = "Vaultix NAS",
        origin: str = "http://localhost:8001",
        challenge_ttl: int = 300,
        provision_ttl: int = 180,   # enrollment QR/secret valid for 3 minutes
        secret_key: str | bytes | None = None,
    ):
        """
        rp_id      : the site's domain WITHOUT scheme/port, e.g. "raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net"
        origin     : full origin the browser sees, e.g. "https://raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net:8444"
        secret_key : Fernet key for encrypting TOTP secrets at rest (see _load_key).
        """
        self.db_path = db_path
        self.rp_id = rp_id
        self.rp_name = rp_name
        self.origin = origin
        self.challenge_ttl = challenge_ttl
        self.provision_ttl = provision_ttl
        self._fernet = Fernet(self._load_key(secret_key))
        self._challenges: dict[str, tuple[bytes, float]] = {}  # username -> (challenge, expiry)
        self._init_db()

    # ── at-rest encryption for TOTP secrets ──────────────
    def _load_key(self, secret_key) -> bytes:
        """Fernet key priority: explicit arg → env TFA_KEY → a key file beside the DB
        (auto-created, chmod 600). In-memory DBs get an ephemeral per-process key."""
        if secret_key:
            return secret_key.encode() if isinstance(secret_key, str) else secret_key
        env = os.environ.get("TFA_KEY")
        if env:
            return env.encode()
        key_path = None if self.db_path == ":memory:" else self.db_path + ".key"
        if key_path and os.path.exists(key_path):
            return open(key_path, "rb").read()
        key = Fernet.generate_key()
        if key_path:
            with open(key_path, "wb") as f:
                f.write(key)
            try:
                os.chmod(key_path, 0o600)
            except OSError:
                pass
        return key

    def _enc(self, secret: str) -> str:
        return self._fernet.encrypt(secret.encode()).decode()

    def _dec(self, token: str) -> str:
        return self._fernet.decrypt(token.encode()).decode()

    # ── storage ──────────────────────────────────────────
    def _db(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        return conn

    def _init_db(self) -> None:
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS totp (
                    username      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    secret        TEXT NOT NULL,
                    enabled       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    provisioned_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
                )
            """)
            db.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webauthn_creds (
                    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    username      TEXT NOT NULL,
                    credential_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,   -- base64url
                    public_key    TEXT NOT NULL,          -- base64url
                    sign_count    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    label         TEXT,
                    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                )
            """)

    # ── challenge cache (options → verify) ───────────────
    def _put_challenge(self, username: str, challenge: bytes) -> None:
        self._challenges[username] = (challenge, time.time() + self.challenge_ttl)

    def _pop_challenge(self, username: str) -> bytes:
        item = self._challenges.pop(username, None)
        if not item or item[1] < time.time():
            raise ValueError("challenge expired or missing — restart the flow")
        return item[0]

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    #  Method 1 & 2 — TOTP  (+ QR code for enrollment)
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    def totp_provision(self, username: str) -> dict:
        """Create/replace a TOTP secret (disabled until confirmed) and return the
        otpauth URI + a scannable QR code (PNG data-URI). Method 2 = the QR.
        The QR/secret must be confirmed within `provision_ttl` seconds."""
        secret = pyotp.random_base32()
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO totp (username, secret, enabled, provisioned_at) VALUES (?, ?, 0, ?) "
                "ON CONFLICT(username) DO UPDATE SET secret = excluded.secret, "
                "enabled = 0, provisioned_at = excluded.provisioned_at",
                (username, self._enc(secret), time.time()),
            )
        uri = pyotp.TOTP(secret, digits=self.TOTP_DIGITS).provisioning_uri(
            name=username, issuer_name=self.rp_name
        )
        return {"secret": secret, "uri": uri, "qr": self._qr_data_uri(uri),
                "expires_in": self.provision_ttl}

    def totp_enable(self, username: str, code: str) -> bool:
        """Confirm enrollment: verify the first code within the QR validity window,
        then mark enabled."""
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute(
                "SELECT secret, provisioned_at FROM totp WHERE username = ?", (username,)
            ).fetchone()
        if not row:
            return False
        if time.time() - row["provisioned_at"] > self.provision_ttl:
            return False  # QR expired — call totp_provision again
        if not pyotp.TOTP(self._dec(row["secret"]), digits=self.TOTP_DIGITS).verify(
            str(code).replace(" ", ""), valid_window=1
        ):
            return False
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute("UPDATE totp SET enabled = 1 WHERE username = ?", (username,))
        return True

    def totp_verify(self, username: str, code: str) -> bool:
        """Method 1 — verify a TOTP code at login (must be enabled)."""
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute(
                "SELECT secret, enabled FROM totp WHERE username = ?", (username,)
            ).fetchone()
        if not row or not row["enabled"]:
            return False
        return pyotp.TOTP(self._dec(row["secret"]), digits=self.TOTP_DIGITS).verify(
            str(code).replace(" ", ""), valid_window=1
        )

    def totp_disable(self, username: str) -> None:
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute("DELETE FROM totp WHERE username = ?", (username,))

    def totp_status(self, username: str) -> bool:
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute(
                "SELECT enabled FROM totp WHERE username = ?", (username,)
            ).fetchone()
        return bool(row and row["enabled"])

    @staticmethod
    def _qr_data_uri(data: str) -> str:
        img = qrcode.make(data)
        buf = io.BytesIO()
        img.save(buf, format="PNG")
        b64 = base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()
        return f"data:image/png;base64,{b64}"

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    #  Method 3 & 4 — WebAuthn  (phone fingerprint / Windows Hello)
    #  Same code path; both are *platform* authenticators. `label` lets the
    #  caller name the device (e.g. "iPhone", "Windows Hello").
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    def webauthn_register_options(self, username: str) -> str:
        """Return registration options (JSON string) for the browser to pass to
        navigator.credentials.create(). Platform authenticator = built-in biometric."""
        existing = self._get_creds(username)
        opts = generate_registration_options(
            rp_id=self.rp_id,
            rp_name=self.rp_name,
            user_name=username,
            user_id=username.encode(),
            exclude_credentials=[
                PublicKeyCredentialDescriptor(id=base64url_to_bytes(c["credential_id"]))
                for c in existing
            ],
            authenticator_selection=AuthenticatorSelectionCriteria(
                authenticator_attachment=AuthenticatorAttachment.PLATFORM,
                resident_key=ResidentKeyRequirement.PREFERRED,
                user_verification=UserVerificationRequirement.REQUIRED,
            ),
        )
        self._put_challenge(username, opts.challenge)
        return options_to_json(opts)

    def webauthn_register_verify(self, username: str, credential, label: str | None = None) -> bool:
        """Verify navigator.credentials.create() result and store the credential.
        `credential` = the JSON (str or dict) the browser returned."""
        challenge = self._pop_challenge(username)
        verification = verify_registration_response(
            credential=credential,
            expected_challenge=challenge,
            expected_rp_id=self.rp_id,
            expected_origin=self.origin,
            require_user_verification=True,
        )
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO webauthn_creds "
                "(username, credential_id, public_key, sign_count, label) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (
                    username,
                    bytes_to_base64url(verification.credential_id),
                    bytes_to_base64url(verification.credential_public_key),
                    verification.sign_count,
                    label,
                ),
            )
        return True

    def webauthn_auth_options(self, username: str) -> str:
        """Return authentication options (JSON string) for navigator.credentials.get()."""
        creds = self._get_creds(username)
        if not creds:
            raise ValueError("no registered authenticator for this user")
        opts = generate_authentication_options(
            rp_id=self.rp_id,
            allow_credentials=[
                PublicKeyCredentialDescriptor(id=base64url_to_bytes(c["credential_id"]))
                for c in creds
            ],
            user_verification=UserVerificationRequirement.REQUIRED,
        )
        self._put_challenge(username, opts.challenge)
        return options_to_json(opts)

    def webauthn_auth_verify(self, username: str, credential) -> bool:
        """Verify navigator.credentials.get() result at login; bump the sign counter."""
        challenge = self._pop_challenge(username)
        cred_dict = credential if isinstance(credential, dict) else json.loads(credential)
        row = self._get_cred_by_id(cred_dict["id"])
        if not row or row["username"] != username:
            return False
        verification = verify_authentication_response(
            credential=credential,
            expected_challenge=challenge,
            expected_rp_id=self.rp_id,
            expected_origin=self.origin,
            credential_public_key=base64url_to_bytes(row["public_key"]),
            credential_current_sign_count=row["sign_count"],
            require_user_verification=True,
        )
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute(
                "UPDATE webauthn_creds SET sign_count = ? WHERE credential_id = ?",
                (verification.new_sign_count, row["credential_id"]),
            )
        return True

    def webauthn_status(self, username: str) -> dict:
        creds = self._get_creds(username)
        return {
            "registered": len(creds) > 0,
            "devices": [{"label": c["label"], "created_at": c["created_at"]} for c in creds],
        }

    def _get_creds(self, username: str) -> list[dict]:
        with self._db() as db:
            return [dict(r) for r in db.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM webauthn_creds WHERE username = ?", (username,)
            ).fetchall()]

    def _get_cred_by_id(self, credential_id: str) -> dict | None:
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM webauthn_creds WHERE credential_id = ?", (credential_id,)
            ).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row else None


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Quick offline self-test for the TOTP path (no browser needed).
    tf = TwoFactor(db_path=":memory:")
    info = tf.totp_provision("demo")
    print("otpauth URI:", info["uri"])
    code_now = pyotp.TOTP(info["secret"], digits=TwoFactor.TOTP_DIGITS).now()
    print("enable:", tf.totp_enable("demo", code_now))
    print("verify:", tf.totp_verify("demo", pyotp.TOTP(info["secret"], digits=TwoFactor.TOTP_DIGITS).now()))
    print("status:", tf.totp_status("demo"))

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/connection/server.py
# browser (HTML+JS) <--HTTP--> aiohttp (python) <--asyncpg--> PostgreSQL

# API:
# POST /api/register → register
# POST /api/login    → login

import os
from pathlib import Path

from aiohttp import web
import asyncpg
from dotenv import load_dotenv

BASE = Path(__file__).parent

# === read .env ("")

load_dotenv(BASE / ".env")

DB_CONFIG = {
    "host": os.getenv(""),
    "port": os.getenv(""),
    "database": os.getenv(""),
    "user": os.getenv(""),
}
SERVER_PORT = int(os.getenv("SERVER_PORT", 8001))

# conntion pool: aiohttp is async, use pool will be not need to hand per connection.
pool: asyncpg.pool | None = None

#  === database init ===
async def create_db():
    """program are start to create users tbale"""
    async with pool.acquire() as conn:
        await conn.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users(
                id      SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
                username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                password TEXT NOT NULL
            )
        """)

# === HTTP handlers ===
async def home_page(request):
    return web.FileResponse(BASE / "static/index.html")

async def api_login(request):
    """
    POST /api/register  body: {"username": "...", "password": "..."}
    """
    data = await request.json()
    username = str(data.get("username", "")).strip()
    pwd = str(data.get("password", ""))

    if not username or not pwd:
        return web.json_response({"ok": False, "error": "please enter the account and password."}, state=400)

    async with pool.acquire() as conn:
        row = await conn.fetchrow(
            "SELECT password FROM users WHERE username=$1",
            username,
        )

async def api_sign_in(request):
    """
    POST /api/register  body: {"username": "...", "password": "..."}
    """
    data = await request.json()
    username = str(data.get("username", "")).strip()
    pwd = str(data.get("password", ""))

    if not username or not pwd:
        return web.json_response({"ok": False, "error": "account and password can't be empty."}, status=400)
    if len(username) > 20 or len(pwd) > 50:
        return web.json_response({"ok": False, "error": "accout ≤ 20 char, password ≤ 50 char."}, status=400)

    async with pool.acquire() as conn:
        try:
            #
            await conn.excute(
                "INSERT INTO users(username, pwd) VALUES($1, $2)",
                username, pwd
            )
        except asyncpg.UnicodeDecodeError:
            return web.json_response({"ok": False, "error": "this account are sin up."}, status=400)
    return web.json_response({"ok": True, "message": "this account are sin up."}, status=401)

# live week
async def on_startup(app):
    global pool
    try:
        pool = await asyncpg.create_pool(**DB_CONFIG, min_size=1, max_size=5)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[error] disconnect sqlite3: {e}")
        print(f"    setting: host={DB_CONFIG['host']} port={DB_CONFIG['port']} db={DB_CONFIG['database']} user={DB_CONFIG['user']}")
        raise
    await create_db()
    print(f"connction sqlite3 {DB_CONFIG['host']}:{DB_CONFIG['port']}/{DB_CONFIG['database']}")

async def on_cleanup(app):
    if pool:
        await pool.close()

def main():
    app = web.Application()
    app.router.add_get("/", home_page)
    app.router.add_post("/api/register", api_sign_in)
    app.router.add_post("/api/login", api_login)
    app.on_startup.append(on_startup)
    app.on_cleanup.append(on_cleanup)

    print(f"Server about with http://127.0.0.1:{SERVER_PORT}/ (Ctrl+C to stop)")
    web.run_app(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=SERVER_PORT)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

<main>
  <header>

<script>
  const targetsEl = document.getElementById('targets');
  const consoleEl = document.getElementById('console');
  const deviceInfoEl = document.getElementById('deviceInfo');

  let targets = ['https://vaultix-nas.web.app/'];
  let logCount = 0;

  function renderTargets() {
    targetsEl.innerHTML = '';
    targets.forEach((url, i) => {
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'target-row';
      const input = document.createElement('input');
      input.value = url;
      input.readOnly = true;
      const del = document.createElement('button');
      del.textContent = '✕';
      del.title = '移除';
      del.onclick = () => { targets.splice(i, 1); renderTargets(); };
      row.appendChild(input);
      row.appendChild(del);
      targetsEl.appendChild(row);
    });
  }

  document.getElementById('addBtn').onclick = () => {
    const input = document.getElementById('newUrl');
    const v = input.value.trim();
    if (!v) return;
    targets.push(v);
    input.value = '';
    renderTargets();
  };
  document.getElementById('newUrl').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); document.getElementById('addBtn').click(); }
  });

  function log(html) {
    if (logCount === 0) consoleEl.innerHTML = '';
    logCount++;
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'entry';
    div.innerHTML = html;
    consoleEl.appendChild(div);
    consoleEl.scrollTop = consoleEl.scrollHeight;
  }

  function timestamp() {
    const d = new Date();
    return d.toTimeString().slice(0, 8);
  }

  async function probe(url, mode) {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 8000);
    const t0 = performance.now();
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal, mode, cache: 'no-store' });
      const elapsed = performance.now() - t0;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      return { ok: true, elapsed, status: mode === 'no-cors' ? '(opaque)' : res.status };
    } catch (err) {
      const elapsed = performance.now() - t0;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      return { ok: false, elapsed, name: err.name, message: err.message, aborted: err.name === 'AbortError' };
    }
  }

  async function runTest(url) {
    log(`<div class="line1"><span class="tag tag-run">執行中</span><span class="meta">${timestamp()}</span><span class="url">${url}</span></div>`);

    const main = await probe(url, 'cors');

    if (main.ok) {
      log(`<div class="line1"><span class="tag tag-ok">成功</span><span class="meta">${timestamp()} · ${main.elapsed.toFixed(0)}ms · HTTP ${main.status}</span></div><div class="url">${url}</div>`);
      return;
    }

    let diagnosis;
    if (main.aborted) {
      diagnosis = '逾時（8 秒無回應）→ 很可能是真的連不到伺服器：檢查 NAS 是否開機、防火牆規則，或路由器的 Port Forward 設定。';
    } else if (main.elapsed < 150) {
      const noCors = await probe(url, 'no-cors');
      if (noCors.ok) {
        diagnosis = 'CORS 問題 → 伺服器有回應，但沒有回傳允許此網域讀取的標頭（Access-Control-Allow-Origin）。需要在伺服器端加上 CORS 設定。';
      } else {
        diagnosis = '瀏覽器主動封鎖 → 很可能是 Mixed Content（頁面是 https，但這個網址是 http）或 Private Network Access（Chromium 系瀏覽器禁止公開網站連到區網私有 IP，Samsung Internet 可能比電腦版執行得更嚴格）。';
      }
    } else {
      diagnosis = 'DNS 或連線層級失敗 → 網域可能解析不到、伺服器拒絕連線，或中間有防火牆擋掉。';
    }

    log(`<div class="line1"><span class="tag tag-bad">失敗</span><span class="meta">${timestamp()} · ${main.elapsed.toFixed(0)}ms · ${main.name}: ${main.message}</span></div><div class="url">${url}</div><div class="diag">→ ${diagnosis}</div>`);
  }

  document.getElementById('runAll').onclick = async () => {
    for (const url of targets) {
      await runTest(url);
    }
  };

  document.getElementById('clearLog').onclick = () => {
    logCount = 0;
    consoleEl.innerHTML = '<span class="empty">尚未執行測試。</span>';
  };

  document.getElementById('copyLog').onclick = async () => {
    const text = consoleEl.innerText;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      const btn = document.getElementById('copyLog');
      const orig = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = '已複製';
      setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = orig; }, 1200);
    } catch (e) {
      alert('無法自動複製，請手動選取紀錄文字複製。');
    }
  };

  function fillDeviceInfo() {
    const rows = [
      ['目前網址', location.href],
      ['協定', location.protocol],
      ['User Agent', navigator.userAgent],
      ['是否在線 (navigator.onLine)', navigator.onLine ? '是' : '否'],
    ];
    if (navigator.connection) {
      rows.push(['網路類型', navigator.connection.effectiveType || '未知']);
    }
    deviceInfoEl.innerHTML = rows.map(([k, v]) => `<dt>${k}</dt><dd>${v}</dd>`).join('');
  }

  renderTargets();
  fillDeviceInfo();
</script>
</body>
</html>

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/dev_tools.py
"""Dev tool launcher panels — Python port of 7 near-identical "link list"
components: AndroidStudio.tsx, ArduinoIDE.tsx, Circuit.tsx, KiCadPanel.tsx,
QuartusPanel.tsx, VisualStudio.tsx, OpenClawPanel.tsx (sub-batch 7a of
category 7, the first of category 7's sub-batches — Anaconda.tsx is 7b,
terminal.tsx is 7c).

Scope finding (confirmed by reading all 7 in full before writing code): every
one is the exact same shape — header badge, a list of external links (icon +
label + sub-label, opens in a new tab), an optional footer note / info box —
differing only in copy, accent color, and link data. That's the same
"read first, confirm real duplication, merge" call as 8d's Reels/TelegramReels
(and even stronger evidence here: 7 files, not 2). So this is ONE
parameterized page route + a TOOLS config table, not 7 near-duplicate files.

OpenClawPanel.tsx is, despite its filename, actually the "Claude AI" panel
(header says "Claude AI — Anthropic AI Assistant & Claude Code") — its data
maps onto the `claude` id that already exists in builtin_apps.py, so no new
app-launcher entry was added for it; the existing entry's route is wired to
this module instead of creating a duplicate tile.

None of these 7 use useLang()/translation keys in the source (confirmed by
survey — only Quartus among category 7 happened to be i18n'd, the rest are
100% hardcoded English) — no i18n scaffolding is added here since frontend-py
has no language-toggle mechanism yet, consistent with plain-English pages
shipped elsewhere in this migration (downloader.py, tools_remote_desktop.py).
"""

def _icon(d: str, fill: bool = False, sw: str = "1.5") -> str:
    if fill:
        return f'<svg class="w-5 h-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="{d}"/></svg>'
    return f'<svg class="w-5 h-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="{sw}" d="{d}"/></svg>'

def _link_row(link: dict, accent: str) -> str:
    primary = link["primary"]
    icon_html = f'<span class="dt-link-icon">{link["icon"]}</span>' if link["icon"] else ""
    style = f'style="--dt-accent:{accent}"' if primary else ""
    return f"""<a class="dt-link{' primary' if primary else ''}" href="{esc(link['url'])}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" {style}>
      {icon_html}
      <span class="dt-link-body"><span class="dt-link-label">{esc(link['label'])}</span><span class="dt-link-sub">{esc(link['sub'])}</span></span>
      <span class="dt-link-chevron">{ICO_EXTLINK}</span>
    </a>"""


def _render_page(tool_id: str) -> str:
    t = TOOLS[tool_id]
    links_html = "".join(_link_row(l, t["accent"]) for l in t["links"])
    footer_html = f'<p class="dt-footer">{t["footer"]}</p>' if t["footer"] else ""
    info_html = f'''<div class="dt-infobox">
      <svg class="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="margin-top:2px">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M11.25 11.25l.041-.02a.75.75 0 011.063.852l-.708 2.836a.75.75 0 001.063.853l.041-.021M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0zm-9-3.75h.008v.008H12V8.25z" />
      </svg>
      <p>{t["info_box"]}</p></div>''' if t["info_box"] else ""
    return f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-Hant">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>{esc(t['title'])} — Vaultix NAS</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/style.css"/>
</head>
<body class="shell dt-shell">
  <div class="dt-card">
    <div class="dt-head">
      <div class="dt-head-left">
        <div class="dt-badge" style="background:{t['gradient']}">{t['header_icon']}</div>
        <div><p class="dt-title">{esc(t['title'])}</p><p class="hint">{esc(t['subtitle'])}</p></div>
      </div>
      <a class="icon-btn" href="/home" title="Close">×</a>
    </div>
    {info_html}
    <div class="dt-links">{links_html}</div>
    {footer_html}
  </div>
</body>
</html>"""


async def _tool_page(tool_id: str, request: Request):
    tok = _token(request)
    user = _username(tok) if tok else None
    if not user:
        return RedirectResponse("/login", status_code=302)
    return HTMLResponse(_render_page(tool_id))

@router.post("/api/downloader/cookies/upload")
async def dl_cookies_upload(request: Request, cookies: UploadFile = File(...)):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20) as client:
            r = await client.post(
                f"{NODE_API}/api/ytdl/cookies/upload",
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}"},
                files={"cookies": (cookies.filename, await cookies.read(), cookies.content_type)},
            )
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)


@router.get("/api/downloader/browse")
async def dl_browse(request: Request, path: str = ""):
    """Folder-only listing for the save-folder picker (mirrors widgets.py's
    /api/widgets/browse, but folders only — no image filtering needed here)."""
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    try:
        r = await node_get(f"/api/files?path={quote(path)}", tok)
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status_code=r.status_code)
    items = r.json().get("items", [])
    folders = [i["name"] for i in items if i.get("type") == "folder"]
    return JSONResponse({"folders": folders})

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/edit_video.py
"""Video editor — Python port of components/EditVideo.tsx (887 lines,
category 4 batch 4e). CapCut-style multi-clip timeline: trim in/out points,
speed control, text overlay preview (canvas), audio track overlay, async
export job with progress polling.

Known pre-existing gap, more serious than 4d's (not introduced by this
port): grepping the live Pi server.py for "api/video" finds **zero** matches
for /api/video/info, /api/video/export or /api/video/export/{jobId} — none
of this feature's backend has ever been implemented, in Node or Python.
Concretely: `addVideoClip()` (the function that runs the instant you click a
video file) calls GET /api/video/info to get its duration — that call 404s,
so the clip is never added to the timeline and the editor never advances
past the file-picker dialog in production today. This module ports the
entire UI faithfully anyway (same reasoning as the AI-subtitle gap in
video_app.py: thin proxies that relay whatever the backend does, not a
silent fix, not a regression) so that the day someone implements the ffmpeg
export backend, the frontend is already there and correct.

File listing (browse dialog + destination picker) is real and works today —
only /api/video/info and /api/video/export are the missing pieces.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, RedirectResponse

from admin_shell import NODE_PUBLIC_URL, node_get, node_json, token as _token, username as _username

router = APIRouter()

VIDEO_EXTS = {".mp4", ".mov", ".avi", ".mkv", ".webm", ".m4v", ".3gp", ".flv", ".wmv"}
AUDIO_EXTS = {".mp3", ".aac", ".wav", ".flac", ".m4a", ".ogg"}


def _is_video(name: str) -> bool:
    return Path(name).suffix.lower() in VIDEO_EXTS


def _is_audio(name: str) -> bool:
    return Path(name).suffix.lower() in AUDIO_EXTS


def _download_url(path: str, tok: str) -> str:
    return f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/api/files/download?path={quote(path)}&token={tok}"


def _no_login():
    return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)


@router.get("/tools/editvideo", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def edit_video_page(request: Request):
    tok = _token(request)
    user = _username(tok) if tok else None
    if not user:
        return RedirectResponse("/login", status_code=302)
    return """<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-Hant">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>Video Editor — Vaultix NAS</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/style.css"/>
</head>
<body class="shell">
  <div id="evRoot"></div>
  <script src="/static/edit_video.js"></script>
</body>
</html>"""


@router.get("/api/editvideo/list")
async def editvideo_list(request: Request, path: str = ""):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    r = await node_get(f"/api/files?path={quote(path)}", tok)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status_code=r.status_code)
    items = r.json().get("items", [])
    folders = [{"name": i["name"]} for i in items if i.get("type") == "folder"]
    videos, audios = [], []
    for i in items:
        if i.get("type") != "file":
            continue
        name = i["name"]
        rel = f"{path}/{name}" if path else name
        if _is_video(name):
            videos.append({"name": name, "path": rel, "download_url": _download_url(rel, tok)})
        elif _is_audio(name):
            audios.append({"name": name, "path": rel, "download_url": _download_url(rel, tok)})
    return JSONResponse({"folders": folders, "videos": videos, "audios": audios})

    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/explorer.py
"""Core file explorer API — Python port of Category 3 (檔案總管核心)'s
non-app-launcher logic from home.tsx, plus SearchBar.tsx.

Split from the existing milestone-1 `/files` page (app.py, kept as-is —
category 4a already extended it with PDF/text "open" buttons) because
`/files` is a plain server-rendered category browser with full-page-reload
links, while this module gives `/home` a real client-driven explorer
(upload queue, multi-select, drag-drop move/copy, context menu, rename,
search) matching what home.tsx actually did. The page body itself is built
by explorer_body() below and injected into home.html's `.home-content`
placeholder by app.py's home_page().

Three endpoints in here (ocr index/index-folder/search) are honest thin
proxies to routes that do NOT exist on the real backend — confirmed by SSH
grep against the Pi's live server.py, which only has a single synchronous
`POST /api/ocr` (one-shot tesseract extract), not the index/search pair
home.tsx's context menu and SearchBar call. This is the same kind of
pre-existing "front-end complete, backend never built" gap already found
and documented three times in category 4 (AI subtitle, video editor,
file converter) — ported as-is, not fixed, not hidden, per that same
precedent (see websites/CLAUDE.md category 4 notes).
"""
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from admin_shell import NODE_API, NODE_PUBLIC_URL, node_get, node_json, token as _token
from file_filter import categorize, icon_for
import viewers

router = APIRouter()
