def _no_login():
    return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)


def _download_url(path: str, tok: str) -> str:
    return f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/api/files/download?path={quote(path)}&token={tok}"


# ── browser-facing listing (JSON; distinct from app.py's server-rendered
#    /files page, which stays untouched) ───────────────────────────────
@router.get("/api/files")
async def files_list(request: Request, path: str = ""):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    r = await node_get(f"/api/files?path={quote(path)}", tok)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status_code=r.status_code)
    items = r.json().get("items", [])
    out = []
    for i in items:
        rel = f"{path}/{i['name']}" if path else i["name"]
        entry = {"name": i["name"], "type": i.get("type"), "modified": i.get("modified"),
                  "isMount": bool(i.get("isMount"))}
        if i.get("type") == "file":
            cat = categorize(i["name"])
            entry.update({
                "size": i.get("size"), "category": cat, "icon": icon_for(i["name"]),
                "download_url": _download_url(rel, tok),
                "open_kind": viewers.open_kind(i["name"]),
            })
        else:
            # Folder download (zip) — the real backend already zips a
            # directory download server-side (context menu's "下載（壓縮為
            # zip）" in the original home.tsx used the same download_url shape).
            entry["download_url"] = _download_url(rel, tok)
        out.append(entry)
    return JSONResponse({"items": out})


@router.delete("/api/files")
async def files_delete(request: Request, path: str):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30) as client:
        try:
            r = await client.delete(f"{NODE_API}/api/files?path={quote(path)}",
                                     headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}"})
        except httpx.RequestError as e:
            return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)

@router.post("/api/files/upload")
async def files_upload(request: Request):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    path = request.query_params.get("path", "")
    body = await request.body()
    content_type = request.headers.get("content-type", "")
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=300) as client:
        try:
            r = await client.post(
                f"{NODE_API}/api/files/upload?path={quote(path)}",
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}", "Content-Type": content_type},
                content=body,
            )
        except httpx.RequestError as e:
            return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)

# ── terminal `*.app` bridge — lets the already-built terminal.js
#    BroadcastChannel("nas-terminal-bus") "open-app" message (from the
#    original home.tsx handleLaunchBuiltin dispatch) resolve to a real
#    frontend-py route. ────────────────────────────────────────────────
@router.get("/api/explorer/app-route/{app_id}")
async def app_route_lookup(app_id: str):
    from builtin_apps import BUILTIN_APPS
    app = next((a for a in BUILTIN_APPS if a["id"] == app_id), None)
    return JSONResponse({"route": app["route"] if app else None})

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/file_converter.py
"""File format converter — Python port of components/FileConverter.tsx
(264 lines, category 4 batch 4f, first of the two final files in this
category).

Known pre-existing gap (same pattern as 4e): grepping the live Pi server.py
for "file/convert" and "to-images" finds zero matches — POST /api/file/convert
and POST /api/video/to-images have never been implemented on any backend.
The file browser (GET /api/files, already proxied everywhere else in this
migration) works fine; only the actual "press convert" action 404s today,
exactly as in production. Ported faithfully as a thin proxy per this whole
migration's established rule for known gaps (see edit_video.py, video_app.py).
"""
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, RedirectResponse

from admin_shell import node_get, node_json, token as _token, username as _username

router = APIRouter()

VIDEO_EXTS = {".mp4", ".mov", ".avi", ".mkv", ".webm", ".m4v", ".3gp", ".flv", ".wmv"}
AUDIO_EXTS = {".mp3", ".aac", ".wav", ".flac", ".m4a", ".ogg", ".wma"}
IMAGE_EXTS = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".gif", ".bmp", ".webp", ".tiff", ".heic"}


def _category(name: str) -> str:
    ext = Path(name).suffix.lower()
    if ext in VIDEO_EXTS:
        return "video"
    if ext in AUDIO_EXTS:
        return "audio"
    if ext in IMAGE_EXTS:
        return "image"
    return "other"


def _no_login():
    return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)


@router.get("/tools/fileconvert", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def file_convert_page(request: Request):
    tok = _token(request)
    user = _username(tok) if tok else None
    if not user:
        return RedirectResponse("/login", status_code=302)
    return """<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-Hant">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>File Converter — Vaultix NAS</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/style.css"/>
</head>
<body class="shell">
  <div id="fcRoot"></div>
  <script src="/static/file_converter.js"></script>
</body>
</html>"""


@router.get("/api/fileconvert/list")
async def fileconvert_list(request: Request, path: str = ""):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    r = await node_get(f"/api/files?path={quote(path)}", tok)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status_code=r.status_code)
    items = r.json().get("items", [])
    out = []
    for i in items:
        if i.get("type") == "folder":
            out.append({"name": i["name"], "type": "folder", "category": None})
        else:
            out.append({"name": i["name"], "type": "file", "category": _category(i["name"])})
    return JSONResponse({"items": out})

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/file_details.py
"""File Details & Duplicates Cleaner — Python port of Category 3 sub-batch 3c
(FileDetailPanel.tsx, FileEdit.tsx, extrafile.tsx).

Provides API proxies for duplicate file scanning (/api/files/duplicates) and extra file metadata details.
Also provides standalone page route /tools/duplicates for cleaning redundant file copies.
"""

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse
from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates

from admin_shell import NODE_API, token as _token

router = APIRouter()
templates = Jinja2Templates(directory="templates")


@router.get("/api/files/duplicates")
async def duplicates_get(request: Request):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=60) as client:
        try:
            r = await client.get(
                f"{NODE_API}/api/files/duplicates",
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}"}
            )
        except httpx.RequestError as e:
            return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)


@router.get("/tools/duplicates", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def duplicates_page(request: Request):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return HTMLResponse("<script>location.href='/login';</script>")
    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, "duplicates.html", {})

def categorize(filename: str) -> str:
    return _EXT_MAP.get(Path(filename).suffix.lower(), "other")


def icon_for(filename: str) -> str:
    """SVG icon for a file, keyed by exact extension where the original app draws a
    distinct glyph (pdf/doc/xlsx/pptx/txt), falling back to the broader category."""
    ext = Path(filename).suffix.lower()
    if ext in _EXT_ICON:
        return _EXT_ICON[ext]
    return _CATEGORY_ICON.get(categorize(filename), _ICON_OTHER)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/.claude/skills/run-frontend-py/driver.py
#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
REPL driver for the Vaultix NAS Python frontend (frontend-py). Drives a
headless Chromium via Playwright so an agent can poke the running app one
line at a time. Run with the project's own .venv (see SKILL.md) — that venv
already has `playwright` + `pyotp` installed, and the Chromium browser
downloaded via `python -m playwright install chromium`.

Usage:
    .venv/Scripts/python.exe .claude/skills/run-frontend-py/driver.py
    (interactive stdin loop; also accepts a script piped in, e.g. via heredoc)
"""
import base64
import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

# Windows consoles default to a legacy codepage (cp950/cp1252) that can't
# encode the emoji/CJK text this app's pages return via `text`/`eval` — force
# UTF-8 so those commands don't crash the REPL loop.
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

SHOT_DIR = os.environ.get("SCREENSHOT_DIR") or os.path.join(
    tempfile.gettempdir(), "vaultix-frontend-py-shots"
)
os.makedirs(SHOT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

state = {"pw": None, "browser": None, "page": None, "console": []}


def _page():
    if state["page"] is None:
        print("ERROR: launch first")
        return None
    return state["page"]


def cmd_launch(_arg):
    if state["page"] is not None:
        print("already launched")
        return
    state["pw"] = sync_playwright().start()
    state["browser"] = state["pw"].chromium.launch()
    page = state["browser"].new_page()
    page.on("console", lambda m: state["console"].append((m.type, m.text)))
    page.on("pageerror", lambda e: state["console"].append(("pageerror", str(e))))
    state["page"] = page
    print("launched")


def cmd_nav(arg):
    page = _page()
    if not page:
        return
    page.goto(arg, wait_until="load")
    print("nav ->", page.url)


def cmd_login(arg):
    """login <username> [role] [base_url] — forge the nas_jwt cookie.

    app.py's _jwt_username()/_jwt_role() decode the cookie's JWT payload for
    DISPLAY ONLY and never check the signature (Node/nas-python is the real
    signer+verifier at actual login time). That means any base64url JSON
    payload wrapped in `x.<payload>.x` is accepted, so the driver can reach
    any logged-in page (/home, /security, ...) without a live Node/nas-python
    backend — which lives on the user's Raspberry Pi and isn't reachable
    from wherever this driver runs.
    """
    parts = arg.split()
    username = parts[0] if parts else "demo_agent"
    role = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else "user"
    base_url = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else (_page().url if _page() else "http://127.0.0.1:8001")
    payload = json.dumps({"username": username, "role": role}).encode()
    b64 = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(payload).decode().rstrip("=")
    token = f"x.{b64}.x"
    page = _page()
    if not page:
        return
    u = urlparse(base_url)
    cookie_url = f"{u.scheme or 'http'}://{u.netloc or u.path}"
    page.context.add_cookies([{"name": "nas_jwt", "value": token, "url": cookie_url}])
    print(f"cookie set: username={username} role={role}")


def cmd_click(arg):
    page = _page()
    if not page:
        return
    page.click(arg)
    print("click", arg)


def cmd_click_text(arg):
    page = _page()
    if not page:
        return
    page.get_by_text(arg).first.click()
    print("click-text", arg)


def cmd_fill(arg):
    page = _page()
    if not page:
        return
    sel, _, text = arg.partition(" ")
    page.fill(sel, text)
    print("fill", sel)


def cmd_press(arg):
    page = _page()
    if not page:
        return
    page.keyboard.press(arg)
    print("press", arg)


def cmd_wait(arg):
    page = _page()
    if not page:
        return
    try:
        page.wait_for_selector(arg, timeout=10_000)
        print("found:", arg)
    except Exception:
        print("TIMEOUT:", arg)


def cmd_eval(arg):
    page = _page()
    if not page:
        return
    try:
        print(json.dumps(page.evaluate(arg)))
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR:", e)


def cmd_text(arg):
    page = _page()
    if not page:
        return
    sel = arg.strip() or None
    js = "(s) => (s ? document.querySelector(s) : document.body)?.innerText ?? '(null)'"
    print(page.evaluate(js, sel))


def cmd_ss(arg):
    page = _page()
    if not page:
        return
    name = arg.strip() or f"ss-{int(time.time())}"
    path = os.path.join(SHOT_DIR, name + ".png")
    page.screenshot(path=path)
    print("screenshot:", path)


def cmd_totp(arg):
    """totp <secret> — compute the current 6-digit TOTP code so the driver
    can complete 2FA enrollment end-to-end without a real phone/authenticator
    app (mirrors what pwd_2FA_check.TwoFactor.totp_enable() verifies)."""
    import pyotp

    print(pyotp.TOTP(arg.strip()).now())


def cmd_autofill_totp(_arg):
    """autofill-totp — read the #secret element the /security page just
    showed after 'click #setupBtn', compute the current 6-digit code with
    pyotp, and fill() it into #code. One command instead of eval+totp+fill
    because this exact three-step dance is the only way to get through TOTP
    enrollment without a real phone/authenticator app."""
    page = _page()
    if not page:
        return
    import pyotp

    secret = page.eval_on_selector("#secret", "el => el.textContent")
    code = pyotp.TOTP(secret.strip()).now()
    page.fill("#code", code)
    print(f"autofill-totp: secret={secret} code={code}")


def cmd_console(_arg):
    if not state["console"]:
        print("(no console messages captured)")
        return
    for kind, text in state["console"]:
        print(f"[{kind}] {text}")


def cmd_quit(_arg):
    if state["browser"]:
        state["browser"].close()
    if state["pw"]:
        state["pw"].stop()
    print("bye")


COMMANDS = {
    "launch": cmd_launch,
    "nav": cmd_nav,
    "login": cmd_login,
    "click": cmd_click,
    "click-text": cmd_click_text,
    "fill": cmd_fill,
    "press": cmd_press,
    "wait": cmd_wait,
    "eval": cmd_eval,
    "text": cmd_text,
    "ss": cmd_ss,
    "totp": cmd_totp,
    "autofill-totp": cmd_autofill_totp,
    "console": cmd_console,
    "quit": cmd_quit,
}


def main():
    print("frontend-py driver — commands:", ", ".join(COMMANDS))
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        cmd, _, arg = line.partition(" ")
        fn = COMMANDS.get(cmd)
        if not fn:
            print("unknown:", cmd, "— try one of:", ", ".join(COMMANDS))
            continue
        try:
            fn(arg)
        except Exception as e:
            print("ERROR:", e)
        if cmd == "quit":
            return
    cmd_quit("")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/admin_automation.js
// Schedule Manager — behind /automation.
const UPDATE_TARGETS = [
  ["apt", "System Packages", "apt-get upgrade (all packages)"],
  ["nginx", "Nginx", "Upgrade packages and reload config"],
  ["fail2ban", "Fail2ban", "Upgrade packages and restart service"],
  ["mariadb", "MariaDB", "Upgrade mariadb-server package"],
];
const PRESETS = [
  ["0 2 * * *", "Daily 02:00"], ["0 3 * * *", "Daily 03:00"], ["0 3 * * 0", "Weekly Sun 03:00"],
  ["0 2 * * 1", "Weekly Mon 02:00"], ["0 2 1 * *", "Monthly 1st 02:00"], ["custom", "Custom"],
];
function cronLabel(expr) { return (PRESETS.find(([v]) => v === expr) || [])[1] || expr; }
function cronPickerHtml(id, expr) {
  const isCustom = !PRESETS.slice(0, -1).some(([v]) => v === expr);
  return `<select id="${id}" class="cron-select">${PRESETS.map(([v, l]) => `<option value="${v}"${(isCustom ? "custom" : expr) === v ? " selected" : ""}>${l}</option>`).join("")}</select>
    <input id="${id}Custom" class="cron-custom${isCustom ? "" : " hidden"}" value="${isCustom ? expr : ""}" placeholder="cron expression, e.g. 0 2 * * *" style="font-family:monospace;margin-top:6px"/>`;
}
function wireCronPicker(id, onChange) {
  const sel = $(id), custom = $(id + "Custom");
  sel.addEventListener("change", () => {
    custom.classList.toggle("hidden", sel.value !== "custom");
    onChange(sel.value === "custom" ? custom.value : sel.value);
  });
  custom.addEventListener("input", () => onChange(custom.value));
}
function fmtTaskTime(iso) {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  const d = new Date(iso), p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${d.getFullYear()}/${p(d.getMonth() + 1)}/${p(d.getDate())} ${p(d.getHours())}:${p(d.getMinutes())}`;
}
function statusBadge(status) {
  if (!status) return '<span class="hint">—</span>';
  return status === "success" ? '<span style="color:#4ade80;font-size:11px">✓ Success</span>' : '<span style="color:#f87171;font-size:11px">✗ Failed</span>';
}

let tasks = [], runningId = null;

async function loadTasks() {
  try { tasks = await getJSON("/api/admin/schedule/tasks"); } catch { toast("Failed to load schedules", "error"); tasks = []; }
  renderBackup(); renderUpdateCards();
}

// ── Backup tab ────────────────────────────────────────────────
function backupRowHtml(t) {
  return `<div class="admin-card" data-id="${t.id}" style="${t.enabled ? "" : "opacity:0.6"}">
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px">
      <div style="min-width:0">
        <div class="docker-name-row"><span class="docker-name">${t.name}</span>
          <span class="jail-status-badge" style="${t.enabled ? "background:rgba(74,222,128,0.15);color:#4ade80" : ""}">${t.enabled ? "Active" : "Disabled"}</span></div>
        <p class="hint" style="font-family:monospace;margin:4px 0 0">${t.source_path} → ${t.dest_path}</p>
        <p class="hint">${cronLabel(t.cron_expr)} / Keep ${t.keep_count} copies</p>
        <p class="hint">Last run: ${fmtTaskTime(t.last_run)} ${statusBadge(t.last_status)}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="docker-actions">
        <button class="btn-mini" data-act="run">${runningId === t.id ? "…" : "Run"}</button>
        <button class="btn-mini" data-act="toggle">${t.enabled ? "Disable" : "Enable"}</button>
        <button class="btn-mini" data-act="delete">Delete</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
function renderBackup() {
  const backupTasks = tasks.filter((t) => t.type === "backup");
  const host = $("backupList");
  host.innerHTML = backupTasks.length ? backupTasks.map(backupRowHtml).join("") : '<div class="admin-empty"><p>No backup jobs yet</p></div>';
  host.querySelectorAll(".admin-card").forEach((card) => {
    const id = card.dataset.id;
    card.querySelector('[data-act="run"]').addEventListener("click", () => runTask(id));
    card.querySelector('[data-act="toggle"]').addEventListener("click", () => toggleTask(id, tasks.find((t) => t.id === id).enabled));
    card.querySelector('[data-act="delete"]').addEventListener("click", () => deleteTask(id));
  });
}
$("btnToggleBackupForm").addEventListener("click", () => {
  const form = $("backupForm");
  const show = form.classList.toggle("hidden") === false;
  if (show) form.innerHTML = `
    <p style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px">Add Backup Job</p>
    <label class="field-label">Job Name</label><input id="fName" placeholder="e.g. Daily Backup" style="margin-bottom:8px"/>
    <label class="field-label">Retain Copies</label><input id="fKeep" type="number" value="7" min="1" max="99" style="margin-bottom:8px"/>
    <label class="field-label">Source Path</label><input id="fSrc" value="/DATA" style="font-family:monospace;margin-bottom:8px"/>
    <label class="field-label">Destination Path</label><input id="fDst" value="/DATA/backups" style="font-family:monospace;margin-bottom:8px"/>
    <label class="field-label">Schedule</label>${cronPickerHtml("fCron", "0 2 * * *")}
    <div class="admin-actions" style="margin-top:10px;justify-content:flex-end">
      <button class="btn-secondary" id="fCancel">Cancel</button>
      <button class="btn-primary" id="fSubmit">Create</button>
    </div>`;
  if (show) {
    let cronVal = "0 2 * * *";
    wireCronPicker("fCron", (v) => { cronVal = v; });
    $("fCancel").addEventListener("click", () => form.classList.add("hidden"));
    $("fSubmit").addEventListener("click", () => addBackup(cronVal));
  }
});
async function addBackup(cronVal) {
  const name = $("fName").value.trim(), src = $("fSrc").value.trim(), dst = $("fDst").value.trim(), keep = Number($("fKeep").value);
  if (!name) return toast("Please enter a job name", "error");
  if (!src || !dst) return toast("Please fill in source and destination paths", "error");
  if (!cronVal) return toast("Please set a schedule", "error");
  try {
    await postJSON("/api/admin/schedule/tasks", { name, type: "backup", cron_expr: cronVal, source_path: src, dest_path: dst, keep_count: keep });
    toast("Backup job created");
    $("backupForm").classList.add("hidden");
    await loadTasks();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}
async function toggleTask(id, enabled) {
  try {
    await fetch(`/api/admin/schedule/tasks/${id}`, { method: "PUT", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF": "1" }, body: JSON.stringify({ enabled: !enabled }) });
    await loadTasks();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}
async function deleteTask(id) {
  try {
    await fetch(`/api/admin/schedule/tasks/${id}`, { method: "DELETE", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" } });
    toast("Job deleted");
    await loadTasks();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}
async function runTask(id) {
  runningId = id; renderBackup(); renderUpdateCards();
  try {
    const d = await postJSON(`/api/admin/schedule/tasks/${id}/run`);
    toast(d.message || "Started");
    setTimeout(loadTasks, 3000);
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
  runningId = null;
}

// ── Update tab ────────────────────────────────────────────────
function parseUpdateTargets(task) {
  try {
    const arr = JSON.parse(task?.source_path || "[]");
    if (Array.isArray(arr) && arr.length) return new Set(arr);
  } catch {}
  return new Set(["apt"]);
}

// The 3 "independent" cards (PM2/Tailscale/SecurityScan) share one shape —
// name/note/default-cron differ, everything else (enable/disable, cron
// picker, save, run-now) is identical, so one builder covers all three.
const SIMPLE_UPDATE_CARDS = [
  { taskName: "PM2 Auto Update", title: "PM2 Update", sub: "(獨立排程 / 建議每月)", defCron: "0 2 1 * *", sourceKey: "pm2",
    note: "pm2 update 會重啟 daemon 並短暫中斷服務，已與其他更新拆開獨立排程（預設每月），避免頻繁中斷。" },
  { taskName: "Tailscale Funnel Watchdog", title: "Tailscale Funnel Watchdog", sub: "(獨立排程 / 建議每 5 分鐘)", defCron: "*/5 * * * *", sourceKey: "tailscale",
    note: "每次執行檢查 NAS 對外網址 (Funnel) 是否還開著，掉線會自動 tailscale funnel --bg 3000 復原，並在管理員通知鈴鐺 + email 留下紀錄。" },
  { taskName: "Security Vulnerability Scan", title: "Security Vulnerability Scan", sub: "(獨立排程 / 建議每日)", defCron: "0 3 * * *", sourceKey: "security-scan",
    note: "每次執行會跑一次 Security Dashboard 的完整掃描。只有「新出現」或「剛恢復」的問題才會寄 email 通知，同一個問題持續存在不會每次都重複通知。" },
];

function simpleCardHtml(cfg, task) {
  const enabled = task?.enabled ?? false;
  const cronId = `cron_${cfg.sourceKey}`;
  return `<div class="admin-card" data-task="${cfg.taskName}">
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start">
      <div><p style="margin:0;font-weight:600">${cfg.title} <span class="hint">${cfg.sub}</span></p>
        <p class="hint" style="margin-top:2px">${task ? `Last run: ${fmtTaskTime(task.last_run)} ${statusBadge(task.last_status)}` : "No schedule set"}</p></div>
      <div class="admin-actions">
        <button class="btn-mini ${enabled ? "btn-mini-primary" : ""}" data-act="enable">Enable</button>
        <button class="btn-mini ${!enabled && task ? "btn-mini-danger" : ""}" data-act="disable">Disable</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="office-warn" style="margin:10px 0">${cfg.note}</div>
    <label class="field-label">Run Schedule</label>${cronPickerHtml(cronId, task?.cron_expr || cfg.defCron)}
    <div class="admin-actions" style="margin-top:10px">
      <button class="btn-primary" data-act="save">Save Schedule</button>
      <button class="btn-secondary" data-act="run" ${!task ? "disabled" : ""}>${runningId === task?.id ? "Running…" : "Run Now"}</button>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
function renderUpdateCards() {
  const host = $("updateCards");
  const generalTask = tasks.find((t) => t.type === "update" && !SIMPLE_UPDATE_CARDS.some((c) => c.taskName === t.name)) || null;
  let html = generalUpdateCardHtml(generalTask);
  for (const cfg of SIMPLE_UPDATE_CARDS) {
    html += simpleCardHtml(cfg, tasks.find((t) => t.type === "update" && t.name === cfg.taskName) || null);
  }
  host.innerHTML = html;
  wireGeneralCard(generalTask);
  SIMPLE_UPDATE_CARDS.forEach((cfg) => wireSimpleCard(cfg, tasks.find((t) => t.type === "update" && t.name === cfg.taskName) || null));
}

let uTargets = null;
function generalUpdateCardHtml(task) {
  if (!uTargets) uTargets = parseUpdateTargets(task);
  const enabled = task?.enabled ?? false;
  return `<div class="admin-card" data-task="general">
    <div class="office-warn" style="margin-bottom:10px">Runs selected updates. Requires sudo NOPASSWD configured on the Pi.</div>
    <p class="section-label">Update Items</p>
    <div class="admin-actions" style="flex-wrap:wrap">
      ${UPDATE_TARGETS.map(([k, l, d]) => `<label class="raid-disk-option${uTargets.has(k) ? " selected" : ""}" style="cursor:pointer">
        <input type="checkbox" data-target="${k}" ${uTargets.has(k) ? "checked" : ""}/><span>${l}</span><span class="hint">${d}</span></label>`).join("")}
    </div>
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:12px">
      <div><p style="margin:0;font-weight:600">Auto System Update</p>
        <p class="hint">${task ? `Last run: ${fmtTaskTime(task.last_run)} ${statusBadge(task.last_status)}` : "No schedule set"}</p></div>
      <div class="admin-actions">
        <button class="btn-mini ${enabled ? "btn-mini-primary" : ""}" data-act="enable">Enable</button>
        <button class="btn-mini ${!enabled && task ? "btn-mini-danger" : ""}" data-act="disable">Disable</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <label class="field-label">Run Schedule</label>${cronPickerHtml("cron_general", task?.cron_expr || "0 3 * * 0")}
    <div class="admin-actions" style="margin-top:10px">
      <button class="btn-primary" data-act="save">Save Settings</button>
      <button class="btn-secondary" data-act="run" ${!task ? "disabled" : ""}>${runningId === task?.id ? "Running…" : "Run Now"}</button>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
function wireGeneralCard(task) {
  const card = document.querySelector('[data-task="general"]');
  if (!card) return;
  let cronVal = task?.cron_expr || "0 3 * * 0";
  wireCronPicker("cron_general", (v) => { cronVal = v; });
  card.querySelectorAll("[data-target]").forEach((cb) => cb.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
    if (e.target.checked) uTargets.add(e.target.dataset.target); else uTargets.delete(e.target.dataset.target);
  }));
  card.querySelector('[data-act="enable"]').addEventListener("click", () => saveGeneral(cronVal, true, task));
  card.querySelector('[data-act="disable"]').addEventListener("click", () => saveGeneral(cronVal, false, task));
  card.querySelector('[data-act="save"]').addEventListener("click", () => saveGeneral(cronVal, undefined, task));
  card.querySelector('[data-act="run"]')?.addEventListener("click", () => task && runTask(task.id));
}
async function saveGeneral(cronVal, enabled, task) {
  if (!cronVal) return toast("Please set a schedule", "error");
  const targetsJson = JSON.stringify([...uTargets].filter((k) => k !== "pm2"));
  try {
    if (task) await fetch(`/api/admin/schedule/tasks/${task.id}`, { method: "PUT", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF": "1" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ cron_expr: cronVal, source_path: targetsJson, ...(enabled !== undefined && { enabled }) }) });
    else await postJSON("/api/admin/schedule/tasks", { name: "Auto System Update", type: "update", cron_expr: cronVal, source_path: targetsJson, enabled: enabled !== false });
    toast("Settings saved");
    await loadTasks();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}
function wireSimpleCard(cfg, task) {
  const card = document.querySelector(`[data-task="${CSS.escape(cfg.taskName)}"]`);
  if (!card) return;
  let cronVal = task?.cron_expr || cfg.defCron;
  wireCronPicker(`cron_${cfg.sourceKey}`, (v) => { cronVal = v; });
  const save = (enabled) => saveSimple(cfg, cronVal, enabled, task);
  card.querySelector('[data-act="enable"]').addEventListener("click", () => save(true));
  card.querySelector('[data-act="disable"]').addEventListener("click", () => save(false));
  card.querySelector('[data-act="save"]').addEventListener("click", () => save(undefined));
  card.querySelector('[data-act="run"]')?.addEventListener("click", () => task && runTask(task.id));
}
async function saveSimple(cfg, cronVal, enabled, task) {
  if (!cronVal) return toast("Please set a schedule", "error");
  const sourceJson = JSON.stringify([cfg.sourceKey]);
  try {
    if (task) await fetch(`/api/admin/schedule/tasks/${task.id}`, { method: "PUT", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF": "1" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ cron_expr: cronVal, source_path: sourceJson, ...(enabled !== undefined && { enabled }) }) });
    else await postJSON("/api/admin/schedule/tasks", { name: cfg.taskName, type: "update", cron_expr: cronVal, source_path: sourceJson, enabled: enabled !== false });
    toast(`${cfg.title} schedule saved`);
    await loadTasks();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}

window.onAdminTab = (tab) => document.querySelectorAll(".admin-tab-pane").forEach((p) => p.classList.toggle("hidden", p.dataset.pane !== tab));
window.onAdminRefresh = loadTasks;
loadTasks();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/admin_common.js
// Shared helpers for category-6 admin panel pages (admin_shell.py's page_shell()).
// Same conventions as widgets.js/office_workspace.js: $(), X-CSRF header, toast().
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const $$ = (sel) => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(sel));

function toast(msg, kind = "info") {
  const host = $("toastHost");
  if (!host) return;
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = `toast toast-${kind}`;
  el.textContent = msg;
  host.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(() => el.classList.add("toast-out"), 2200);
  setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 2600);
}

async function copyText(text, label) {
  try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); toast(`${label} 已複製`); }
  catch { toast("複製失敗", "error"); }
}

async function reqJSON(url, opts) {
  const r = await fetch(url, { headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" }, ...opts });
  const data = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${r.status}`);
  return data;
}
const getJSON = (url) => reqJSON(url);
const postJSON = (url, body) => reqJSON(url, {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF": "1" },
  body: JSON.stringify(body ?? {}),
});

// Tab bar: switching tabs updates the URL (?tab=) via a full navigation
// (server-rendered per-tab content, no client-side tab panes to keep each
// panel's page_shell() usage simple) unless the page defines window.onAdminTab
// for client-side switching instead.
$$(".admin-tab").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  if (typeof window.onAdminTab === "function") {
    $$(".admin-tab").forEach((b) => b.classList.remove("active"));
    btn.classList.add("active");
    window.onAdminTab(btn.dataset.tab);
  } else {
    const url = new URL(location.href);
    url.searchParams.set("tab", btn.dataset.tab);
    location.href = url.toString();
  }
}));

$("btnRefresh")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
  if (typeof window.onAdminRefresh === "function") window.onAdminRefresh();
  else location.reload();
});

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/admin_docker.js
// Docker Containers — behind /tools/docker.
function firstHostPort(ports) {
  const m = ports?.match(/(?:0\.0\.0\.0|::):(\d+)->/);
  return m ? parseInt(m[1]) : null;
}
function statusLabel(c) {
  return c.State === "running" ? "Running" : c.State === "exited" ? "Stopped" : c.State === "paused" ? "Paused" : c.State;
}

function containerRowHtml(c) {
  const shortId = c.ID?.length > 12 ? c.ID.slice(0, 12) : c.ID;
  const port = firstHostPort(c.Ports);
  return `<div class="admin-card docker-row" data-id="${c.ID}">
    <span class="svc-dot ${c.State === "running" ? "svc-dot-on" : "svc-dot-off"}"></span>
    <div class="docker-info">
      <div class="docker-name-row"><span class="docker-name">${(c.Names || "").replace(/^\//, "")}</span>
        <span class="jail-status-badge">${statusLabel(c)}</span></div>
      <div class="hint" style="font-family:monospace">${c.Image} · ${shortId}</div>
      <div class="hint">${port ? `<a href="http://${location.hostname}:${port}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">:${port}</a> · ` : ""}${c.Status}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="docker-actions">
      ${c.State === "running"
        ? `<button class="btn-mini" data-act="stop">Stop</button>`
        : `<button class="btn-mini btn-mini-primary" data-act="start">Start</button>`}
      <button class="btn-mini" data-act="restart">Restart</button>
      <button class="btn-mini" data-act="pull" title="Update Image">Update</button>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

async function load() {
  const host = $("dockerBody");
  host.innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div>';
  try {
    const data = await getJSON("/api/admin/docker/containers");
    const containers = (data.apps || []).filter((a) => !a.ID.startsWith("pm2_"));
    if (data.unavailable) {
      const reason = data.reason === "permission" ? "Insufficient Docker permissions" : data.reason === "not_installed" ? "Docker not installed" : "Docker service not running";
      host.innerHTML = `<div class="admin-empty"><p>${reason}</p></div>`;
      return;
    }
    if (!containers.length) { host.innerHTML = '<div class="admin-empty"><p>No Docker containers</p></div>'; return; }
    const running = containers.filter((c) => c.State === "running").length;
    host.innerHTML = `<p class="hint" style="margin-bottom:10px"><strong style="color:var(--text)">${containers.length}</strong> containers total, <span style="color:#4ade80">${running}</span> running</p>`
      + containers.map(containerRowHtml).join("");
    host.querySelectorAll(".docker-row").forEach((row) => {
      row.querySelectorAll("[data-act]").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => doAction(row.dataset.id, btn.dataset.act, btn)));
    });
  } catch (err) {
    host.innerHTML = `<p class="hint" style="color:var(--error)">${err.message}</p>`;
  }
}

async function doAction(id, action, btn) {
  btn.disabled = true; const orig = btn.textContent; btn.textContent = "…";
  try {
    if (action === "pull") {
      const d = await postJSON(`/api/admin/docker/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/pull`);
      toast(d.updated ? `${d.image} updated` : `${d.image} already up to date`);
      if (d.updated) await load();
    } else {
      await postJSON(`/api/admin/docker/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/control`, { action });
      toast({ start: "Started", stop: "Stopped", restart: "Restarted" }[action] || "Done");
      await load();
    }
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
  btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = orig;
}

window.onAdminRefresh = load;
load();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/admin_errorlog.js
// Execution Log — behind /tools/errorlog.
function fmtLogTime(iso) {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${d.getFullYear()}/${p(d.getMonth() + 1)}/${p(d.getDate())} ${p(d.getHours())}:${p(d.getMinutes())}:${p(d.getSeconds())}`;
}
function fmtDuration(ms) {
  if (!ms) return "";
  if (ms < 1000) return `${ms}ms`;
  if (ms < 60000) return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`;
  return `${Math.floor(ms / 60000)}m ${Math.floor((ms % 60000) / 1000)}s`;
}
let logs = [], expanded = new Set();

function render() {
  const host = $("errlogBody");
  if (!logs.length) { host.innerHTML = '<div class="admin-empty"><p>No matching records</p></div>'; return; }
  host.innerHTML = logs.map((log) => `
    <div class="admin-card log-row-card">
      <div class="log-row-head">
        <span class="log-status-dot ${log.status === "success" ? "ok" : "fail"}">${log.status === "success" ? "✓" : "✕"}</span>
        <span style="font-weight:600">${log.task_name}</span>
        <span class="jail-status-badge" style="background:${log.type === "backup" ? "rgba(96,165,250,0.15)" : "rgba(167,139,250,0.15)"};color:${log.type === "backup" ? "#60a5fa" : "#a78bfa"}">${log.type === "backup" ? "Backup" : "Update"}</span>
        ${log.duration_ms != null ? `<span class="hint">${fmtDuration(log.duration_ms)}</span>` : ""}
        <span class="hint" style="margin-left:auto">${fmtLogTime(log.created_at)}</span>
      </div>
      ${log.message ? `<button class="link-btn log-expand-btn" data-id="${log.id}">${expanded.has(log.id) ? "▲ Collapse" : "▼ Expand Message"}</button>
        ${expanded.has(log.id) ? `<pre class="patch-output">${log.message}</pre>` : ""}` : ""}
    </div>`).join("") + `<p class="hint" style="margin-top:10px">${logs.length} records total</p>`;
  host.querySelectorAll(".log-expand-btn").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const id = Number(btn.dataset.id);
    expanded.has(id) ? expanded.delete(id) : expanded.add(id);
    render();
  }));
}

async function load() {
  $("errlogBody").innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div>';
  try {
    const type = $("logTypeFilter").value, status = $("logStatusFilter").value;
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (type) params.set("type", type);
    if (status) params.set("status", status);
    logs = await getJSON(`/api/admin/schedule/logs?${params}`);
    render();
  } catch { toast("Failed to load logs", "error"); }
}

$("logTypeFilter").addEventListener("change", load);
$("logStatusFilter").addEventListener("change", load);
$("btnClearLog").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  if (!confirm("Clear all execution logs?")) return;
  try {
    await fetch("/api/admin/schedule/logs", { method: "DELETE", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" } });
    logs = []; render();
    toast("Log cleared");
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
});

window.onAdminRefresh = load;
load();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/admin_fail2ban.js
// Fail2ban (Status + Log) — behind admin_security.py's /security/fail2ban.
function countryFlag(code) {
  if (!code || code.length !== 2) return "🌐";
  const A = 0x1F1E6;
  return [...code.toUpperCase()].map((c) => String.fromCodePoint(A + c.charCodeAt(0) - 65)).join("");
}
function geoTagHtml(geo) {
  if (!geo) return '<span class="hint">…</span>';
  if (geo.private) return '<span class="hint">Private / LAN</span>';
  if (geo.error || !geo.country) return '<span class="hint">Unknown location</span>';
  const mapUrl = geo.lat != null && geo.lon != null
    ? `https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=${geo.lat}&mlon=${geo.lon}#map=8/${geo.lat}/${geo.lon}` : null;
  return `<span class="geo-tag">${countryFlag(geo.countryCode)} ${geo.country}${geo.city ? " · " + geo.city : ""}` +
    (mapUrl ? ` <a href="${mapUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">📍 GPS</a>` : "") + `</span>`;
}
function parseLogLine(line) {
  const m = line.match(/^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}),\d+\s+(fail2ban\.\S+)\s+\[.*?\]:\s+(\w+)\s+\[([^\]]+)\]\s+(\w+)\s+([\d.:a-fA-F]+)/);
  if (!m) return null;
  return { time: m[1], component: m[2], level: m[3], jail: m[4], action: m[5], ip: m[6], raw: line };
}
function actionClass(action, level) {
  if (action === "Ban") return "act-ban";
  if (action === "Unban") return "act-unban";
  if (action === "Found") return "act-found";
  if (level === "WARNING" || level === "ERROR") return "act-warn";
  return "act-other";
}
function actionIcon(action) {
  return action === "Ban" ? "🚫" : action === "Unban" ? "✅" : action === "Found" ? "🔍" : action === "Ignore" ? "⏭" : "•";
}

const geoCache = {}, geoRequested = new Set();
async function loadGeo(ips, onDone) {
  const need = [...new Set(ips.filter((ip) => ip && !geoRequested.has(ip)))];
  if (!need.length) return;
  need.forEach((ip) => geoRequested.add(ip));
  try {
    const data = await getJSON(`/api/admin/fail2ban/geo?ips=${encodeURIComponent(need.join(","))}`);
    Object.assign(geoCache, data);
    onDone();
  } catch {
    need.forEach((ip) => geoRequested.delete(ip));
  }
}
function refreshGeoTags() {
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-geo-ip]").forEach((el) => { el.outerHTML = geoTagHtml(geoCache[el.dataset.geoIp]).replace("<span", `<span data-geo-ip="${el.dataset.geoIp}"`); });
}

let jailsData = [];
async function loadStatus() {
  const host = $("f2bStatus");
  host.innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div>';
  try {
    const data = await getJSON("/api/admin/fail2ban/status");
    if (data.unavailable) {
      host.innerHTML = `<div class="admin-empty">
        <p>Fail2ban not installed or not running</p>
        <pre class="patch-output" style="text-align:left;max-width:420px;margin:12px auto">sudo apt install fail2ban

# Allow NAS backend passwordless access:
echo 'roy ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/fail2ban-client' \\
  | sudo tee /etc/sudoers.d/vaultix-fail2ban
sudo chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/vaultix-fail2ban</pre></div>`;
      return;
    }
    jailsData = data.jails;
    if (!jailsData.length) { host.innerHTML = '<div class="admin-empty"><p>No active jail rules</p></div>'; return; }
    const totalBanned = jailsData.reduce((s, j) => s + j.banned, 0);
    const totalBannedAll = jailsData.reduce((s, j) => s + j.totalBanned, 0);
    host.innerHTML = `
      <div class="stat-row">
        <div class="stat-card"><p class="stat-value" style="color:#fb923c">${jailsData.length}</p><p class="stat-label">Jails</p></div>
        <div class="stat-card"><p class="stat-value" style="color:#f87171">${totalBanned}</p><p class="stat-label">Currently Banned</p></div>
        <div class="stat-card"><p class="stat-value">${totalBannedAll}</p><p class="stat-label">Total Banned</p></div>
      </div>
      ${jailsData.map((j) => `
        <div class="admin-card jail-card">
          <div class="jail-head"><span class="svc-dot ${j.status === "active" ? "svc-dot-on" : "svc-dot-off"}"></span>
            <span class="jail-name">${j.name}</span>
            <span class="jail-status-badge">${j.status === "active" ? "Active" : j.status}</span></div>
          <div class="stat-row stat-row-4">
            <div class="stat-card"><p class="stat-value" style="color:#f87171">${j.banned}</p><p class="stat-label">Currently Banned</p></div>
            <div class="stat-card"><p class="stat-value">${j.totalBanned}</p><p class="stat-label">Total Banned</p></div>
            <div class="stat-card"><p class="stat-value" style="color:#facc15">${j.failed}</p><p class="stat-label">Current Failures</p></div>
            <div class="stat-card"><p class="stat-value">${j.totalFailed}</p><p class="stat-label">Total Failures</p></div>
          </div>
          ${j.bannedIps.length ? `<p class="section-label">Banned IPs</p><div class="banned-ip-list">
            ${j.bannedIps.map((ip) => `
              <div class="banned-ip-chip">
                <span class="dot dot-inactive" style="width:6px;height:6px"></span>
                <span class="ip-text">${ip}</span>
                <button class="unban-btn" data-jail="${j.name}" data-ip="${ip}" title="Unban">↺</button>
                <div class="geo-line" data-geo-ip="${ip}">${geoTagHtml(geoCache[ip])}</div>
              </div>`).join("")}
          </div>` : ""}
        </div>`).join("")}
    `;
    host.querySelectorAll(".unban-btn").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => unbanIp(btn.dataset.jail, btn.dataset.ip)));
    loadGeo(jailsData.flatMap((j) => j.bannedIps), refreshGeoTags);
  } catch (err) {
    host.innerHTML = `<p class="hint" style="color:var(--error)">${err.message}</p>`;
  }
}

async function unbanIp(jail, ip) {
  const btn = document.querySelector(`.unban-btn[data-jail="${CSS.escape(jail)}"][data-ip="${CSS.escape(ip)}"]`);
  if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
  try {
    await postJSON("/api/admin/fail2ban/unban", { jail, ip });
    toast(`${ip} unbanned`);
    await loadStatus();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); if (btn) btn.disabled = false; }
}

let logLines = [], logParsed = [], logFilter = "all", logRaw = false, logLoaded = false;
async function loadLog() {
  const host = $("f2bLog");
  host.innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div>';
  try {
    const data = await getJSON("/api/admin/fail2ban/log");
    logLines = data.lines;
    logParsed = logLines.map(parseLogLine).filter(Boolean);
    renderLog();
    loadGeo(logParsed.map((e) => e.ip), refreshGeoTags);
  } catch (err) {
    host.innerHTML = `<p class="hint" style="color:var(--error)">${err.message}</p>`;
  }
}
function renderLog() {
  const host = $("f2bLog");
  const filteredParsed = logFilter === "all" ? logParsed : logParsed.filter((e) => e.action === (logFilter === "ban" ? "Ban" : logFilter === "unban" ? "Unban" : "Found"));
  const key = logFilter === "ban" ? " Ban " : logFilter === "unban" ? " Unban " : " Found ";
  const filteredRaw = logFilter === "all" ? logLines : logLines.filter((l) => l.includes(key));
  $("f2bLogCount").textContent = logRaw ? `${filteredRaw.length} lines` : `${filteredParsed.length} events`;

  if (logRaw) {
    host.innerHTML = filteredRaw.length
      ? `<pre class="log-raw">${filteredRaw.map((l) => {
          const cls = l.includes(" Ban ") ? "act-ban" : l.includes(" Unban ") ? "act-unban" : l.includes(" Found ") ? "act-found" : "";
          return `<div class="${cls}">${l}</div>`;
        }).join("")}</pre>`
      : '<div class="admin-empty"><p>(No logs)</p></div>';
    return;
  }
  if (!filteredParsed.length) {
    host.innerHTML = `<div class="admin-empty"><p>${logLines.length === 0 ? "Cannot read log file" : "No records match the filter"}</p>
      ${logLines.length === 0 ? '<p class="hint">Please check that /var/log/fail2ban.log exists, or the backend user has sudo read permissions.</p>' : ""}</div>`;
    return;
  }
  host.innerHTML = filteredParsed.map((e) => `
    <div class="log-entry">
      <span class="log-icon">${actionIcon(e.action)}</span>
      <div class="log-body">
        <span class="act-badge ${actionClass(e.action, e.level)}">${e.action}</span>
        <span class="log-jail">[${e.jail}]</span>
        <span class="log-ip">${e.ip}</span>
        <span class="geo-line" data-geo-ip="${e.ip}">${geoTagHtml(geoCache[e.ip])}</span>
        <span class="log-time">${e.time}</span>
      </div>
    </div>`).join("");
}
$("f2bRawToggle")?.addEventListener("click", () => { logRaw = !logRaw; $("f2bRawToggle").classList.toggle("active", logRaw); renderLog(); });
document.querySelectorAll("#f2bFilterGroup .filter-pill").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  document.querySelectorAll("#f2bFilterGroup .filter-pill").forEach((b) => b.classList.remove("active"));
  btn.classList.add("active");
  logFilter = btn.dataset.filter;
  renderLog();
}));

window.onAdminTab = (tab) => {
  document.querySelectorAll(".admin-tab-pane").forEach((p) => p.classList.toggle("hidden", p.dataset.pane !== tab));
  if (tab === "log" && !logLoaded) { logLoaded = true; loadLog(); }
};
window.onAdminRefresh = () => {
  const active = document.querySelector(".admin-tab.active")?.dataset.tab || "status";
  if (active === "status") loadStatus(); else { logLoaded = true; loadLog(); }
};

loadStatus();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/admin_mailserver.js
// Mail Server Setup — behind /mail/server-setup. Two tiers on one page:
// the "my mailbox" self-service card is for every logged-in user; the
// install-status/DKIM/firewall cards are admin-only and just silently hide
// themselves if those API calls come back 403 (see admin_mailserver.py's
// docstring for why this is one page instead of two).
const SVC_LABEL = { active: "Active", inactive: "Inactive", failed: "Failed", unknown: "Unknown" };
const SVC_COLOR = { active: "#4ade80", inactive: "#f87171", failed: "#f87171", unknown: "#6b7280" };

let isAdmin = true; // optimistic; flipped to false the first time an admin call 403s
let mailbox = null;

function svcBadge(name, state) {
  const st = state || "unknown";
  return `<div class="dev-badge" style="border-color:${SVC_COLOR[st]}44">
    <span class="dot" style="background:${SVC_COLOR[st]};width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block"></span>
    <span>${name}</span><span class="hint">${SVC_LABEL[st] || st}</span>
  </div>`;
}

function myMailboxCardHtml() {
  if (mailbox?.provisioned) {
    return `<div class="admin-card">
      <h3>My mailbox</h3>
      <p class="hint">${mailbox.address} ${mailbox.enabled ? "" : "(disabled)"}</p>
      <button class="btn-secondary" id="btnDisableMailbox">Disable my mailbox</button>
    </div>`;
  }
  const domainHint = mailbox?.domain
    ? `@${mailbox.domain}`
    : "(no domain configured yet — ask an admin to finish server setup below)";
  return `<div class="admin-card">
    <h3>Set up my mailbox</h3>
    <p class="hint">Choose a name, set a password (separate from your NAS login password), and this becomes your own self-hosted address ${domainHint}.</p>
    <div class="field-row">
      <input class="ex-modal-input" id="mbLocalPart" placeholder="local part, e.g. roy"/>
      <input class="ex-modal-input" type="password" id="mbPassword" placeholder="password (min 8 chars)"/>
    </div>
    <button class="btn-primary" id="btnCreateMailbox" ${mailbox?.domain ? "" : "disabled"}>Create mailbox</button>
  </div>`;
}

function adminCardsHtml(status, dkim) {
  if (!isAdmin) return "";
  const svc = status
    ? `<div class="dev-badge-row">
        ${svcBadge("postfix", status.postfix)}
        ${svcBadge("dovecot", status.dovecot)}
        ${svcBadge("opendkim", status.opendkim)}
      </div>
      <p class="hint">Queue depth: ${status.queueDepth ?? "unknown"}</p>`
    : `<p class="hint">Mail server not installed yet — run <code>setup_mailserver.py &lt;your-duckdns-domain&gt; | ssh vaultix-pi bash</code> first.</p>`;

  const dnsRows = status?.domain
    ? [
        ["MX", status.domain, `${status.domain} (priority 10)`],
        ["TXT (SPF)", status.domain, "v=spf1 mx ~all"],
        ["TXT (DMARC)", `_dmarc.${status.domain}`, `v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:postmaster@${status.domain}`],
      ]
    : [];
  if (dkim?.recordName) dnsRows.push(["TXT (DKIM)", dkim.recordName, dkim.recordValue]);

  const dnsHtml = dnsRows.length
    ? `<table class="admin-table"><tbody>${dnsRows.map(([type, name, value]) => `
        <tr>
          <td class="hint">${type}</td>
          <td style="font-family:monospace;word-break:break-all">${name}</td>
          <td style="font-family:monospace;word-break:break-all">${value}
            <button class="link-btn" data-copy="${encodeURIComponent(value)}">copy</button>
          </td>
        </tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table>`
    : `<p class="hint">DNS records will appear here once the mail server is installed.</p>`;

  return `
    <div class="admin-card">
      <h3>Server status (admin)</h3>
      ${svc}
    </div>
    <div class="admin-card">
      <h3>DNS records to publish on DuckDNS (admin)</h3>
      ${dnsHtml}
      <p class="hint" style="margin-top:8px">Reminder: PTR (reverse DNS) cannot be configured here — that's controlled by your ISP, and almost no residential ISP allows it. Gmail/Yahoo may still reject or spam-box mail from this server even with everything above published correctly.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="admin-card">
      <h3>Firewall (admin)</h3>
      <p class="hint">Opens 25/tcp + 587/tcp on this Pi's UFW. You still need to forward port 25 on your router yourself — no script can do that.</p>
      <button class="btn-secondary" id="btnOpenFirewall">Open mail ports</button>
    </div>`;
}

function render(status, dkim) {
  $("mailServerBody").innerHTML = `
    ${myMailboxCardHtml()}
    ${adminCardsHtml(status, dkim)}
  `;

  $("btnCreateMailbox")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const local_part = $("mbLocalPart").value.trim();
    const password = $("mbPassword").value;
    if (!local_part || !password) return toast("請輸入帳號名稱與密碼", "error");
    try {
      const r = await postJSON("/api/mail/mailbox", { local_part, password });
      toast(`已建立 ${r.address}`);
      await load();
    } catch (e) { toast(e.message, "error"); }
  });

  $("btnDisableMailbox")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    try {
      await reqJSON("/api/mail/mailbox", { method: "DELETE", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" } });
      toast("已停用信箱");
      await load();
    } catch (e) { toast(e.message, "error"); }
  });

  $("btnOpenFirewall")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    try {
      await postJSON("/api/admin/mail/firewall/open", {});
      toast("已開放 25/587 埠（仍需自行設定路由器 port forward）");
    } catch (e) { toast(e.message, "error"); }
  });

  $$("[data-copy]").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    copyText(decodeURIComponent(btn.dataset.copy), "DNS 記錄");
  }));
}

async function fetchAdminOnly(url) {
  // Distinguishes "you're not an admin" (403 -> hide the section) from
  // other failures (unreachable sidecar, not provisioned yet, etc. ->
  // still an admin, just nothing to show) by checking the real HTTP status
  // instead of string-matching an error message.
  const r = await fetch(url, { headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" } });
  if (r.status === 403) { isAdmin = false; return null; }
  const data = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${r.status}`);
  return data;
}

async function load() {
  try {
    mailbox = await getJSON("/api/mail/mailbox");
  } catch (e) {
    mailbox = null;
  }

  let status = null, dkim = null;
  if (isAdmin) {
    try {
      status = await fetchAdminOnly("/api/admin/mail/status");
    } catch (e) { /* sidecar unreachable etc. -- still an admin, just nothing to show */ }
    if (isAdmin) {
      try { dkim = await fetchAdminOnly("/api/admin/mail/dkim"); } catch (e) { /* not provisioned yet, fine */ }
    }
  }

  render(status, dkim);
}

window.onAdminRefresh = load;
load();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/admin_raid.js
// RAID Array management — behind /storage/raid.
function formatBlocks(blocks) {
  let v = blocks * 512, u = 0;
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB", "PB"];
  while (v >= 1024 && u < units.length - 1) { v /= 1024; u++; }
  return `${v.toFixed(1)} ${units[u]}`;
}
const STATE_COLOR = { clean: "#4ade80", active: "#4ade80", degraded: "#fbbf24", recovering: "#60a5fa", resyncing: "#60a5fa", inactive: "#6b7280" };
const STATE_LABEL = { clean: "Healthy", active: "Healthy", degraded: "Degraded", recovering: "Rebuilding", resyncing: "Syncing", inactive: "Inactive" };
const LEVEL_LABEL = { raid1: "RAID 1", raid5: "RAID 5", raid6: "RAID 6", raid0: "RAID 0", linear: "Linear" };
const MIN_DISKS = { 1: 2, 5: 3, 6: 4 };
const LEVEL_DESC = {
  1: "Mirror — requires ≥2 disks; capacity = smallest disk; survives any 1 drive failure",
  5: "Stripe+Parity — requires ≥3 disks; tolerates 1 drive failure",
  6: "Double Parity — requires ≥4 disks; tolerates 2 simultaneous drive failures",
};

let status = null, busy = false, cLevel = 1, cName = "md0", cDevices = [];

function devBadgeHtml(dev, char, isHealthy, arrName) {
  const isUp = char === "U", isFail = char === "F", isSpare = char === "S";
  const cls = isUp ? "dev-up" : isFail ? "dev-fail" : isSpare ? "dev-spare" : "dev-other";
  const dot = isUp ? "●" : isFail ? "✕" : isSpare ? "◎" : "○";
  return `<div class="dev-badge ${cls}">
    <span>${dot}</span><span>/dev/${dev.name}</span><span class="dev-idx">[${dev.index}]</span>
    ${isUp && isHealthy ? `<button class="dev-action" data-act="fail" data-arr="${arrName}" data-dev="/dev/${dev.name}">Mark Failed</button>` : ""}
    ${isFail ? `<button class="dev-action dev-action-danger" data-act="remove" data-arr="${arrName}" data-dev="/dev/${dev.name}">Remove</button>` : ""}
  </div>`;
}

function arrayCardHtml(arr) {
  const isHealthy = arr.state === "clean" || arr.state === "active";
  return `<div class="admin-card raid-array-card">
    <div class="raid-array-head">
      <span class="dot" style="background:${STATE_COLOR[arr.state] || "#6b7280"};width:10px;height:10px"></span>
      <span class="raid-arr-name">/dev/${arr.name}</span>
      <span class="raid-level-badge">${LEVEL_LABEL[arr.level] || arr.level.toUpperCase()}</span>
      <span style="color:${STATE_COLOR[arr.state] || "#9ca3af"};font-size:12px;font-weight:600">${STATE_LABEL[arr.state] || arr.state}</span>
      <span class="hint" style="margin-left:auto">${arr.activeDevices}/${arr.totalDevices} disks · ${formatBlocks(arr.sizeBlocks)}</span>
      <button class="btn-secondary raid-manage-btn" data-arr="${arr.name}">Manage</button>
    </div>
    <div class="dev-badge-row">${arr.devices.map((d, i) => devBadgeHtml(d, arr.deviceStates[i] ?? "U", isHealthy, arr.name)).join("")}</div>
    ${arr.syncPct !== undefined ? `
      <div class="raid-sync">
        <div class="usage-diskbar-labels"><span>Rebuild Progress</span><span>${arr.syncPct.toFixed(1)}% · ~${arr.syncFinish} remaining</span></div>
        <div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill bar-ok" style="width:${arr.syncPct}%"></div></div>
        ${arr.syncSpeed ? `<p class="hint" style="font-family:monospace">${arr.syncSpeed}</p>` : ""}
      </div>` : ""}
  </div>`;
}

function usedDevNames() { return new Set((status?.arrays ?? []).flatMap((a) => a.devices.map((d) => d.name))); }
function allDisks() { return (status?.disks ?? []).filter((d) => d.type === "disk" && !d.children?.some((c) => c.mountpoint) && !d.mountpoint); }
function freeDisks() { const used = usedDevNames(); return allDisks().filter((d) => !used.has(d.name)); }

function render() {
  const host = $("raidBody");
  if (!status?.mdadmAvailable) {
    host.innerHTML = '<div class="admin-empty"><p>mdadm not installed or backend not updated</p><code class="hint" style="display:block;margin-top:8px">sudo apt install mdadm</code></div>';
    return;
  }
  const used = usedDevNames();
  host.innerHTML = `
    <div class="admin-actions" style="margin-bottom:14px">
      <button class="btn-primary" id="btnCreateRaid">+ Create New Array</button>
      <span class="hint">${status.arrays.length ? `${status.arrays.length} arrays · ${status.arrays.filter((a) => a.state === "clean" || a.state === "active").length} healthy` : "No arrays created"}</span>
    </div>
    ${status.arrays.length === 0
      ? '<div class="admin-empty"><p>No RAID arrays yet</p></div>'
      : status.arrays.map(arrayCardHtml).join("")}
    ${allDisks().length ? `<p class="section-label" style="margin-top:16px">Disk List</p>
      <div class="admin-card" style="padding:0">${allDisks().map((d) => `
        <div class="raid-disk-row"><span class="raid-disk-name">/dev/${d.name}</span><span class="hint">${d.size}</span>
          ${d.model ? `<span class="hint">${d.model}</span>` : ""}
          <span class="${used.has(d.name) ? "badge-mounted" : "jail-status-badge"}" style="margin-left:auto">${used.has(d.name) ? "In Array" : "Free"}</span></div>`).join("")}</div>` : ""}
  `;
  $("btnCreateRaid")?.addEventListener("click", openCreate);
  $$(".raid-manage-btn").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => openManage(btn.dataset.arr)));
  $$(".dev-action").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => doAction(btn.dataset.arr, btn.dataset.act, btn.dataset.dev)));
}

async function load() {
  $("raidBody").innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div>';
  try {
    status = await getJSON("/api/admin/raid/status");
  } catch {
    status = { arrays: [], disks: [], mdadmAvailable: false };
  }
  render();
}

async function doAction(array, action, device) {
  busy = true;
  try {
    await postJSON("/api/admin/raid/action", { array, action, device });
    toast({ add: "Disk added, rebuilding…", remove: "Disk removed", fail: "Disk marked as failed", stop: "Array stopped" }[action] || "Done");
    closeAllModals();
    await load();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
  busy = false;
}

function closeAllModals() { ["modalManage", "modalAddDisk", "modalStop", "modalCreateRaid"].forEach(closeModal); }

function openManage(arrName) {
  const arr = status.arrays.find((a) => a.name === arrName);
  if (!arr) return;
  $("manageContent").innerHTML = `
    <div class="modal-header"><span class="modal-title">/dev/${arr.name} Management</span><button class="modal-close" data-close="modalManage">×</button></div>
    <div class="modal-body">
      <div class="meta-row"><span>Level</span><span>${LEVEL_LABEL[arr.level] || arr.level}</span></div>
      <div class="meta-row"><span>Status</span><span style="color:${STATE_COLOR[arr.state]}">${STATE_LABEL[arr.state] || arr.state}</span></div>
      <div class="meta-row"><span>Disks</span><span>${arr.activeDevices}/${arr.totalDevices}</span></div>
      <div class="meta-row"><span>Capacity</span><span>${formatBlocks(arr.sizeBlocks)}</span></div>
      <div class="admin-actions" style="margin-top:12px;flex-direction:column">
        ${freeDisks().length ? `<button class="btn-secondary btn-block" id="mAddDisk">Add Disk</button>` : ""}
        <button class="btn-danger" style="width:100%" id="mStop">Stop Array</button>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  $("manageContent").querySelector('[data-close]').addEventListener("click", () => closeModal("modalManage"));
  $("mAddDisk")?.addEventListener("click", () => { closeModal("modalManage"); openAddDisk(arr.name); });
  $("mStop")?.addEventListener("click", () => { closeModal("modalManage"); openStop(arr.name); });
  openModal("modalManage");
}

function openAddDisk(arrName) {
  let addDev = "";
  function paint() {
    $("addDiskContent").innerHTML = `
      <div class="modal-header"><span class="modal-title">Add disk to /dev/${arrName}</span><button class="modal-close" data-close="modalAddDisk">×</button></div>

            <input type="radio" name="addDisk" value="/dev/${d.name}" ${addDev === "/dev/" + d.name ? "checked" : ""}/>

      </div>
      <div class="modal-footer" style="display:flex;gap:8px">
        <button class="btn-primary" style="flex:1" id="addDiskConfirm" ${!addDev ? "disabled" : ""}>Confirm Add</button>
        <button class="btn-secondary" data-close="modalAddDisk">Cancel</button>
      </div>`;

function openCreate() {
  cLevel = 1; cName = "md0"; cDevices = [];
  const used = usedDevNames();
  for (let i = 0; i <= 9; i++) { if (!used.has(`md${i}`)) { cName = `md${i}`; break; } }
  paintCreate();
  openModal("modalCreateRaid");
}
function paintCreate() {
  const used = usedDevNames();
  $("createContent").innerHTML = `
    <div class="modal-header"><span class="modal-title">Create New RAID Array</span><button class="modal-close" data-close="modalCreateRaid">×</button></div>
    <div class="modal-body">
      <p class="section-label">RAID Level</p>
      <div class="admin-actions">${[1, 5, 6].map((l) => `<button class="btn-secondary raid-level-btn${cLevel === l ? " active" : ""}" data-level="${l}">RAID ${l}</button>`).join("")}</div>
      <p class="hint" style="margin:6px 0 12px">${LEVEL_DESC[cLevel]}</p>
      <p class="section-label">Array Name</p>
      <input id="createNameInput" value="${cName}" placeholder="md0" style="font-family:monospace;margin-bottom:12px"/>
      <p class="section-label">Select Disks (selected ${cDevices.length}, minimum ${MIN_DISKS[cLevel] ?? 2})</p>
      <div style="max-height:180px;overflow-y:auto">
        ${allDisks().length === 0 ? '<p class="hint" style="text-align:center;padding:16px 0">No available disks</p>' :
          allDisks().map((d) => { const path = `/dev/${d.name}`; const inUse = used.has(d.name); const checked = cDevices.includes(path);
            return `<label class="raid-disk-option${inUse ? " inuse" : checked ? " selected" : ""}">
              <input type="checkbox" data-path="${path}" ${checked ? "checked" : ""} ${inUse ? "disabled" : ""}/>
              <span style="font-family:monospace">${path}</span><span class="hint">${d.size}</span>${d.model ? `<span class="hint">${d.model}</span>` : ""}${inUse ? '<span class="hint" style="color:#fbbf24">In use</span>' : ""}</label>`; }).join("")}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-footer" style="display:flex;gap:8px">
      <button class="btn-primary" style="flex:1" id="createConfirm" ${cDevices.length < (MIN_DISKS[cLevel] ?? 2) ? "disabled" : ""}>Create RAID ${cLevel} Array</button>
      <button class="btn-secondary" data-close="modalCreateRaid">Cancel</button>
    </div>`;
  $$('#createContent [data-close]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => closeModal("modalCreateRaid")));
  $$(".raid-level-btn").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => { cLevel = Number(b.dataset.level); cDevices = []; paintCreate(); }));
  $("createNameInput").addEventListener("input", (e) => { cName = e.target.value; });
  $$('#createContent input[type="checkbox"]').forEach((cb) => cb.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
    if (e.target.checked) cDevices.push(e.target.dataset.path); else cDevices = cDevices.filter((x) => x !== e.target.dataset.path);
    paintCreate();
  }));
  $("createConfirm")?.addEventListener("click", doCreate);
}
async function doCreate() {
  const min = MIN_DISKS[cLevel] ?? 2;
  if (cDevices.length < min) { toast(`RAID ${cLevel} requires at least ${min} disks`, "error"); return; }
  if (!/^md\d{1,3}$/.test(cName)) { toast("Array name must be md0~md127", "error"); return; }
  try {
    await postJSON("/api/admin/raid/create", { name: cName, level: cLevel, devices: cDevices });
    toast(`/dev/${cName} created, syncing…`);
    closeAllModals();
    await load();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/admin_security.js
// Security Dashboard (Scan + Patches) — behind admin_security.py's /security/scan.
const CATEGORY_LABEL = { network: "Network", access: "Access Control", system: "System", application: "Application" };
const CATEGORY_ORDER = ["network", "access", "application", "system"];
const STATUS_CLASS = { pass: "chk-pass", warn: "chk-warn", fail: "chk-fail", info: "chk-info" };
const STATUS_ICON = { pass: "✅", warn: "⚠️", fail: "🛑", info: "ℹ️" };
const SEVERITY_CLASS = { critical: "sev-critical", high: "sev-high", medium: "sev-medium", low: "sev-low", info: "sev-info" };

function scoreClass(score) {
  if (score >= 90) return "score-good";
  if (score >= 70) return "score-ok";
  if (score >= 40) return "score-warn";
  return "score-bad";
}
function scoreGrade(score) {
  if (score >= 90) return "A"; if (score >= 80) return "B"; if (score >= 70) return "C"; if (score >= 50) return "D"; return "F";
}
function fmtSize(b) { return b < 1024 ? `${b} B` : `${(b / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`; }

let patchesLoaded = false;

async function loadScan(force) {
  const host = $("scanContent");
  host.innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div>';
  try {
    const data = await getJSON(`/api/admin/security/scan${force ? "?force=1" : ""}`);
    const grouped = CATEGORY_ORDER.map((cat) => ({ cat, checks: data.checks.filter((c) => c.category === cat) })).filter((g) => g.checks.length);
    host.innerHTML = `
      <div class="stat-row">
        <div class="stat-card stat-card-wide"><p class="stat-value ${scoreClass(data.score)}">${data.score}</p><p class="stat-label">Score (grade ${scoreGrade(data.score)})</p></div>
        <div class="stat-card"><p class="stat-value" style="color:#4ade80">${data.summary.pass}</p><p class="stat-label">Pass</p></div>
        <div class="stat-card"><p class="stat-value" style="color:#facc15">${data.summary.warn}</p><p class="stat-label">Warn</p></div>
        <div class="stat-card"><p class="stat-value" style="color:#f87171">${data.summary.fail}</p><p class="stat-label">Fail</p></div>
      </div>
      <p class="hint">Last scanned ${new Date(data.generatedAt).toLocaleString()}${data.cached ? " (cached, refreshes every 5 min — press Refresh to force a rerun)" : ""}</p>
      ${grouped.map(({ cat, checks }) => `
        <div class="check-group">
          <h2 class="section-label">${CATEGORY_LABEL[cat]}</h2>
          ${checks.map((c) => `
            <div class="check-row ${STATUS_CLASS[c.status]}">
              <span class="check-icon">${STATUS_ICON[c.status]}</span>
              <div class="check-body">
                <div class="check-title-row"><span class="check-title">${c.title}</span>
                  <span class="sev-badge ${SEVERITY_CLASS[c.severity]}">${c.severity}</span></div>
                <p class="check-detail">${c.detail}</p>
                ${c.recommendation ? `<p class="check-rec">💡 ${c.recommendation}</p>` : ""}
              </div>
            </div>`).join("")}
        </div>`).join("")}
    `;
  } catch (err) {
    host.innerHTML = `<p class="hint" style="color:var(--error)">${err.message}</p>`;
  }
}

function patchRowHtml(p) {
  return `<div class="admin-card" data-patch="${p.name}">
    <div class="patch-row-head">
      <div><p class="patch-name">${p.name}</p>
        ${p.description ? `<p class="hint">${p.description}</p>` : ""}
        <p class="hint">${fmtSize(p.size)} · 修改於 ${new Date(p.modifiedAt).toLocaleString()}</p></div>
      <button class="btn-primary btn-apply-patch" data-name="${p.name}">套用</button>
    </div>
    <div class="patch-result hidden"></div>
  </div>`;
}

async function loadPatches() {
  const host = $("patchesContent");
  host.innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div>';
  try {
    const data = await getJSON("/api/admin/security/patches");
    host.innerHTML = data.patches.length
      ? data.patches.map(patchRowHtml).join("")
      : '<p class="hint" style="text-align:center;padding:24px 0">Pi 上的 scripts/ 目錄找不到任何補丁腳本</p>';
    host.querySelectorAll(".btn-apply-patch").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => applyPatch(btn.dataset.name)));
  } catch (err) {
    host.innerHTML = `<p class="hint" style="color:var(--error)">${err.message}</p>`;
  }
}

async function applyPatch(name) {
  const card = document.querySelector(`[data-patch="${CSS.escape(name)}"]`);
  const btn = card.querySelector(".btn-apply-patch");
  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "套用中…";
  try {
    const result = await postJSON(`/api/admin/security/patches/${encodeURIComponent(name)}/apply`);
    const allOk = Object.values(result.checks).every((c) => c.ok !== false);
    toast(result.ok && allOk ? `${name} 套用成功` : `${name} 套用完成，但有項目失敗`, result.ok && allOk ? "info" : "error");
    const resultEl = card.querySelector(".patch-result");
    resultEl.classList.remove("hidden");
    resultEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="patch-checks">${Object.entries(result.checks).map(([file, c]) =>
        `<span class="patch-check-badge ${c.ok === true ? "ok" : c.ok === false ? "fail" : ""}" title="${c.error || ""}">${file} ${c.ok === true ? "✓" : c.ok === false ? "✗" : "?"}</span>`
      ).join("")}</div>
      <pre class="patch-output">${result.output || "(無輸出)"}</pre>`;
  } catch (err) {
    toast(err.message, "error");
  }
  btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "套用";
}

document.querySelectorAll("[data-restart]").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const service = btn.dataset.restart;
  if (!confirm(`確定要重啟「${btn.textContent}」嗎？這會中斷所有進行中的連線與工作。`)) return;
  btn.disabled = true;
  try {
    const d = await postJSON("/api/admin/security/restart-service", { service });
    toast(d.note || "重啟指令已送出");
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
  btn.disabled = false;
}));

  document.querySelectorAll(".admin-tab-pane").forEach((p) => p.classList.toggle("hidden", p.dataset.pane !== tab));
  if (tab === "patches" && !patchesLoaded) { patchesLoaded = true; loadPatches(); }
};
window.onAdminRefresh = () => {
  const active = document.querySelector(".admin-tab.active")?.dataset.tab || "scan";
  if (active === "scan") loadScan(true); else { patchesLoaded = true; loadPatches(); }
};
