// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/admin_snapshots.js
// Snapshot Manager — behind /tools/snapshots.
function fmtSnapTime(iso) {
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleString("zh-TW", { year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
}
let snapshots = [];

function render() {
  const host = $("snapBody");
  const filter = $("snapFilter").value.trim();
  const shown = filter ? snapshots.filter((s) => s.originalPath.includes(filter)) : snapshots;
  if (!shown.length) {
    host.innerHTML = `<div class="admin-empty"><p>${filter ? "No snapshots match" : "No snapshots yet"}</p><p class="hint">Right-click a folder → "Create Snapshot"</p></div>`;
    return;
  }
  const grouped = {};
  shown.forEach((s) => { const k = s.originalPath || "/"; (grouped[k] = grouped[k] || []).push(s); });
  host.innerHTML = Object.entries(grouped).map(([origPath, snaps]) => `
    <div class="admin-card">
      <p class="hint" style="font-family:monospace;margin-bottom:8px">📁 ${origPath || "/"} · ${snaps.length} snapshots</p>
      ${snaps.slice().sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt)).map((snap) => `
        <div class="snap-row" data-id="${snap.id}">
          <div class="snap-info"><p style="margin:0">${fmtSnapTime(snap.createdAt)}</p>${snap.size ? `<p class="hint" style="margin:2px 0 0">${snap.size}</p>` : ""}</div>
          <button class="btn-mini btn-mini-primary" data-act="restore">Restore</button>
          <button class="btn-mini" data-act="delete" data-name="${snap.name}" data-time="${fmtSnapTime(snap.createdAt)}">Delete</button>
        </div>`).join("")}
    </div>`).join("");
  host.querySelectorAll(".snap-row").forEach((row) => {
    row.querySelector('[data-act="restore"]').addEventListener("click", () => restore(row.dataset.id));
    row.querySelector('[data-act="delete"]').addEventListener("click", (e) => remove(row.dataset.id, e.target.dataset.name, e.target.dataset.time));
  });
}

async function load() {
  $("snapBody").innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div>';
  try {
    const data = await getJSON("/api/admin/snapshots");
    snapshots = data.snapshots;
    render();
  } catch { toast("Failed to load snapshots", "error"); }
}

async function restore(id) {
  try {
    const d = await postJSON(`/api/admin/snapshots/${id}/restore`);
    toast(`Restored to: ${d.restoredPath}`);
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}

async function remove(id, name, time) {
  if (!confirm(`Delete snapshot "${name} · ${time}"?`)) return;
  try {
    await fetch(`/api/admin/snapshots/${id}`, { method: "DELETE", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" } });
    toast("Snapshot deleted");
    snapshots = snapshots.filter((s) => s.id !== id);
    render();
  } catch { toast("Delete failed", "error"); }
}

$("snapFilter").addEventListener("input", render);
window.onAdminRefresh = load;
load();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/admin_storage_manager.js
// Storage Manager (mount/umount/rename/access) — behind /storage/manager.
const SYSTEM_PREFIXES = ["mmcblk0", "mmcblk1"];
const isSystemDisk = (name) => SYSTEM_PREFIXES.some((p) => name === p || name.startsWith(p + "p"));

function getPartitions(dev) {
  const parts = [];
  for (const c of dev.children ?? []) {
    if (c.mountpoint === "/") continue;
    if (c.type === "part") parts.push(c);
    parts.push(...getPartitions(c));
  }
  if (parts.length === 0 && dev.type === "disk" && dev.mountpoint !== "/") parts.push(dev);
  return parts;
}

let blockDevices = [], registry = [], users = [], mountNames = {};

async function loadAccessInfo() {
  try {
    const [reg, us] = await Promise.all([getJSON("/api/admin/storage/registry"), getJSON("/api/admin/storage/users")]);
    registry = reg.disks; users = us.users;
  } catch { /* access panel is a bonus */ }
}

function accessPanelHtml(partName) {
  const entry = registry.find((d) => d.device === `/dev/${partName}`);
  if (!entry) return "";
  const grantable = users.filter((u) => u.role !== "admin" && u.username !== entry.ownerUsername);
  if (!grantable.length) return "";
  const grantedIds = new Set(entry.grantedUsers.map((g) => g.id));
  return `<div class="access-panel">
    <p class="hint">存取權限（擁有者 ${entry.ownerUsername} 與所有管理員預設可用）</p>
    <div class="access-chips">
      ${grantable.map((u) => `<button class="access-chip${grantedIds.has(u.id) ? " granted" : ""}" data-disk="${entry.id}" data-user="${u.id}" data-granted="${grantedIds.has(u.id)}">${grantedIds.has(u.id) ? "✓ " : ""}${u.display_name || u.username}</button>`).join("")}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

function partitionHtml(part) {
  const sysMount = part.mountpoint;
  const defaultName = mountNames[part.name] ?? part.label ?? part.name;
  return `<div class="sm-partition" data-part="${part.name}">
    <div class="sm-part-info">
      <div class="sm-part-name-row">
        <span class="sm-part-name">/dev/${part.name}</span>
        ${part.label ? `<span class="hint">(${part.label})</span>` : ""}
        <button class="rename-btn" data-part="${part.name}" data-default="${defaultName}" title="重新命名磁碟標籤">✎</button>
      </div>
      <p class="hint">${part.size} · ${part.fstype ?? "Unknown format"}</p>
      ${sysMount ? `<p class="sm-sysmount">System mounted at ${sysMount}</p>` : ""}
    </div>
    ${sysMount ? '<span class="badge-mounted">Mounted</span>' : '<span class="badge-unmounted">Not mounted</span>'}
    <div class="sm-part-actions">
      <input type="text" class="sm-name-input" data-part="${part.name}" placeholder="NAS folder name" value="${defaultName}"/>
      <button class="btn-primary sm-mount-btn" data-part="${part.name}" data-sysmount="${sysMount || ""}">${sysMount ? "Add to NAS" : "Mount to NAS"}</button>
    </div>
    ${sysMount ? '<p class="hint">System-mounted. Click "Add to NAS" to access it in the file list.</p>' : ""}
    ${accessPanelHtml(part.name)}
  </div>`;
}

function diskHtml(disk) {
  const parts = getPartitions(disk);
  return `<div class="admin-card sm-disk">
    <div class="sm-disk-head"><span class="sm-disk-name">/dev/${disk.name}</span><span class="hint">${disk.size}</span>
      <span class="badge-external">External</span></div>
    ${parts.map(partitionHtml).join("")}
  </div>`;
}

async function load() {
  const host = $("smBody");
  host.innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div>';
  try {
    const res = await getJSON("/api/admin/storage/disks");
    blockDevices = res.blockdevices ?? [];
  } catch (err) {
    host.innerHTML = `<div class="admin-card" style="border-color:var(--error)"><p style="color:var(--error);font-weight:600">Cannot read disk info</p><p class="hint" style="font-family:monospace">${err.message}</p></div>`;
    return;
  }
  await loadAccessInfo();
  const mountable = blockDevices.filter((d) => (d.type === "disk" || d.type === "part") && !isSystemDisk(d.name));
  host.innerHTML = mountable.length
    ? mountable.map(diskHtml).join("") + '<div id="smMsg"></div>' + setupNoteHtml()
    : `<div class="admin-empty"><p>No external devices detected</p><p class="hint">Please check the device is connected</p><p class="hint">System disks (${SYSTEM_PREFIXES.join(", ")} prefix) are excluded</p></div>${setupNoteHtml()}`;
  wireRows();
}

function setupNoteHtml() {
  return `<div class="admin-card" style="margin-top:10px">
    <p class="hint">If mounting fails, check sudo permissions on the Raspberry Pi:</p>
    <pre class="patch-output" style="color:#4ade80">echo "roy ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /bin/mount, /bin/umount" | sudo tee /etc/sudoers.d/casaos-mount</pre>
  </div>`;
}

function showMsg(text, ok) {
  const el = $("smMsg");
  if (!el) return;
  el.innerHTML = `<div class="admin-card" style="border-color:${ok ? "#4ade80" : "var(--error)"};color:${ok ? "#4ade80" : "var(--error)"}">${text}</div>`;
}

function wireRows() {
  $$(".sm-mount-btn").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => doMount(btn.dataset.part, btn.dataset.sysmount || null)));
  $$(".sm-name-input").forEach((inp) => inp.addEventListener("input", () => { mountNames[inp.dataset.part] = inp.value; }));
  $$(".rename-btn").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => startRename(btn.dataset.part, btn.dataset.default)));
  $$(".access-chip").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => toggleAccess(btn.dataset.disk, btn.dataset.user, btn.dataset.granted !== "true")));
}

async function doMount(partName, existingMountpoint) {
  const folderName = (mountNames[partName] ?? partName).trim();
  if (!folderName) { showMsg("Please enter a folder name", false); return; }
  const btn = document.querySelector(`.sm-mount-btn[data-part="${CSS.escape(partName)}"]`);
  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "…";
  try {
    await postJSON("/api/admin/storage/mount", { device: `/dev/${partName}`, folderName, bindSource: existingMountpoint || null });
    showMsg(`✓ Mounted /dev/${partName} in NAS. Refresh the file list to see it.`, true);
    await load();
  } catch (err) { showMsg(`✗ ${err.message}`, false); btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = existingMountpoint ? "Add to NAS" : "Mount to NAS"; }
}

function startRename(partName, defaultName) {
  const row = document.querySelector(`.sm-partition[data-part="${CSS.escape(partName)}"] .sm-part-name-row`);
  row.innerHTML = `<input type="text" class="rename-input" placeholder="新名稱（目前：${defaultName}）" value=""/>
    <button class="btn-mini btn-mini-primary rename-confirm">確認</button>
    <button class="btn-mini rename-cancel">取消</button>`;
  const input = row.querySelector(".rename-input");
  input.focus();
  const confirm = () => renameFolder(partName, defaultName, input.value);
  row.querySelector(".rename-confirm").addEventListener("click", confirm);
  row.querySelector(".rename-cancel").addEventListener("click", load);
  input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") confirm(); if (e.key === "Escape") load(); });
}

async function renameFolder(partName, oldName, newName) {
  if (!newName.trim()) return;
  try {
    await postJSON("/api/admin/storage/rename-folder", { oldName: oldName.trim(), newName: newName.trim() });
    showMsg(`✓ 已將 "${oldName}" 重新命名為 "${newName.trim()}"（如有掛載已自動重新掛載）`, true);
    mountNames[partName] = newName.trim();
    await load();
  } catch (err) { showMsg(`✗ ${err.message}`, false); }
}

async function toggleAccess(diskId, userId, grant) {
  try {
    if (grant) await postJSON(`/api/admin/storage/access/${diskId}`, { userId: Number(userId) });
    else await fetch(`/api/admin/storage/access/${diskId}/${userId}`, { method: "DELETE", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" } });
    await load();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}

window.onAdminRefresh = load;
load();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/admin_storage_usage.js
// Storage Usage (pie chart) — behind /storage/usage.
const TYPE_COLORS = { video: "#6366f1", audio: "#8b5cf6", image: "#06b6d4", pdf: "#ef4444", doc: "#3b82f6",
  sheet: "#22c55e", slide: "#f59e0b", archive: "#f97316", code: "#a3e635", text: "#64748b", other: "#4b5563" };
const TYPE_LABELS = { video: "影片", audio: "音訊", image: "圖片", pdf: "PDF", doc: "文件", sheet: "試算表",
  slide: "簡報", archive: "壓縮檔", code: "程式碼", text: "文字", other: "其他" };
const USER_PALETTE = ["#f59e0b", "#6366f1", "#22c55e", "#ef4444", "#06b6d4", "#8b5cf6", "#f97316", "#84cc16", "#ec4899", "#14b8a6"];

function fmtBytes(b) {
  if (b === 0) return "0 B";
  const sizes = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  const i = Math.floor(Math.log(b) / Math.log(1024));
  return `${(b / Math.pow(1024, i)).toFixed(1)} ${sizes[i]}`;
}

let usageData = null, scope = "system", kind = "type", hovered = -1;

function currentSlices() {
  const scopeData = usageData?.[scope];
  if (kind === "type") {
    return Object.entries(TYPE_LABELS).map(([key, label]) => ({ label, value: scopeData?.byType?.[key] ?? 0, color: TYPE_COLORS[key] ?? "#4b5563" }));
  }
  return Object.entries(scopeData?.byUser ?? {}).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([name, value], i) => ({ label: name, value, color: USER_PALETTE[i % USER_PALETTE.length] }));
}

function drawPie(canvas, slices) {
  const SIZE = 200;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  if (canvas.width !== SIZE * dpr) {
    canvas.width = SIZE * dpr; canvas.height = SIZE * dpr;
    canvas.style.width = SIZE + "px"; canvas.style.height = SIZE + "px";
  }
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, SIZE, SIZE);
  const cx = SIZE / 2, cy = SIZE / 2, outerR = SIZE / 2 - 6, innerR = outerR * 0.55;
  const total = slices.reduce((s, d) => s + d.value, 0);

  if (total === 0) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, outerR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.strokeStyle = "#374151"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
  } else {
    let startAngle = -Math.PI / 2;
    slices.forEach((slice, i) => {
      if (slice.value === 0) return;
      const angle = (slice.value / total) * Math.PI * 2;
      const isHov = hovered === i;
      const midA = startAngle + angle / 2;
      const offset = isHov ? 7 : 0;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(Math.cos(midA) * offset, Math.sin(midA) * offset);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy); ctx.arc(cx, cy, outerR, startAngle, startAngle + angle); ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = slice.color; ctx.globalAlpha = isHov ? 1 : 0.85; ctx.fill(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
      startAngle += angle;
    });
  }
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, innerR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fillStyle = "#0f1117"; ctx.fill();
  ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  if (hovered >= 0 && hovered < slices.length && slices[hovered].value > 0) {
    const s = slices[hovered];
    ctx.fillStyle = s.color; ctx.font = "bold 11px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText(s.label, cx, cy - 9);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#d1d5db"; ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText(fmtBytes(s.value), cx, cy + 8);
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9ca3af"; ctx.font = "bold 13px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText(fmtBytes(total), cx, cy - 7);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#6b7280"; ctx.font = "10px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("總計", cx, cy + 9);
  }
}

function pieHover(canvas, slices, e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = e.clientX - rect.left - 100, y = e.clientY - rect.top - 100;
  const dist = Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y);
  const outerR = 94, innerR = outerR * 0.55;
  const total = slices.reduce((s, d) => s + d.value, 0);
  if (dist < innerR || dist > outerR || total === 0) { hovered = -1; drawPie(canvas, slices); return; }
  let angle = Math.atan2(y, x) + Math.PI / 2;
  if (angle < 0) angle += Math.PI * 2;
  let cum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < slices.length; i++) {
    if (slices[i].value === 0) continue;
    cum += (slices[i].value / total) * Math.PI * 2;
    if (angle <= cum) { hovered = i; drawPie(canvas, slices); return; }
  }
  hovered = -1; drawPie(canvas, slices);
}

function legendHtml(slices) {
  const total = slices.reduce((s, d) => s + d.value, 0);
  const sorted = slices.filter((s) => s.value > 0).sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);
  if (!sorted.length) return '<p class="hint" style="font-style:italic">尚無資料</p>';
  return `<div class="usage-legend">${sorted.map((s) => `
    <div class="usage-legend-row"><span class="legend-dot" style="background:${s.color}"></span>
      <span class="legend-label">${s.label}</span>
      <span class="legend-value">${fmtBytes(s.value)}</span>
      <span class="legend-pct">${total > 0 ? ((s.value / total) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0}%</span></div>`).join("")}</div>`;
}

function diskBarHtml(disk) {
  if (!disk) return '<p class="hint" style="font-style:italic">尚無磁碟容量資訊</p>';
  const pct = disk.total > 0 ? Math.min(100, (disk.used / disk.total) * 100) : 0;
  const cls = pct >= 90 ? "bar-danger" : pct >= 75 ? "bar-warn" : "bar-ok";
  return `<div class="bar-track" style="height:10px;margin-bottom:6px"><div class="bar-fill ${cls}" style="width:${pct}%"></div></div>
    <div class="usage-diskbar-labels"><span>已用 ${fmtBytes(disk.used)} (${pct.toFixed(1)}%)</span>
      <span style="color:#4ade80">剩餘 ${fmtBytes(disk.free)}</span><span class="hint">總共 ${fmtBytes(disk.total)}</span></div>`;
}

function render() {
  const host = $("usageBody");
  const scopeData = usageData?.[scope];
  const slices = currentSlices();
  host.innerHTML = `
    ${diskBarHtml(scopeData?.disk ?? null)}
    <div class="usage-chart-row">
      <canvas id="usagePie" width="200" height="200"></canvas>
      <div id="usageLegendHost">${legendHtml(slices)}</div>
    </div>`;
  const canvas = $("usagePie");
  drawPie(canvas, slices);
  canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => pieHover(canvas, slices, e));
  canvas.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => { hovered = -1; drawPie(canvas, slices); });
}

async function load() {
  const host = $("usageBody");
  host.innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div>';
  try {
    usageData = await getJSON("/api/admin/storage/usage");
    render();
  } catch (err) {
    host.innerHTML = `<div class="admin-card" style="border-color:var(--error)"><p style="color:var(--error);font-weight:600">無法取得儲存用量資料</p><pre class="patch-output" style="color:var(--error)">${err.message}</pre></div>`;
  }
}

$$(".scope-tab").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  $$(".scope-tab").forEach((b) => b.classList.remove("active")); btn.classList.add("active");
  scope = btn.dataset.scope; hovered = -1; render();
}));
$$(".kind-tab").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  $$(".kind-tab").forEach((b) => b.classList.remove("active")); btn.classList.add("active");
  kind = btn.dataset.kind; hovered = -1; render();
}));

window.onAdminRefresh = load;
load();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/admin_system.js
// System Settings — behind /system.
function safeId() {
  try { if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && crypto.randomUUID) return crypto.randomUUID(); } catch {}
  return `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
}
function bytesFmt(n) {
  if (n >= 1e12) return `${(n / 1e12).toFixed(1)} TB`;
  if (n >= 1e9) return `${(n / 1e9).toFixed(1)} GB`;
  if (n >= 1e6) return `${(n / 1e6).toFixed(1)} MB`;
  return `${(n / 1e3).toFixed(0)} KB`;
}
function uptimeFmt(s) {
  const d = Math.floor(s / 86400), h = Math.floor((s % 86400) / 3600), m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60);
  if (d > 0) return `${d}d ${h}h`;
  if (h > 0) return `${h}h ${m}m`;
  return `${m}m`;
}

      <div><p class="hint">IP Address</p><p style="font-family:monospace">${info.ip}</p></div>
      <div><p class="hint">Uptime</p><p>${uptimeFmt(info.uptime)}</p></div>
      <div><p class="hint">Memory</p><p>${bytesFmt(memUsed)} / ${bytesFmt(info.memory.total)}</p>
        <div class="bar-track" style="width:120px;margin-top:4px"><div class="bar-fill bar-ok" style="width:${(memUsed / info.memory.total) * 100}%"></div></div></div>
    </div>
    ${info.disk ? `<p class="section-label" style="margin-top:14px">Storage</p>

      <div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill ${info.disk.used / info.disk.total > 0.85 ? "bar-danger" : "bar-ok"}" style="width:${(info.disk.used / info.disk.total) * 100}%"></div></div>` : ""}

async function toggleService(btn) {
  const active = btn.dataset.active === "true";
  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "…";
  try {
    await postJSON(`/api/admin/system/services/${btn.dataset.api}/${active ? "stop" : "start"}`);
    await loadInfo();
  } catch { toast(`Operation failed. Please ensure ${btn.dataset.api} is installed and sudoers is configured.`, "error"); btn.disabled = false; }
}

// ── Saved devices (via /api/widgets/prefs) ─────────────────────
function deviceCardHtml(d) {
  const base = d.port ? `${d.scheme}://${d.ip}:${d.port}` : `${d.scheme}://${d.ip}`;
  const links = [[d.scheme.toUpperCase(), base], ["SSH", `ssh://root@${d.ip}`], ["SMB", `smb://${d.ip}`], ["FTP", `ftp://${d.ip}`]];
  return `<div class="admin-card device-card" data-id="${d.id}">
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px">
      <div style="min-width:0"><p style="margin:0;font-weight:600">${d.name}</p>
        <p class="hint" style="font-family:monospace">${d.scheme}://${d.ip}${d.port ? ":" + d.port : ""}</p>
        ${d.note ? `<p class="hint">${d.note}</p>` : ""}</div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:4px;flex-shrink:0">
        <button class="link-btn dev-copy" data-ip="${d.ip}">Copy IP</button>
        <button class="btn-mini dev-edit">Edit</button>
        <button class="btn-mini dev-delete">Delete</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="admin-actions" style="margin-top:8px">
      ${links.map(([l, href]) => `<a class="link-btn" style="border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 10px" href="${href}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${l}</a>`).join("")}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
function renderDevices() {
  const host = $("devicesBody");
  host.innerHTML = devices.length ? devices.map(deviceCardHtml).join("") :
    '<div class="admin-empty"><p>No devices added yet</p><p class="hint">Click "Add Device" to add one by IP address</p></div>';
  host.querySelectorAll(".device-card").forEach((card) => {
    const id = card.dataset.id;
    card.querySelector(".dev-copy").addEventListener("click", (e) => copyText(e.target.dataset.ip, "IP"));
    card.querySelector(".dev-edit").addEventListener("click", () => openDeviceModal(devices.find((d) => d.id === id)));
    card.querySelector(".dev-delete").addEventListener("click", () => deleteDevice(id));
  });
}
async function loadDevices() {
  try {
    const prefs = await getJSON("/api/widgets/prefs");
    devices = prefs.saved_devices || [];
  } catch { devices = []; }
  renderDevices();
}
async function saveDevices() {
  await postJSON("/api/widgets/prefs", { saved_devices: devices });
}
async function deleteDevice(id) {
  devices = devices.filter((d) => d.id !== id);
  renderDevices();
  await saveDevices();
}

function openDeviceModal(existing) {
  const form = existing ? { ...existing } : { name: "", ip: "", port: "", scheme: "http", note: "" };
  function paint(err) {
    $("deviceModalContent").innerHTML = `
      <div class="modal-header"><span class="modal-title">${existing ? "Edit Device" : "Add Device"}</span><button class="modal-close" data-close="modalDevice">×</button></div>
      <div class="modal-body">
        <label class="field-label">IP Address / Hostname *</label>
        <input id="devIp" value="${form.ip}" placeholder="192.168.1.100 or https://your-name.ts.net" style="font-family:monospace;margin-bottom:4px"/>
        ${err ? `<p class="vid-error">${err}</p>` : ""}
        <p class="hint" style="margin-bottom:10px">You can paste a full https:// URL and the scheme below will update automatically.</p>
        <label class="field-label">Connection Type</label>
        <div class="admin-actions" style="margin-bottom:10px">
          <button class="btn-secondary scheme-btn${form.scheme === "http" ? " active" : ""}" data-scheme="http">http://</button>
          <button class="btn-secondary scheme-btn${form.scheme === "https" ? " active" : ""}" data-scheme="https">https://</button>
        </div>
        <label class="field-label">Device Name (optional)</label><input id="devName" value="${form.name}" placeholder="My NAS, Pi Server..." style="margin-bottom:10px"/>
        <label class="field-label">Primary Port (optional)</label><input id="devPort" value="${form.port}" placeholder="3000" style="font-family:monospace;margin-bottom:10px"/>
        <label class="field-label">Notes (optional)</label><input id="devNote" value="${form.note}" placeholder="Describe usage or location..."/>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-footer" style="display:flex;gap:8px">
        <button class="btn-secondary" style="flex:1" data-close="modalDevice">Cancel</button>
        <button class="btn-primary" style="flex:1" id="devSubmit">${existing ? "Save" : "Add"}</button>
      </div>`;
    $$('#deviceModalContent [data-close]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => closeModal("modalDevice")));
    $$(".scheme-btn").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => { form.scheme = b.dataset.scheme; paint(); }));
    $("devIp").addEventListener("input", (e) => { form.ip = e.target.value; });
    $("devName").addEventListener("input", (e) => { form.name = e.target.value; });
    $("devPort").addEventListener("input", (e) => { form.port = e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ""); });
    $("devNote").addEventListener("input", (e) => { form.note = e.target.value; });
    $("devSubmit").addEventListener("click", () => submit(form, paint));
  }
  paint();
  openModal("modalDevice");
}
async function submit(form, paint) {
  let ip = form.ip.replace(/[\s ]+/g, " ").trim();
  let scheme = form.scheme, port = (form.port || "").trim();
  const schemeMatch = ip.match(/^(https?):\/\//i);
  if (schemeMatch) { scheme = schemeMatch[1].toLowerCase(); ip = ip.slice(schemeMatch[0].length); }
  ip = ip.replace(/\/.*$/, "");
  const portMatch = ip.match(/^(.+):(\d{1,5})$/);
  if (portMatch) { ip = portMatch[1]; if (!port) port = portMatch[2]; }
  if (!ip) { paint("Please enter an IP address"); return; }
  const ipRe = /^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$|^[a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9-]*\.?)+[a-zA-Z0-9]$/;
  if (!ipRe.test(ip)) { paint("Invalid format, please enter a valid IP or hostname"); return; }
  const data = { name: form.name.trim() || ip, ip, port, scheme, note: form.note.trim() };
  if (form.id) {
    devices = devices.map((d) => (d.id === form.id ? { ...d, ...data } : d));
  } else {
    devices.push({ ...data, id: safeId(), addedAt: Date.now() });
  }
  renderDevices();
  await saveDevices();
  closeModal("modalDevice");
}

loadDevices();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/admin_todo.js
// To-Do — behind /tools/todo.
const PRIORITY_COLOR = { high: "#f87171", normal: "#fb923c", low: "#6b7280" };
const PRIORITY_LABEL = { high: "High", normal: "Normal", low: "Low" };

let todos = [], filter = "active", priority = "normal", editId = null;

function fmtDue(d) {
  if (!d) return "";
  const date = new Date(d), today = new Date(); today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const diff = Math.ceil((date.getTime() - today.getTime()) / 86400000);
  if (diff < 0) return `<span style="color:#f87171;font-size:10px">${-diff} day(s) overdue</span>`;
  if (diff === 0) return '<span style="color:#facc15;font-size:10px">Today</span>';
  if (diff === 1) return '<span style="color:#fb923c;font-size:10px">Tomorrow</span>';
  return `<span class="hint">${date.toLocaleDateString("zh-TW", { month: "short", day: "numeric" })}</span>`;
}

function todoRowHtml(t) {
  return `<div class="todo-row${t.done ? " done" : ""}" data-id="${t.id}">
    <button class="todo-check${t.done ? " done" : ""}">${t.done ? "✓" : ""}</button>
    <div class="todo-body">
      <p class="todo-title${t.done ? " done" : ""}" data-edit-trigger>${t.title}</p>
      <div class="admin-actions" style="gap:6px;margin-top:2px">
        <span style="color:${PRIORITY_COLOR[t.priority]};font-size:10px">● ${PRIORITY_LABEL[t.priority]}</span>
        ${t.due_date ? fmtDue(t.due_date) : ""}
      </div>
    </div>
    <button class="todo-del" title="Delete">×</button>
  </div>`;
}

function render() {
  const host = $("todoList");
  const filtered = todos.filter((t) => (filter === "all" ? true : filter === "active" ? !t.done : t.done));
  host.innerHTML = filtered.length ? filtered.map(todoRowHtml).join("")
    : `<div class="admin-empty"><p>${filter === "done" ? "No completed items yet" : "No tasks — take a break!"}</p></div>`;
  host.querySelectorAll(".todo-row").forEach((row) => {
    const id = Number(row.dataset.id);
    row.querySelector(".todo-check").addEventListener("click", () => toggle(id));
    row.querySelector(".todo-del").addEventListener("click", () => remove(id));
    row.querySelector("[data-edit-trigger]").addEventListener("dblclick", () => startEdit(row, id));
  });
  const doneCount = todos.filter((t) => t.done).length;
  $("todoClearRow").innerHTML = doneCount > 0 ? `<button class="link-btn" id="todoClearDone">Clear all done (${doneCount})</button>` : "";
  $("todoClearDone")?.addEventListener("click", clearDone);
}

function startEdit(row, id) {
  const t = todos.find((x) => x.id === id);
  const p = row.querySelector("[data-edit-trigger]");
  p.outerHTML = `<input class="todo-edit-input" value="${t.title}"/>`;
  const input = row.querySelector(".todo-edit-input");
  input.focus();
  const save = () => saveEdit(id, input.value);
  input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") save(); if (e.key === "Escape") render(); });
  input.addEventListener("blur", save);
}
async function saveEdit(id, title) {
  if (!title.trim()) return;
  try {
    await fetch(`/api/admin/todos/${id}`, { method: "PUT", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF": "1" }, body: JSON.stringify({ title: title.trim() }) });
    todos = todos.map((t) => (t.id === id ? { ...t, title: title.trim() } : t));
    render();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}

async function load() {
  $("todoList").innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div>';
  try { todos = await getJSON("/api/admin/todos"); render(); }
  catch { toast("Failed to load tasks", "error"); }
}
$("todoAdd").addEventListener("click", addTodo);
$("todoInput").addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") addTodo(); });
async function addTodo() {
  const title = $("todoInput").value.trim();
  if (!title) return;
  try {
    const t = await postJSON("/api/admin/todos", { title, priority, due_date: $("todoDue").value || null });
    todos.unshift(t);
    $("todoInput").value = ""; $("todoDue").value = "";
    render();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}
async function toggle(id) {
  const t = todos.find((x) => x.id === id);
  try {
    await fetch(`/api/admin/todos/${id}`, { method: "PUT", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF": "1" }, body: JSON.stringify({ done: !t.done }) });
    todos = todos.map((x) => (x.id === id ? { ...x, done: !x.done } : x));
    render();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}
async function remove(id) {
  try {
    await fetch(`/api/admin/todos/${id}`, { method: "DELETE", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" } });
    todos = todos.filter((t) => t.id !== id);
    render();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}
async function clearDone() {
  const doneIds = todos.filter((t) => t.done).map((t) => t.id);
  await Promise.all(doneIds.map((id) => fetch(`/api/admin/todos/${id}`, { method: "DELETE", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" } })));
  todos = todos.filter((t) => !t.done);
  render();
  toast("Cleared completed items");
}

$$("#prioGroup .filter-pill").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  $$("#prioGroup .filter-pill").forEach((b) => b.classList.remove("active"));
  btn.classList.add("active");
  priority = btn.dataset.prio;
}));

window.onAdminTab = (tab) => { filter = tab; render(); };
window.onAdminRefresh = load;
load();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/admin_ups.js
// UPS System — behind /tools/ups.
function statusBadgeHtml(status) {
  const online = status.includes("OL") && !status.includes("OB");
  const onBatt = status.includes("OB");
  const lowBatt = status.includes("LB");
  const charging = status.includes("CHRG");
  let color = "#9ca3af", dot = "#9ca3af";
  if (lowBatt) { color = "#f87171"; dot = "#f87171"; }
  else if (onBatt) { color = "#fde047"; dot = "#facc15"; }
  else if (online || charging) { color = "#4ade80"; dot = "#4ade80"; }
  const label = lowBatt ? "Low Battery" : onBatt ? "On Battery" : online ? "On AC" : charging ? "Charging" : "Unknown";
  return `<span class="ups-badge" style="color:${color};background:${color}22"><span class="dot" style="background:${dot};width:6px;height:6px"></span>${label}</span>`;
}
function batteryBarHtml(pct) {
  const cls = pct > 50 ? "bar-ok" : pct > 20 ? "bar-warn" : "bar-danger";
  return `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px">
    <div class="bar-track" style="flex:1;height:12px"><div class="bar-fill ${cls}" style="width:${pct}%"></div></div>
    <span style="font-weight:700;width:42px;text-align:right">${pct.toFixed(0)}%</span></div>`;
}

async function load() {
  const host = $("upsBody");
  host.innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div>';
  let data;
  try { data = await getJSON("/api/admin/ups"); } catch { data = { connected: false }; }

  if (!data.connected) {
    host.innerHTML = `<div class="admin-empty"><p>No UPS detected</p>
      <p class="hint">Please ensure NUT (upsd) or apcupsd is installed on the Pi<br/>and a USB UPS is connected</p></div>`;
    return;
  }
  const stats = [];
  if (data.runtimeMin != null) stats.push(["Runtime Est.", `${data.runtimeMin} min`]);
  if (data.loadPct != null) stats.push(["Load", `${data.loadPct.toFixed(0)}%`]);
  if (data.inputVoltage != null) stats.push(["Input Voltage", `${data.inputVoltage.toFixed(1)} V`]);
  if (data.outputVoltage != null) stats.push(["Output Voltage", `${data.outputVoltage.toFixed(1)} V`]);
  if (data.batteryVoltage != null) stats.push(["Battery Voltage", `${data.batteryVoltage.toFixed(1)} V`]);
  if (data.temperature != null) stats.push(["Temperature", `${data.temperature.toFixed(1)} °C`]);

  host.innerHTML = `
    <div class="admin-card">
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px">
        <div><p style="margin:0;font-weight:700">${data.model || "UPS Device"}</p>${data.manufacturer ? `<p class="hint" style="margin:2px 0 0">${data.manufacturer}</p>` : ""}</div>
        ${data.status ? statusBadgeHtml(data.status) : ""}
      </div>
      ${data.batteryPct != null ? `<p class="hint" style="margin-bottom:6px">Battery</p>${batteryBarHtml(data.batteryPct)}` : ""}
      ${stats.length ? `<div class="stat-row" style="margin-top:14px">${stats.map(([l, v]) => `<div class="stat-card"><p class="stat-value" style="font-size:16px">${v}</p><p class="stat-label">${l}</p></div>`).join("")}</div>` : ""}
      <p class="hint" style="text-align:right;margin-top:10px">Driver: ${data.driver === "nut" ? "NUT (Network UPS Tools)" : "apcupsd"}</p>
    </div>`;
}

window.onAdminRefresh = load;
load();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/admin_users.js
// User Management — behind /admin/users. NODE_API user id for "me" isn't known
// client-side without decoding the cookie, so avatar upload for the logged-in
// user's own row is detected server-side isn't possible either — instead we
// just always target the specific row's user id via the admin endpoint; the
// backend's /api/admin/users/:id/avatar works for any id including your own
// when you're an admin, so the me-vs-other split from the original tsx isn't
// needed here.
let users = [], avatarTargetId = null;

function fmtRemaining(expiresAt) {
  const diff = new Date(expiresAt).getTime() - Date.now();
  if (diff <= 0) return "已過期";
  const mins = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
  if (mins < 60) return `${mins} 分鐘後到期`;
  const h = Math.floor(mins / 60), m = mins % 60;
  return m === 0 ? `${h} 小時後到期` : `${h} 小時 ${m} 分後到期`;
}
function avatarHtml(u) {
  if (u.avatar_ext) return `<img src="${window.__nodePublicUrl}/api/avatars/${u.username}?t=${Date.now()}" class="avatar-sm" style="width:40px;height:40px" alt="${u.username}"/>`;
  return `<div class="avatar-sm avatar-fallback" style="width:40px;height:40px;font-size:16px">${(u.display_name || u.username).charAt(0).toUpperCase()}</div>`;
}

function userRowHtml(u, meId) {
  const isSelf = u.id === meId;
  const isTemp = !!u.is_temporary;
  const tempExpired = isTemp && u.temp_expires_at && new Date(u.temp_expires_at) < new Date();
  let badges = "";
  if (isTemp) badges += `<span class="jail-status-badge" style="background:rgba(250,204,21,0.15);color:#facc15">臨時</span>`;
  else badges += `<span class="jail-status-badge" style="${u.role === "admin" ? "background:rgba(251,146,60,0.15);color:#fb923c" : ""}">${u.role === "admin" ? "管理員" : "一般使用者"}</span>`;
  if (u.disabled) badges += `<span class="jail-status-badge" style="background:rgba(248,113,113,0.15);color:#f87171">已停用</span>`;
  if (isTemp && u.temp_login_used) badges += `<span class="jail-status-badge">已使用</span>`;
  else if (isTemp && tempExpired) badges += `<span class="jail-status-badge" style="background:rgba(248,113,113,0.1);color:#f87171">已過期</span>`;
  else if (isTemp && u.temp_expires_at) badges += `<span class="hint">${fmtRemaining(u.temp_expires_at)}</span>`;
  else if (isTemp) badges += `<span class="hint">無時效限制</span>`;

  return `<div class="admin-card user-row" data-id="${u.id}" data-username="${u.username}" data-role="${u.role}">
    <button class="user-avatar-btn" data-id="${u.id}" title="點擊更換頭貼">${avatarHtml(u)}</button>
    <div class="user-info">
      <div class="docker-name-row"><span class="docker-name">${u.display_name || u.username}</span>
        ${u.display_name ? `<span class="hint">@${u.username}</span>` : ""}
        ${isSelf ? '<span class="jail-status-badge" style="background:rgba(96,165,250,0.15);color:#60a5fa">你</span>' : ""}</div>
      <div class="admin-actions" style="margin-top:4px">${badges}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="docker-actions">
      ${u.role !== "admin" ? `<button class="btn-mini" data-act="disk">磁碟</button>` : ""}
      <button class="btn-mini" data-act="edit">編輯</button>
      ${!isSelf ? `<button class="btn-mini" data-act="delete">刪除</button>` : ""}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

function render() {
  const host = $("usersBody");
  $("userCount").textContent = `${users.length} 位使用者`;
  host.innerHTML = users.map((u) => userRowHtml(u, window.__meId)).join("");
  host.querySelectorAll(".user-row").forEach((row) => {
    const id = row.dataset.id;
    row.querySelector(".user-avatar-btn")?.addEventListener("click", () => { avatarTargetId = id; $("avatarFileInput").click(); });
    row.querySelector('[data-act="disk"]')?.addEventListener("click", () => openDiskAccess(id));
    row.querySelector('[data-act="edit"]')?.addEventListener("click", () => openEdit(id));
    row.querySelector('[data-act="delete"]')?.addEventListener("click", () => deleteUser(id, row.dataset.username));
  });
}

async function load() {
  $("usersBody").innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div>';
  try {
    const data = await getJSON("/api/admin/userlist");
    users = data.users;
    render();
  } catch { toast("無法載入使用者列表", "error"); }
}

$("avatarFileInput").addEventListener("change", async (e) => {
  const file = e.target.files?.[0];
  e.target.value = "";
  if (!file || !avatarTargetId) return;
  const form = new FormData(); form.append("avatar", file);
  try {
    const r = await fetch(`/api/admin/userlist/${avatarTargetId}/avatar`, { method: "POST", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" }, body: form });
    const d = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(d.error || `HTTP ${r.status}`);
    toast("頭貼已更新");
    await load();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
  avatarTargetId = null;
});

async function deleteUser(id, username) {
  if (!confirm(`確定要刪除使用者「${username}」？\n\n使用者的檔案不會被刪除。`)) return;
  try {
    await fetch(`/api/admin/userlist/${id}`, { method: "DELETE", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" } });
    toast("已刪除使用者");
    users = users.filter((u) => String(u.id) !== String(id));
    render();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}

// ── Add user dialog ──────────────────────────────────────────
const EXPIRY_LABEL = { none: "無時效", "15": "15 分鐘", "30": "30 分鐘", "60": "1 小時", custom: "自訂時效" };
let addTemp = false, addExpiry = "60", addCustomMin = 120;

function openAdd() {
  addTemp = false; addExpiry = "60"; addCustomMin = 120;
  paintAdd();
  openModal("modalAddUser");
}
function paintAdd() {
  $("addUserContent").innerHTML = `
    <div class="modal-header"><span class="modal-title">新增使用者</span><button class="modal-close" data-close="modalAddUser">×</button></div>
    <div class="modal-body">
      <label class="field-label">帳號 *</label><input id="addUsername" placeholder="英數字、底線（2-32字）" style="margin-bottom:10px"/>
      <label class="field-label">顯示名稱</label><input id="addDisplayName" placeholder="留空則使用帳號名稱" style="margin-bottom:10px"/>
      <label class="field-label">密碼 *（最少8字元）</label><input id="addPassword" type="password" style="margin-bottom:10px"/>
      ${!addTemp ? `<label class="field-label">角色</label>
        <select id="addRole" style="width:100%;margin-bottom:10px"><option value="user">一般使用者</option><option value="admin">管理員</option></select>` : ""}
      <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:8px 0;cursor:pointer">
        <input type="checkbox" id="addIsTemp" ${addTemp ? "checked" : ""}/>
        <span>臨時使用者</span><span class="hint">（僅能登入一次）</span></label>
      ${addTemp ? `
        <div class="admin-card" style="background:rgba(250,204,21,0.06);border-color:rgba(250,204,21,0.3)">
          <p class="hint" style="color:#facc15;margin-bottom:6px">帳號時效</p>
          <div class="admin-actions">${Object.entries(EXPIRY_LABEL).map(([k, l]) => `<button class="btn-secondary expiry-opt${addExpiry === k ? " active" : ""}" data-exp="${k}">${l}</button>`).join("")}</div>
          ${addExpiry === "custom" ? `<div style="margin-top:8px"><input type="number" id="addCustomMin" value="${addCustomMin}" min="1" max="10080" style="width:100px"/> <span class="hint">分鐘（最多 7 天）</span></div>` : ""}
        </div>` : ""}
    </div>
    <div class="modal-footer" style="display:flex;gap:8px">
      <button class="btn-primary" style="flex:1" id="addUserSubmit">建立</button>
      <button class="btn-secondary" data-close="modalAddUser">取消</button>
    </div>`;
  $$('#addUserContent [data-close]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => closeModal("modalAddUser")));
  $("addIsTemp").addEventListener("change", (e) => { addTemp = e.target.checked; paintAdd(); });
  $$(".expiry-opt").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => { addExpiry = b.dataset.exp; paintAdd(); }));
  $("addCustomMin")?.addEventListener("input", (e) => { addCustomMin = Number(e.target.value); });
  $("addUserSubmit").addEventListener("click", submitAdd);
}
async function submitAdd() {
  const username = $("addUsername").value.trim();
  const password = $("addPassword").value;
  if (!username || password.length < 8) { toast("帳號必填，密碼至少 8 字元", "error"); return; }
  const expiryMinutes = !addTemp ? null : addExpiry === "none" ? null : addExpiry === "custom" ? (addCustomMin > 0 ? addCustomMin : null) : Number(addExpiry);
  try {
    await postJSON("/api/admin/userlist", {
      username, displayName: $("addDisplayName").value.trim() || undefined, password,
      role: addTemp ? "user" : $("addRole").value, isTemporary: addTemp, tempExpiryMinutes: expiryMinutes,
    });
    toast(`已新增${addTemp ? "臨時" : ""}使用者：${username}`);
    closeModal("modalAddUser");
    await load();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}
$("btnAddUser").addEventListener("click", openAdd);

// ── Edit user dialog ──────────────────────────────────────────
function openEdit(id) {
  const u = users.find((x) => String(x.id) === String(id));
  if (!u) return;
  $("editUserContent").innerHTML = `
    <div class="modal-header"><span class="modal-title">編輯使用者</span><button class="modal-close" data-close="modalEditUser">×</button></div>
    <div class="modal-body">
      <label class="field-label">帳號</label><input id="editUsername" value="${u.username}" style="margin-bottom:10px"/>
      <label class="field-label">顯示名稱</label><input id="editDisplayName" value="${u.display_name || ""}" placeholder="留空則使用帳號名稱" style="margin-bottom:10px"/>
      <label class="field-label">新密碼（留空不更改）</label><input id="editPassword" type="password" placeholder="最少 8 字元" style="margin-bottom:10px"/>
      ${!u.is_temporary ? `<label class="field-label">角色</label>
        <select id="editRole" style="width:100%;margin-bottom:10px"><option value="user"${u.role === "user" ? " selected" : ""}>一般使用者</option><option value="admin"${u.role === "admin" ? " selected" : ""}>管理員</option></select>` : ""}
      <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer">
        <input type="checkbox" id="editDisabled" ${u.disabled ? "checked" : ""}/><span>停用此帳號</span></label>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-footer" style="display:flex;gap:8px">
      <button class="btn-primary" style="flex:1" id="editUserSubmit">儲存</button>
      <button class="btn-secondary" data-close="modalEditUser">取消</button>
    </div>`;
  $$('#editUserContent [data-close]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => closeModal("modalEditUser")));
  $("editUserSubmit").addEventListener("click", () => submitEdit(u.id));
  openModal("modalEditUser");
}
async function submitEdit(id) {
  const body = {
    username: $("editUsername").value.trim(), displayName: $("editDisplayName").value.trim(), disabled: $("editDisabled").checked,
  };
  const roleSel = $("editRole");
  if (roleSel) body.role = roleSel.value;
  const pw = $("editPassword").value;
  if (pw) body.password = pw;
  try {
    await fetch(`/api/admin/userlist/${id}`, { method: "PUT", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF": "1" }, body: JSON.stringify(body) })
      .then(async (r) => { const d = await r.json(); if (!r.ok) throw new Error(d.error || `HTTP ${r.status}`); });
    toast("已更新");
    closeModal("modalEditUser");
    await load();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}

// ── Disk access dialog (reuses 6b's storage endpoints) ─────────
async function openDiskAccess(id) {
  const u = users.find((x) => String(x.id) === String(id));
  if (!u) return;
  $("diskAccessContent").innerHTML = `
    <div class="modal-header"><span class="modal-title">${u.display_name || u.username} 的磁碟權限</span><button class="modal-close" data-close="modalDiskAccess">×</button></div>
    <div class="modal-body"><p class="hint" style="margin-bottom:10px">預設看不到任何外接磁碟，只有勾選的項目才會出現在此使用者的檔案總管裡。</p>
      <div id="diskAccessList"><div class="spinner"></div></div></div>
    <div class="modal-footer"><button class="btn-secondary btn-block" data-close="modalDiskAccess">關閉</button></div>`;
  $$('#diskAccessContent [data-close]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => closeModal("modalDiskAccess")));
  openModal("modalDiskAccess");
  try {
    const data = await getJSON("/api/admin/storage/registry");
    const disks = data.disks;
    const host = $("diskAccessList");
    host.innerHTML = disks.length ? disks.map((d) => {
      const granted = d.grantedUsers.some((g) => String(g.id) === String(u.id));
      const isOwner = d.ownerUsername === u.username;
      return `<div class="snap-row"><div class="snap-info"><p style="margin:0;font-family:monospace">${d.folderName}</p><p class="hint" style="margin:2px 0 0">擁有者：${d.ownerUsername}</p></div>
        ${isOwner ? '<span class="hint">擁有者</span>' : `<button class="access-chip${granted ? " granted" : ""}" data-disk="${d.id}" data-granted="${granted}">${granted ? "✓ 已授權" : "未授權"}</button>`}</div>`;
    }).join("") : '<p class="hint" style="text-align:center;padding:16px 0">尚未掛載任何外接磁碟</p>';
    host.querySelectorAll(".access-chip").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => toggleDiskAccess(btn, u.id)));
  } catch (err) { $("diskAccessList").innerHTML = `<p class="hint" style="color:var(--error)">${err.message}</p>`; }
}
async function toggleDiskAccess(btn, userId) {
  const grant = btn.dataset.granted !== "true";
  btn.disabled = true;
  try {
    if (grant) await postJSON(`/api/admin/storage/access/${btn.dataset.disk}`, { userId: Number(userId) });
    else await fetch(`/api/admin/storage/access/${btn.dataset.disk}/${userId}`, { method: "DELETE", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" } });
    btn.dataset.granted = String(grant);
    btn.classList.toggle("granted", grant);
    btn.textContent = grant ? "✓ 已授權" : "未授權";
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
  btn.disabled = false;
}

window.onAdminRefresh = load;
load();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/anaconda.js
// Anaconda / Jupyter — behind /tools/dev/anaconda. Pure client-side: the
// Jupyter URL is a localStorage preference, the iframe talks directly to it.
const STORAGE_KEY = "jupyter_url";
const DEFAULT_URL = window.ANACONDA_DEFAULT_URL.replace(/\/+$/, "");

let url = (localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || DEFAULT_URL).replace(/\/+$/, "");

function updateChrome() {
  $("anUrlLabel").textContent = url;
  $("anOpenTab").href = url;
  $("anErrorOpenTab").href = url;
  $("anErrorUrl").textContent = url;
  $("anMixedWarning").classList.toggle("hidden", url.startsWith("https://") || !$("anSettings").classList.contains("hidden"));
}

function load() {
  $("anLoading").classList.remove("hidden");
  $("anError").classList.add("hidden");
  $("anFrame").src = url;
  updateChrome();
}

$("anFrame").addEventListener("load", () => $("anLoading").classList.add("hidden"));
$("anFrame").addEventListener("error", () => { $("anLoading").classList.add("hidden"); $("anError").classList.remove("hidden"); });

$("anReload").addEventListener("click", () => { $("anLoading").classList.remove("hidden"); $("anError").classList.add("hidden"); $("anFrame").src = url; });
$("anRetryBtn").addEventListener("click", () => { $("anLoading").classList.remove("hidden"); $("anError").classList.add("hidden"); $("anFrame").src = url; });

function toggleSettings(show) {
  $("anSettings").classList.toggle("hidden", !show);
  if (show) $("anUrlInput").value = url;
  updateChrome();
}
$("anSettingsBtn").addEventListener("click", () => toggleSettings($("anSettings").classList.contains("hidden")));
$("anChangeUrlBtn").addEventListener("click", () => toggleSettings(true));

$("anUrlInput").addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") applyUrl(); });
$("anUrlApply").addEventListener("click", applyUrl);
function applyUrl() {
  const trimmed = $("anUrlInput").value.trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");
  if (!trimmed) return;
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, trimmed);
  url = trimmed;
  toggleSettings(false);
  load();
}

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "Escape" && $("anSettings").classList.contains("hidden")) window.location.href = "/home";
});

load();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/camera.js
// Camera system — Python port of components/Camera.tsx (category 4, batch
// 4f). Unlike its sibling in this batch, the backend is fully implemented —
// see camera.py's docstring.
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('cmRoot');
  const isAdmin = !!window.CAMERA_IS_ADMIN;

  let tab = 'live';
  let cameras = [];
  let loading = true;
  let gridCols = 2;
  let fullscreenId = null;
  let dialog = null; // 'new' | camera object | null
  let deleting = null;
  const feedRetryTimers = {};

  function esc(s) { return (s || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;'); }
  function toast(msg) {
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'ev-toast'; t.textContent = msg;
    document.body.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(function () { t.remove(); }, 2500);
  }

  function load() {
    loading = true; render();
    fetch('/api/cameras').then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) { cameras = Array.isArray(d) ? d : []; loading = false; render(); })
      .catch(function () { cameras = []; loading = false; render(); });
  }

  function handleSave(vals) {
    const isNew = dialog === 'new';
    const url = isNew ? '/api/cameras' : '/api/cameras/' + encodeURIComponent(dialog.id);
    const method = isNew ? 'POST' : 'PUT';
    return fetch(url, { method: method, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF': '1' }, body: JSON.stringify(vals) })
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) return r.json().catch(function () { return {}; }).then(function (d) { throw new Error(d.error || 'Operation failed'); }); return r.json(); })
      .then(function () {
        toast(isNew ? 'Camera added' : 'Updated');
        dialog = null; render();
        load();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { toast(e.message); throw e; });
  }

  function handleDelete(id, name) {
    if (!confirm('Delete "' + name + '"?')) return;
    deleting = id; render();
    fetch('/api/cameras/' + encodeURIComponent(id), { method: 'DELETE', headers: { 'X-CSRF': '1' } })
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.json().catch(function () { return {}; }); })
      .then(function () { toast('Deleted'); load(); })
      .catch(function () { toast('Delete failed'); })
      .finally(function () { deleting = null; render(); });
  }

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
    if (fullscreenId) { fullscreenId = null; render(); return; }
    if (dialog !== null) { dialog = null; render(); return; }
    window.location.href = '/home';
  });

  // ── camera feed (MJPEG <img> with online/offline retry) ─────────────
  function feedHtml(cam, id, fullscreen) {
    return '<div class="cm-feed' + (fullscreen ? ' cm-feed-full' : '') + '" data-cam="' + esc(cam.id) + '" data-feed-id="' + id + '">' +
      '<img class="cm-feed-img hidden" data-feed-id="' + id + '" alt="' + esc(cam.name) + '">' +
      '<div class="cm-feed-placeholder" data-feed-id="' + id + '">' +
        '<div class="cm-feed-spinner"></div><p class="cm-feed-status hidden" data-status-text="' + id + '"></p>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="cm-feed-bar"><span class="cm-feed-dot cm-dot-connecting" data-dot="' + id + '"></span>' +
        '<span class="cm-feed-name">' + esc(cam.name) + '</span></div>' +
    '</div>';
  }

  function mountFeed(id, cam) {
    const img = root.querySelector('.cm-feed-img[data-feed-id="' + id + '"]');
    const placeholder = root.querySelector('.cm-feed-placeholder[data-feed-id="' + id + '"]');
    const spinner = placeholder ? placeholder.querySelector('.cm-feed-spinner') : null;
    const statusText = root.querySelector('[data-status-text="' + id + '"]');
    const dot = root.querySelector('[data-dot="' + id + '"]');
    if (!img) return;

    function setStatus(status) {
      dot.className = 'cm-feed-dot ' + (status === 'online' ? 'cm-dot-online' : status === 'offline' ? 'cm-dot-offline' : 'cm-dot-connecting');
      if (status === 'online') { img.classList.remove('hidden'); placeholder.classList.add('hidden'); }
      else {
        img.classList.add('hidden'); placeholder.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (spinner) spinner.classList.toggle('hidden', status !== 'connecting');
        statusText.classList.toggle('hidden', status !== 'offline');
        statusText.textContent = 'Offline · Retrying in 5s';
      }
    }

    function connect() {
      setStatus('connecting');
      img.src = cam.stream_url + '&_=' + Date.now();
    }

    img.onload = function () { setStatus('online'); };
    img.onerror = function () {
      setStatus('offline');
      if (feedRetryTimers[id]) clearTimeout(feedRetryTimers[id]);
      feedRetryTimers[id] = setTimeout(connect, 5000);
    };
    connect();
  }

  // ── add/edit dialog ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderDialog() {
    if (dialog === null) return '';
    const initial = dialog !== 'new' ? dialog : null;
    return '<div class="ev-modal-backdrop" id="cmDialogBackdrop">' +
      '<div class="cm-dialog">' +
        '<div class="cm-dialog-header"><h3>' + (initial ? 'Edit Camera' : 'Add Camera') + '</h3><button type="button" class="ev-icon-btn" id="cmDialogCloseBtn">×</button></div>' +
        '<form class="cm-dialog-form" id="cmDialogForm">' +
          '<div><label>Camera Name</label><input id="cmFormName" required autofocus placeholder="Front door, living room, garage…" value="' + esc(initial ? initial.name : '') + '"></div>' +
          '<div><label>Stream URL</label><input id="cmFormUrl" required placeholder="rtsp://192.168.1.x:554/stream 或 http://…/mjpeg" class="cm-mono" value="' + esc(initial ? initial.url : '') + '">' +
            '<p class="cm-field-hint">Supports RTSP and HTTP MJPEG. Backend proxies via ffmpeg.</p></div>' +
          '<div><label>Notes (optional)</label><input id="cmFormNotes" placeholder="Location, IP, etc…" value="' + esc(initial ? (initial.notes || '') : '') + '"></div>' +
          '<div class="cm-dialog-actions"><button type="button" class="cm-btn-cancel" id="cmDialogCancelBtn">Cancel</button>' +
            '<button type="submit" class="cm-btn-save" id="cmDialogSaveBtn">Save</button></div>' +
        '</form>' +
      '</div>' +
    '</div>';
  }

  function wireDialog() {
    const backdrop = document.getElementById('cmDialogBackdrop');
    if (!backdrop) return;
    backdrop.onclick = function (e) { if (e.target === backdrop) { dialog = null; render(); } };
    document.getElementById('cmDialogCloseBtn').onclick = function () { dialog = null; render(); };
    document.getElementById('cmDialogCancelBtn').onclick = function () { dialog = null; render(); };
    document.getElementById('cmDialogForm').onsubmit = function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const vals = {
        name: document.getElementById('cmFormName').value.trim(),
        url: document.getElementById('cmFormUrl').value.trim(),
        notes: document.getElementById('cmFormNotes').value.trim(),
      };
      if (!vals.name || !vals.url) return;
      const saveBtn = document.getElementById('cmDialogSaveBtn');
      saveBtn.disabled = true; saveBtn.textContent = 'Saving…';
      handleSave(vals).catch(function () { saveBtn.disabled = false; saveBtn.textContent = 'Save'; });
    };
  }

  // ── main render ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function render() {
    const fullscreenCam = fullscreenId ? cameras.find(function (c) { return c.id === fullscreenId; }) : null;
    const cols = cameras.length <= 1 ? 1 : cameras.length <= 4 ? Math.min(gridCols, 2) : gridCols;

    root.innerHTML =
      '<div class="cm-shell">' +
        '<header class="cm-header">' +
          '<div class="cm-header-left"><span class="cm-header-icon">🎥</span><h1>Camera System</h1>' +
            (tab === 'live' && cameras.length > 0 ? '<span class="cm-live-badge"><span class="cm-live-dot"></span>LIVE</span>' : '') +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="cm-header-right">' +
            '<div class="cm-tabs">' +
              '<button type="button" class="cm-tab' + (tab === 'live' ? ' active' : '') + '" data-tab="live">Live View</button>' +
              '<button type="button" class="cm-tab' + (tab === 'manage' ? ' active' : '') + '" data-tab="manage">Camera Management</button>' +
            '</div>' +
            (tab === 'live' && cameras.length > 1
              ? '<div class="cm-grid-sel">' + [1, 2, 3].map(function (n) { return '<button type="button" class="cm-grid-btn' + (gridCols === n ? ' active' : '') + '" data-cols="' + n + '" title="' + n + '×' + n + '">' + n + '×' + n + '</button>'; }).join('') + '</div>'
              : '') +
            '<button type="button" class="ev-icon-btn" id="cmCloseBtn">×</button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</header>' +
        '<div class="cm-body">' + renderBody(cols) + '</div>' +
        (fullscreenCam ? renderFullscreen(fullscreenCam) : '') +
        renderDialog() +
      '</div>';

    document.getElementById('cmCloseBtn').onclick = function () { window.location.href = '/home'; };
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(root.querySelectorAll('.cm-tab'), function (btn) { btn.onclick = function () { tab = btn.dataset.tab; render(); }; });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(root.querySelectorAll('.cm-grid-btn'), function (btn) { btn.onclick = function () { gridCols = parseInt(btn.dataset.cols, 10); render(); }; });

    if (loading) return;

    if (tab === 'live' && cameras.length > 0) {
      cameras.forEach(function (cam, i) {
        const el = root.querySelector('.cm-feed[data-feed-id="live' + i + '"]');
        if (el) el.onclick = function () { fullscreenId = cam.id; render(); };
        mountFeed('live' + i, cam);
      });
    }
    if (fullscreenCam) {
      mountFeed('full', fullscreenCam);
      document.getElementById('cmFullscreenCloseBtn').onclick = function () { fullscreenId = null; render(); };
    }

    if (tab === 'manage') {
      const addBtn = document.getElementById('cmAddBtn');
      if (addBtn) addBtn.onclick = function () { dialog = 'new'; render(); };
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(root.querySelectorAll('.cm-manage-view'), function (btn) {
        btn.onclick = function () { tab = 'live'; fullscreenId = btn.dataset.id; render(); };
      });
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(root.querySelectorAll('.cm-manage-edit'), function (btn) {
        btn.onclick = function () { dialog = cameras.find(function (c) { return c.id === btn.dataset.id; }); render(); };
      });
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(root.querySelectorAll('.cm-manage-delete'), function (btn) {
        btn.onclick = function () { handleDelete(btn.dataset.id, btn.dataset.name); };
      });
    }
    const goManageBtn = document.getElementById('cmGoManageBtn');
    if (goManageBtn) goManageBtn.onclick = function () { tab = 'manage'; render(); };

    wireDialog();
  }

  function renderBody(cols) {
    if (loading) return '<div class="cm-loading-full"><div class="cm-spinner-lg"></div></div>';
    if (cameras.length === 0 && tab === 'live') {
      return '<div class="cm-empty-full"><p>No cameras added yet</p>' +
        (isAdmin ? '<button type="button" class="cm-btn-primary" id="cmGoManageBtn">Go to Management</button>' : '') + '</div>';
    }
    if (tab === 'live') {
      return '<div class="cm-grid cm-grid-' + cols + '">' +
        cameras.map(function (cam, i) { return feedHtml(cam, 'live' + i, false); }).join('') + '</div>';
    }
    // manage tab
    let html = '<div class="cm-manage-wrap"><div class="cm-manage-head"><h2>Camera List <span>(' + cameras.length + ')</span></h2>' +
      (isAdmin ? '<button type="button" class="cm-btn-primary" id="cmAddBtn">+ Add Camera</button>' : '') + '</div>';
    if (cameras.length === 0) {
      html += '<div class="cm-empty-full"><p>No cameras configured</p></div>';
    } else {
      html += '<ul class="cm-manage-list">' + cameras.map(function (cam) {
        return '<li class="cm-manage-row"><div class="cm-manage-icon">🎥</div>' +
          '<div class="cm-flex1"><p class="cm-manage-name">' + esc(cam.name) + '</p><p class="cm-manage-url">' + esc(cam.url) + '</p>' +
          (cam.notes ? '<p class="cm-manage-notes">' + esc(cam.notes) + '</p>' : '') + '</div>' +
          '<div class="cm-manage-actions"><button type="button" class="cm-manage-view" data-id="' + esc(cam.id) + '">View</button>' +
          (isAdmin ? '<button type="button" class="cm-manage-edit" data-id="' + esc(cam.id) + '">Edit</button>' +
            '<button type="button" class="cm-manage-delete" data-id="' + esc(cam.id) + '" data-name="' + esc(cam.name) + '"' + (deleting === cam.id ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' + (deleting === cam.id ? '…' : 'Delete') + '</button>' : '') +
          '</div></li>';
      }).join('') + '</ul>';
    }
    html += '<div class="cm-setup-hint"><p class="cm-setup-title">📡 Supported Stream Formats</p>' +
      '<p><span class="cm-mono cm-red">rtsp://</span> IP Camera RTSP stream (requires ffmpeg)</p>' +
      '<p><span class="cm-mono cm-orange">http://</span> HTTP MJPEG stream (e.g. /mjpeg, /video.cgi)</p>' +
      '<p>Backend proxies via ffmpeg. Install on Pi: <code>sudo apt install ffmpeg</code></p></div></div>';
    return html;
  }

  function renderFullscreen(cam) {
    return '<div class="cm-fullscreen"><div class="cm-fullscreen-bar"><span class="cm-live-dot"></span><span>' + esc(cam.name) + '</span><span class="cm-fullscreen-live">LIVE</span>' +
      '<button type="button" class="ev-icon-btn cm-fullscreen-close" id="cmFullscreenCloseBtn">×</button></div>' +
      '<div class="cm-fullscreen-body">' + feedHtml(cam, 'full', true) + '</div></div>';
  }

  load();
})();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/downloader.js
// Media Downloader — behind /tools/downloader. Proxies to /api/downloader/*
// (this page's own routes), which forward to the backend's /api/ytdl/*.
const MP3_QUALITIES = [["best", "Best (VBR)"], ["320", "320 Kbps"], ["192", "192 Kbps"], ["128", "128 Kbps"]];
const MP4_QUALITIES = [["best", "Best available"], ["1080", "1080p"], ["720", "720p"], ["480", "480p"], ["360", "360p"]];

function esc(s) {
  return (s ?? "").toString().replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]));
}
function fmtTime(iso) {
  const d = new Date(iso), p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${p(d.getMonth() + 1)}/${p(d.getDate())} ${p(d.getHours())}:${p(d.getMinutes())}`;
}
function urlHost(url) { try { return new URL(url).hostname.replace(/^www\./, ""); } catch { return url.slice(0, 40); } }
function parseUrls(text) { return text.split(/\r?\n/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean); }
function defaultFormatForPath(path) {
  const segs = path.toLowerCase().split("/").filter(Boolean);
  if (segs.some((s) => s.includes("private") || s.includes("picture") || s.includes("photo"))) return "image";
  if (segs.some((s) => s.includes("video") || s.includes("reel"))) return "mp4";
  if (segs.some((s) => s.includes("music"))) return "mp3";
  return null;
}

let format = "mp4", destPath = "";

function applyQualityOptions() {
  $("dlQualityWrap").classList.toggle("hidden", format === "image");
  if (format === "image") return;
  const opts = format === "mp3" ? MP3_QUALITIES : MP4_QUALITIES;
  $("dlQuality").innerHTML = opts.map(([v, label]) => `<option value="${v}">${label}</option>`).join("");
}
$$("#dlFormatGroup .filter-pill").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  $$("#dlFormatGroup .filter-pill").forEach((b) => b.classList.remove("active"));
  btn.classList.add("active");
  format = btn.dataset.fmt;
  applyQualityOptions();
}));
applyQualityOptions();

function setDest(path) {
  destPath = path || "";
  $("dlDestLabel").textContent = destPath ? `/${destPath}` : "/ (root) — click to pick";
  $("dlBrowse").classList.toggle("empty", !destPath);
  $("dlClearDest").style.display = destPath ? "block" : "none";
  const def = defaultFormatForPath(destPath);
  if (def) {
    format = def;
    $$("#dlFormatGroup .filter-pill").forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.fmt === def));
    applyQualityOptions();
  }
}
$("dlClearDest").addEventListener("click", () => setDest(""));

// Auto-detect multiple pasted URLs (one per line), matching the original's paste handler.
$("dlUrl").addEventListener("paste", (e) => {
  const text = e.clipboardData.getData("text");
  const matches = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/g);
  if (!matches?.length) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const cleaned = matches.map((m) => m.replace(/[,，。.!！?？]+$/, ""));
  $("dlUrl").value = [...parseUrls($("dlUrl").value), ...cleaned].join("\n");
  checkNetflix();
});
$("dlUrl").addEventListener("input", checkNetflix);
function checkNetflix() {
  $("dlNetflixHint").classList.toggle("hidden", !parseUrls($("dlUrl").value).some((u) => u.includes("netflix.com")));
}

// ── Folder picker ──────────────────────────────────────────
let browsePath = "";
function crumbHtml() {
  const segs = browsePath ? browsePath.split("/").filter(Boolean) : [];
  let html = `<button class="crumb-btn" data-path="">root</button>`;
  const acc = [];
  for (const s of segs) { acc.push(s); html += ` / <button class="crumb-btn" data-path="${esc(acc.join("/"))}">${esc(s)}</button>`; }
  return html;
}
async function loadBrowseDir() {
  $("dlCrumb").innerHTML = crumbHtml();
  $("dlCrumb").querySelectorAll(".crumb-btn").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => { browsePath = b.dataset.path; loadBrowseDir(); }));
  const list = $("dlFolderList");
  list.innerHTML = '<p class="hint">Loading...</p>';
  try {
    const d = await getJSON(`/api/downloader/browse?path=${encodeURIComponent(browsePath)}`);
    list.innerHTML = d.folders.length
      ? d.folders.map((f) => `<button class="dl-folder-row" data-folder="${esc(f)}">📁 ${esc(f)}</button>`).join("")
      : '<p class="hint">No subfolders</p>';
    list.querySelectorAll(".dl-folder-row").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
      browsePath = browsePath ? `${browsePath}/${b.dataset.folder}` : b.dataset.folder;
      loadBrowseDir();
    }));
  } catch (err) { list.innerHTML = `<p class="hint">${esc(err.message)}</p>`; }
}
$("dlBrowse").addEventListener("click", () => { browsePath = destPath; $("dlFolderModal").classList.remove("hidden"); loadBrowseDir(); });
$$("[data-close]").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => $(b.dataset.close).classList.add("hidden")));
$("dlSelectFolder").addEventListener("click", () => { setDest(browsePath); $("dlFolderModal").classList.add("hidden"); });

// ── Cookie management ───────────────────────────────────────
async function loadCookieStatus() {
  try {
    const { exists } = await getJSON("/api/downloader/cookies");
    $("dlCookieDot").className = `dot ${exists ? "dot-active" : "dot-inactive"}`;
    $("dlCookieText").textContent = exists ? "Set" : "Not set";
    $("dlCookieRemove").classList.toggle("hidden", !exists);
  } catch {}
}
$("dlCookieRemove").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  try { await reqJSON("/api/downloader/cookies", { method: "DELETE", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" } }); toast("Cookie removed"); loadCookieStatus(); }
  catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
});
$("dlCookieFile").addEventListener("change", async (e) => {
  const file = e.target.files?.[0];
  if (!file) return;
  $("dlUploadLabel").textContent = "Uploading...";
  try {
    const form = new FormData(); form.append("cookies", file);
    await fetch("/api/downloader/cookies/upload", { method: "POST", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" }, body: form })
      .then(async (r) => { const d = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); if (!r.ok) throw new Error(d.error || `HTTP ${r.status}`); });
    toast("Cookie file uploaded");
    loadCookieStatus();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
  finally { $("dlUploadLabel").textContent = "📤 Upload cookies.txt (Douyin / Netflix / generic)"; e.target.value = ""; }
});
$("dlSaveTwitter").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const auth_token = $("dlAuthToken").value.trim(), ct0 = $("dlCt0").value.trim();
  if (!auth_token || !ct0) return toast("Fill in both auth_token and ct0", "error");
  try {
    await postJSON("/api/downloader/cookies/twitter", { auth_token, ct0 });
    $("dlAuthToken").value = ""; $("dlCt0").value = "";
    toast("Twitter cookie saved");
    loadCookieStatus();
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
});

// ── Submit ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
$("dlSubmit").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const urls = parseUrls($("dlUrl").value);
  if (!urls.length) return toast("Enter at least one URL", "error");
  if (urls.some((u) => u.includes("netflix.com"))) {
    const { exists } = await getJSON("/api/downloader/cookies").catch(() => ({ exists: false }));
    if (!exists) return toast("Netflix downloads need cookies uploaded first", "error");
  }
  $("dlSubmit").disabled = true;
  $("dlSubmit").textContent = "Adding...";
  const quality = format === "image" ? "best" : $("dlQuality").value;
  let ok = 0, failed = 0;
  for (const url of urls) {
    try { await postJSON("/api/downloader/start", { url, format, quality, destPath }); ok++; }
    catch (err) { failed++; console.error("[Downloader] failed to queue", url, err); }
  }
  if (ok) toast(urls.length > 1 ? `${ok}/${urls.length} added to queue` : "Added to queue");
  if (failed) toast(`${failed} link(s) failed to queue`, "error");
  $("dlUrl").value = "";
  checkNetflix();
  $("dlSubmit").disabled = false;
  $("dlSubmit").textContent = "⬇️ Start Download";
  await loadJobs(true);
});

// ── Job list ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
let jobs = [], pollTimer = null;

function jobRowHtml(job) {
  const title = esc(job.title || job.filename || urlHost(job.url));
  const statusHtml = job.status === "running" ? `${job.progress}%`
    : job.status === "done" ? "Done" : job.status === "error" ? "Error" : "Pending";
  return `<div class="dl-job${job.status === "error" ? " error" : ""}" data-id="${job.id}">
    <div class="dl-job-head">
      <span class="dl-job-fmt ${job.format}">${job.format.toUpperCase()}</span>
      <div class="dl-job-body">
        <p class="dl-job-title">${title}</p>
        <p class="dl-job-meta">${esc(urlHost(job.url))} · ${fmtTime(job.createdAt)}${job.destPath ? ` · → ${esc(job.destPath)}` : ""}</p>
      </div>
      <span class="dl-job-status ${job.status}">${statusHtml}</span>
      ${job.status === "running" || job.status === "pending" ? `<button class="dl-job-cancel" title="Cancel">×</button>` : ""}
    </div>
    ${job.status === "running" ? `<div class="dl-progress"><div class="dl-progress-bar" style="width:${job.progress}%"></div></div>` : ""}
    ${job.status === "error" && job.error ? `<button class="dl-error-toggle">▼ Show error</button><pre class="dl-error-log hidden">${esc(job.error)}</pre>` : ""}
  </div>`;
}

function renderJobs() {
  const host = $("dlJobs");
  host.innerHTML = jobs.length ? jobs.map(jobRowHtml).join("") : '<p class="hint" style="padding:20px 0">No downloads yet</p>';
  host.querySelectorAll(".dl-job-cancel").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", (e) => cancelJob(e.target.closest(".dl-job").dataset.id)));
  host.querySelectorAll(".dl-error-toggle").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const pre = b.nextElementSibling;
    pre.classList.toggle("hidden");
    b.textContent = pre.classList.contains("hidden") ? "▼ Show error" : "▲ Hide error";
  }));
  const finishCount = jobs.filter((j) => j.status === "done" || j.status === "error").length;
  $("dlClearDone").classList.toggle("hidden", finishCount === 0);
}

async function loadJobs(silent) {
  if (!silent) $("dlJobs").innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div>';
  try { jobs = await getJSON("/api/downloader/jobs"); renderJobs(); } catch {}
  const hasActive = jobs.some((j) => j.status === "running" || j.status === "pending");
  if (hasActive && !pollTimer) pollTimer = setInterval(() => loadJobs(true), 2000);
  else if (!hasActive && pollTimer) { clearInterval(pollTimer); pollTimer = null; }
}
async function cancelJob(id) {
  try { await reqJSON(`/api/downloader/jobs/${id}`, { method: "DELETE", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" } }); jobs = jobs.filter((j) => j.id !== id); renderJobs(); }
  catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}
$("dlClearDone").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const done = jobs.filter((j) => j.status === "done" || j.status === "error");
  await Promise.all(done.map((j) => reqJSON(`/api/downloader/jobs/${j.id}`, { method: "DELETE", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" } }).catch(() => {})));
  jobs = jobs.filter((j) => j.status === "running" || j.status === "pending");
  renderJobs();
});
$("dlRefreshJobs").addEventListener("click", () => loadJobs());

window.onAdminRefresh = () => loadJobs();
loadCookieStatus();
loadJobs();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/duplicates.js
(function () {
  const container = document.getElementById('duplicates-container');
  const scanStatus = document.getElementById('scan-status');
  const btnRescan = document.getElementById('btn-rescan');
  const rescanIcon = document.getElementById('rescan-icon');

  let groups = [];
  let scanned = null;
  let keepMap = {};
  let doneHashes = new Set();
  let busyHash = null;
  let scanning = false;

  function fmtBytes(b) {
    if (b >= 1e12) return (b / 1e12).toFixed(1) + ' TB';
    if (b >= 1e9)  return (b / 1e9).toFixed(1)  + ' GB';
    if (b >= 1e6)  return (b / 1e6).toFixed(1)  + ' MB';
    if (b >= 1e3)  return (b / 1e3).toFixed(1)  + ' KB';
    return b + ' B';
  }

  function fmtDate(iso) {
    return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('zh-TW', {
      year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit',
    });
  }

  async function scanDuplicates() {
    scanning = true;
    rescanIcon.classList.add('animate-spin');
    scanStatus.innerText = '掃描中…';
    container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 gap-4">
        <div class="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-orange-400 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
        <p class="text-slate-400 text-sm">正在掃描重複檔案…</p>
        <p class="text-slate-600 text-xs">比對檔案大小與 MD5 哈希值</p>
      </div>
    `;

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/files/duplicates');
      if (res.status === 401) {
        location.href = '/login';
        return;
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      groups = data.groups || [];
      scanned = data.scanned || 0;
      keepMap = {};
      doneHashes = new Set();

      for (let g of groups) {
        if (g.files && g.files.length) {
          keepMap[g.hash] = g.files[0].path;
        }
      }

      scanStatus.innerText = `已掃描 ${scanned} 個檔案，發現 ${groups.length} 組重複`;
      renderUI();
    } catch (e) {
      container.innerHTML = `<div class="p-8 text-center text-red-400">掃描重複檔案失敗</div>`;
      scanStatus.innerText = '掃描失敗';
    } finally {
      scanning = false;
      rescanIcon.classList.remove('animate-spin');
    }
  }

  function renderUI() {
    const pendingGroups = groups.filter(g => !doneHashes.has(g.hash));
    const resolvedGroups = groups.filter(g => doneHashes.has(g.hash));
    const totalWaste = pendingGroups.reduce((acc, g) => acc + g.size * (g.files.length - 1), 0);

    if (pendingGroups.length === 0 && resolvedGroups.length === 0) {
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 gap-3 text-slate-500">
          <svg class="w-14 h-14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
          </svg>
          <p class="text-sm text-slate-400">讚！未發現重複檔案</p>
        </div>
      `;
      return;
    }

    let html = '';

    if (pendingGroups.length > 0) {
      html += `
        <div class="mx-5 mt-4 mb-2 px-4 py-3 bg-orange-500/10 border border-orange-500/20 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <p class="text-sm text-orange-300 font-medium">
              ${pendingGroups.length} 組重複檔案，可釋放約 <span class="font-bold">${fmtBytes(totalWaste)}</span> 空間
            </p>
            <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">預設保留最新版本，點擊可切換保留檔案。</p>
          </div>
          <button id="btn-clean-all" class="shrink-0 text-sm px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-500 text-white font-medium transition-colors">
            一鍵清理全部
          </button>
        </div>

        <div class="divide-y divide-slate-800 px-5 pb-4">
          ${pendingGroups.map(group => {
            const busy = busyHash === group.hash;
            const keep = keepMap[group.hash];
            const extraCount = group.files.length - 1;

            return `
              <div class="py-4">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
                  <span class="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-orange-500/15 text-orange-400 font-mono">
                    ${group.hash.slice(0, 8)}
                  </span>
                  <span class="text-xs text-slate-400">${fmtBytes(group.size)}</span>
                  <span class="text-xs text-slate-600">·</span>
                  <span class="text-xs text-slate-400">${group.files.length} 個副本</span>
                  <div class="flex-1"></div>
                  <button
