                    class="btn-delete-others text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-red-600/80 hover:bg-red-500 disabled:opacity-40 text-white transition-colors flex items-center gap-1"
                    data-hash="${group.hash}"
                    ${busy ? 'disabled' : ''}
                  >
                    ${busy ? '清理中…' : `刪除其餘 ${extraCount} 個副本`}
                  </button>
                </div>

                <ul class="space-y-1.5">
                  ${group.files.map((f, idx) => {
                    const isKeep = keep === f.path;
                    return `
                      <li
                        class="btn-select-file flex items-start gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                          isKeep
                            ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/30'
                            : 'bg-slate-800/50 border-slate-700/40 hover:border-slate-600/60'
                        }"
                        data-hash="${group.hash}"
                        data-path="${f.path}"
                      >
                        <div class="mt-0.5 w-4 h-4 rounded-full border-2 shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors ${
                          isKeep ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500' : 'border-slate-600'
                        }">
                          ${isKeep ? '<div class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-white"></div>' : ''}
                        </div>
                        <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                          <p class="text-sm font-medium truncate ${isKeep ? 'text-emerald-300' : 'text-slate-300'}">
                            ${f.name}
                          </p>
                          <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono truncate mt-0.5" title="${f.path}">${f.path}</p>
                          <p class="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-0.5">${fmtDate(f.modifiedAt)}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                          ${isKeep
                            ? '<span class="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400">保留</span>'
                            : (idx === 0
                              ? '<span class="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400">最新</span>'
                              : '<span class="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-red-500/10 text-red-400">刪除</span>')
                          }
                        </div>
                      </li>
                    `;
                  }).join('')}
                </ul>
              </div>
            `;
          }).join('')}
        </div>
      `;
    }

    if (resolvedGroups.length > 0) {
      html += `
        <div class="px-5 pb-4 pt-2">
          <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mb-2">已完成清理 (${resolvedGroups.length} 組)</p>
          <div class="space-y-1.5">
            ${resolvedGroups.map(g => `
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-800/30 border border-slate-800">
                <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"/></svg>
                <span class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono">${g.hash.slice(0, 8)}</span>
                <span class="text-xs text-slate-300">${g.files[0].name}</span>
                <span class="text-xs text-slate-500 ml-auto">已刪除 ${g.files.length - 1} 個副本</span>
              </div>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    container.innerHTML = html;
    bindEvents();
  }

  function bindEvents() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.btn-select-file').forEach(el => {
      el.onclick = () => {
        const hash = el.dataset.hash;
        const path = el.dataset.path;
        keepMap[hash] = path;
        renderUI();
      };
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.btn-delete-others').forEach(el => {
      el.onclick = async () => {
        const hash = el.dataset.hash;
        const group = groups.find(g => g.hash === hash);
        if (!group) return;

        const keep = keepMap[hash];
        const toDelete = group.files.filter(f => f.path !== keep);
        if (toDelete.length === 0) return;

        busyHash = hash;
        renderUI();

        let failed = 0;
        for (let f of toDelete) {
          try {
            const res = await fetch(`/api/files?path=${encodeURIComponent(f.path)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (!res.ok) failed++;
          } catch {
            failed++;
          }
        }

        busyHash = null;
        if (failed === 0) {
          doneHashes.add(hash);
        } else {
          alert(`${failed} 個檔案刪除失敗`);
        }
        renderUI();
      };
    });

    const btnCleanAll = document.getElementById('btn-clean-all');
    if (btnCleanAll) {
      btnCleanAll.onclick = async () => {
        const pending = groups.filter(g => !doneHashes.has(g.hash));
        if (pending.length === 0) return;
        const totalExtra = pending.reduce((acc, g) => acc + g.files.length - 1, 0);

        if (!confirm(`確定要清理全部 ${pending.length} 組重複檔案（共刪除 ${totalExtra} 個多餘副本）？`)) return;

        for (let g of pending) {
          const keep = keepMap[g.hash];
          busyHash = g.hash;
          renderUI();

          for (let f of g.files) {
            if (f.path === keep) continue;
            try {
              await fetch(`/api/files?path=${encodeURIComponent(f.path)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            } catch {}
          }
          doneHashes.add(g.hash);
        }
        busyHash = null;
        renderUI();
      };
    }
  }

  btnRescan.onclick = scanDuplicates;
  scanDuplicates();
})();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/edit_video.js
// Video editor — Python port of components/EditVideo.tsx (category 4, batch
// 4e). See edit_video.py's docstring: /api/video/info + /api/video/export
// have never been implemented on any backend, so past the file-picker this
// UI cannot be exercised end-to-end today — ported faithfully anyway so the
// frontend is ready the day the ffmpeg backend exists.
(function () {
  const VIDEO_EXTS = new Set(['mp4', 'mov', 'avi', 'mkv', 'webm', 'm4v', '3gp', 'flv', 'wmv']);
  const AUDIO_EXTS = new Set(['mp3', 'aac', 'wav', 'flac', 'm4a', 'ogg']);
  function isVid(n) { return VIDEO_EXTS.has((n.split('.').pop() || '').toLowerCase()); }
  function isAud(n) { return AUDIO_EXTS.has((n.split('.').pop() || '').toLowerCase()); }
  function esc(s) { return (s || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;'); }
  function fmtTime(s) {
    const m = Math.floor(s / 60), sec = (s % 60).toFixed(1);
    return String(m).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + sec.padStart(4, '0');
  }

  const root = document.getElementById('evRoot');

  // ── state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let selectedPath = null;
  let browsePath = '', browseItems = [], browseLoading = false, fileTab = 'video';
  let clips = [], audioTracks = [], activeClip = 0;
  let currentTime = 0, scrubTime = null, playing = false, previewMode = false, isFullscreen = false, speed = 1;
  let activePanel = null;
  let textOverlay = { text: '', size: 48, color: 'white', position: 'bottom' };
  let showExportDialog = false, exportName = 'output', exportVideoFmt = 'mp4', exportAudioFmt = 'aac';
  let exportQuality = 'fast', exportResolution = '1080p';
  let destPath = '', showDestPicker = false, destPickerPath = '', destPickerItems = [], destPickerLoading = false;
  let busy = false, exportProgress = 0, exportLog = '';
  let timelineZoom = 1;
  let rafId = null;
  let seekTimer = null;

  function clip() { return clips[activeClip] || null; }
  function clipDurations() { return clips.map(function (c) { return c.outPt - c.inPt; }); }
  function totalDuration() { return clipDurations().reduce(function (s, d) { return s + d; }, 0); }
  function clipOffsets() {
    const durs = clipDurations(); const acc = [];
    durs.forEach(function (d, i) { acc.push(i === 0 ? 0 : acc[i - 1] + durs[i - 1]); });
    return acc;
  }
  function displayTime() { return scrubTime !== null ? scrubTime : currentTime; }

  // ── data loading ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function loadBrowse(p) {
    browseLoading = true; renderLeftPanel();
    fetch('/api/editvideo/list?path=' + encodeURIComponent(p))
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        browseItems = (d.folders || []).map(function (f) { return { name: f.name, type: 'folder' }; })
          .concat((d.videos || []).map(function (v) { return { name: v.name, type: 'file', path: v.path }; }))
          .concat((d.audios || []).map(function (a) { return { name: a.name, type: 'file', path: a.path }; }));
        browsePath = p; browseLoading = false;
        renderLeftPanel(); renderBrowseDialog();
      })
      .catch(function () { browseLoading = false; renderLeftPanel(); });
  }

  function addVideoClip(path, name) {
    fetch('/api/video/info?path=' + encodeURIComponent(path))
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.json(); })
      .then(function (info) {
        const c = { path: path, name: name, inPt: 0, outPt: info.duration, duration: info.duration };
        activeClip = clips.length;
        clips = clips.concat([c]);
        exportName = name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '') + '_edited';
        if (!selectedPath) { selectedPath = path; renderRoot(); } else { renderAll(); }
      })
      .catch(function () { toast('無法讀取影片資訊'); });
  }

  function addAudioTrack(path, name) {
    audioTracks = audioTracks.concat([{ path: path, name: name, volume: 1 }]);
    toast('已加入音軌：' + name);
    renderAll();
  }

  function toast(msg) {
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'ev-toast'; t.textContent = msg;
    document.body.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(function () { t.remove(); }, 2500);
  }

  // ── playback helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function video() { return document.getElementById('evVideo'); }

  function startPreview() {
    if (!clips.length) { toast('請先加入影片'); return; }
    activeClip = 0; previewMode = true; renderAll();
    setTimeout(function () {
      const v = video();
      if (v) {
        v.pause(); v.currentTime = clips[0].inPt; v.playbackRate = speed;
        const onS = function () { v.removeEventListener('seeked', onS); v.play().catch(function () {}); };
        v.addEventListener('seeked', onS);
      }
    }, 50);
  }

  function stopPreview() { previewMode = false; const v = video(); if (v) v.pause(); renderAll(); }

  function toggleFullscreen() {
    const container = document.getElementById('evContainer');
    if (!document.fullscreenElement) { container.requestFullscreen(); isFullscreen = true; }
    else { document.exitFullscreen(); isFullscreen = false; }
    renderHeader();
  }

  function setInPoint() {
    const c = clip(); if (!c) return;
    const t = video() ? video().currentTime : 0;
    clips = clips.map(function (cl, i) { return i === activeClip ? Object.assign({}, cl, { inPt: Math.min(t, cl.outPt - 0.1) }) : cl; });
    renderAll();
  }

  function setOutPoint() {
    const c = clip(); if (!c) return;
    const t = video() ? video().currentTime : 0;
    clips = clips.map(function (cl, i) { return i === activeClip ? Object.assign({}, cl, { outPt: Math.max(t, cl.inPt + 0.1) }) : cl; });
    renderAll();
  }

  // ── export ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function handleExport() {
    if (!clips.length) { toast('請先加入影片'); return; }
    stopPreview();
    const v = video(); if (v) v.pause();
    const outputName = (exportName.trim() || 'output') + '.' + exportVideoFmt;
    const txtOpts = textOverlay.text.trim() ? Object.assign({}, textOverlay) : undefined;
    showExportDialog = false; busy = true; exportProgress = 0; exportLog = '';
    renderAll();

    const resMap = { '720p': '1280:720', '1080p': '1920:1080', '2k': '2560:1440', '4k': '3840:2160', '8k': '7680:4320', 'source': '' };
    const resolution = resMap[exportResolution] || '';

    const body = clips.length === 1
      ? JSON.stringify({ path: clips[0].path, outputName: outputName, destPath: destPath || undefined,
          operations: Object.assign({ start: clips[0].inPt, end: clips[0].outPt, speed: speed, preset: exportQuality, resolution: resolution, textOverlay: txtOpts },
            audioTracks[0] ? { audioOverlay: { path: audioTracks[0].path, volume: audioTracks[0].volume } } : {}) })
      : JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ clips: clips.map(function (c) { return { path: c.path, inPt: c.inPt, outPt: c.outPt }; }),
          outputName: outputName, destPath: destPath || undefined, resolution: resolution, textOverlay: txtOpts },
          audioTracks[0] ? { audioOverlay: { path: audioTracks[0].path, volume: audioTracks[0].volume } } : {}));

    fetch('/api/video/export', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF': '1' }, body: body })
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) return r.json().catch(function () { return {}; }).then(function (d) { throw new Error(d.error || ('HTTP ' + r.status)); }); return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
          const poll = setInterval(function () {
            fetch('/api/video/export/' + d.jobId).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (job) {
              exportProgress = job.progress || 0;
              if (job.log) exportLog = job.log.split('\n').filter(Boolean).pop() || '';
              renderExportDialog(); renderHeader();
              if (job.status === 'done') { clearInterval(poll); resolve(); }
              if (job.status === 'error') { clearInterval(poll); reject(new Error(job.error || '匯出失敗')); }
            }).catch(function (e) { clearInterval(poll); reject(e); });
          }, 1000);
        });
      })
      .then(function () {
        toast('已儲存：' + outputName);
        busy = false;
        window.location.href = '/home';
      })
      .catch(function (e) { toast(e.message); busy = false; renderAll(); });
  }

  // ── keyboard shortcuts ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (!selectedPath) return;
    const inInput = e.target instanceof HTMLInputElement || e.target instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement || e.target instanceof HTMLSelectElement;
    if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === 'b') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const c = clip(); if (!c) return;
      const t = video() ? video().currentTime : currentTime;
      if (t <= c.inPt || t >= c.outPt) { toast('剪切點必須在片段範圍內'); return; }
      const a = Object.assign({}, c, { outPt: t }), b = Object.assign({}, c, { inPt: t });
      clips = clips.slice(0, activeClip).concat([a, b], clips.slice(activeClip + 1));
      toast('已剪切片段'); renderAll();
    }
    if (e.ctrlKey && (e.key === '=' || e.key === '+')) { e.preventDefault(); timelineZoom = Math.min(timelineZoom * 1.5, 20); renderTimeline(); }
    if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === '-') { e.preventDefault(); timelineZoom = Math.max(timelineZoom / 1.5, 0.2); renderTimeline(); }
    if ((e.key === 'Delete' || e.key === 'Backspace') && !inInput) {
      if (clips.length > 0) {
        clips = clips.filter(function (_, i) { return i !== activeClip; });
        activeClip = Math.max(0, activeClip - 1);
        toast('已刪除片段'); renderAll();
      }
    }
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && !inInput) window.location.href = '/home';
    if (!inInput && (e.key === 'f' || e.key === 'F') && !e.ctrlKey) toggleFullscreen();
    if (!inInput && (e.key === 'k' || e.key === 'K')) { e.preventDefault(); const v = video(); if (v) { v.paused ? v.play().catch(function () {}) : v.pause(); } }
  });

  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', function () { isFullscreen = !!document.fullscreenElement; renderHeader(); });

  document.addEventListener('wheel', function (e) {
    if (!e.ctrlKey || !selectedPath) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const v = video(); if (!v) return;
    const step = e.deltaY > 0 ? 3 : -3;
    v.currentTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(v.duration || 0, v.currentTime + step));
  }, { passive: false });

  // ── rendering ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderRoot() {
    if (!selectedPath) { renderBrowseDialogOnly(); return; }
    renderEditor();
  }

  function renderBrowseDialogOnly() {
    root.innerHTML =
      '<div class="ev-modal-backdrop" id="evBackdrop">' +
        '<div class="ev-browse-card" id="evBrowseCard">' +
          '<div class="ev-browse-header">' +
            (browsePath ? '<button type="button" class="ev-icon-btn" id="evBrowseUpBtn">←</button>' : '') +
            '<span class="ev-browse-title">選擇影片</span>' +
            '<button type="button" class="ev-icon-btn" id="evBrowseCloseBtn">×</button>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="ev-browse-body" id="evBrowseBody"></div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    document.getElementById('evBackdrop').onclick = function () { window.location.href = '/home'; };
    document.getElementById('evBrowseCard').onclick = function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); };
    document.getElementById('evBrowseCloseBtn').onclick = function () { window.location.href = '/home'; };
    const upBtn = document.getElementById('evBrowseUpBtn');
    if (upBtn) upBtn.onclick = function () { loadBrowse(browsePath.split('/').slice(0, -1).join('/')); };
    renderBrowseDialog();
    loadBrowse('');
  }

  function renderBrowseDialog() {
    const body = document.getElementById('evBrowseBody');
    if (!body) return;
    if (browseLoading) { body.innerHTML = '<div class="ev-loading">載入中...</div>'; return; }
    const folders = browseItems.filter(function (i) { return i.type === 'folder'; });
    const videos = browseItems.filter(function (i) { return i.type === 'file' && isVid(i.name); });
    let html = '';
    folders.forEach(function (f) {
      html += '<button type="button" class="ev-browse-row ev-browse-folder" data-name="' + esc(f.name) + '">📁 ' + esc(f.name) + '</button>';
    });
    videos.forEach(function (f) {
      html += '<button type="button" class="ev-browse-row ev-browse-video" data-path="' + esc(f.path) + '" data-name="' + esc(f.name) + '">🎬 ' + esc(f.name) + '</button>';
    });
    if (folders.length === 0 && videos.length === 0) html = '<div class="ev-browse-empty">此資料夾沒有影片</div>';
    body.innerHTML = html;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(body.querySelectorAll('.ev-browse-folder'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { loadBrowse(browsePath ? browsePath + '/' + btn.dataset.name : btn.dataset.name); };
    });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(body.querySelectorAll('.ev-browse-video'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { addVideoClip(btn.dataset.path, btn.dataset.name); };
    });
  }

  function renderEditor() {
    root.innerHTML =
      '<div id="evContainer" class="ev-shell">' +
        '<div class="ev-header" id="evHeader"></div>' +
        '<div class="ev-main">' +
          '<div class="ev-left" id="evLeft"></div>' +
          '<div class="ev-center">' +
            '<div class="ev-preview" id="evPreview"></div>' +
            '<div class="ev-controls" id="evControls"></div>' +
            '<div class="ev-duration-zoom" id="evDurationZoom"></div>' +
            '<div class="ev-tools" id="evTools"></div>' +
            '<div class="ev-timeline" id="evTimeline"></div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="evDestPicker"></div>' +
        '<div id="evExportDialog"></div>' +
      '</div>';
    renderAll();
  }

  function renderAll() {
    renderHeader(); renderLeftPanel(); renderPreview(); renderControls();
    renderDurationZoom(); renderTools(); renderTimeline(); renderDestPicker(); renderExportDialog();
  }

  function renderHeader() {
    const el = document.getElementById('evHeader');
    if (!el) return;
    const c = clip();
    el.innerHTML =
      '<button type="button" class="ev-icon-btn" id="evCloseBtn">×</button>' +
      '<span class="ev-header-title">影片剪輯</span>' +
      '<span class="ev-header-clip">' + (c ? esc(c.name) : '') + '</span>' +
      '<div class="ev-flex1"></div>' +
      '<span class="ev-header-hint">Ctrl+B 剪切 · K 播放/暫停 · Del 刪除片段 · F 全螢幕</span>' +
      '<button type="button" class="ev-icon-btn" id="evFullscreenBtn">' + (isFullscreen ? '⛶' : '⛶') + '</button>' +
      '<button type="button" class="ev-btn-secondary" id="evPreviewBtn"' + (!clips.length ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' + (previewMode ? '⏹ 停止' : '▶ 預覽') + '</button>' +
      '<button type="button" class="ev-btn-primary" id="evExportBtn">' + (busy ? '匯出中 ' + exportProgress + '%' : '💾 匯出') + '</button>';
    document.getElementById('evCloseBtn').onclick = function () { window.location.href = '/home'; };
    document.getElementById('evFullscreenBtn').onclick = toggleFullscreen;
    document.getElementById('evPreviewBtn').onclick = function () { previewMode ? stopPreview() : startPreview(); };
    document.getElementById('evExportBtn').onclick = function () {
      if (!clips.length) { toast('請先從左側加入影片'); return; }
      busy = false; stopPreview();
      const v = video(); if (v) v.pause();
      showExportDialog = true; renderExportDialog();
    };
  }

  function renderLeftPanel() {
    const el = document.getElementById('evLeft');
    if (!el) return;
    el.innerHTML =
      '<div class="ev-left-tabs">' +
        '<button type="button" class="ev-left-tab' + (fileTab === 'video' ? ' active' : '') + '" id="evTabVideo">🎬 影片' + (clips.length ? '<span class="ev-badge ev-badge-purple">' + clips.length + '</span>' : '') + '</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="ev-left-tab' + (fileTab === 'audio' ? ' active' : '') + '" id="evTabAudio">🎵 音訊' + (audioTracks.length ? '<span class="ev-badge ev-badge-blue">' + audioTracks.length + '</span>' : '') + '</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="ev-left-crumb">' +
        '<button type="button" class="ev-crumb-root" id="evCrumbRoot">根目錄</button>' +
        (browsePath ? '<span class="ev-crumb-cur">/' + esc(browsePath.split('/').pop()) + '</span>' : '') +
        (browsePath ? '<button type="button" class="ev-crumb-up" id="evCrumbUp">←</button>' : '') +
      '</div>' +
      '<p class="ev-left-hint">' + (fileTab === 'video' ? '點擊影片加入時間軸' : '點擊音訊加入音軌') + '</p>' +
      '<div class="ev-left-list" id="evLeftList">' + (browseLoading ? '<div class="ev-loading">載入中...</div>' : '') + '</div>';
    document.getElementById('evTabVideo').onclick = function () { fileTab = 'video'; renderLeftPanel(); };
    document.getElementById('evTabAudio').onclick = function () { fileTab = 'audio'; renderLeftPanel(); };
    document.getElementById('evCrumbRoot').onclick = function () { loadBrowse(''); };
    const crumbUp = document.getElementById('evCrumbUp');
    if (crumbUp) crumbUp.onclick = function () { loadBrowse(browsePath.split('/').slice(0, -1).join('/')); };

    if (!browseLoading) {
      const listEl = document.getElementById('evLeftList');
      let html = '';
      browseItems.forEach(function (item) {
        const isDir = item.type === 'folder';
        if (!isDir && fileTab === 'video' && !isVid(item.name)) return;
        if (!isDir && fileTab === 'audio' && !isAud(item.name)) return;
        const cls = isDir ? 'ev-item-folder' : isVid(item.name) ? 'ev-item-video' : 'ev-item-audio';
        const icon = isDir ? '📁' : isVid(item.name) ? '🎬' : '🎵';
        html += '<button type="button" class="ev-item ' + cls + '" data-dir="' + (isDir ? '1' : '0') + '" data-name="' + esc(item.name) + '" data-path="' + esc(item.path || '') + '">' + icon + ' ' + esc(item.name) + '</button>';
      });
      listEl.innerHTML = html;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(listEl.querySelectorAll('.ev-item'), function (btn) {
        btn.onclick = function () {
          if (btn.dataset.dir === '1') { loadBrowse(browsePath ? browsePath + '/' + btn.dataset.name : btn.dataset.name); return; }
          const p = btn.dataset.path;
          if (isVid(btn.dataset.name)) addVideoClip(p, btn.dataset.name);
          else if (isAud(btn.dataset.name)) addAudioTrack(p, btn.dataset.name);
        };
      });
    }
  }

  function renderPreview() {
    const el = document.getElementById('evPreview');
    if (!el) return;
    const c = clip();
    if (!c) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="ev-preview-empty">從左側加入影片片段</div>'; return; }
    const needsNewVideo = !document.getElementById('evVideo') || document.getElementById('evVideo').dataset.path !== c.path;
    if (needsNewVideo) {
      el.innerHTML =
        '<video id="evVideo" class="ev-video" data-path="' + esc(c.path) + '"></video>' +
        '<canvas id="evCanvas" class="ev-canvas" width="1280" height="720"></canvas>' +
        '<div id="evPreviewBadge" class="ev-preview-badge hidden"></div>';
      const v = document.getElementById('evVideo');
      v.src = c.download_url || ('/api/files/download?path=' + encodeURIComponent(c.path));
      v.onclick = function () { v.paused ? v.play().catch(function () {}) : v.pause(); };
      v.addEventListener('timeupdate', onVideoTimeUpdate);
      v.addEventListener('play', function () { playing = true; });
      v.addEventListener('pause', function () { playing = false; });
      v.playbackRate = speed;
      startCanvasLoop();
    }
    renderPreviewBadge();
  }

  function renderPreviewBadge() {
    const badge = document.getElementById('evPreviewBadge');
    if (!badge) return;
    if (previewMode) {
      badge.classList.remove('hidden');
      badge.innerHTML = '<span class="ev-rec-dot"></span><span>前端預覽中</span><button type="button" id="evStopPreviewBtn">停止</button>';
      document.getElementById('evStopPreviewBtn').onclick = stopPreview;
    } else { badge.classList.add('hidden'); badge.innerHTML = ''; }
  }

  function onVideoTimeUpdate() {
    const v = video(); if (!v) return;
    currentTime = v.currentTime;
    const c = clip();
    if (previewMode && c && v.currentTime >= c.outPt - 0.05) {
      if (activeClip < clips.length - 1) {
        const next = activeClip + 1;
        activeClip = next;
        renderPreview(); renderControls(); renderTimeline();
        setTimeout(function () {
          const vv = video();
          if (vv) {
            vv.pause(); vv.currentTime = clips[next].inPt; vv.playbackRate = speed;
            const onS = function () { vv.removeEventListener('seeked', onS); vv.play().catch(function () {}); };
            vv.addEventListener('seeked', onS);
          }
        }, 50);
      } else { v.pause(); playing = false; previewMode = false; renderPreviewBadge(); }
    }
    updateScrubUI();
  }

  function updateScrubUI() {
    const timeLabel = document.getElementById('evCurTimeLabel');
    if (timeLabel) timeLabel.textContent = fmtTime(displayTime());
    renderTimelinePlayhead();
  }

  function startCanvasLoop() {
    if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    function draw() {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('evCanvas');
      if (!canvas) { rafId = requestAnimationFrame(draw); return; }
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      if (textOverlay.text) {
        const fs = Math.round(canvas.height * (textOverlay.size / 720));
        ctx.font = 'bold ' + fs + 'px sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.shadowColor = 'black'; ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
        ctx.fillStyle = textOverlay.color;
        const y = textOverlay.position === 'top' ? fs + 20 : textOverlay.position === 'center' ? canvas.height / 2 : canvas.height - 40;
        ctx.fillText(textOverlay.text, canvas.width / 2, y);
      }
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    }
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }

  function renderControls() {
    const el = document.getElementById('evControls');
    if (!el) return;
    const c = clip();
    if (!c) { el.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    el.innerHTML =
      '<div class="ev-ctl-row">' +
        '<button type="button" class="ev-play-btn" id="evPlayBtn">' + (playing ? '⏸' : '▶') + '</button>' +
        '<span class="ev-time" id="evCurTimeLabel">' + fmtTime(displayTime()) + '</span>' +
        '<div class="ev-flex1"></div>' +
        '<span class="ev-io-label">IN ' + fmtTime(c.inPt) + ' → OUT ' + fmtTime(c.outPt) + ' (' + fmtTime(c.outPt - c.inPt) + ')</span>' +
        '<span class="ev-time ev-time-right">' + fmtTime(c.duration) + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="ev-scrubber" id="evScrubber"></div>' +
      '<div class="ev-io-actions">' +
        '<button type="button" class="ev-io-btn ev-io-in" id="evSetInBtn">設 IN</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="ev-io-btn ev-io-out" id="evSetOutBtn">設 OUT</button>' +
        '<span class="ev-io-hint">拖拉 🟢IN 🔴OUT ⬜播放頭</span>' +
      '</div>';
    document.getElementById('evPlayBtn').onclick = function () { const v = video(); if (v) v.paused ? v.play().catch(function () {}) : v.pause(); };
    document.getElementById('evSetInBtn').onclick = setInPoint;
    document.getElementById('evSetOutBtn').onclick = setOutPoint;
    wireScrubber();
  }

  function wireScrubber() {
    const bar = document.getElementById('evScrubber');
    if (!bar) return;
    renderScrubberBar();
    bar.onmousedown = function (e) {
      const c = clip(); if (!c) return;
      const rect = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
      const getT = function (x) { return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (x - rect.left) / rect.width)) * c.duration; };
      const clickPx = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const inPx = (c.inPt / c.duration) * rect.width;
      const outPx = (c.outPt / c.duration) * rect.width;
      let mode = 'seek';
      if (Math.abs(clickPx - inPx) < 10) mode = 'in';
      else if (Math.abs(clickPx - outPx) < 10) mode = 'out';
      else if (video()) video().currentTime = getT(e.clientX);

      function onMove(me) {
        const t = getT(me.clientX);
        if (mode === 'in') { clips = clips.map(function (cl, i) { return i === activeClip ? Object.assign({}, cl, { inPt: Math.min(t, cl.outPt - 0.1) }) : cl; }); renderScrubberBar(); renderControls(); return; }
        if (mode === 'out') { clips = clips.map(function (cl, i) { return i === activeClip ? Object.assign({}, cl, { outPt: Math.max(t, cl.inPt + 0.1) }) : cl; }); renderScrubberBar(); renderControls(); return; }
        scrubTime = t; updateScrubUI();
        if (seekTimer) clearTimeout(seekTimer);
        seekTimer = setTimeout(function () { if (video()) video().currentTime = t; seekTimer = null; }, 80);
      }
      function onUp(me) {
        if (mode === 'seek') {
          if (seekTimer) { clearTimeout(seekTimer); seekTimer = null; }
          if (video()) video().currentTime = getT(me.clientX);
          scrubTime = null; updateScrubUI();
        }
        window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
        window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
        renderTimeline();
      }
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
    };
  }

  function renderScrubberBar() {
    const bar = document.getElementById('evScrubber');
    const c = clip();
    if (!bar || !c) return;
    const curPct = c.duration > 0 ? (displayTime() / c.duration) * 100 : 0;
    bar.innerHTML =
      '<div class="ev-scrub-range" style="left:' + ((c.inPt / c.duration) * 100) + '%;width:' + (((c.outPt - c.inPt) / c.duration) * 100) + '%"></div>' +
      '<div class="ev-scrub-in" style="left:calc(' + ((c.inPt / c.duration) * 100) + '% - 3px)"></div>' +
      '<div class="ev-scrub-out" style="left:calc(' + ((c.outPt / c.duration) * 100) + '% - 3px)"></div>' +
      '<div class="ev-scrub-playhead" style="left:' + curPct + '%"><div class="ev-scrub-playhead-dot"></div></div>';
  }

  function renderDurationZoom() {
    const el = document.getElementById('evDurationZoom');
    if (!el) return;
    el.innerHTML =
      '<span class="ev-total-dur">總時長 <span class="ev-total-dur-val">' + fmtTime(totalDuration()) + '</span></span>' +
      '<div class="ev-flex1"></div>' +
      '<span class="ev-zoom-label">縮放</span>' +
      '<button type="button" class="ev-zoom-btn" id="evZoomOutBtn">−</button>' +
      '<span class="ev-zoom-pct">' + Math.round(timelineZoom * 100) + '%</span>' +
      '<button type="button" class="ev-zoom-btn" id="evZoomInBtn">+</button>' +
      '<button type="button" class="ev-zoom-reset" id="evZoomResetBtn">重置</button>';
    document.getElementById('evZoomOutBtn').onclick = function () { timelineZoom = Math.max(timelineZoom / 1.5, 0.2); renderDurationZoom(); renderTimeline(); };
    document.getElementById('evZoomInBtn').onclick = function () { timelineZoom = Math.min(timelineZoom * 1.5, 20); renderDurationZoom(); renderTimeline(); };
    document.getElementById('evZoomResetBtn').onclick = function () { timelineZoom = 1; renderDurationZoom(); renderTimeline(); };
  }

  function renderTools() {
    const el = document.getElementById('evTools');
    if (!el) return;
    let html = '<div class="ev-tools-tabs">' +
      ['text', 'audio', 'speed'].map(function (t) {
        const label = t === 'text' ? '📝 文字' : t === 'audio' ? '🎵 音訊' : '⚡ 速度';
        return '<button type="button" class="ev-tools-tab' + (activePanel === t ? ' active' : '') + '" data-panel="' + t + '">' + label + '</button>';
      }).join('') + '</div><div id="evToolsPanel"></div>';
    el.innerHTML = html;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll('.ev-tools-tab'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { activePanel = activePanel === btn.dataset.panel ? null : btn.dataset.panel; renderTools(); };
    });
    renderToolsPanel();
  }

  function renderToolsPanel() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('evToolsPanel');
    if (!panel) return;
    if (activePanel === 'text') {
      panel.innerHTML =
        '<div class="ev-tools-row">' +
          '<div class="ev-field ev-flex1"><label>文字</label><input id="evTxtText" value="' + esc(textOverlay.text) + '" placeholder="輸入文字..."></div>' +
          '<div class="ev-field"><label>大小</label><input id="evTxtSize" type="number" min="20" max="120" value="' + textOverlay.size + '"></div>' +
          '<div class="ev-field"><label>顏色</label><select id="evTxtColor">' + ['white', 'yellow', 'red', 'black', 'cyan'].map(function (c) { return '<option value="' + c + '"' + (textOverlay.color === c ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + c + '</option>'; }).join('') + '</select></div>' +
          '<div class="ev-field"><label>位置</label><select id="evTxtPos">' + [['bottom', '下方'], ['center', '中間'], ['top', '上方']].map(function (p) { return '<option value="' + p[0] + '"' + (textOverlay.position === p[0] ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + p[1] + '</option>'; }).join('') + '</select></div>' +
        '</div>';
      document.getElementById('evTxtText').oninput = function (e) { textOverlay.text = e.target.value; };
      document.getElementById('evTxtSize').oninput = function (e) { textOverlay.size = Number(e.target.value); };
      document.getElementById('evTxtColor').onchange = function (e) { textOverlay.color = e.target.value; };
      document.getElementById('evTxtPos').onchange = function (e) { textOverlay.position = e.target.value; };
    } else if (activePanel === 'audio') {
      if (audioTracks.length === 0) { panel.innerHTML = '<p class="ev-hint-sm">從左側「音訊」tab 選擇音訊檔</p>'; return; }
      panel.innerHTML = audioTracks.map(function (at, i) {
        return '<div class="ev-audio-row"><span class="ev-audio-name">' + esc(at.name) + '</span>' +
          '<input type="range" min="0" max="2" step="0.1" value="' + at.volume + '" class="ev-audio-vol" data-idx="' + i + '">' +
          '<span class="ev-audio-pct">' + Math.round(at.volume * 100) + '%</span>' +
          '<button type="button" class="ev-audio-del" data-idx="' + i + '">✕</button></div>';
      }).join('');
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(panel.querySelectorAll('.ev-audio-vol'), function (input) {
        input.oninput = function () { audioTracks[parseInt(input.dataset.idx, 10)].volume = Number(input.value); renderToolsPanel(); renderTimeline(); };
      });
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(panel.querySelectorAll('.ev-audio-del'), function (btn) {
        btn.onclick = function () { audioTracks = audioTracks.filter(function (_, j) { return j !== parseInt(btn.dataset.idx, 10); }); renderToolsPanel(); renderTimeline(); };
      });
    } else if (activePanel === 'speed') {
      panel.innerHTML =
        '<div class="ev-speed-row"><span>速度 ' + speed + 'x</span><div class="ev-speed-btns">' +
          [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2].map(function (s) { return '<button type="button" class="ev-speed-opt' + (speed === s ? ' active' : '') + '" data-speed="' + s + '">' + s + 'x</button>'; }).join('') +
          '</div><input type="range" id="evSpeedSlider" min="0.25" max="2" step="0.05" value="' + speed + '" class="ev-flex1"></div>';
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(panel.querySelectorAll('.ev-speed-opt'), function (btn) {
        btn.onclick = function () { speed = parseFloat(btn.dataset.speed); if (video()) video().playbackRate = speed; renderToolsPanel(); };
      });
      document.getElementById('evSpeedSlider').oninput = function (e) { speed = Number(e.target.value); if (video()) video().playbackRate = speed; renderToolsPanel(); };
    } else { panel.innerHTML = ''; }
  }

  // ── CapCut-style multi-track timeline ────────────────────────────────
  function renderTimeline() {
    const el = document.getElementById('evTimeline');
    if (!el) return;
    const pxPerSec = 60 * timelineZoom;
    const trackW = Math.max(600, totalDuration() * pxPerSec + 120);
    const cols = ['ev-clip-purple', 'ev-clip-blue', 'ev-clip-teal', 'ev-clip-indigo'];
    const offsets = clipOffsets();

    let rulerMarks = '';
    const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(5 / timelineZoom));
    const n = Math.ceil(totalDuration() / Math.max(1, step)) + 2;
    for (let idx = 0; idx < n; idx++) {
      const t = idx * step;
      if (t <= totalDuration() + step) {
        rulerMarks += '<div class="ev-ruler-mark" style="left:' + (t * pxPerSec) + 'px"><span>' + fmtTime(t) + '</span></div>';
      }
    }

    let clipsHtml = clips.length === 0
      ? '<div class="ev-track-empty">從左側加入影片 →</div>'
      : clips.map(function (c, i) {
          const dur = c.outPt - c.inPt;
          const wPx = Math.max(dur * pxPerSec, 6);
          const lPx = offsets[i] * pxPerSec;
          return '<div class="ev-clip ' + cols[i % cols.length] + (activeClip === i ? ' active' : '') + '" data-idx="' + i + '" style="left:' + lPx + 'px;width:' + wPx + 'px">' +
            '<div class="ev-clip-inner"><span class="ev-clip-name">' + esc(c.name) + '</span>' +
            '<div class="ev-clip-times"><span class="ev-clip-in">' + fmtTime(c.inPt) + '</span>' +
            (wPx > 80 ? '<span class="ev-clip-dur">' + fmtTime(dur) + '</span>' : '') +
            '<span class="ev-clip-out">' + fmtTime(c.outPt) + '</span></div></div>' +
            '<button type="button" class="ev-clip-del" data-idx="' + i + '">✕</button></div>';
        }).join('');

    let audioHtml = audioTracks.map(function (at) {
      return '<div class="ev-audio-track"><div class="ev-audio-bar" style="width:' + (totalDuration() * pxPerSec) + 'px"><span class="ev-audio-bar-label">🎵 ' + esc(at.name) + '</span></div>' +
        '<div class="ev-track-playhead" style="left:' + (displayTime() * pxPerSec) + 'px"></div></div>';
    }).join('');

    el.innerHTML =
      '<div class="ev-tl-labels">' +
        '<div class="ev-tl-ruler-spacer"></div>' +
        '<div class="ev-tl-v1-label">V1</div>' +
        audioTracks.map(function (at, i) {
          return '<div class="ev-tl-a-label"><span>A' + (i + 1) + '</span><span class="ev-tl-a-name">' + esc(at.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '')) + '</span>' +
            '<input type="range" min="0" max="2" step="0.1" value="' + at.volume + '" class="ev-tl-a-vol" data-idx="' + i + '">' +
            '<button type="button" class="ev-tl-a-del" data-idx="' + i + '">✕</button></div>';
        }).join('') +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="ev-tl-tracks" id="evTlTracks">' +
        '<div style="width:' + trackW + 'px" class="ev-tl-tracks-inner">' +
          '<div class="ev-tl-ruler">' + rulerMarks + '<div class="ev-tl-ruler-playhead" style="left:' + (displayTime() * pxPerSec) + 'px"><div class="ev-tl-ruler-flag"></div></div></div>' +
          '<div class="ev-tl-video-track">' + clipsHtml + '<div class="ev-track-playhead" style="left:' + (displayTime() * pxPerSec) + 'px"></div></div>' +
          audioHtml +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll('.ev-clip'), function (div) {
      div.onclick = function (e) { if (e.target.classList.contains('ev-clip-del')) return; activeClip = parseInt(div.dataset.idx, 10); renderAll(); };
    });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll('.ev-clip-del'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const i = parseInt(btn.dataset.idx, 10);
        clips = clips.filter(function (_, j) { return j !== i; });
        activeClip = Math.max(0, i - 1);
        renderAll();
      };
    });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll('.ev-tl-a-vol'), function (input) {
      input.oninput = function () { audioTracks[parseInt(input.dataset.idx, 10)].volume = Number(input.value); renderToolsPanel(); };
    });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll('.ev-tl-a-del'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { audioTracks = audioTracks.filter(function (_, j) { return j !== parseInt(btn.dataset.idx, 10); }); renderAll(); };
    });
  }

  function renderTimelinePlayhead() {
    const pxPerSec = 60 * timelineZoom;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.ev-track-playhead'), function (el) { el.style.left = (displayTime() * pxPerSec) + 'px'; });
    const rulerPlayhead = document.querySelector('.ev-tl-ruler-playhead');
    if (rulerPlayhead) rulerPlayhead.style.left = (displayTime() * pxPerSec) + 'px';
    renderScrubberBar();
  }

  // ── destination picker modal ─────────────────────────────────────────
  function loadDestPicker(p) {
    destPickerLoading = true; renderDestPicker();
    fetch('/api/editvideo/list?path=' + encodeURIComponent(p))
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) { destPickerItems = d.folders || []; destPickerPath = p; destPickerLoading = false; renderDestPicker(); })
      .catch(function () { destPickerLoading = false; renderDestPicker(); });
  }

  function renderDestPicker() {
    const el = document.getElementById('evDestPicker');
    if (!el) return;
    if (!showDestPicker) { el.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    el.innerHTML =
      '<div class="ev-modal-backdrop" id="evDestBackdrop">' +
        '<div class="ev-dest-card" id="evDestCard">' +
          '<div class="ev-browse-header">' +
            (destPickerPath ? '<button type="button" class="ev-icon-btn" id="evDestUpBtn">←</button>' : '') +
            '<span class="ev-browse-title">' + esc(destPickerPath || '根目錄') + '</span>' +
            '<button type="button" class="ev-icon-btn" id="evDestCloseBtn">×</button>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="ev-browse-body" id="evDestBody">' +
            (destPickerLoading ? '<div class="ev-loading">載入中...</div>' :
              (destPickerItems.length === 0 ? '<div class="ev-browse-empty">此資料夾沒有子資料夾</div>' :
                destPickerItems.map(function (f) { return '<button type="button" class="ev-browse-row ev-browse-folder" data-name="' + esc(f.name) + '">📁 ' + esc(f.name) + '</button>'; }).join(''))) +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="ev-dest-footer"><button type="button" class="ev-btn-primary ev-flex1" id="evDestChooseBtn">選擇「' + esc(destPickerPath || '根目錄') + '」</button></div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    document.getElementById('evDestBackdrop').onclick = function () { showDestPicker = false; renderDestPicker(); };
    document.getElementById('evDestCard').onclick = function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); };
    document.getElementById('evDestCloseBtn').onclick = function () { showDestPicker = false; renderDestPicker(); };
    const upBtn = document.getElementById('evDestUpBtn');
    if (upBtn) upBtn.onclick = function () { loadDestPicker(destPickerPath.split('/').slice(0, -1).join('/')); };
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll('.ev-browse-folder'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { loadDestPicker(destPickerPath ? destPickerPath + '/' + btn.dataset.name : btn.dataset.name); };
    });
    document.getElementById('evDestChooseBtn').onclick = function () { destPath = destPickerPath; showDestPicker = false; renderDestPicker(); renderExportDialog(); };
  }

            '<div class="ev-summary"><div><span>片段數</span><span>' + clips.length + '</span></div><div><span>總時長</span><span>' + fmtTime(totalDuration()) + '</span></div>' +
              '<div><span>解析度</span><span>' + exportResolution.toUpperCase() + '</span></div><div><span>輸出</span><span>' + esc(exportName || 'output') + '.' + exportVideoFmt + '</span></div></div>' +
            (busy ? '<div class="ev-export-progress"><div class="ev-export-progress-row"><span>匯出進度</span><span>' + exportProgress + '%</span></div><div class="ev-bar"><div class="ev-bar-fill" style="width:' + exportProgress + '%"></div></div>' + (exportLog ? '<p class="ev-export-log">' + esc(exportLog) + '</p>' : '') + '</div>' : '') +
            '<button type="button" class="ev-btn-primary ev-export-go" id="evExportGoBtn"' + (busy || !exportName.trim() ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' + (busy ? '處理中 ' + exportProgress + '%' : '💾 開始匯出 → ' + esc(exportName || 'output') + '.' + exportVideoFmt) + '</button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    document.getElementById('evExportBackdrop').onclick = function () { showExportDialog = false; renderExportDialog(); };
    document.getElementById('evExportCard').onclick = function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); };
    document.getElementById('evExportCloseBtn').onclick = function () { showExportDialog = false; renderExportDialog(); };
    document.getElementById('evPickDestBtn').onclick = function (e) {
      if (e.target.id === 'evClearDestBtn') return;
      destPickerPath = ''; showDestPicker = true; loadDestPicker('');
    };
    const clearBtn = document.getElementById('evClearDestBtn');
    if (clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); destPath = ''; renderExportDialog(); };
    document.getElementById('evExportNameInput').oninput = function (e) { exportName = e.target.value; renderExportDialog(); };
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll('[data-fmt]'), function (btn) { btn.onclick = function () { exportVideoFmt = btn.dataset.fmt; renderExportDialog(); }; });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll('[data-afmt]'), function (btn) { btn.onclick = function () { exportAudioFmt = btn.dataset.afmt; renderExportDialog(); }; });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll('[data-q]'), function (btn) { btn.onclick = function () { exportQuality = btn.dataset.q; renderExportDialog(); }; });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll('[data-res]'), function (btn) { btn.onclick = function () { exportResolution = btn.dataset.res; renderExportDialog(); }; });
    document.getElementById('evExportGoBtn').onclick = handleExport;
  }

  renderRoot();
})();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/file_converter.js
// File format converter — Python port of components/FileConverter.tsx
// (category 4, batch 4f). See file_converter.py docstring: the actual
// convert action has no working backend today (thin proxy, will error).
(function () {
  const CONVERT_OPTIONS = {
    video: { targets: [
      ['to-images', '→ 圖片 (JPG)'], ['mp4', '→ MP4'], ['mkv', '→ MKV'], ['mov', '→ MOV'],
      ['webm', '→ WebM'], ['gif', '→ GIF（動圖）'], ['mp3', '→ MP3（萃取音頻）'], ['aac', '→ AAC（萃取音頻）'],
    ] },
    audio: { targets: [['mp3', '→ MP3'], ['aac', '→ AAC'], ['wav', '→ WAV'], ['flac', '→ FLAC'], ['ogg', '→ OGG']] },
    image: { targets: [['jpg', '→ JPG'], ['png', '→ PNG'], ['webp', '→ WebP'], ['gif', '→ GIF'], ['bmp', '→ BMP']] },
  };

  function esc(s) { return (s || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;'); }
  function catIcon(c) { return c === 'video' ? '🎬' : c === 'audio' ? '🎵' : c === 'image' ? '🖼' : ''; }

  const root = document.getElementById('fcRoot');

  let browsePath = '', browseItems = [], browseLoading = false, loaded = false;
  let selectedFile = null, targetFmt = '', busy = false, result = null;

  function toast(msg) {
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'ev-toast'; t.textContent = msg;
    document.body.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(function () { t.remove(); }, 2500);
  }

  function loadBrowse(p) {
    browseLoading = true; render();
    fetch('/api/fileconvert/list?path=' + encodeURIComponent(p))
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) { browseItems = d.items || []; browsePath = p; loaded = true; browseLoading = false; render(); })
      .catch(function () { toast('載入失敗'); browseLoading = false; render(); });
  }

  function handleConvert() {
    if (!selectedFile || !targetFmt) return;
    busy = true; result = null; render();
    const req = targetFmt === 'to-images'
      ? fetch('/api/video/to-images', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF': '1' }, body: JSON.stringify({ path: selectedFile.path }) })
      : fetch('/api/file/convert', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF': '1' }, body: JSON.stringify({ path: selectedFile.path, format: targetFmt }) });
    req.then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) return r.json().catch(function () { return {}; }).then(function (d) { throw new Error(d.error || ('HTTP ' + r.status)); }); return r.json(); })
      .then(function (r) {
        if (targetFmt === 'to-images') {
          result = r.type === 'single'
            ? '已轉換為 ' + r.output + '（影片長度 ' + r.duration.toFixed(2) + ' 秒 < 1 秒）'
            : '已擷取 ' + r.count + ' 張圖片（每秒一幀）';
        } else { result = '已轉換：' + r.output; }
        toast('轉換完成');
      })
      .catch(function (e) { toast(e.message); })
      .finally(function () { busy = false; render(); });
  }

  function render() {
    root.innerHTML =
      '<div class="ev-modal-backdrop" id="fcBackdrop">' +
        '<div class="fc-card" id="fcCard">' +
          '<div class="fc-header">' +
            '<div class="fc-header-icon">⇄</div>' +
            '<div class="fc-flex1"><p class="fc-title">檔案轉換</p><p class="fc-subtitle">影片 / 音訊 / 圖片 格式轉換</p></div>' +
            '<button type="button" class="ev-icon-btn" id="fcCloseBtn">×</button>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="fc-body">' +
            '<div class="fc-left" id="fcLeft"></div>' +
            '<div class="fc-right" id="fcRight"></div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    document.getElementById('fcBackdrop').onclick = function () { window.location.href = '/home'; };
    document.getElementById('fcCard').onclick = function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); };
    document.getElementById('fcCloseBtn').onclick = function () { window.location.href = '/home'; };
    renderLeft(); renderRight();
  }

  function renderLeft() {
    const el = document.getElementById('fcLeft');
    if (!el) return;
    el.innerHTML =
      '<div class="fc-left-crumb">' +
        (browsePath ? '<button type="button" class="fc-crumb-up" id="fcUpBtn">←</button>' : '') +
        '<span class="fc-crumb-path">' + esc(browsePath || '根目錄') + '</span>' +
        (!loaded ? '<button type="button" class="fc-load-btn" id="fcLoadBtnTop">載入</button>' : '') +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="fc-left-list" id="fcLeftList"></div>';
    const upBtn = document.getElementById('fcUpBtn');
    if (upBtn) upBtn.onclick = function () { loadBrowse(browsePath.split('/').slice(0, -1).join('/')); };
    const loadBtnTop = document.getElementById('fcLoadBtnTop');
    if (loadBtnTop) loadBtnTop.onclick = function () { loadBrowse(''); };

    const listEl = document.getElementById('fcLeftList');
    if (!loaded) {
      listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="fc-browse-cta"><button type="button" class="fc-browse-cta-btn" id="fcBrowseCtaBtn">瀏覽檔案</button></div>';
      document.getElementById('fcBrowseCtaBtn').onclick = function () { loadBrowse(''); };
      return;
    }
    if (browseLoading) { listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="ev-loading">載入中...</div>'; return; }
    listEl.innerHTML = browseItems.map(function (item) {
      const isDir = item.type === 'folder';
      const supported = isDir || item.category !== 'other';
      const path = browsePath ? browsePath + '/' + item.name : item.name;
      const active = selectedFile && selectedFile.path === path;
      const cls = isDir ? 'fc-item-folder' : item.category === 'video' ? 'fc-item-video' : item.category === 'audio' ? 'fc-item-audio' : item.category === 'image' ? 'fc-item-image' : 'fc-item-other';
      return '<button type="button" class="fc-item ' + cls + (active ? ' active' : '') + '"' + (supported ? '' : ' disabled') +
        ' data-dir="' + (isDir ? '1' : '0') + '" data-name="' + esc(item.name) + '" data-path="' + esc(path) + '">' +
        (isDir ? '📁' : catIcon(item.category)) + ' ' + esc(item.name) + '</button>';
    }).join('');
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(listEl.querySelectorAll('.fc-item:not([disabled])'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () {
        if (btn.dataset.dir === '1') { loadBrowse(btn.dataset.path); return; }
        selectedFile = { path: btn.dataset.path, name: btn.dataset.name };
        targetFmt = ''; result = null;
        render();
      };
    });
  }

  function renderRight() {
    const el = document.getElementById('fcRight');
    if (!el) return;
    if (!selectedFile) {
      el.innerHTML = '<div class="fc-empty"><p>從左側選擇要轉換的檔案</p><p class="fc-empty-sub">支援影片 / 音訊 / 圖片</p></div>';
      return;
    }
    const cat = (function () {
      const item = browseItems.find(function (i) { return (browsePath ? browsePath + '/' + i.name : i.name) === selectedFile.path; });
      return item ? item.category : 'other';
    })();
    const options = CONVERT_OPTIONS[cat] ? CONVERT_OPTIONS[cat].targets : [];
    const selectedLabel = targetFmt ? (options.find(function (o) { return o[0] === targetFmt; }) || [])[1] : '';

    el.innerHTML =
      '<div class="fc-selected"><div class="fc-selected-icon">' + catIcon(cat) + '</div>' +
        '<div class="fc-flex1"><p class="fc-selected-name">' + esc(selectedFile.name) + '</p><p class="fc-selected-path">' + esc(selectedFile.path) + '</p></div>' +
        '<button type="button" class="fc-selected-clear" id="fcClearBtn">✕</button></div>' +
      '<div><p class="fc-fmt-label">選擇輸出格式</p><div class="fc-fmt-grid">' +
        options.map(function (o) { return '<button type="button" class="fc-fmt-btn' + (targetFmt === o[0] ? ' active' : '') + '" data-fmt="' + o[0] + '">' + o[1] + '</button>'; }).join('') +
      '</div></div>' +
      '<button type="button" class="fc-convert-btn" id="fcConvertBtn"' + (!targetFmt || busy ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' +
        (busy ? '⏳ 轉換中...' : targetFmt ? '開始轉換 ' + esc(selectedFile.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '')) + ' ' + selectedLabel : '請選擇輸出格式') +
      '</button>' +
      (result ? '<div class="fc-result"><p class="fc-result-title">✓ 轉換成功</p><p class="fc-result-detail">' + esc(result) + '</p><p class="fc-result-note">檔案已儲存至原始目錄</p></div>' : '');

    document.getElementById('fcClearBtn').onclick = function () { selectedFile = null; targetFmt = ''; result = null; render(); };
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll('.fc-fmt-btn'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { targetFmt = btn.dataset.fmt; render(); };
    });
    const convertBtn = document.getElementById('fcConvertBtn');
    if (convertBtn) convertBtn.onclick = handleConvert;
  }

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') window.location.href = '/home'; });

  render();
})();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/locker.js
// Private Album — behind /tools/locker. Lock screen (fingerprint/TOTP/mobile)
// + media grid + lightbox. WebAuthn ceremony delegated to webauthn_native.js.
const AUTO_LOCK_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
const DEFAULT_PATH = "sda1/Private";

let lockMode = "fingerprint", hasCredential = false, devices = [];
let lockerPath = DEFAULT_PATH, items = [], lightboxIndex = null;
let authBusy = false, mobileCountdown = 0;
let lockTimer = null, pollTimer = null, cdTimer = null;

function setAuthError(msg) {
  const el = $("lkAuthError");
  el.textContent = msg || "";
  el.classList.toggle("hidden", !msg);
}
function setSettingsError(msg) {
  const el = $("lkSettingsError");
  el.textContent = msg || "";
  el.classList.toggle("hidden", !msg);
}

function stopMobilePoll() {
  if (pollTimer) { clearInterval(pollTimer); pollTimer = null; }
  if (cdTimer) { clearInterval(cdTimer); cdTimer = null; }
}
function startMobilePoll() {
  stopMobilePoll();
  mobileCountdown = 60;
  $("lkMobileWaiting").classList.remove("hidden");
  $("lkMobileRetry").classList.add("hidden");
  $("lkMobileCountdown").textContent = `Waiting… ${mobileCountdown}s`;
  cdTimer = setInterval(() => {
    mobileCountdown--;
    if (mobileCountdown <= 0) { stopMobilePoll(); setAuthError("Timeout, please try again"); $("lkMobileWaiting").classList.add("hidden"); $("lkMobileRetry").classList.remove("hidden"); return; }
    $("lkMobileCountdown").textContent = `Waiting… ${mobileCountdown}s`;
  }, 1000);
  pollTimer = setInterval(async () => {
    try { const r = await getJSON("/api/locker/mobile-signal"); if (r.ready) { stopMobilePoll(); unlock(); } } catch {}
  }, 2000);
}

// ── Mode tabs ────────────────────────────────────────────────
$$(".lk-mode-tabs .filter-pill").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  stopMobilePoll();
  $$(".lk-mode-tabs .filter-pill").forEach((b) => b.classList.remove("active"));
  btn.classList.add("active");
  lockMode = btn.dataset.mode;
  setAuthError("");
  $("lkFingerprintPane").classList.toggle("hidden", lockMode !== "fingerprint");
  $("lkTotpPane").classList.toggle("hidden", lockMode !== "totp");
  $("lkMobilePane").classList.toggle("hidden", lockMode !== "mobile");
  $("lkLockSub").textContent = lockMode === "fingerprint" ? "Fingerprint / Face ID Unlock"
    : lockMode === "totp" ? "Enter App Verification Code" : "Unlock from your phone";
  if (lockMode === "mobile") startMobilePoll();
}));

// ── WebAuthn ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function checkWebAuthnReady() {
  if (!window.isSecureContext) { setAuthError("Fingerprint requires HTTPS."); return false; }
  if (!WebAuthnNative.supported()) { setAuthError("This browser does not support biometrics. Use Chrome, Safari, or Edge."); return false; }
  return true;
}
function parseWebAuthnError(err) {
  const msg = (err && err.message) || "";
  const low = msg.toLowerCase();
  if (err?.name === "NotAllowedError" || low.includes("cancel") || low.includes("abort")) return "Cancelled";
  if (["https", "secure", "insecure", "relying party", "rpid", "registrable domain"].some((k) => low.includes(k))) {
    return `Fingerprint error: URL mismatch\n(${msg})`;
  }
  return msg;
}

async function refreshDevices() {
  try { const d = await getJSON("/api/locker/webauthn/status"); hasCredential = d.registered; devices = d.devices || []; renderDeviceList(); updateFingerprintPane(); }
  catch {}
}
function updateFingerprintPane() {
  $("lkAuthBtn").textContent = hasCredential ? "Unlock with Fingerprint" : "Set Up Fingerprint";
  $("lkReregisterBtn").classList.toggle("hidden", !hasCredential);
}

async function handleRegister() {
  if (!checkWebAuthnReady()) return;
  authBusy = true; setAuthError(""); $("lkAuthBtn").disabled = true;
  try {
    const origin = encodeURIComponent(window.location.origin);
    const optionsJSON = await getJSON(`/api/locker/webauthn/register-options?origin=${origin}`);
    const response = await WebAuthnNative.startRegistration(optionsJSON);
    const deviceName = navigator.platform || "Unknown Device";
    await postJSON("/api/locker/webauthn/register-verify", { response, deviceName });
    hasCredential = true;
    toast("Fingerprint set up, auto-unlocked");
    unlock();
    refreshDevices();
  } catch (err) { setAuthError(parseWebAuthnError(err)); }
  authBusy = false; $("lkAuthBtn").disabled = false;
}

async function handleAuth(retried) {
  if (!checkWebAuthnReady()) return;
  authBusy = true; setAuthError(""); $("lkAuthBtn").disabled = true;
  try {
    const origin = encodeURIComponent(window.location.origin);
    const optionsJSON = await getJSON(`/api/locker/webauthn/auth-options?origin=${origin}`);
    const response = await WebAuthnNative.startAuthentication(optionsJSON);
    await postJSON("/api/locker/webauthn/auth-verify", { response });
    unlock();
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = (err && err.message) || "";
    if (!retried && /challenge expired|驗證已過期|expired/i.test(msg)) {
      authBusy = false; $("lkAuthBtn").disabled = false;
      setTimeout(() => handleAuth(true), 300);
      return;
    }
    if (msg === "no_credential") { hasCredential = false; updateFingerprintPane(); setAuthError("No fingerprint set up. Please set one up first."); }
    else setAuthError(parseWebAuthnError(err));
  }
  authBusy = false; $("lkAuthBtn").disabled = false;
}
$("lkAuthBtn").addEventListener("click", () => (hasCredential ? handleAuth(false) : handleRegister()));
$("lkReregisterBtn").addEventListener("click", handleRegister);
$("lkAddDevice").addEventListener("click", handleRegister);

// ── TOTP unlock ──────────────────────────────────────────────
$("lkTotpInput").addEventListener("input", (e) => {
  const raw = e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6);
  e.target.value = raw.length > 3 ? `${raw.slice(0, 3)} ${raw.slice(3)}` : raw;
  setAuthError("");
  $("lkTotpBtn").disabled = raw.length !== 6;
});
$("lkTotpInput").addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter" && !$("lkTotpBtn").disabled) handleTotpUnlock(); });
$("lkTotpBtn").addEventListener("click", handleTotpUnlock);
async function handleTotpUnlock() {
  const clean = $("lkTotpInput").value.replace(/\s/g, "");
  if (clean.length !== 6) return setAuthError("Please enter a 6-digit code");
  authBusy = true; setAuthError(""); $("lkTotpBtn").disabled = true;
  try { await postJSON("/api/locker/unlock", { code: clean }); $("lkTotpInput").value = ""; unlock(); }
  catch (err) { setAuthError(err.message); }
  authBusy = false; $("lkTotpBtn").disabled = false;
}
$("lkMobileCancel").addEventListener("click", () => { stopMobilePoll(); $$(".lk-mode-tabs .filter-pill")[0].click(); });
$("lkMobileRetry").addEventListener("click", () => { setAuthError(""); startMobilePoll(); });

// ── Device management ────────────────────────────────────────
function renderDeviceList() {
  const host = $("lkDeviceList");
  host.innerHTML = devices.length ? devices.map((d) => `
    <div class="lk-device-row" data-id="${d.id}">
      <span>🔐 ${d.device_name || "Unknown device"}<br/><span class="hint">${new Date(d.created_at).toLocaleDateString("en-US")}</span></span>
      <button class="link-btn lk-device-del">Remove</button>
    </div>`).join("") : '<p class="hint">No devices registered</p>';
  host.querySelectorAll(".lk-device-del").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const id = Number(e.target.closest(".lk-device-row").dataset.id);
    handleDeleteDevice(id);
  }));
}
async function handleDeleteDevice(id) {
  if (!confirm("Remove fingerprint authentication for this device?")) return;
  try {
    await reqJSON(`/api/locker/webauthn/${id}`, { method: "DELETE", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" } });
    await refreshDevices();
    toast("Removed");
  } catch (err) { setSettingsError(err.message); }
}

// ── Auto-lock + visibility handling ───────────────────────────
function resetLockTimer() {
  if (lockTimer) clearTimeout(lockTimer);
  lockTimer = setTimeout(lockNow, AUTO_LOCK_MS);
}
let hiddenAt = 0;
document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
  if (document.visibilityState === "hidden") { hiddenAt = Date.now(); return; }
  authBusy = false; setAuthError("");
  if (hiddenAt && Date.now() - hiddenAt > AUTO_LOCK_MS && !$("lkGallery").classList.contains("hidden")) lockNow();
});

function lockNow() {
  if (lockTimer) { clearTimeout(lockTimer); lockTimer = null; }
  window.removeEventListener("mousemove", resetLockTimer);
  window.removeEventListener("keydown", resetLockTimer);
  $("lkGallery").classList.add("hidden");
  $("lkSettings").classList.add("hidden");
  $("lkLightbox").classList.add("hidden");
  $("lkLock").classList.remove("hidden");
  $$(".lk-mode-tabs .filter-pill")[0].click();
}

async function unlock() {
  $("lkLock").classList.add("hidden");
  $("lkSettings").classList.add("hidden");
  $("lkGallery").classList.remove("hidden");
  resetLockTimer();
  window.addEventListener("mousemove", resetLockTimer);
  window.addEventListener("keydown", resetLockTimer);
  try { const prefs = await getJSON("/api/widgets/prefs"); lockerPath = prefs.locker_path || DEFAULT_PATH; } catch {}
  $("lkGalleryPath").textContent = lockerPath;
  await loadFiles();
}

// ── Gallery ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function loadFiles() {
  $("lkGalleryBody").innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div>';
  try {
    const d = await getJSON(`/api/locker/files?path=${encodeURIComponent(lockerPath)}`);
    items = d.items || [];
    renderGallery();
  } catch (err) { $("lkGalleryBody").innerHTML = `<p class="hint">${err.message}</p>`; }
}
function renderGallery() {
  $("lkItemCount").textContent = `${items.length} media items`;
  const body = $("lkGalleryBody");
  if (!items.length) {
    body.innerHTML = `<div class="lk-empty"><p>📁</p><p class="lk-lock-sub">Private Album is empty</p><p class="hint">Upload photos or videos — only you can see them</p></div>`;
    return;
  }
  body.innerHTML = `<div class="lk-grid">${items.map((it, i) => `
    <div class="lk-tile" data-idx="${i}">
      ${it.isVideo ? `<video src="${it.url}" preload="metadata"></video><span class="lk-vid-badge">▶</span>` : `<img src="${it.url}" loading="lazy"/>`}
      <button class="lk-tile-del" title="Move to Trash">🗑</button>
    </div>`).join("")}</div>`;
  body.querySelectorAll(".lk-tile").forEach((el) => {
    const idx = Number(el.dataset.idx);
    el.addEventListener("click", (e) => { if (!e.target.closest(".lk-tile-del")) openLightbox(idx); });
    el.querySelector(".lk-tile-del").addEventListener("click", (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); deleteItem(items[idx].name); });
  });
}
async function deleteItem(name) {
  if (!confirm(`Move "${name}" to trash?`)) return;
  try {
    await reqJSON(`/api/locker/files?path=${encodeURIComponent(`${lockerPath}/${name}`)}`, { method: "DELETE", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" } });
    items = items.filter((f) => f.name !== name);
    renderGallery();
    if (lightboxIndex !== null) closeLightbox();
    toast("Moved to trash");
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}

$("lkUploadBtn").addEventListener("click", () => $("lkFileInput").click());
$("lkFileInput").addEventListener("change", async (e) => {
  const files = e.target.files;
  if (!files?.length) return;
  $("lkUploadBtn").textContent = "Uploading…"; $("lkUploadBtn").disabled = true;
  try {
    const form = new FormData();
    for (const f of files) form.append("files", f);
    const r = await fetch(`/api/locker/upload?path=${encodeURIComponent(lockerPath)}`, { method: "POST", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" }, body: form });
    const d = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (d.ok) toast(`${d.ok} files uploaded`);
    if (d.fail) toast(`${d.fail} failed`, "error");
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
  $("lkUploadBtn").textContent = "⬆️ Upload"; $("lkUploadBtn").disabled = false;
  e.target.value = "";
  loadFiles();
});
$("lkRefreshBtn").addEventListener("click", loadFiles);
$("lkLockBtn").addEventListener("click", lockNow);
$("lkSettingsBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  $("lkPathInput").value = lockerPath; $("lkPathCurrent").textContent = lockerPath; setSettingsError("");
  $("lkGallery").classList.add("hidden"); $("lkSettings").classList.remove("hidden");
});
$("lkSettingsBack").addEventListener("click", () => { $("lkSettings").classList.add("hidden"); $("lkGallery").classList.remove("hidden"); });
$("lkPathApply").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const p = $("lkPathInput").value.trim().replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, "");
  if (!p) return toast("Path cannot be empty", "error");
  lockerPath = p;
  try { await postJSON("/api/widgets/prefs", { locker_path: p }); } catch {}
  toast("Applied");
  $("lkSettings").classList.add("hidden"); $("lkGallery").classList.remove("hidden");
  $("lkGalleryPath").textContent = lockerPath;
  loadFiles();
});

// ── Lightbox ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function openLightbox(i) { lightboxIndex = i; renderLightbox(); $("lkLightbox").classList.remove("hidden"); }
function closeLightbox() { lightboxIndex = null; $("lkLightbox").classList.add("hidden"); $("lkLightbox").innerHTML = ""; }
function renderLightbox() {
  const item = items[lightboxIndex];
  const host = $("lkLightbox");
  host.innerHTML = `
    <div class="lk-lb-top">
      <span class="lk-lb-name">${item.name}</span>
      <span class="hint">${lightboxIndex + 1} / ${items.length}</span>
      <button class="icon-btn" id="lkLbClose">×</button>
    </div>
    ${lightboxIndex > 0 ? '<button class="lk-lb-nav lk-lb-prev">‹</button>' : ""}
    ${lightboxIndex < items.length - 1 ? '<button class="lk-lb-nav lk-lb-next">›</button>' : ""}
    <div class="lk-lb-media">
      ${item.isVideo ? `<video src="${item.url}" controls controlsList="nodownload noplaybackrate noremoteplayback" autoplay></video>` : `<img src="${item.url}"/>`}
    </div>
    ${items.length > 1 ? `<div class="lk-lb-strip">${items.map((it, i) => `<button class="lk-lb-thumb${i === lightboxIndex ? " active" : ""}" data-idx="${i}">${it.isVideo ? "▶" : `<img src="${it.url}" loading="lazy"/>`}</button>`).join("")}</div>` : ""}
  `;
  host.querySelector("#lkLbClose").addEventListener("click", closeLightbox);
  host.querySelector(".lk-lb-prev")?.addEventListener("click", () => { lightboxIndex--; renderLightbox(); });
  host.querySelector(".lk-lb-next")?.addEventListener("click", () => { lightboxIndex++; renderLightbox(); });
  host.querySelectorAll(".lk-lb-thumb").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => { lightboxIndex = Number(b.dataset.idx); renderLightbox(); }));
  host.addEventListener("click", (e) => { if (e.target === host) closeLightbox(); });
}
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (lightboxIndex === null) return;
  if (e.key === "Escape") closeLightbox();
  else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" && lightboxIndex > 0) { lightboxIndex--; renderLightbox(); }
  else if (e.key === "ArrowRight" && lightboxIndex < items.length - 1) { lightboxIndex++; renderLightbox(); }
});

refreshDevices();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/mail.js
// Mail (IMAP/SMTP webmail) — self-contained page script.
// $, $$, toast, getJSON, postJSON, reqJSON come from admin_common.js (loaded
// first by page_shell()). openModal/closeModal are defined locally here
// (not imported from widgets.js) because this page uses page_shell, not
// the home shell — same convention as locker.js/downloader.js.
function esc(s) {
  return (s ?? "").toString().replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]));
}
function fmtDate(raw) {
  const d = new Date(raw);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return raw || "";
  const p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  const now = new Date();
  const sameDay = d.toDateString() === now.toDateString();
  return sameDay ? `${p(d.getHours())}:${p(d.getMinutes())}` : `${p(d.getMonth() + 1)}/${p(d.getDate())}`;
}
function openModal(id) { $(id)?.classList.remove("hidden"); }
function closeModal(id) { $(id)?.classList.add("hidden"); }
document.querySelectorAll(".modal-close").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => closeModal(b.dataset.close)));
document.querySelectorAll(".modal-overlay").forEach((ov) =>
  ov.addEventListener("click", (e) => { if (e.target === ov) ov.classList.add("hidden"); }));

const S = {
  accounts: [],
  accountId: null,
  folders: [],
  folder: "INBOX",
  messages: [],
  total: 0,
  offset: 0,
  limit: 30,
  uid: null,
};

async function loadAccounts() {
  S.accounts = await getJSON("/api/mail/accounts");
  renderAccounts();
  if (!S.accounts.length) {
    $("mailFolders").innerHTML = "";
    $("mailMsgList").innerHTML = "";
    return;
  }
  if (!S.accountId || !S.accounts.some((a) => a.id === S.accountId)) {
    selectAccount(S.accounts[0].id);
  }
}

function renderAccounts() {
  $("mailAccounts").innerHTML = S.accounts.map((a) => `
    <div class="mail-acct-row ${a.id === S.accountId ? "active" : ""}" data-id="${a.id}">
      <span class="mail-acct-name">${a.type === "local" ? "🏠 " : ""}${esc(a.label || a.email_addr)}</span>
      <button class="mail-acct-del" data-id="${a.id}" title="Remove account">&times;</button>
    </div>
  `).join("");
  $$("#mailAccounts .mail-acct-row").forEach((row) =>
    row.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      if (e.target.closest(".mail-acct-del")) return;
      selectAccount(Number(row.dataset.id));
    }));
  $$("#mailAccounts .mail-acct-del").forEach((btn) =>
    btn.addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (!confirm("Remove this mail account? (mail itself stays on the server, only the saved login is removed)")) return;
      try {
        await reqJSON(`/api/mail/accounts/${btn.dataset.id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
        if (S.accountId === Number(btn.dataset.id)) { S.accountId = null; S.uid = null; }
        toast("Account removed");
        await loadAccounts();
      } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
    }));
}

async function selectAccount(id) {
  S.accountId = id;
  S.folder = "INBOX";
  S.uid = null;
  renderAccounts();
  $("mailReading").innerHTML = '<div class="mail-empty">Loading…</div>';
  try {
    const r = await getJSON(`/api/mail/accounts/${id}/folders`);
    S.folders = r.folders;
  } catch (err) {
    toast(err.message, "error");
    S.folders = ["INBOX"];
  }
  renderFolders();
  await loadMessages(true);
}

function renderFolders() {
  $("mailFolders").innerHTML = S.folders.map((f) => `
    <div class="mail-folder-row ${f === S.folder ? "active" : ""}" data-folder="${esc(f)}">${esc(f)}</div>
  `).join("");
  $$("#mailFolders .mail-folder-row").forEach((row) =>
    row.addEventListener("click", () => selectFolder(row.dataset.folder)));
}

async function selectFolder(folder) {
  S.folder = folder;
  S.uid = null;
  renderFolders();
  $("mailReading").innerHTML = '<div class="mail-empty">Select a message to read</div>';
  await loadMessages(true);
}

async function loadMessages(reset) {
  if (reset) { S.offset = 0; S.messages = []; }
  $("mailMsgList").innerHTML = '<div class="mail-empty">Loading…</div>';
  try {
    const r = await getJSON(`/api/mail/accounts/${S.accountId}/messages?folder=${encodeURIComponent(S.folder)}&offset=${S.offset}&limit=${S.limit}`);
    S.total = r.total;
    S.messages = reset ? r.items : S.messages.concat(r.items);
    S.offset = S.messages.length;
  } catch (err) {
    $("mailMsgList").innerHTML = `<div class="mail-empty">${esc(err.message)}</div>`;
    return;
  }
  renderMessages();
}

function renderMessages() {
  if (!S.messages.length) {
    $("mailMsgList").innerHTML = '<div class="mail-empty">No messages</div>';
  } else {
    $("mailMsgList").innerHTML = S.messages.map((m) => `
      <div class="mail-msg-row ${m.uid === S.uid ? "active" : ""} ${m.seen ? "" : "unread"}" data-uid="${m.uid}">
        <div class="mail-msg-top">
          <span class="mail-msg-from">${esc(m.from)}</span>
          <span class="mail-msg-date">${esc(fmtDate(m.date))}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="mail-msg-subject">${esc(m.subject)}</div>
      </div>
    `).join("");
    $$("#mailMsgList .mail-msg-row").forEach((row) =>
      row.addEventListener("click", () => selectMessage(Number(row.dataset.uid))));
  }
  $("mailLoadMoreBtn").classList.toggle("hidden", S.offset >= S.total);
}

async function selectMessage(uid) {
  S.uid = uid;
  renderMessages();
  $("mailReading").innerHTML = '<div class="mail-empty">Loading…</div>';
  let detail;
  try {
    detail = await getJSON(`/api/mail/accounts/${S.accountId}/messages/${uid}?folder=${encodeURIComponent(S.folder)}`);
  } catch (err) {
    $("mailReading").innerHTML = `<div class="mail-empty">${esc(err.message)}</div>`;
    return;
  }
  renderMessageDetail(detail);
  if (!detail.seen) {
    reqJSON(`/api/mail/accounts/${S.accountId}/messages/${uid}/seen?folder=${encodeURIComponent(S.folder)}`, { method: "POST" })
      .then(() => { const m = S.messages.find((x) => x.uid === uid); if (m) { m.seen = true; renderMessages(); } })
      .catch(() => {});
  }
}

// Untrusted HTML from a remote sender is never inserted via innerHTML.
// An empty sandbox strips script execution, form submission, top
// navigation and same-origin access — inert even if the source HTML
// carries an XSS payload.
function renderHtmlBody(html) {
  const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
  iframe.sandbox = "";
  iframe.srcdoc = html;
  iframe.addEventListener("load", () => {
    try { iframe.style.height = (iframe.contentWindow.document.body.scrollHeight + 24) + "px"; } catch { /* cross-origin no-op */ }
  });
  return iframe;
}

function renderMessageDetail(d) {
  const root = $("mailReading");
  root.innerHTML = `
    <div class="mail-reading-header">
      <p class="mail-reading-subject">${esc(d.subject)}</p>
      <div class="mail-reading-meta">From: ${esc(d.from)}</div>
      <div class="mail-reading-meta">To: ${esc(d.to)}</div>
      ${d.cc ? `<div class="mail-reading-meta">Cc: ${esc(d.cc)}</div>` : ""}
      <div class="mail-reading-meta">${esc(d.date)}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="mail-reading-body" id="mailBodyHost">${d.html ? "" : `<pre style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-family:inherit;margin:0">${esc(d.text || "(no content)")}</pre>`}</div>
    ${d.attachments.length ? `<div class="mail-attachments">${d.attachments.map((a) =>
      `<a class="mail-attachment" href="/api/mail/accounts/${S.accountId}/messages/${d.uid}/attachments/${a.index}?folder=${encodeURIComponent(S.folder)}">📎 ${esc(a.filename)} (${fmtSize(a.size)})</a>`
    ).join("")}</div>` : ""}
    <div class="mail-reading-actions">
      <button class="btn-secondary" id="mailReplyBtn">Reply</button>
      <button class="btn-secondary" id="mailDeleteBtn">Delete</button>
    </div>
  `;
  if (d.html) $("mailBodyHost").appendChild(renderHtmlBody(d.html));

  $("mailReplyBtn").addEventListener("click", () => openCompose({
    to: d.from, subject: d.subject.startsWith("Re:") ? d.subject : `Re: ${d.subject}`,
    body: `\n\n---- On ${d.date}, ${d.from} wrote ----\n${(d.text || "").split("\n").map((l) => "> " + l).join("\n")}`,
  }));
  $("mailDeleteBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    if (!confirm("Delete this message?")) return;
    try {
      await reqJSON(`/api/mail/accounts/${S.accountId}/messages/${d.uid}?folder=${encodeURIComponent(S.folder)}`, { method: "DELETE" });
      toast("Deleted");
      S.uid = null;
