      root.innerHTML = '<div class="mail-empty">Select a message to read</div>';
      await loadMessages(true);
    } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
  });
}

function fmtSize(n) {
  if (n < 1024) return `${n} B`;
  if (n < 1024 * 1024) return `${(n / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(n / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB`;
}

// ── Compose ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function openCompose(prefill) {
  $("mailCTo").value = prefill?.to || "";
  $("mailCCc").value = "";
  $("mailCSubject").value = prefill?.subject || "";
  $("mailCBody").value = prefill?.body || "";
  $("mailCFiles").value = "";
  openModal("mailComposeModal");
}

$("mailComposeBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  if (!S.accountId) { toast("Add a mail account first", "error"); return; }
  openCompose();
});

$("mailCSend").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  if (!S.accountId) return;
  const to = $("mailCTo").value.trim();
  if (!to) { toast("Please enter a recipient", "error"); return; }
  const form = new FormData();
  form.append("account_id", String(S.accountId));
  form.append("to", to);
  form.append("cc", $("mailCCc").value.trim());
  form.append("subject", $("mailCSubject").value.trim());
  form.append("body", $("mailCBody").value);
  for (const f of $("mailCFiles").files) form.append("files", f);

  $("mailCSend").disabled = true;
  try {
    const r = await fetch("/api/mail/send", { method: "POST", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" }, body: form });
    const data = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${r.status}`);
    toast("Sent");
    closeModal("mailComposeModal");
  } catch (err) {
    toast(err.message, "error");
  } finally {
    $("mailCSend").disabled = false;
  }
});

// ── Add account ──────────────────────────────────────────
// Account type toggle: 'external' (existing IMAP/SMTP client, unchanged) vs
// 'local' (this NAS's own self-hosted mailbox, see admin_mailserver.py /
// /mail/server-setup). Same "Connect & Save" flow either way — the backend
// (mail.py's accounts_create) is the one place that actually enforces
// host=127.0.0.1 for 'local', never trusting the client for that.
let newAcctType = "external";

async function refreshLocalMailboxFields() {
  $("mailLocalNotProvisioned").classList.add("hidden");
  $("mailLocalProvisioned").classList.add("hidden");
  try {
    const mb = await getJSON("/api/mail/mailbox");
    if (mb.provisioned) {
      $("mailLocalAddress").value = mb.address;
      $("mailLocalPassword").value = "";
      $("mailLocalProvisioned").classList.remove("hidden");
    } else {
      $("mailLocalNotProvisioned").classList.remove("hidden");
    }
  } catch {
    $("mailLocalNotProvisioned").classList.remove("hidden");
  }
}

$$("#mailTypeToggle .mail-type-btn").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  newAcctType = btn.dataset.type;
  $$("#mailTypeToggle .mail-type-btn").forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn));
  $("mailExternalFields").classList.toggle("hidden", newAcctType !== "external");
  $("mailLocalFields").classList.toggle("hidden", newAcctType !== "local");
  if (newAcctType === "local") refreshLocalMailboxFields();
}));

$("mailAddAcctBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  ["mailNewEmail", "mailNewLabel", "mailNewImapHost", "mailNewSmtpHost", "mailNewLoginUser", "mailNewPassword"]
    .forEach((id) => { $(id).value = ""; });
  $("mailNewImapPort").value = "993";
  $("mailNewSmtpPort").value = "587";
  newAcctType = "external";
  $$("#mailTypeToggle .mail-type-btn").forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.type === "external"));
  $("mailExternalFields").classList.remove("hidden");
  $("mailLocalFields").classList.add("hidden");
  openModal("mailAddAcctModal");
});

$("mailNewEmail").addEventListener("blur", () => {
  const email = $("mailNewEmail").value.trim();
  const domain = email.split("@")[1]?.toLowerCase();
  const preset = domain && window.MAIL_PRESETS[domain];
  if (preset) {
    if (!$("mailNewImapHost").value) $("mailNewImapHost").value = preset.imap_host;
    if (!$("mailNewImapPort").value || $("mailNewImapPort").value === "993") $("mailNewImapPort").value = preset.imap_port;
    if (!$("mailNewSmtpHost").value) $("mailNewSmtpHost").value = preset.smtp_host;
    if (!$("mailNewSmtpPort").value || $("mailNewSmtpPort").value === "587") $("mailNewSmtpPort").value = preset.smtp_port;
  }
  if (!$("mailNewLoginUser").value) $("mailNewLoginUser").value = email;
});

$("mailNewSubmit").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  let payload;
  if (newAcctType === "local") {
    payload = {
      type: "local",
      email_addr: $("mailLocalAddress").value.trim(),
      password: $("mailLocalPassword").value,
    };
    if (!payload.email_addr || !payload.password) {
      toast("Set up your mailbox first, then enter its password", "error");
      return;
    }
  } else {
    payload = {
      type: "external",
      email_addr: $("mailNewEmail").value.trim(),
      label: $("mailNewLabel").value.trim(),
      imap_host: $("mailNewImapHost").value.trim(),
      imap_port: Number($("mailNewImapPort").value) || 993,
      smtp_host: $("mailNewSmtpHost").value.trim(),
      smtp_port: Number($("mailNewSmtpPort").value) || 587,
      login_user: $("mailNewLoginUser").value.trim(),
      password: $("mailNewPassword").value,
    };
    if (!payload.email_addr || !payload.imap_host || !payload.smtp_host || !payload.password) {
      toast("Please fill in the required fields", "error");
      return;
    }
  }
  $("mailNewSubmit").disabled = true;
  $("mailNewSubmit").textContent = "Connecting…";
  try {
    const r = await postJSON("/api/mail/accounts", payload);
    toast("Account connected");
    closeModal("mailAddAcctModal");
    S.accountId = r.id;
    await loadAccounts();
  } catch (err) {
    toast(err.message, "error");
  } finally {
    $("mailNewSubmit").disabled = false;
    $("mailNewSubmit").textContent = "Connect & Save";
  }
});

$("mailLoadMoreBtn").addEventListener("click", () => loadMessages(false));

loadAccounts();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/meta_panel.js
// Shared media metadata side panel (tags/location/category/note) — Python
// port of viewers/MetaPanel.tsx. Used by photo.py (batch 4b); video_app.py
// (batch 4d, VideoPlayer's info panel) reuses this unchanged rather than
// re-implementing, same as the original tsx shared one MetaPanel component.
(function () {
  const CATEGORIES = ['Landscape', 'Portrait', 'Travel', 'Food', 'Life', 'Animals', 'Architecture', 'Festival', 'Sports', 'Other'];
  const EMPTY = { tags: [], location: '', category: '', note: '' };

  function esc(s) {
    return (s || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }

  // Mounts into `container` (a DOM element) for `filePath`; returns { destroy }.
  function mount(container, filePath, onClose) {
    let meta = Object.assign({}, EMPTY);
    let saveTimer = null;

    container.innerHTML =
      '<div class="mp-panel">' +
        '<div class="mp-header">' +
          '<span class="mp-label">媒體資訊</span>' +
          '<div class="mp-header-actions">' +
            '<span id="mpSavingDot" class="mp-saving hidden">儲存中…</span>' +
            '<span id="mpSavedDot" class="mp-saved-dot hidden" title="已儲存資訊"></span>' +
            '<button type="button" id="mpCloseBtn" class="mp-close">×</button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="mp-body" id="mpBody"><div class="viewer-loading">Loading…</div></div>' +
      '</div>';

    container.querySelector('#mpCloseBtn').onclick = function () { destroy(); if (onClose) onClose(); };

    function render() {
      const name = filePath.split('/').pop() || filePath;
      const body = container.querySelector('#mpBody');
      body.innerHTML =
        '<div class="mp-field"><p class="mp-field-label">檔案名稱</p><p class="mp-filename">' + esc(name) + '</p></div>' +
        '<div class="mp-field">' +
          '<p class="mp-field-label">🏷 標籤</p>' +
          '<div class="mp-tags" id="mpTags"></div>' +
          '<div class="mp-tag-add">' +
            '<input id="mpTagInput" class="mp-input" placeholder="輸入標籤 Enter 新增…">' +
            '<button type="button" id="mpTagAddBtn" class="mp-tag-add-btn">+</button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="mp-field">' +
          '<p class="mp-field-label">📍 地點</p>' +
          '<input id="mpLocation" class="mp-input" placeholder="拍攝地點…" value="' + esc(meta.location) + '">' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="mp-field"><p class="mp-field-label">📂 分類</p><div class="mp-cats" id="mpCats"></div></div>' +
        '<div class="mp-field">' +
          '<p class="mp-field-label">📝 備註</p>' +
          '<textarea id="mpNote" class="mp-input mp-note" rows="3" placeholder="備註…">' + esc(meta.note) + '</textarea>' +
        '</div>';

      renderTags();
      renderCats();
      body.querySelector('#mpLocation').addEventListener('change', function (e) { update({ location: e.target.value }); });
      body.querySelector('#mpNote').addEventListener('change', function (e) { update({ note: e.target.value }); });
      const tagInput = body.querySelector('#mpTagInput');
      tagInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); addTag(); } });
      body.querySelector('#mpTagAddBtn').onclick = addTag;
    }

    function renderTags() {
      const wrap = container.querySelector('#mpTags');
      if (!wrap) return;
      wrap.innerHTML = meta.tags.length
        ? meta.tags.map(function (t) {
            return '<span class="mp-tag">' + esc(t) + '<button type="button" data-tag="' + esc(t) + '" class="mp-tag-remove">×</button></span>';
          }).join('')
        : '<span class="mp-empty-hint">尚未標記</span>';
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(wrap.querySelectorAll('.mp-tag-remove'), function (btn) {
        btn.onclick = function () { update({ tags: meta.tags.filter(function (t) { return t !== btn.dataset.tag; }) }); };
      });
    }

    function renderCats() {
      const wrap = container.querySelector('#mpCats');
      if (!wrap) return;
      const opts = [''].concat(CATEGORIES);
      wrap.innerHTML = opts.map(function (c) {
        return '<button type="button" class="mp-cat-btn' + (meta.category === c ? ' mp-cat-active' : '') + '" data-cat="' + esc(c) + '">' + (c || '無') + '</button>';
      }).join('');
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(wrap.querySelectorAll('.mp-cat-btn'), function (btn) {
        btn.onclick = function () { update({ category: btn.dataset.cat }); };
      });
    }

    function addTag() {
      const input = container.querySelector('#mpTagInput');
      const t = input.value.trim();
      if (!t || meta.tags.indexOf(t) !== -1) { input.value = ''; return; }
      update({ tags: meta.tags.concat([t]) });
      input.value = '';
    }

    function update(patch) {
      meta = Object.assign({}, meta, patch);
      renderTags();
      renderCats();
      if (saveTimer) clearTimeout(saveTimer);
      saveTimer = setTimeout(save, 700);
    }

    function save() {
      const savingDot = container.querySelector('#mpSavingDot');
      const savedDot = container.querySelector('#mpSavedDot');
      if (savingDot) savingDot.classList.remove('hidden');
      fetch('/api/media/meta', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF': '1' },
        body: JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ path: filePath }, meta)),
      })
        .then(function (r) {
          if (!r.ok) throw new Error('儲存失敗');
          if (savedDot) savedDot.classList.remove('hidden');
        })
        .catch(function () {})
        .finally(function () { if (savingDot) savingDot.classList.add('hidden'); });
    }

    fetch('/api/media/meta?path=' + encodeURIComponent(filePath))
      .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : { meta: null }; })
      .then(function (d) {
        meta = Object.assign({}, EMPTY, d.meta || {});
        render();
        const hasMeta = meta.tags.length > 0 || !!meta.location || !!meta.category;
        const savedDot = container.querySelector('#mpSavedDot');
        if (savedDot) savedDot.classList.toggle('hidden', !hasMeta);
      })
      .catch(function () { meta = Object.assign({}, EMPTY); render(); });

    function destroy() { container.innerHTML = ''; }
    return { destroy: destroy };
  }

  window.MetaPanel = { mount: mount };
})();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/music.js
// Music player — Python port of components/music.tsx (category 4, batch 4c).
// ID3v2 parsing / LRC parsing+formatting are ported verbatim (client-side
// binary/text parsing, unchanged from the original — see music.py docstring).
(function () {
  // ── ID3v2 tag parser (verbatim port) ──────────────────────────────────
  const ID3_GENRES = [
    'Blues', 'Classic Rock', 'Country', 'Dance', 'Disco', 'Funk', 'Grunge', 'Hip-Hop', 'Jazz',
    'Metal', 'New Age', 'Oldies', 'Other', 'Pop', 'R&B', 'Rap', 'Reggae', 'Rock', 'Techno',
    'Industrial', 'Alternative', 'Ska', 'Death Metal', 'Pranks', 'Soundtrack', 'Euro-Techno',
    'Ambient', 'Trip-Hop', 'Vocal', 'Jazz+Funk', 'Fusion', 'Trance', 'Classical', 'Instrumental',
    'Acid', 'House', 'Game', 'Sound Clip', 'Gospel', 'Noise', 'AlternRock', 'Bass', 'Soul', 'Punk',
    'Space', 'Meditative', 'Instrumental Pop', 'Instrumental Rock', 'Ethnic', 'Gothic', 'Darkwave',
    'Techno-Industrial', 'Electronic', 'Pop-Folk', 'Eurodance', 'Dream', 'Southern Rock',
    'Comedy', 'Cult', 'Gangsta', 'Top 40', 'Christian Rap', 'Pop/Funk', 'Jungle', 'Native US',
    'Cabaret', 'New Wave', 'Psychadelic', 'Rave', 'Showtunes', 'Trailer', 'Lo-Fi', 'Tribal',
    'Acid Punk', 'Acid Jazz', 'Polka', 'Retro', 'Musical', 'Rock & Roll', 'Hard Rock',
  ];

  function readSyncsafe(view, offset) {
    return ((view.getUint8(offset) & 0x7f) << 21)
      | ((view.getUint8(offset + 1) & 0x7f) << 14)
      | ((view.getUint8(offset + 2) & 0x7f) << 7)
      | (view.getUint8(offset + 3) & 0x7f);
  }

  function id3DecodeText(data) {
    if (!data.length) return '';
    const enc = data[0], raw = data.slice(1);
    try {
      if (enc === 0) return new TextDecoder('iso-8859-1').decode(raw).replace(/\0/g, '').trim();
      if (enc === 1) return new TextDecoder('utf-16').decode(raw).replace(/\0/g, '').trim();
      if (enc === 2) return new TextDecoder('utf-16be').decode(raw).replace(/\0/g, '').trim();
      return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(raw).replace(/\0/g, '').trim();
    } catch (e) { return ''; }
  }

  function id3NullEnd(buf, from, wide) {
    for (let i = from; i < buf.length - (wide ? 1 : 0); i += wide ? 2 : 1) {
      if (buf[i] === 0 && (!wide || buf[i + 1] === 0)) return i;
    }
    return buf.length;
  }

  function parseID3v2(buf) {
    const r = {};
    if (buf[0] !== 0x49 || buf[1] !== 0x44 || buf[2] !== 0x33) return r;
    const ver = buf[3];
    if (ver < 2 || ver > 4) return r;
    const view = new DataView(buf.buffer, buf.byteOffset, buf.byteLength);
    let off = 10;
    if (buf[5] & 0x40) off += (ver === 4 ? readSyncsafe(view, off) : view.getUint32(off));
    const end = Math.min(10 + readSyncsafe(view, 6), buf.length);

    while (off + (ver === 2 ? 6 : 10) <= end) {
      let id, sz;
      if (ver === 2) {
        id = String.fromCharCode(buf[off], buf[off + 1], buf[off + 2]);
        sz = (buf[off + 3] << 16) | (buf[off + 4] << 8) | buf[off + 5];
        off += 6;
      } else {
        id = String.fromCharCode(buf[off], buf[off + 1], buf[off + 2], buf[off + 3]);
        sz = ver === 4 ? readSyncsafe(view, off + 4) : view.getUint32(off + 4);
        off += 10;
      }
      if (id[0] === '\0' || sz <= 0) break;
      const dEnd = Math.min(off + sz, end);
      const d = buf.slice(off, dEnd);
      off += sz;

      if (id === 'TIT2' || id === 'TT2') r.title = id3DecodeText(d);
      else if (id === 'TPE1' || id === 'TP1') r.artist = id3DecodeText(d);
      else if (id === 'TALB' || id === 'TAL') r.album = id3DecodeText(d);
      else if (['TYER', 'TYE', 'TDRC', 'TDA'].indexOf(id) !== -1) r.year = id3DecodeText(d).slice(0, 4);
      else if (id === 'TCON' || id === 'TCO') {
        let g = id3DecodeText(d);
        g = g.replace(/^\((\d+)\).*/, function (_, n) { return ID3_GENRES[+n] || g; });
        r.genre = g;
      } else if ((id === 'APIC' || id === 'PIC') && !r.cover && dEnd > off - sz + 4) {
        const enc = d[0]; const wide = enc === 1 || enc === 2;
        let mime, afterMime;
        if (id === 'APIC') {
          const me = d.indexOf(0, 1);
          mime = new TextDecoder().decode(d.slice(1, me < 0 ? d.length : me));
          afterMime = (me < 0 ? d.length : me) + 2;
        } else {
          mime = 'image/' + String.fromCharCode(d[1], d[2], d[3]).toLowerCase().replace('jpg', 'jpeg');
          afterMime = 5;
        }
        const descEnd = id3NullEnd(d, afterMime, wide);
        const imgStart = descEnd + (wide ? 2 : 1);
        if (imgStart < d.length) r.cover = { data: d.slice(imgStart), mime: mime.indexOf('/') !== -1 ? mime : 'image/' + mime };
      }
    }
    return r;
  }

  // ── LRC + time formatting helpers (verbatim port) ─────────────────────
  function fmtTime(sec) {
    if (!isFinite(sec) || sec < 0) return '0:00';
    const m = Math.floor(sec / 60), s = Math.floor(sec % 60);
    return m + ':' + String(s).padStart(2, '0');
  }

  function fmtTimePrecise(sec) {
    if (!isFinite(sec) || sec < 0) return '00:00.000';
    const m = Math.floor(sec / 60), s = sec % 60, sInt = Math.floor(s), ms = Math.round((s - sInt) * 1000);
    return String(m).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(sInt).padStart(2, '0') + '.' + String(ms).padStart(3, '0');
  }

  function parseTimestamp(str) {
    const m = str.trim().match(/^(\d{1,3}):(\d{2})\.(\d{1,3})$/);
    if (!m) return null;
    const min = parseInt(m[1], 10), sec = parseInt(m[2], 10);
    if (sec >= 60) return null;
    const ms = parseInt(m[3].padEnd(3, '0').slice(0, 3), 10);
    return min * 60 + sec + ms / 1000;
  }

  function baseName(name) { return name.indexOf('.') !== -1 ? name.slice(0, name.lastIndexOf('.')) : name; }
  function lrcNameOf(name) { return baseName(name) + '.lrc'; }

  function parseLrc(text) {
    const lines = [];
    const tagRe = /^\[(ti|ar|al|by|offset|re|ve):.*\]$/;
    text.split('\n').forEach(function (raw) {
      const line = raw.trim();
      if (!line || tagRe.test(line)) return;
      const matches = line.matchAll(/\[(\d{1,3}):(\d{2})(?:[.:](\d{2,3}))?\]/g);
      const textPart = line.replace(/\[.+?\]/g, '').trim();
      if (!textPart) return;
      for (const m of matches) {
        const min = parseInt(m[1], 10), sec = parseInt(m[2], 10), ms = parseInt(m[3] || '0', 10);
        const time = min * 60 + sec + ((m[3] || '').length === 3 ? ms / 1000 : ms / 100);
        lines.push({ time: time, text: textPart });
      }
    });
    lines.sort(function (a, b) { return a.time - b.time; });
    return lines;
  }

  function buildLrcContent(lines, times) {
    return lines.map(function (text, i) {
      const t = times[i];
      if (t === undefined) return '[00:00.000]' + text;
      const min = Math.floor(t / 60), sec = t % 60, secInt = Math.floor(sec), ms = Math.round((sec - secInt) * 1000);
      return '[' + String(min).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(secInt).padStart(2, '0') + '.' + String(ms).padStart(3, '0') + ']' + text;
    }).join('\n');
  }

  function esc(s) { return (s || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;'); }

  // ── state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let path = '';
  let folders = [], tracks = [], lrcs = [], folderCover = null;
  let imgCovers = {};
  let currentIndex = null;
  let playing = false, currentTime = 0, duration = 0, volume = 0.8, muted = false;
  let lyrics = [], lyricsLoading = false, lyricsReqId = 0;
  let showHelp = false;
  let pairMode = false, pairInput = '', pairLines = [], pairTimes = {}, pairIdx = 0, pairSaving = false;
  let editingIdx = null, editingField = 'time', editingVal = '';
  let lrcEditor = null, lrcEditCell = null, lrcEditVal = '', lrcSaving = false;
  let songMeta = null, coverUrl = null, metaLoading = false;
  let loading = true;

  const audio = document.getElementById('muAudio');
  const breadcrumbEl = document.getElementById('muBreadcrumb');
  const sidebarEl = document.getElementById('muSidebar');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('muCount');
  const backBtn = document.getElementById('muBackBtn');
  const playerBarEl = document.getElementById('muPlayerBar');
  const contentEl = document.getElementById('muContent');
  const helpOverlay = document.getElementById('muHelpOverlay');
  const lrcEditorEl = document.getElementById('muLrcEditor');

  function currentTrackName() { return currentIndex !== null && tracks[currentIndex] ? tracks[currentIndex].name : null; }
  function trackLrcUrl(i) { return tracks[i] ? tracks[i].lrc_url : null; }

  // ── data loading ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function load(dir) {
    loading = true;
    renderContent();
    fetch('/api/music/list?path=' + encodeURIComponent(dir))
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        folders = d.folders || []; tracks = d.tracks || []; lrcs = d.lrcs || []; folderCover = d.folder_cover || null;
        loading = false;
        renderBreadcrumb(); renderSidebar(); renderContent();
        countEl.textContent = tracks.length + ' tracks';
        backBtn.style.display = path ? '' : 'none';
      })
      .catch(function () { folders = []; tracks = []; lrcs = []; loading = false; renderContent(); });
  }

  fetch('/api/music/covers').then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) { imgCovers = d.covers || {}; renderPlayerBar(); }).catch(function () {});

  function renderBreadcrumb() {
    const parts = path.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    let html = '<button type="button" class="mu-crumb" data-path="">All Music</button>';
    const acc = [];
    parts.forEach(function (p) {
      acc.push(p);
      html += '<span class="mu-crumb-sep">/</span><button type="button" class="mu-crumb" data-path="' + acc.join('/') + '">' + p + '</button>';
    });
    breadcrumbEl.innerHTML = html;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(breadcrumbEl.querySelectorAll('.mu-crumb'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { path = btn.dataset.path; load(path); };
    });
  }

  function renderSidebar() {
    sidebarEl.innerHTML =
      (path ? '<button type="button" class="mu-sidebar-up" id="muUpBtn">↑ 上一層</button>' : '') +
      '<p class="mu-sidebar-label">Folders</p>' +
      (folders.length
        ? folders.map(function (f) { return '<button type="button" class="mu-sidebar-folder" data-name="' + esc(f.name) + '">📁 ' + esc(f.name) + '</button>'; }).join('')
        : (path ? '' : '<p class="mu-sidebar-empty">沒有子資料夾</p>'));
    if (path) document.getElementById('muUpBtn').onclick = goBack;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(sidebarEl.querySelectorAll('.mu-sidebar-folder'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { path = path ? path + '/' + btn.dataset.name : btn.dataset.name; load(path); };
    });
  }

  function goBack() {
    const idx = path.lastIndexOf('/');
    path = idx === -1 ? '' : path.slice(0, idx);
    load(path);
  }

  // ── playback ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function playTrack(index) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= tracks.length) return;
    currentIndex = index;
    audio.src = tracks[index].download_url;
    audio.play().catch(function () {});
    playing = true;
    loadLyrics(index);
    loadMeta(index);
    renderPlayerBar(); renderContent();
  }

  function togglePlay() {
    if (currentIndex === null && tracks.length > 0) { playTrack(0); return; }
    if (audio.paused) { audio.play().catch(function () {}); } else { audio.pause(); }
  }

  function nextTrack() { if (currentIndex !== null && currentIndex < tracks.length - 1) playTrack(currentIndex + 1); }
  function prevTrack() { if (currentIndex !== null && currentIndex > 0) playTrack(currentIndex - 1); }

  function handleEnded() {
    if (currentIndex !== null && currentIndex < tracks.length - 1) playTrack(currentIndex + 1);
    else { playing = false; renderPlayerBar(); }
  }

  audio.addEventListener('play', function () { playing = true; renderPlayerBar(); });
  audio.addEventListener('pause', function () { playing = false; renderPlayerBar(); });
  audio.addEventListener('timeupdate', function () {
    currentTime = audio.currentTime || 0;
    updateSeekUI();
    updateLyricsHighlight();
  });
  audio.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', function () { duration = audio.duration || 0; updateSeekUI(); });
  audio.addEventListener('ended', handleEnded);

  // ── lyrics ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function loadLyrics(index) {
    const reqId = ++lyricsReqId;
    lyrics = []; lyricsLoading = true;
    const url = trackLrcUrl(index);
    if (!url) { lyricsLoading = false; return; }
    fetch(url)
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.text(); })
      .then(function (text) { if (reqId !== lyricsReqId) return; lyrics = parseLrc(text); })
      .catch(function () {})
      .finally(function () { if (reqId === lyricsReqId) { lyricsLoading = false; renderPlayerBar(); renderContent(); } });
  }

  function currentLyricIdx() {
    let idx = -1;
    for (let i = 0; i < lyrics.length; i++) { if (lyrics[i].time <= currentTime) idx = i; }
    return idx;
  }

  function updateLyricsHighlight() {
    if (pairMode || !currentTrackName() || lyrics.length === 0) return;
    const idx = currentLyricIdx();
    const list = document.getElementById('muLyricsList');
    if (!list) return;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(list.children, function (el, i) {
      el.className = i === idx ? 'mu-lyric-line mu-lyric-current' : i < idx ? 'mu-lyric-line mu-lyric-past' : 'mu-lyric-line';
    });
    const cur = list.children[idx];
    if (cur) cur.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' });
  }

  // ── ID3 metadata + cover ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  function loadMeta(index) {
    songMeta = null;
    if (coverUrl) { URL.revokeObjectURL(coverUrl); coverUrl = null; }
    metaLoading = true;
    renderPlayerBar();
    const url = tracks[index] && tracks[index].download_url;
    if (!url) { metaLoading = false; return; }
    fetch(url).then(function (res) {
      if (!res.ok || !res.body) throw new Error();
      const reader = res.body.getReader();
      const LIMIT = 1024 * 1024;
      const chunks = []; let total = 0;
      function pump() {
        return reader.read().then(function (result) {
          if (result.done || !result.value || total >= LIMIT) { reader.cancel().catch(function () {}); return; }
          chunks.push(result.value); total += result.value.length;
          if (total < LIMIT) return pump();
        });
      }
      return pump().then(function () {
        const buf = new Uint8Array(Math.min(total, LIMIT));
        let off = 0;
        for (const chunk of chunks) {
          const take = Math.min(chunk.length, LIMIT - off);
          buf.set(chunk.slice(0, take), off);
          off += take;
          if (off >= LIMIT) break;
        }
        const parsed = parseID3v2(buf);
        songMeta = {
          title: parsed.title || null, artist: parsed.artist || null, album: parsed.album || null,
          year: parsed.year ? (parseInt(parsed.year, 10) || null) : null, genre: parsed.genre || null,
        };
        if (parsed.cover) {
          const blob = new Blob([new Uint8Array(parsed.cover.data)], { type: parsed.cover.mime });
          coverUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        }
      });
    }).catch(function () {}).finally(function () { metaLoading = false; renderPlayerBar(); });
  }

  // ── player bar rendering ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  function albumArtUrl() {
    const name = currentTrackName();
    const imgCover = name ? imgCovers[baseName(name).toLowerCase()] : undefined;
    return imgCover || folderCover || coverUrl || null;
  }

  function updateSeekUI() {
    const seek = document.getElementById('muSeek');
    const curEl = document.getElementById('muCurTime');
    const durEl = document.getElementById('muDurTime');
    if (seek) { seek.max = duration || 100; seek.value = currentTime; }
    if (curEl) curEl.textContent = fmtTime(currentTime);
    if (durEl) durEl.textContent = fmtTime(duration);
  }

  function renderPlayerBar() {
    const name = currentTrackName();
    if (!name) { playerBarEl.classList.add('hidden'); playerBarEl.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    playerBarEl.classList.remove('hidden');
    const art = albumArtUrl();
    const title = (songMeta && songMeta.title) || baseName(name);
    const subLine = (songMeta && songMeta.album) ? esc(songMeta.album) + (songMeta.year ? ' · ' + songMeta.year : '') : esc(name.split('.').pop().toUpperCase());
    playerBarEl.innerHTML =
      '<div class="mu-bar-row">' +
        '<div class="mu-art">' + (art ? '<img src="' + art + '" alt="cover">' : '<span class="mu-art-fallback">🎵</span>') + '</div>' +
        '<div class="mu-meta">' +
          '<div class="mu-meta-top">' +
            '<span class="mu-track-title">' + esc(title) + '</span>' +
            (metaLoading ? '<span class="mu-spin mu-spin-blue"></span>' : (lyricsLoading ? '<span class="mu-spin mu-spin-pink"></span>' : '')) +
            (!lyricsLoading && lyrics.length > 0 ? '<span class="mu-lrc-badge">LRC</span>' : '') +
            (!pairMode ? '<button type="button" class="mu-pair-btn" id="muPairBtn">' + (lyrics.length > 0 ? '繼續編輯' : '配對') + '</button>' : '<span class="mu-pairing-badge">配對中</span>') +
          '</div>' +
          (songMeta && songMeta.artist ? '<p class="mu-artist">' + esc(songMeta.artist) + '</p>' : '') +
          '<p class="mu-sub">' + subLine + '</p>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="mu-controls">' +
          '<button type="button" id="muPrevBtn" class="mu-ctl-btn"' + (currentIndex === null || currentIndex <= 0 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>⏮</button>' +
          '<button type="button" id="muPlayBtn" class="mu-play-btn">' + (playing ? '⏸' : '▶') + '</button>' +
          '<button type="button" id="muNextBtn" class="mu-ctl-btn"' + (currentIndex === null || currentIndex >= tracks.length - 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>⏭</button>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="mu-seek-row">' +
        '<span class="mu-time" id="muCurTime">' + fmtTime(currentTime) + '</span>' +
        '<input type="range" id="muSeek" min="0" max="' + (duration || 100) + '" value="' + currentTime + '" class="mu-seek">' +
        '<span class="mu-time" id="muDurTime">' + fmtTime(duration) + '</span>' +
        '<div class="mu-volume">' +
          '<button type="button" id="muMuteBtn" class="mu-mute-btn">' + (muted || volume === 0 ? '🔇' : '🔊') + '</button>' +
          '<input type="range" id="muVolume" min="0" max="1" step="0.05" value="' + (muted ? 0 : volume) + '" class="mu-volume-slider">' +
          '<span class="mu-vol-pct">' + (muted ? 'Muted' : Math.round(volume * 100) + '%') + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    document.getElementById('muPrevBtn').onclick = prevTrack;
    document.getElementById('muNextBtn').onclick = nextTrack;
    document.getElementById('muPlayBtn').onclick = togglePlay;
    document.getElementById('muSeek').oninput = function (e) { audio.currentTime = Number(e.target.value); };
    document.getElementById('muMuteBtn').onclick = function () { audio.muted = !audio.muted; muted = audio.muted; renderPlayerBar(); };
    document.getElementById('muVolume').oninput = function (e) {
      volume = Number(e.target.value); audio.volume = volume;
      if (volume > 0 && audio.muted) { audio.muted = false; muted = false; }
      renderPlayerBar();
    };
    const pairBtn = document.getElementById('muPairBtn');
    if (pairBtn) pairBtn.onclick = enterPairMode;
  }

  // ── main content: track list / lyrics / pairing ─────────────────────
  function renderContent() {
    if (pairMode && currentTrackName()) { renderPairing(); return; }
    if (currentTrackName() && lyrics.length > 0) { renderLyricsView(); return; }
    renderTrackList();
  }

  function renderLyricsView() {
    contentEl.innerHTML =
      '<div class="mu-lyrics-wrap"><div class="mu-lyrics-list" id="muLyricsList">' +
        lyrics.map(function (l) { return '<p class="mu-lyric-line" data-time="' + l.time + '">' + esc(l.text) + '</p>'; }).join('') +
      '</div></div>' +
      '<div class="mu-mini-playlist"><details><summary class="mu-mini-summary">Playlist (' + tracks.length + ')</summary>' +
        '<div class="mu-mini-list">' +
          tracks.map(function (t, i) {
            return '<button type="button" class="mu-mini-item' + (currentIndex === i ? ' mu-mini-active' : '') + '" data-idx="' + i + '">' +
              '<span class="mu-mini-idx">' + (i + 1) + '</span><span class="mu-mini-name">' + esc(baseName(t.name)) + '</span></button>';
          }).join('') +
        '</div></details></div>';
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(contentEl.querySelectorAll('.mu-lyric-line'), function (el) {
      el.onclick = function () { audio.currentTime = parseFloat(el.dataset.time); };
    });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(contentEl.querySelectorAll('.mu-mini-item'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { playTrack(parseInt(btn.dataset.idx, 10)); };
    });
    updateLyricsHighlight();
  }

  function renderTrackList() {
    if (loading) { contentEl.innerHTML = '<div class="viewer-loading">Loading…</div>'; return; }
    let html = '<div class="mu-track-list-wrap">';
    if (tracks.length > 0) {
      html += '<ul class="mu-track-list">' + tracks.map(function (t, i) {
        return '<li><button type="button" class="mu-track-row' + (currentIndex === i ? ' mu-track-active' : '') + '" data-idx="' + i + '">' +
          '<span class="mu-track-num">' + (currentIndex === i && playing ? '♪' : (i + 1)) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="mu-track-icon">🎵</span>' +
          '<span class="mu-track-info"><p class="mu-track-name">' + esc(baseName(t.name)) + '</p>' +
          '<p class="mu-track-sub">' + esc(t.name.split('.').pop().toUpperCase()) + (t.size ? ' · ' + (t.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' MB' : '') + '</p></span>' +
          '</button></li>';
      }).join('') + '</ul>';
    } else if (folders.length === 0 && lrcs.length === 0) {
      html += '<div class="mu-empty">No music files in this folder</div>';
    }
    if (lrcs.length > 0) {
      html += '<div class="mu-lrc-section"><p class="mu-lrc-section-label">LRC Lyrics</p><ul class="mu-lrc-list">' +
        lrcs.map(function (f) {
          return '<li><button type="button" class="mu-lrc-row" data-path="' + esc(f.path) + '"><span class="mu-lrc-name">' + esc(f.name) + '</span><span class="mu-lrc-edit">編輯</span></button></li>';
        }).join('') + '</ul></div>';
    }
    html += '</div>';
    contentEl.innerHTML = html;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(contentEl.querySelectorAll('.mu-track-row'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { playTrack(parseInt(btn.dataset.idx, 10)); };
    });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(contentEl.querySelectorAll('.mu-lrc-row'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { openLrcEditor(btn.dataset.path); };
    });
  }

  // ── lyric pairing tool ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  function enterPairMode() {
    if (lyrics.length > 0) {
      pairLines = lyrics.map(function (l) { return l.text; });
      pairTimes = {};
      lyrics.forEach(function (l, i) { pairTimes[i] = l.time; });
      pairIdx = lyrics.length;
    } else {
      pairInput = ''; pairLines = []; pairTimes = {}; pairIdx = 0;
    }
    pairMode = true;
    renderPlayerBar(); renderContent();
  }

  function exitPair() {
    pairMode = false; pairInput = ''; pairLines = []; pairTimes = {}; pairIdx = 0;
    renderPlayerBar(); renderContent();
  }

  function startPairing() {
    const lines = pairInput.split('\n').map(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lines.length) return;
    pairLines = lines; pairTimes = {}; pairIdx = 0;
    if (audio.paused) audio.play().catch(function () {});
    renderContent();
  }

  function downloadLrc() {
    const content = buildLrcContent(pairLines, pairTimes);
    const fname = currentTrackName() ? baseName(currentTrackName()) + '.lrc' : 'lyrics.lrc';
    const blob = new Blob([content], { type: 'text/plain' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url; a.download = fname; a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  function saveLrcFromPairing() {
    if (currentIndex === null || !pairLines.length) return;
    pairSaving = true; renderContent();
    const content = buildLrcContent(pairLines, pairTimes);
    const lrcPath = MUSIC_LYRIC_PATH_OF(tracks[currentIndex].name);
    fetch('/api/viewer/text?path=' + encodeURIComponent(lrcPath), {
      method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8', 'X-CSRF': '1' }, body: content,
    }).then(function () {
      exitPair();
      loadLyrics(currentIndex);
    }).catch(function () {}).finally(function () { pairSaving = false; });
  }

  // Derive the central lyrics-dir path for a track name (mirrors music.py's MUSIC_LYRIC_DIR).
  function MUSIC_LYRIC_PATH_OF(name) { return 'sda1/Music/lyrics/' + lrcNameOf(name); }

  function renderPairing() {
    const hasLines = pairLines.length > 0;
    const allDone = hasLines && pairIdx >= pairLines.length;
    contentEl.innerHTML =
      '<div class="mu-pair-wrap">' +
        '<div class="mu-pair-header">' +
          '<div class="mu-pair-hint">' +
            (hasLines && !allDone
              ? '按 <kbd>Space</kbd> 標記時間點 <kbd>Backspace</kbd> 復原上一行 <span class="mu-pair-progress">' + pairIdx + ' / ' + pairLines.length + ' 句</span>'
              : hasLines ? '<span class="mu-pair-done">✓ 所有歌詞已配對完成，可點擊時間點繼續調整，或直接「儲存」</span>'
              : '貼上歌詞文字，播放音樂後按空白鍵標記每句的時間點') +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="mu-pair-actions">' +
            (hasLines ? '<button type="button" class="btn-small" id="muPairRestartBtn">重新開始</button>' +
              '<button type="button" class="btn-small" id="muPairExportBtn">匯出 LRC</button>' +
              '<button type="button" class="btn-small" id="muPairSaveBtn"' + (pairSaving ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' + (pairSaving ? '儲存中...' : '儲存') + '</button>' : '') +
            '<button type="button" class="btn-small" id="muPairExitBtn">退出</button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        (!hasLines
          ? '<div class="mu-pair-input-wrap"><textarea id="muPairInput" class="mu-pair-textarea" placeholder="在此貼上歌詞（每行一句）...">' + esc(pairInput) + '</textarea>' +
            '<button type="button" class="btn-primary" id="muPairStartBtn"' + (!pairInput.trim() ? ' disabled' : '') + '>開始配對</button></div>'
          : '<div class="mu-pair-list" id="muPairList">' +
              pairLines.map(function (line, i) {
                const t = pairTimes[i];
                const isDone = t !== undefined;
                const isCurrent = i === pairIdx;
                return '<div class="mu-pair-row' + (isCurrent ? ' mu-pair-current' : isDone ? ' mu-pair-past' : ' mu-pair-future') + '">' +
                  '<span class="mu-pair-time" data-idx="' + i + '" data-field="time">' + (isDone ? fmtTimePrecise(t) : (isCurrent ? '▶ 等待' : '--:--.---')) + '</span>' +
                  '<span class="mu-pair-text' + (isDone ? ' mu-pair-text-editable' : '') + '" data-idx="' + i + '" data-field="text">' + esc(line) + '</span>' +
                '</div>';
              }).join('') +
            '</div>'
        ) +
      '</div>';

    document.getElementById('muPairExitBtn').onclick = exitPair;
    const restartBtn = document.getElementById('muPairRestartBtn');
    if (restartBtn) restartBtn.onclick = function () { pairLines = []; pairTimes = {}; pairIdx = 0; renderContent(); };
    const exportBtn = document.getElementById('muPairExportBtn');
    if (exportBtn) exportBtn.onclick = downloadLrc;
    const saveBtn = document.getElementById('muPairSaveBtn');
    if (saveBtn) saveBtn.onclick = saveLrcFromPairing;

    if (!hasLines) {
      const ta = document.getElementById('muPairInput');
      ta.oninput = function (e) { pairInput = e.target.value; document.getElementById('muPairStartBtn').disabled = !pairInput.trim(); };
      document.getElementById('muPairStartBtn').onclick = startPairing;
    } else {
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(contentEl.querySelectorAll('.mu-pair-time, .mu-pair-text-editable'), function (el) {
        el.onclick = function () {
          const i = parseInt(el.dataset.idx, 10);
          const field = el.dataset.field;
          editingIdx = i; editingField = field;
          editingVal = field === 'time' ? fmtTimePrecise(pairTimes[i]) : pairLines[i];
          const input = document.createElement('input');
          input.type = 'text'; input.value = editingVal; input.className = field === 'time' ? 'mu-pair-edit-input mu-mono' : 'mu-pair-edit-input';
          el.replaceWith(input); input.focus(); input.select();
          function commit() {
            const v = input.value;
            if (field === 'time') { const p = parseTimestamp(v); if (p !== null) pairTimes[i] = p; }
            else { const t = v.trim(); if (t) pairLines[i] = t; }
            editingIdx = null; renderPairing();
          }
          input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') commit();
            else if (e.key === 'Escape') { editingIdx = null; renderPairing(); }
          });
          input.addEventListener('blur', commit);
        };
      });
      const list = document.getElementById('muPairList');
      const cur = list.children[Math.min(pairIdx, pairLines.length - 1)];
      if (cur) cur.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  }

  // ── LRC table editor (for any standalone .lrc file in the folder) ────
  function openLrcEditor(filePath) {
    lrcEditor = { path: filePath, lines: [] };
    lrcEditCell = null;
    renderLrcEditor();
    fetch('/api/viewer/text?path=' + encodeURIComponent(filePath))
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.text(); })
      .then(function (text) {
        const parsed = parseLrc(text);
        lrcEditor = { path: filePath, lines: parsed.map(function (l) { return { time: l.time, text: l.text }; }) };
        renderLrcEditor();
      })
      .catch(function () { renderLrcEditor(); });
  }

  function saveLrc() {
    if (!lrcEditor) return;
    lrcSaving = true; renderLrcEditor();
    const content = lrcEditor.lines.slice()
      .filter(function (l) { return l.text.trim(); })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return (a.time === null ? Infinity : a.time) - (b.time === null ? Infinity : b.time); })
      .map(function (l) {
        if (l.time === null) return l.text;
        const min = Math.floor(l.time / 60), sec = l.time % 60, sInt = Math.floor(sec), ms = Math.round((sec - sInt) * 1000);
        return '[' + String(min).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(sInt).padStart(2, '0') + '.' + String(ms).padStart(3, '0') + ']' + l.text;
      }).join('\n');
    fetch('/api/viewer/text?path=' + encodeURIComponent(lrcEditor.path), {
      method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8', 'X-CSRF': '1' }, body: content,
    }).then(function () {
      lrcEditor = null; lrcEditCell = null;
      if (currentIndex !== null) loadLyrics(currentIndex);
      renderLrcEditor();
    }).catch(function () {}).finally(function () { lrcSaving = false; renderLrcEditor(); });
  }

  function renderLrcEditor() {
    if (!lrcEditor) { lrcEditorEl.classList.add('hidden'); lrcEditorEl.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    lrcEditorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
    const fname = lrcEditor.path.split('/').pop();
    lrcEditorEl.innerHTML =
      '<div class="mu-lrced-header">' +
        '<span class="mu-lrced-name">' + esc(fname) + '<span class="mu-lrced-count">' + lrcEditor.lines.length + ' 行</span></span>' +
        '<div class="mu-lrced-actions">' +
          '<button type="button" class="btn-small" id="muLrcedSortBtn">↕ 排序</button>' +
          '<button type="button" class="btn-small" id="muLrcedAddBtn">+ 新增行</button>' +
          '<button type="button" class="btn-small" id="muLrcedSaveBtn"' + (lrcSaving ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' + (lrcSaving ? '儲存中...' : '儲存') + '</button>' +
          '<button type="button" class="viewer-close" id="muLrcedCloseBtn">×</button>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="mu-lrced-body">' +
        (lrcEditor.lines.length === 0
          ? '<div class="mu-lrced-empty">無歌詞行，點擊「+ 新增行」開始編輯</div>'
          : '<table class="mu-lrced-table"><thead><tr><th class="mu-lrced-th-num">#</th><th class="mu-lrced-th-time">時間</th><th>歌詞</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
            lrcEditor.lines.map(function (line, i) {
              const timeStr = line.time !== null ? fmtTimePrecise(line.time) : '--:--.---';
              const isEditingTime = lrcEditCell && lrcEditCell.idx === i && lrcEditCell.field === 'time';
              const isEditingText = lrcEditCell && lrcEditCell.idx === i && lrcEditCell.field === 'text';
              return '<tr><td class="mu-lrced-num">' + (i + 1) + '</td>' +
                '<td>' + (isEditingTime
                  ? '<input class="mu-lrced-input mu-mono" id="muLrcedCellInput" value="' + esc(lrcEditVal) + '" placeholder="00:00.000">'
                  : '<button type="button" class="mu-lrced-time-btn" data-idx="' + i + '">' + timeStr + '</button>') + '</td>' +
                '<td>' + (isEditingText
                  ? '<input class="mu-lrced-input" id="muLrcedCellInput" value="' + esc(lrcEditVal) + '">'
                  : '<button type="button" class="mu-lrced-text-btn" data-idx="' + i + '">' + (line.text ? esc(line.text) : '<span class="mu-lrced-placeholder">點擊輸入歌詞...</span>') + '</button>') + '</td>' +
                '<td><button type="button" class="mu-lrced-del-btn" data-idx="' + i + '">✕</button></td></tr>';
            }).join('') + '</tbody></table>')
      + '</div>';

    document.getElementById('muLrcedCloseBtn').onclick = function () { lrcEditor = null; lrcEditCell = null; renderLrcEditor(); };
    document.getElementById('muLrcedSortBtn').onclick = function () {
      lrcEditor.lines.sort(function (a, b) { return (a.time === null ? Infinity : a.time) - (b.time === null ? Infinity : b.time); });
      renderLrcEditor();
    };
    document.getElementById('muLrcedAddBtn').onclick = function () { lrcEditor.lines.push({ time: null, text: '' }); renderLrcEditor(); };
    document.getElementById('muLrcedSaveBtn').onclick = saveLrc;

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(lrcEditorEl.querySelectorAll('.mu-lrced-time-btn'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () {
        const i = parseInt(btn.dataset.idx, 10);
        lrcEditCell = { idx: i, field: 'time' };
        lrcEditVal = lrcEditor.lines[i].time !== null ? fmtTimePrecise(lrcEditor.lines[i].time) : '';
        renderLrcEditor();
      };
    });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(lrcEditorEl.querySelectorAll('.mu-lrced-text-btn'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () {
        const i = parseInt(btn.dataset.idx, 10);
        lrcEditCell = { idx: i, field: 'text' };
        lrcEditVal = lrcEditor.lines[i].text;
        renderLrcEditor();
      };
    });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(lrcEditorEl.querySelectorAll('.mu-lrced-del-btn'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { lrcEditor.lines.splice(parseInt(btn.dataset.idx, 10), 1); renderLrcEditor(); };
    });
    const cellInput = document.getElementById('muLrcedCellInput');
    if (cellInput) {
      cellInput.focus();
      function commit() {
        const i = lrcEditCell.idx, field = lrcEditCell.field;
        if (field === 'time') lrcEditor.lines[i].time = parseTimestamp(cellInput.value);
        else lrcEditor.lines[i].text = cellInput.value;
        lrcEditCell = null; renderLrcEditor();
      }
      cellInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') commit();
        else if (e.key === 'Escape') { lrcEditCell = null; renderLrcEditor(); }
      });
      cellInput.addEventListener('blur', commit);
    }
  }

  // ── help overlay ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderHelp() {
    if (!showHelp) { helpOverlay.classList.add('hidden'); helpOverlay.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    helpOverlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    const shortcuts = (pairMode && pairLines.length > 0)
      ? [['Space', 'Stamp timestamp'], ['Backspace', 'Undo last stamp'], ['Esc', 'Exit pair mode']]
      : [['Space', 'Play / Pause'], ['→', 'Forward 5s'], ['←', 'Rewind 5s'], ['↑', 'Volume +5%'], ['↓', 'Volume -5%'],
         ['M', 'Toggle Mute'], ['Shift+?', 'Keyboard Shortcuts'], ['Esc', 'Close']];
    helpOverlay.innerHTML =
      '<div class="mu-help-card">' +
        '<div class="mu-help-header"><h3>Keyboard Shortcuts</h3><button type="button" class="viewer-close" id="muHelpCloseBtn">×</button></div>' +
        '<div class="mu-help-list">' + shortcuts.map(function (s) { return '<div class="mu-help-row"><kbd>' + s[0] + '</kbd><span>' + s[1] + '</span></div>'; }).join('') + '</div>' +
        '<p class="mu-help-footer">Press Shift+? again to close</p>' +
      '</div>';
    document.getElementById('muHelpCloseBtn').onclick = function () { showHelp = false; renderHelp(); };
    helpOverlay.onclick = function (e) { if (e.target === helpOverlay) { showHelp = false; renderHelp(); } };
  }

  // ── keyboard shortcuts ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    const tag = (e.target && e.target.tagName) || '';
    if (tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA') return;

    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      if (showHelp) { showHelp = false; renderHelp(); return; }
      if (pairMode) { exitPair(); return; }
      window.location.href = '/home'; return;
    }
    if (e.shiftKey && e.key === '?') { e.preventDefault(); showHelp = !showHelp; renderHelp(); return; }
    if (e.key === ' ') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (pairMode && pairLines.length > 0 && pairIdx < pairLines.length) {
        pairTimes[pairIdx] = audio.currentTime; pairIdx += 1;
        if (audio.paused) audio.play().catch(function () {});
        renderContent();
        return;
      }
      if (currentIndex === null && tracks.length > 0) { playTrack(0); return; }
      if (audio.paused) audio.play().catch(function () {}); else audio.pause();
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === 'm' || e.key === 'M') { audio.muted = !audio.muted; muted = audio.muted; renderPlayerBar(); return; }
    if (e.key === 'Backspace' && pairMode && pairIdx > 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      pairIdx -= 1;
      delete pairTimes[pairIdx];
      renderContent();
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); audio.currentTime = Math.min(audio.duration || 0, audio.currentTime + 5); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); audio.currentTime = Math.max(0, audio.currentTime - 5); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); volume = Math.min(1, Math.round((audio.volume + 0.05) * 100) / 100); audio.volume = volume; if (volume > 0 && audio.muted) { audio.muted = false; muted = false; } renderPlayerBar(); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); volume = Math.max(0, Math.round((audio.volume - 0.05) * 100) / 100); audio.volume = volume; renderPlayerBar(); }
  });

  document.getElementById('muHelpBtn').onclick = function () { showHelp = !showHelp; renderHelp(); };
  backBtn.onclick = goBack;

  load('');
})();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/office_workspace.js
// Office Cowork Workspace — vanilla JS behind office_workspace.py.
// Same conventions as widgets.js ($(), X-CSRF header, toast()).
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const CFG = window.OFFICE_CFG || {};

function toast(msg, kind = "info") {
  const host = $("toastHost");
  if (!host) return;
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = `toast toast-${kind}`;
  el.textContent = msg;
  host.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(() => el.classList.add("toast-out"), 2200);
  setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 2600);
}

async function postJSON(url, body) {
  const r = await fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF": "1" },
    body: JSON.stringify(body ?? {}),
  });
  const data = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${r.status}`);
  return data;
}

async function copyText(text, label) {
  try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); toast(`${label} 已複製`); }
  catch { toast("複製失敗", "error"); }
}

// ── Word edit mode ────────────────────────────────────────────
let wordDirty = false;
$("btnEditToggle")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
  const area = $("docArea");
  const toolbar = $("wordToolbar");
  const saveBtn = $("btnSave");
  if (!area) { toggleSheetEdit(); return; }
  const editing = area.contentEditable === "true";
  area.contentEditable = editing ? "false" : "true";
  toolbar?.classList.toggle("hidden", editing);
  saveBtn?.classList.toggle("hidden", editing);
  $("btnEditToggle").textContent = editing ? "📝 編輯模式" : "👁 檢視模式";
});
document.querySelectorAll("#wordToolbar [data-cmd]").forEach((btn) =>
  btn.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    document.execCommand(btn.dataset.cmd, false);
    $("docArea")?.focus();
  }));
$("btnSave")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const area = $("docArea");
  if (!area) return;
  try {
    const d = await postJSON("/office/edit/save-doc", { path: CFG.path, html: area.innerHTML });
    toast(`已儲存為 ${d.savedAs}`);
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
});

// ── Excel edit mode ───────────────────────────────────────────
function toggleSheetEdit() {
  const table = $("sheetTable");
  if (!table) return;
  const editing = table.classList.toggle("editing");
  $("sheetActions")?.classList.toggle("hidden", !editing);
  $("btnSave")?.classList.toggle("hidden", !editing);
  $("btnEditToggle").textContent = editing ? "👁 檢視模式" : "📝 編輯模式";
  table.querySelectorAll("td").forEach((td) => {
    const span = td.querySelector(".cell-text");
    if (editing) {
      const input = document.createElement("input");
      input.type = "text";
      input.value = span ? span.textContent : "";
      input.className = "cell-input";
      td.innerHTML = "";
      td.appendChild(input);
    } else {
      const input = td.querySelector(".cell-input");
      const text = input ? input.value : "";
      td.innerHTML = `<span class="cell-text"></span>`;
      td.querySelector(".cell-text").textContent = text;
    }
  });
}
$("btnAddRow")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
  const table = $("sheetTable");
  if (!table) return;
  const cols = table.rows[0]?.cells.length ?? 1;
  const row = table.insertRow();
  for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
    const td = row.insertCell();
    td.innerHTML = `<input type="text" class="cell-input"/>`;
  }
});
$("btnAddCol")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
  const table = $("sheetTable");
  if (!table) return;
  Array.from(table.rows).forEach((row) => {
    const td = row.insertCell();
    td.innerHTML = `<input type="text" class="cell-input"/>`;
  });
});
$("btnSave")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const table = $("sheetTable");
  if (!table) return;
  const grid = Array.from(table.rows).map((row) =>
    Array.from(row.cells).map((td) => td.querySelector(".cell-input")?.value ?? td.textContent ?? ""));
  try {
    await postJSON("/office/edit/save-sheet", { path: CFG.path, sheetName: CFG.sheet || "Sheet1", grid });
    toast("已儲存");
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
});

// ── PDF blob preview (bypasses Content-Disposition: attachment) ─
(async function loadPdf() {
  const host = $("pdfHost");
  if (!host) return;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(CFG.downloadUrl);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const blob = await res.blob();
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([blob], { type: "application/pdf" }));
    host.innerHTML = `<iframe src="${url}#toolbar=1&navpanes=0" class="office-pdf-frame" title="${CFG.name}"></iframe>`;
  } catch (err) {
    host.innerHTML = `<p class="hint">無法載入 PDF：${err.message}</p>`;
  }
})();

// ── WebDAV / share actions ───────────────────────────────────
$("btnCopyWebdav")?.addEventListener("click", (e) => copyText(e.target.dataset.url, "WebDAV 連結"));
$("btnCollabLink")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  try {
    const d = await postJSON("/office/edit/share", { path: CFG.path });
    await copyText(`${location.origin}/share/${d.token}`, "協作連結");
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
});

// ── Collaboration (presence / tasks / notes / activity) ──────
let ws = null;
function collabConnect() {
  if (!CFG.collabUrl) return;
  ws = new WebSocket(CFG.collabUrl);
  ws.onopen = () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: "join", filePath: CFG.path, fileName: CFG.name, docType: CFG.category }));
  ws.onmessage = (event) => {
    let msg; try { msg = JSON.parse(event.data); } catch { return; }
    if (msg.type === "snapshot") {
      $("collabStatus").textContent = `${(msg.users ?? []).length} 人在線`;
      renderUsers(msg.users ?? []);
      renderTasks(msg.tasks ?? []);
      renderNotes(msg.notes ?? []);
    } else if (msg.type === "presence") {
      $("collabStatus").textContent = `${(msg.users ?? []).length} 人在線`;
      renderUsers(msg.users ?? []);
    } else if (msg.type === "tasks") {
      renderTasks(msg.tasks ?? []);
    } else if (msg.type === "note") {
      appendNote(msg.note);
    } else if (msg.type === "activity") {
      appendActivity(msg.text);
    } else if (msg.type === "error") {
      toast(msg.error || "協作連線發生錯誤", "error");
    }
  };
  ws.onclose = () => { $("collabStatus").textContent = "已斷線"; };
  ws.onerror = () => { $("collabStatus").textContent = "連線錯誤"; };
}
function sendCollab(payload) {
  if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) { toast("協作連線尚未就緒", "error"); return false; }
  ws.send(JSON.stringify(payload));
  return true;
}
function renderUsers(users) {
  const host = $("collabUsers");
  if (!host) return;
  host.innerHTML = users.length
    ? users.map((u) => `<span class="collab-user"><span class="collab-dot" style="background:${u.color}"></span>${u.displayName || u.username}</span>`).join("")
    : '<span class="hint">目前沒有其他成員</span>';
}
function renderTasks(tasks) {
  const host = $("taskList");
  if (!host) return;
  $("taskCount").textContent = tasks.filter((t) => !t.done).length;
  host.innerHTML = tasks.length ? "" : '<p class="hint">沒有待辦事項</p>';
  tasks.forEach((t) => {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "collab-task";
    row.innerHTML = `<button class="task-check${t.done ? " done" : ""}" data-id="${t.id}">${t.done ? "✓" : ""}</button>
      <span class="task-title${t.done ? " done" : ""}">${t.title}</span>
      <button class="task-del" data-id="${t.id}">×</button>`;
    row.querySelector(".task-check").addEventListener("click", () => sendCollab({ type: "toggle-task", id: t.id }));
    row.querySelector(".task-del").addEventListener("click", () => sendCollab({ type: "delete-task", id: t.id }));
    host.appendChild(row);
  });
}
function renderNotes(notes) {
  const host = $("noteList");
  if (!host) return;
  $("noteCount").textContent = notes.length;
  host.innerHTML = "";
  notes.slice().reverse().forEach(appendNote);
}
function appendNote(note) {
  const host = $("noteList");
  if (!host || !note) return;
  const el = document.createElement("article");
  el.className = "collab-note";
  el.innerHTML = `<p>${note.text}</p><p class="hint">${note.author}</p>`;
  host.prepend(el);
  $("noteCount").textContent = host.children.length;
}
function appendActivity(text) {
  const host = $("activityList");
  if (!host || !text) return;
  const p = document.createElement("p");
  p.className = "hint";
  p.textContent = text;
  host.prepend(p);
  while (host.children.length > 6) host.removeChild(host.lastChild);
}
$("taskForm")?.addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const v = $("taskInput").value.trim();
  if (v && sendCollab({ type: "add-task", title: v })) $("taskInput").value = "";
});
$("noteForm")?.addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const v = $("noteInput").value.trim();
  if (v && sendCollab({ type: "add-note", text: v })) $("noteInput").value = "";
});

if (CFG.path) collabConnect();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/photo.js
// Photo gallery — Python port of components/photo.tsx (category 4, batch 4b).
(function () {
  let path = '';
  let photos = [];
  let folders = [];
  let viewIdx = null;
  let showInfo = false;
  let metaHandle = null;

  const gridWrap = document.getElementById('phGridWrap');
  const sidebar = document.getElementById('phSidebar');
  const breadcrumb = document.getElementById('phBreadcrumb');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('phCount');
  const backBtn = document.getElementById('phBackBtn');
  const lightbox = document.getElementById('phLightbox');

  function load(dir) {
    gridWrap.innerHTML = '<div class="viewer-loading">Loading…</div>';
    fetch('/api/photo/list?path=' + encodeURIComponent(dir))
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        folders = d.folders || [];
        photos = d.photos || [];
        renderSidebar();
        renderBreadcrumb();
        renderGrid();
        countEl.textContent = photos.length + ' photos';
        backBtn.style.display = path ? '' : 'none';
      })
      .catch(function () {
        folders = []; photos = [];
        gridWrap.innerHTML = '<div class="viewer-error">Failed to load</div>';
      });
  }

  function renderBreadcrumb() {
    const parts = path.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    let html = '<button type="button" class="ph-crumb" data-path="">All Photos</button>';
    const acc = [];
    parts.forEach(function (p) {
      acc.push(p);
      html += '<span class="ph-crumb-sep">/</span><button type="button" class="ph-crumb" data-path="' + acc.join('/') + '">' + p + '</button>';
    });
    breadcrumb.innerHTML = html;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(breadcrumb.querySelectorAll('.ph-crumb'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { path = btn.dataset.path; load(path); };
    });
  }

  function renderSidebar() {
    sidebar.innerHTML =
      (path ? '<button type="button" class="ph-sidebar-up" id="phUpBtn">↑ 上一層</button>' : '') +
      '<p class="ph-sidebar-label">Folders</p>' +
      (folders.length
        ? folders.map(function (f) { return '<button type="button" class="ph-sidebar-folder" data-name="' + f.name + '">📁 ' + f.name + '</button>'; }).join('')
        : (path ? '' : '<p class="ph-sidebar-empty">沒有子資料夾</p>'));
    if (path) document.getElementById('phUpBtn').onclick = goBack;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(sidebar.querySelectorAll('.ph-sidebar-folder'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { path = path ? path + '/' + btn.dataset.name : btn.dataset.name; load(path); };
    });
  }

  function goBack() {
    const idx = path.lastIndexOf('/');
    path = idx === -1 ? '' : path.slice(0, idx);
    load(path);
  }

  function renderGrid() {
    if (photos.length === 0) {
      gridWrap.innerHTML = '<div class="ph-empty">No photos in this folder</div>';
      return;
    }
    gridWrap.innerHTML = '<div class="ph-grid">' +
      photos.map(function (p, i) {
        return '<button type="button" class="ph-thumb" data-idx="' + i + '">' +
          '<img src="' + p.download_url + '" alt="' + p.name + '" loading="lazy">' +
          '<span class="ph-thumb-name">' + p.name + '</span>' +
        '</button>';
      }).join('') + '</div>';
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(gridWrap.querySelectorAll('.ph-thumb'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { openViewer(parseInt(btn.dataset.idx, 10)); };
    });
  }

  function openViewer(idx) {
    viewIdx = idx;
    showInfo = false;
    renderLightbox();
  }

  function closeViewer() {
    viewIdx = null;
    showInfo = false;
    if (metaHandle) { metaHandle.destroy(); metaHandle = null; }
    lightbox.classList.add('hidden');
    lightbox.innerHTML = '';
  }

  function renderLightbox() {
    if (viewIdx === null) { lightbox.classList.add('hidden'); lightbox.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    const p = photos[viewIdx];
    lightbox.classList.remove('hidden');
    lightbox.innerHTML =
      '<div class="ph-viewer">' +
        '<div class="ph-viewer-header">' +
          '<span class="ph-viewer-name">' + p.name + ' <span class="ph-viewer-count">' + (viewIdx + 1) + ' / ' + photos.length + '</span></span>' +
          '<span class="ph-viewer-hint">← → Navigate&nbsp;&nbsp;I Info</span>' +
          '<button type="button" class="ph-info-btn' + (showInfo ? ' active' : '') + '" id="phInfoBtn">ℹ</button>' +
          '<button type="button" class="viewer-close" id="phCloseBtn">×</button>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="ph-viewer-body">' +
          '<div class="ph-viewer-image-wrap" id="phImageWrap">' +
            '<img src="' + p.download_url + '" class="ph-viewer-image" alt="' + p.name + '">' +
            (viewIdx > 0 ? '<button type="button" class="ph-nav ph-nav-prev" id="phPrevBtn">‹</button>' : '') +
            (viewIdx < photos.length - 1 ? '<button type="button" class="ph-nav ph-nav-next" id="phNextBtn">›</button>' : '') +
          '</div>' +
          (showInfo ? '<div class="ph-viewer-meta" id="phMetaContainer"></div>' : '') +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    document.getElementById('phCloseBtn').onclick = closeViewer;
    document.getElementById('phInfoBtn').onclick = function () { showInfo = !showInfo; renderLightbox(); };
    document.getElementById('phImageWrap').onclick = function (e) { if (e.target.id === 'phImageWrap') closeViewer(); };
    const prevBtn = document.getElementById('phPrevBtn');
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('phNextBtn');
    if (prevBtn) prevBtn.onclick = function () { openViewer(Math.max(0, viewIdx - 1)); };
    if (nextBtn) nextBtn.onclick = function () { openViewer(Math.min(photos.length - 1, viewIdx + 1)); };

    if (showInfo) {
      const container = document.getElementById('phMetaContainer');
      metaHandle = window.MetaPanel.mount(container, p.path, function () { showInfo = false; renderLightbox(); });
    } else if (metaHandle) {
      metaHandle.destroy();
      metaHandle = null;
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (viewIdx !== null) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { closeViewer(); return; }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); openViewer(Math.min(viewIdx + 1, photos.length - 1)); }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); openViewer(Math.max(viewIdx - 1, 0)); }
      if (e.key === 'i' || e.key === 'I') { showInfo = !showInfo; renderLightbox(); }
    } else {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') window.location.href = '/home';
    }
  });

  backBtn.onclick = goBack;
  load('');
})();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/reels_player.js
// Shared TikTok-style swipe player behind /tools/reels and /tools/telegram.
// Parameterized by window.REELS_CONFIG (injected per-page by reels.py).
// Auth (fingerprint/TOTP) hits locker.py's already-shipped /api/locker/*
// endpoints directly — one shared credential unlocks Locker/Reels/Telegram.
const CFG = window.REELS_CONFIG;
const AUTO_LOCK_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;

let hasCredential = false, authBusy = false;
let path = CFG.defaultPath, videos = [], current = 0, loading = true;
let muted = false, playing = true, volume = 1;
let liked = new Set(), collected = new Set();
let lockTimer = null, mobilePollTimer = null, volHintTimer = null;

function setAuthError(msg) { const el = $("rpAuthError"); el.textContent = msg || ""; el.classList.toggle("hidden", !msg); }

// ── Mode tabs ────────────────────────────────────────────────
$$(".lk-mode-tabs .filter-pill").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  $$(".lk-mode-tabs .filter-pill").forEach((b) => b.classList.remove("active"));
  btn.classList.add("active");
  setAuthError("");
  $("rpFingerprintPane").classList.toggle("hidden", btn.dataset.mode !== "fingerprint");
  $("rpTotpPane").classList.toggle("hidden", btn.dataset.mode !== "totp");
  $("rpLockSub").textContent = btn.dataset.mode === "fingerprint" ? "Fingerprint / Face ID" : "Enter code to unlock";
}));

// ── Mobile pairing (passive, polls whenever the lock screen is showing) ──
function stopMobilePoll() { if (mobilePollTimer) { clearInterval(mobilePollTimer); mobilePollTimer = null; } }
function startMobilePoll() {
  stopMobilePoll();
  mobilePollTimer = setInterval(async () => {
    try { const r = await getJSON(`/api/${CFG.appId}/mobile-signal`); if (r.ready) { stopMobilePoll(); unlock(); } } catch {}
  }, 2000);
}

// ── WebAuthn / TOTP (shared /api/locker/* endpoints) ──────────
async function refreshAuthStatus() {
  try { const d = await getJSON("/api/locker/webauthn/status"); hasCredential = d.registered; updateFingerprintBtn(); } catch {}
}
function updateFingerprintBtn() { $("rpAuthBtn").textContent = hasCredential ? "Unlock with Fingerprint" : "Set Up Fingerprint"; }

async function handleRegister() {
  if (!WebAuthnNative.supported()) return setAuthError("Browser does not support biometrics");
  authBusy = true; setAuthError(""); $("rpAuthBtn").disabled = true;
  try {
    const origin = encodeURIComponent(window.location.origin);
    const optionsJSON = await getJSON(`/api/locker/webauthn/register-options?origin=${origin}`);
    const response = await WebAuthnNative.startRegistration(optionsJSON);
    await postJSON("/api/locker/webauthn/register-verify", { response, deviceName: navigator.platform || "Unknown" });
    hasCredential = true; toast("Fingerprint set up"); unlock();
  } catch (err) { setAuthError(err.message); }
  authBusy = false; $("rpAuthBtn").disabled = false;
}
async function handleAuth() {
  if (!WebAuthnNative.supported()) return setAuthError("Browser does not support biometrics");
  authBusy = true; setAuthError(""); $("rpAuthBtn").disabled = true;
  try {
    const origin = encodeURIComponent(window.location.origin);
    const optionsJSON = await getJSON(`/api/locker/webauthn/auth-options?origin=${origin}`);
    const response = await WebAuthnNative.startAuthentication(optionsJSON);
    await postJSON("/api/locker/webauthn/auth-verify", { response });
    unlock();
  } catch (err) {
    setAuthError(err.message === "no_credential" ? "No fingerprint set up. Please set one first." : err.message);
  }
  authBusy = false; $("rpAuthBtn").disabled = false;
}
$("rpAuthBtn").addEventListener("click", () => (hasCredential ? handleAuth() : handleRegister()));

$("rpTotpInput").addEventListener("input", (e) => {
  const raw = e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6);
  e.target.value = raw.length > 3 ? `${raw.slice(0, 3)} ${raw.slice(3)}` : raw;
  setAuthError(""); $("rpTotpBtn").disabled = raw.length !== 6;
});
$("rpTotpInput").addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter" && !$("rpTotpBtn").disabled) handleTotpUnlock(); });
$("rpTotpBtn").addEventListener("click", handleTotpUnlock);
async function handleTotpUnlock() {
  const code = $("rpTotpInput").value.replace(/\s/g, "");
  if (code.length !== 6) return setAuthError("Enter 6 digits");
  authBusy = true; setAuthError(""); $("rpTotpBtn").disabled = true;
  try { await postJSON("/api/locker/unlock", { code }); $("rpTotpInput").value = ""; unlock(); }
  catch (err) { setAuthError(err.message); }
  authBusy = false; $("rpTotpBtn").disabled = false;
}

// ── Auto-lock ────────────────────────────────────────────────
function resetLockTimer() { if (lockTimer) clearTimeout(lockTimer); lockTimer = setTimeout(lockNow, AUTO_LOCK_MS); }
function lockNow() {
  if (lockTimer) { clearTimeout(lockTimer); lockTimer = null; }
  window.removeEventListener("pointermove", resetLockTimer);
  window.removeEventListener("keydown", resetLockTimer);
  if (videoEl()) videoEl().pause();
  $("rpPlayer").classList.add("hidden");
  $("rpLock").classList.remove("hidden");
  $$(".lk-mode-tabs .filter-pill")[0].click();
  startMobilePoll();
}
document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
  authBusy = false; setAuthError("");
});

async function unlock() {
  stopMobilePoll();
  $("rpLock").classList.add("hidden");
  $("rpPlayer").classList.remove("hidden");
  resetLockTimer();
  window.addEventListener("pointermove", resetLockTimer);
  window.addEventListener("keydown", resetLockTimer);
  try {
    const prefs = await getJSON("/api/widgets/prefs");
    path = prefs[`${CFG.appId}_path`] || CFG.defaultPath;
    liked = new Set(prefs[`${CFG.appId}_liked`] || []);
    collected = new Set(prefs[`${CFG.appId}_collected`] || []);
  } catch {}
  await loadVideos();
}

// ── Video loading ────────────────────────────────────────────
async function loadVideos() {
  loading = true; renderStage();
  try {
    const d = await getJSON(`/api/${CFG.appId}/files?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}`);
    videos = d.items || []; current = 0;
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); videos = []; }
  loading = false; renderStage();
}

function videoEl() { return document.getElementById("rpVideo"); }
function likeKey() { const v = videos[current]; return v ? `${path}/${v.name}` : ""; }
function videoTitle(name) { return name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "").replace(/[-_]/g, " "); }

function renderStage(dir) {
  const stage = $("rpStage");
  if (loading) { stage.innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div>'; return; }
  if (!videos.length) {
    stage.innerHTML = `<div class="rp-empty"><p>${CFG.appId === "reels" ? "📼" : "✈️"}</p>
      <p class="lk-lock-title" style="color:#fff">${CFG.appId === "reels" ? "No reels yet" : "No videos yet"}</p>
      <p class="hint">Upload videos to <span style="font-family:monospace">${path}</span></p></div>`;
    return;
  }
  const v = videos[current];
  const isLiked = liked.has(likeKey()), isCollected = collected.has(likeKey());
  stage.innerHTML = `
    <video id="rpVideo" class="rp-video${dir ? ` slide-${dir}` : ""}" src="${v.url}" autoplay playsinline ${muted ? "muted" : ""}></video>
    <div class="rp-pause-icon hidden" id="rpPauseIcon"><span>▶</span></div>
    <div class="rp-vol-hint hidden" id="rpVolHint"><span id="rpVolIcon"></span><div class="rp-vol-bar"><div class="rp-vol-bar-fill" id="rpVolFill"></div></div><span id="rpVolPct" style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px"></span></div>
    <div class="rp-heart hidden" id="rpHeart">❤️</div>
    <div class="rp-side-actions">
      <button class="rp-side-btn" id="rpLikeBtn"><span class="rp-side-circle${isLiked ? " active" : ""}">${isLiked ? "❤️" : "🤍"}</span><span class="rp-side-label">${isLiked ? "Liked" : "Like"}</span></button>
      <button class="rp-side-btn" id="rpMuteBtn"><span class="rp-side-circle">${muted ? "🔇" : "🔊"}</span><span class="rp-side-label">${muted ? "Muted" : "Sound"}</span></button>
      <button class="rp-side-btn" id="rpCollectBtn"><span class="rp-side-circle${isCollected ? " active" : ""}">${isCollected ? "⭐" : "☆"}</span><span class="rp-side-label">${isCollected ? "Saved" : "Save"}</span></button>
      <button class="rp-side-btn" id="rpSettingsBtn"><span class="rp-side-circle">⚙️</span><span class="rp-side-label">Settings</span></button>
    </div>
    <div class="rp-bottom-info">
      <p class="rp-title">${videoTitle(v.name)}</p>
      <p class="rp-counter">${current + 1} / ${videos.length}</p>
      <div class="rp-progress"><div class="rp-progress-bar" id="rpProgressBar" style="width:0%"></div></div>
    </div>
    <button class="rp-nav-btn up" id="rpNavUp" ${current === 0 ? "disabled" : ""}>▲</button>
    <button class="rp-nav-btn down" id="rpNavDown" ${current >= videos.length - 1 ? "disabled" : ""}>▼</button>
  `;
  wireStage();
}

function wireStage() {
  const v = videoEl();
  if (!v) return;
  v.volume = volume;
  v.addEventListener("play", () => { playing = true; $("rpPauseIcon").classList.add("hidden"); });
  v.addEventListener("pause", () => { playing = false; $("rpPauseIcon").classList.remove("hidden"); });
  v.addEventListener("timeupdate", () => { if (v.duration) $("rpProgressBar").style.width = `${(v.currentTime / v.duration) * 100}%`; });
  v.addEventListener("ended", () => goTo(current + 1, "up"));
  $("rpLikeBtn").addEventListener("click", toggleLike);
  $("rpMuteBtn").addEventListener("click", () => { muted = !muted; v.muted = muted; renderStage(); });
  $("rpCollectBtn").addEventListener("click", toggleCollect);
  $("rpSettingsBtn").addEventListener("click", openSettings);
  $("rpNavUp").addEventListener("click", () => goTo(current - 1, "down"));
  $("rpNavDown").addEventListener("click", () => goTo(current + 1, "up"));
}

function goTo(idx, dir) {
  if (idx < 0 || idx >= videos.length) return;
  current = idx; renderStage(dir);
}
function togglePlay() { const v = videoEl(); if (!v) return; v.paused ? v.play() : v.pause(); }

async function persistPrefs(patch) { try { await postJSON("/api/widgets/prefs", patch); } catch {} }
function flashHeart() { const el = $("rpHeart"); if (!el) return; el.classList.remove("hidden"); void el.offsetWidth; setTimeout(() => el.classList.add("hidden"), 850); }
function toggleLike() {
  const key = likeKey(); if (!key) return;
  if (liked.has(key)) liked.delete(key); else { liked.add(key); flashHeart(); }
  persistPrefs({ [`${CFG.appId}_liked`]: [...liked] });
  renderStage();
}
function toggleCollect() {
  const key = likeKey(); if (!key) return;
  if (collected.has(key)) collected.delete(key); else collected.add(key);
  persistPrefs({ [`${CFG.appId}_collected`]: [...collected] });
  renderStage();
}
function handleDoubleTap() { const key = likeKey(); if (!key || liked.has(key)) { flashHeart(); return; } liked.add(key); persistPrefs({ [`${CFG.appId}_liked`]: [...liked] }); flashHeart(); renderStage(); }

// ── Touch / wheel navigation ───────────────────────────────────
let touchStartY = 0, touchMoved = false, lastTapTime = 0;
const stageEl = $("rpStage");
stageEl.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => { touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY; touchMoved = false; });
stageEl.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => { if (Math.abs(e.touches[0].clientY - touchStartY) > 8) touchMoved = true; });
stageEl.addEventListener("touchend", (e) => {
  const dy = e.changedTouches[0].clientY - touchStartY;
  if (Math.abs(dy) > 70) { dy < 0 ? goTo(current + 1, "up") : goTo(current - 1, "down"); return; }
  if (touchMoved) return;
  const now = Date.now();
  if (now - lastTapTime < 350) { handleDoubleTap(); lastTapTime = 0; }
  else { lastTapTime = now; setTimeout(() => { if (lastTapTime === now) { togglePlay(); lastTapTime = 0; } }, 300); }
});
stageEl.addEventListener("wheel", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (e.deltaY > 40) goTo(current + 1, "up"); else if (e.deltaY < -40) goTo(current - 1, "down");
}, { passive: false });

// ── Keyboard shortcuts ───────────────────────────────────────
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if ($("rpPlayer").classList.contains("hidden")) return;
  if (e.target.tagName === "INPUT") return;
  const v = videoEl();
  const sheetOpen = !$("rpSettingsSheet").classList.contains("hidden") || ($("rpDownloadSheet") && !$("rpDownloadSheet").classList.contains("hidden"));
  if (e.key === "Escape" && !sheetOpen) { window.location.href = "/home"; return; }
