  if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "s") { e.preventDefault(); goTo(current + 1, "up"); }
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp" || e.key === "w") { e.preventDefault(); goTo(current - 1, "down"); }
  if (e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); togglePlay(); }
  if ((e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "a") && v) { e.preventDefault(); v.currentTime = Math.max(0, v.currentTime - 5); }
  if ((e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "d") && v) { e.preventDefault(); v.currentTime = Math.min(v.duration || 0, v.currentTime + 5); }
  if (e.key === "+" || e.key === "_") {
    e.preventDefault();
    volume = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, Math.round((volume + (e.key === "+" ? 0.1 : -0.1)) * 10) / 10));
    if (v) v.volume = volume;
    showVolHint();
  }
  if (e.key === "m") { muted = !muted; if (v) v.muted = muted; renderStage(); }
  if (e.key === "l") toggleLike();
  if (e.key === "c") toggleCollect();
  if (e.key === "f") toggleFullscreen();
});
function showVolHint() {
  const el = $("rpVolHint"); if (!el) return;
  $("rpVolIcon").textContent = volume === 0 ? "🔇" : volume < 0.5 ? "🔉" : "🔊";
  $("rpVolFill").style.width = `${volume * 100}%`;
  $("rpVolPct").textContent = `${Math.round(volume * 100)}%`;
  el.classList.remove("hidden");
  if (volHintTimer) clearTimeout(volHintTimer);
  volHintTimer = setTimeout(() => el.classList.add("hidden"), 1200);
}
function toggleFullscreen() {
  if (!document.fullscreenElement) $("rpPlayer").requestFullscreen?.().catch(() => {});
  else document.exitFullscreen().catch(() => {});
}
$("rpFullscreenBtn").addEventListener("click", toggleFullscreen);
$("rpLockBtn").addEventListener("click", lockNow);

$("rpFileInput").addEventListener("change", async (e) => {
  const files = e.target.files;
  if (!files?.length) return;
  $("rpUploadBtn").textContent = "⏳";
  try {
    const form = new FormData();
    for (const f of files) form.append("files", f);
    const r = await fetch(`/api/${CFG.appId}/upload?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}`, { method: "POST", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" }, body: form });
    const d = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (d.ok) toast(`${d.ok} videos uploaded`);

  let dlQuality = "best", dlPollTimer = null;
  $("rpDownloadBtn").addEventListener("click", () => { $("rpDownloadSheet").classList.remove("hidden"); pollDlJobs(); dlPollTimer = setInterval(pollDlJobs, 2000); });
  function closeDl() { $("rpDownloadSheet").classList.add("hidden"); if (dlPollTimer) { clearInterval(dlPollTimer); dlPollTimer = null; } }
  $("rpDownloadClose").addEventListener("click", closeDl);
  $("rpDownloadSheet").addEventListener("click", (e) => { if (e.target === $("rpDownloadSheet")) closeDl(); });
  $$("#rpDlQuality .filter-pill").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
    $$("#rpDlQuality .filter-pill").forEach((x) => x.classList.remove("active"));
    b.classList.add("active"); dlQuality = b.dataset.q;
  }));
  $("rpDlStart").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const url = $("rpDlUrl").value.trim();
    if (!url) return;
    if (!url.startsWith("http")) return toast("Please enter a full https:// URL", "error");
    try {
      await postJSON("/api/downloader/start", { url, format: "mp4", quality: dlQuality, destPath: path });
      $("rpDlUrl").value = ""; toast("Added to download queue"); pollDlJobs();
    } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
  });
  async function pollDlJobs() {
    try {
      const jobs = await getJSON("/api/downloader/jobs");
      const mine = jobs.filter((j) => j.destPath === path).slice(0, 10);
      $("rpDlJobs").innerHTML = mine.length ? mine.map((j) => `
        <div class="rp-dl-job"><span class="rp-dl-dot ${j.status}"></span>
        <span style="flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap">${j.title || j.filename || j.url.slice(0, 40)}</span>
        ${j.status === "running" ? `<span>${j.progress}%</span>` : j.status === "error" ? '<span style="color:#f87171">Failed</span>' : ""}</div>`).join("") : "";
      if (mine.some((j) => j.status === "done")) loadVideos();
    } catch {}
  }
}

  if (nw.length < 8) return toast("新密碼至少需要 8 個字元", "error");

  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/share_page.js
(function () {
  const appEl = document.getElementById('app');
  if (!appEl) return;

  const token = appEl.dataset.token;
  let info = null;
  let shareJwt = null;
  let pathSegments = [];
  let items = [];
  let loadingFiles = false;
  let uploadProgress = null;
  let errMsg = '';

  const OFFICE_APP_NAME = {
    'ms-word': 'Word',
    'ms-excel': 'Excel',
    'ms-powerpoint': 'PowerPoint'
  };

  function formatSize(bytes) {
    if (bytes === undefined || bytes === null) return '';
    if (bytes < 1024) return bytes + ' B';
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';
    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' GB';
  }

  function webdavShareUrl(tok, fileName) {
    return `${window.location.origin}/webdav-share/${tok}/${encodeURIComponent(fileName)}`;
  }

  function downloadUrl(sub) {
    const path = sub || '';
    return `/api/share/${token}/download?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}&shareJwt=${encodeURIComponent(shareJwt || '')}`;
  }

  function renderLoading() {
    appEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div class="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-orange-500"></div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function renderError(msg) {
    appEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center text-white p-6">
        <div class="text-center space-y-3">
          <p class="text-4xl">🔗</p>
          <p class="text-slate-300 font-medium">${msg || '無法連接伺服器'}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function renderPasswordForm(message) {
    appEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center text-white p-6">
        <div class="w-full max-w-sm space-y-6">
          <div class="text-center space-y-1">
            <p class="text-3xl font-bold text-orange-400">Vaultix NAS</p>
            <p class="text-slate-400 text-sm">此分享連結受密碼保護</p>
            ${info && info.fileName ? `<p class="text-white font-medium mt-1">${info.fileName}</p>` : ''}
          </div>
          <form id="pwd-form" class="space-y-3">
            <input
              type="password"
              id="pwd-input"
              placeholder="輸入存取密碼"
              autofocus
              class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-white placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-orange-400"
            />
            ${message ? `<p class="text-red-400 text-sm text-center">${message}</p>` : ''}
            <button
              type="submit"
              id="pwd-submit"
              class="w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600 text-white font-medium transition-colors"
            >
              進入
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    document.getElementById('pwd-form').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const pwd = document.getElementById('pwd-input').value;
      const submitBtn = document.getElementById('pwd-submit');
      submitBtn.disabled = true;
      submitBtn.innerText = '驗證中…';
      await verifyPassword(pwd);
    });
  }

  async function verifyPassword(pwd) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/share/${token}/verify`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ password: pwd })
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        renderPasswordForm(data.error || '密碼錯誤');
        return;
      }
      shareJwt = data.shareJwt;
      if (info.isFolder) {
        loadFolderContents();
      } else {
        renderReadyPage();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      renderError('密碼驗證失敗');
    }
  }

  async function loadFolderContents() {
    loadingFiles = true;
    renderReadyPage();

    const sub = pathSegments.join('/');
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/share/${token}/files?path=${encodeURIComponent(sub)}`, {
        headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${shareJwt}` }
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      items = data.items || [];
    } catch (e) {
      items = [];
    } finally {
      loadingFiles = false;
      renderReadyPage();
    }
  }

  function renderReadyPage() {
    const permLabel = { view: '僅檢視', download: '僅下載', edit: '可編輯' };

    let html = `
      <header class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur">
        <div class="min-w-0">
          <p class="font-bold text-orange-400 text-lg truncate">${info ? info.fileName : ''}</p>
          <p class="text-xs text-slate-400">
            ${info ? (permLabel[info.permission] || info.permission) : ''}
            ${info && info.oneTime ? ' · 一次性連結' : ''}
          </p>
        </div>
        ${info && !info.isFolder && info.permission !== 'view' ? `
          <a
            href="${downloadUrl()}"
            download="${info.fileName}"
            class="shrink-0 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600 text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors"
          >
            下載檔案
          </a>
        ` : ''}
      </header>
    `;

    if (info && info.isFolder) {
      html += `
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-3 border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/50">
          <nav class="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-slate-400 flex-wrap min-w-0">
            <button id="nav-root" class="hover:text-orange-400 transition-colors shrink-0">根目錄</button>
            ${pathSegments.map((seg, idx) => `
              <span class="flex items-center gap-1">
                <span class="text-slate-600">/</span>
                <button class="nav-seg hover:text-orange-400 transition-colors truncate max-w-[120px]" data-idx="${idx}">${seg}</button>
              </span>
            `).join('')}
          </nav>
          ${info.permission === 'edit' ? `
            <div class="shrink-0 ml-4">
              <button id="btn-upload" class="px-3 py-1.5 text-sm rounded-lg bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600 text-white transition-colors">上傳檔案</button>
              <input id="file-input" type="file" multiple class="hidden" />
            </div>
          ` : ''}
        </div>

        ${uploadProgress !== null ? `
          <div class="px-6 py-2 bg-slate-800 border-b border-slate-700">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3 text-sm text-slate-300">
              <span class="shrink-0">上傳中 ${uploadProgress}%</span>
              <div class="flex-1 h-1.5 bg-slate-700 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                <div class="h-full bg-orange-400 transition-all" style="width: ${uploadProgress}%"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ` : ''}

        <main class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
          ${loadingFiles ? `
            <div class="flex items-center justify-center py-24">
              <div class="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-orange-500"></div>
            </div>
          ` : `
            <ul class="px-4 py-2 space-y-1">
              ${items.map(item => {
                const sub = pathSegments.length ? `${pathSegments.join('/')}/${item.name}` : item.name;
                const isDir = item.type === 'folder';
                return `
                  <li class="flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-800 group transition-colors">
                    <div class="shrink-0">
                      ${isDir
                        ? `<svg class="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20"><path d="M2 6a2 2 0 012-2h5l2 2h5a2 2 0 012 2v6a2 2 0 01-2 2H4a2 2 0 01-2-2V6z" /></svg>`
                        : `<svg class="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z" /></svg>`
                      }
                    </div>
                    <button
                      class="${isDir ? 'btn-folder' : ''} flex-1 text-left text-sm text-white hover:text-orange-400 truncate transition-colors"
                      data-name="${item.name}"
                    >
                      ${item.name}
                    </button>
                    ${item.size !== undefined ? `<span class="text-xs text-slate-500 shrink-0 hidden sm:block">${formatSize(item.size)}</span>` : ''}
                    ${!isDir && info.permission !== 'view' ? `
                      <a
                        href="${downloadUrl(sub)}"
                        download="${item.name}"
                        class="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600 text-slate-200 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity shrink-0"
                      >
                        下載
                      </a>
                    ` : ''}
                  </li>
                `;
              }).join('')}
              ${items.length === 0 && !loadingFiles ? `<li class="text-center text-slate-500 text-sm py-16">此資料夾是空的</li>` : ''}
            </ul>
          `}
        </main>
      `;
    } else {
      // Single file view
      html += `
        <main class="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 text-center px-6">
          ${info.isOfficeEdit && info.officeScheme ? `
            <div class="w-full max-w-sm bg-slate-800 border border-orange-500/30 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-3">
              <p class="text-white font-medium">
                直接在 ${OFFICE_APP_NAME[info.officeScheme]} 開啟線上共同編輯
              </p>
              <a
                href="${info.officeScheme}:ofe|u|${webdavShareUrl(token, info.fileName)}"
                class="block w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600 text-white font-medium text-sm transition-colors"
              >
                在 ${OFFICE_APP_NAME[info.officeScheme]} 中開啟
              </a>
              ${info.hasPassword ? `
                <p class="text-xs text-slate-400">
                  Office 會提示輸入帳號密碼——帳號可隨意填寫，密碼輸入此連結的分享密碼。
                </p>
              ` : ''}
              ${info.oneTime ? `
                <p class="text-xs text-amber-400">
                  一次性連結——在 Office 關閉檔案後此連結即失效。
                </p>
              ` : ''}
            </div>
          ` : (info.permission === 'view' ? `
            <p class="text-slate-500 text-sm">僅供檢視 — 不允許下載</p>
          ` : `
            <p class="text-slate-400 text-sm">點擊上方按鈕下載此檔案</p>
          `)}
        </main>
      `;
    }

    appEl.innerHTML = html;
    bindEvents();
  }

  function bindEvents() {
    const navRoot = document.getElementById('nav-root');
    if (navRoot) {
      navRoot.onclick = () => {
        pathSegments = [];
        loadFolderContents();
      };
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-seg').forEach(el => {
      el.onclick = (e) => {
        const idx = parseInt(e.target.dataset.idx, 10);
        pathSegments = pathSegments.slice(0, idx + 1);
        loadFolderContents();
      };
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.btn-folder').forEach(el => {
      el.onclick = (e) => {
        const name = e.target.dataset.name;
        if (name) {
          pathSegments.push(name);
          loadFolderContents();
        }
      };
    });

    const btnUpload = document.getElementById('btn-upload');
    const fileInput = document.getElementById('file-input');
    if (btnUpload && fileInput) {
      btnUpload.onclick = () => fileInput.click();
      fileInput.onchange = handleUpload;
    }
  }

  function handleUpload(e) {
    const files = e.target.files;
    if (!files || files.length === 0 || !shareJwt) return;

    const form = new FormData();
    for (let f of files) {
      form.append('files', f);
      form.append('filenames', f.name);
    }

    const sub = pathSegments.join('/');
    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open('POST', `/api/share/${token}/upload?path=${encodeURIComponent(sub)}`);
    xhr.setRequestHeader('Authorization', `Bearer ${shareJwt}`);

    xhr.upload.onprogress = ev => {
      if (ev.lengthComputable) {
        uploadProgress = Math.round((ev.loaded / ev.total) * 100);
        renderReadyPage();
      }
    };

    xhr.onload = () => {
      uploadProgress = null;
      e.target.value = '';
      loadFolderContents();
    };

    xhr.onerror = () => {
      uploadProgress = null;
      e.target.value = '';
      alert('上傳失敗');
      renderReadyPage();
    };

    xhr.send(form);
  }

  // --- Initial Loading ---
  fetch(`/api/share/${token}`)
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(data => {
      if (data.error) {
        renderError(data.error);
        return;
      }
      info = data;
      if (info.hasPassword) {
        renderPasswordForm();
      } else {
        verifyPassword('');
      }
    })
    .catch(() => renderError('無法連線至伺服器'));
})();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/terminal.js
