const TERM_BUS = "nas-terminal-bus";
const sessions = new Map();
let tabs = [], activeId = null, sessionSeq = 0;

function winToLinux(cmd, raw) {
  if (cmd === "ipconfig /all" || cmd === "ipconfig/all") return "ip a && echo && ip route && echo && ip neigh";
  if (cmd === "ipconfig") return "ip a";
  if (cmd === "tasklist") return "ps aux";
  if (cmd === "netstat -ano") return "ss -anop";
  if (cmd === "dir" || cmd.startsWith("dir ")) return "ls -la";
  if (cmd.startsWith("type ")) return "cat " + raw.slice(5);
  if (cmd.startsWith("del ")) return "rm " + raw.slice(4);
  if (cmd.startsWith("erase ")) return "rm " + raw.slice(6);
  if (cmd.startsWith("copy ")) return "cp " + raw.slice(5);
  if (cmd.startsWith("move ")) return "mv " + raw.slice(5);
  if (cmd.startsWith("rmdir ")) return "rm -r " + raw.slice(6);
  if (cmd.startsWith("findstr ")) return "grep " + raw.slice(8);
  const pidMatch = raw.match(/^taskkill\s.*\/pid\s+(\d+)/i);
  if (pidMatch) return `kill -9 ${pidMatch[1]}`;
  return null;
}
function withProgress(shellCmd) {
  const parts = shellCmd.trim().split(/\s+/);
  const head = parts[0].toLowerCase(), args = parts.slice(1);
  if (head === "cp") {
    const hasFlags = args.some((a) => a.startsWith("-"));
    if (!hasFlags && args.length >= 2) return `rsync -ah --info=progress2 ${args.join(" ")}`;
    return `cp -v ${args.join(" ")}`;
  }
  if (head === "rm") return `rm -v ${args.join(" ")}`;
  return null;
}
function fmtBytes(b) { return b >= 1e12 ? (b / 1e12).toFixed(1) + " TB" : b >= 1e9 ? (b / 1e9).toFixed(1) + " GB" : b >= 1e6 ? (b / 1e6).toFixed(1) + " MB" : b + " B"; }
function fmtUptime(s) { return `${Math.floor(s / 86400)}d ${Math.floor((s % 86400) / 3600)}h ${Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60)}m ${s % 60}s`; }
function pct(used, total) { return total > 0 ? Math.round((used / total) * 100) : 0; }

function createSession() {
  sessionSeq += 1;
  const n = sessionSeq;
  const id = `t${n}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = "tm-session";

  const term = new Terminal({
    cursorBlink: true, cursorStyle: "bar", fontSize: 14,
    fontFamily: "'Consolas','Courier New',monospace",
    theme: { background: "#1a1a2e", foreground: "#e0e0e0", cursor: "#ffa500", selectionBackground: "#334155",
      black: "#1e1e1e", red: "#f44336", green: "#4caf50", yellow: "#ffa500", blue: "#42a5f5", magenta: "#ab47bc", cyan: "#26c6da", white: "#e0e0e0" },
    allowTransparency: true,
  });
  const fitAddon = new FitAddon.FitAddon();
  term.loadAddon(fitAddon);
  term.open(el);

  let ws = null;
  const lineHist = [];
  let line = "", histIdx = -1, savedLine = "";

  function sendResize() {
    const dims = fitAddon.proposeDimensions();
    if (dims && ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: "resize", cols: dims.cols, rows: dims.rows }));
  }
  function send(data) { if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) ws.send(data); }
  function doCtrlC() { line = ""; histIdx = -1; send("\x03"); }
  function doCtrlL() { term.clear(); send("\x0c"); }
  function doTab() { histIdx = -1; line += "\t"; send("\t"); }

  const session = {
    id, title: `Terminal ${n}`, el,
    focus: () => { try { term.focus(); } catch {} },
    refit: () => { try { fitAddon.fit(); sendResize(); } catch {} },
    copySelection: () => { const s = term.getSelection(); if (s) navigator.clipboard.writeText(s).catch(() => {}); },
    sendText: (t) => send(t),
    historyUp: () => navHistory(1), historyDown: () => navHistory(-1),
    sendCtrlC: doCtrlC, sendCtrlD: () => session.onExit?.(), sendCtrlL: doCtrlL, sendTab: doTab,
    dispose: () => { try { ws?.close(); } catch {} ws = null; try { term.dispose(); } catch {} },
  };
  term.onTitleChange((t) => { if (t) { session.title = t; renderTabs(); } });

  term.attachCustomKeyEventHandler((e) => {
    if (["Tab", "F1", "F2", "F3", "F4", "F5", "F12"].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
    if (e.type === "keydown" && e.ctrlKey && e.shiftKey && e.key === "C") {
      e.preventDefault();
      const sel = term.getSelection();
      if (sel) navigator.clipboard.writeText(sel).catch(() => {});
      return false;
    }
    if (e.type === "keydown" && e.ctrlKey && (e.key === "v" || e.key === "V")) {
      e.preventDefault();
      navigator.clipboard.readText().then((text) => { if (text) send(text); }).catch(() => {});
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  function wsUrl() { return `${location.protocol === "https:" ? "wss" : "ws"}://${location.host}/api/terminal/ws`; }
  function connect() {
    const w = new WebSocket(wsUrl());
    ws = w;
    w.onopen = () => { term.focus(); term.write(HELP_TEXT + "\r\n"); setTimeout(sendResize, 100); };
    w.onmessage = (e) => term.write(e.data);
    w.onclose = (e) => {
      if (ws !== w) return;
      const msg = e.code === 4001 ? "Authentication failed, please log in again"
        : e.code === 4003 ? "Admin access required for the terminal"
        : e.code === 1006 ? "Connection closed abnormally (possibly blocked by firewall or reverse proxy)"
        : `Connection lost (code=${e.code})`;
      term.write(`\r\n\x1b[31m${msg}\x1b[0m\r\n`);
    };
    w.onerror = () => { if (ws !== w) return; term.write("\r\n\x1b[31mWebSocket connection error\x1b[0m\r\n"); };
  }
  function reconnect() {
    term.write("\r\n\x1b[33mRestarting terminal...\x1b[0m\r\n");
    const old = ws; ws = null; old?.close();
    setTimeout(() => { term.clear(); connect(); }, 400);
  }

  async function fetchAndDisplaySystemInfo() {
    term.write(`\r\n${C.yellow}Fetching system info…${C.reset}\r\n`);
    try {
      const r = await fetch("/api/terminal/system-info");
      const d = await r.json();
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(d.error || `HTTP ${r.status}`);
      const L = C.cyan, V = C.green, R = C.reset;
      const mem = d.memory, memUsed = mem ? mem.total - mem.free : 0;
      const loadavg = Array.isArray(d.loadavg) ? d.loadavg : [];
      const lines = ["", `${C.yellow}══════════════════════════════════════════════${R}`, `${C.yellow}  Vaultix NAS — System Info${R}`, `${C.yellow}══════════════════════════════════════════════${R}`, "",
        `  ${L}Hostname:${R}          ${V}${d.hostname}${R}`, `  ${L}IP Address:${R}        ${V}${d.ip}${R}`,
        `  ${L}OS:${R}                ${V}${d.osName || d.platform}${R}`, `  ${L}Platform / Arch:${R}   ${V}${d.platform} / ${d.arch}${R}`,
        ...(d.cpuModel ? [`  ${L}CPU:${R}               ${V}${d.cpuModel}${R}`] : []),
        `  ${L}Uptime:${R}            ${V}${fmtUptime(d.uptime)}${R}`,
        ...(loadavg.length ? [`  ${L}Load Avg:${R}          ${V}${loadavg.map((x) => x.toFixed(2)).join(" / ")} (1/5/15 min)${R}`] : []),
        ...(d.cpuTemp != null ? [`  ${L}CPU Temp:${R}          ${V}${d.cpuTemp.toFixed(1)} °C${R}`] : []), "",
        ...(mem ? [`  ${L}RAM:${R}               total ${V}${fmtBytes(mem.total)}${R}  used ${V}${fmtBytes(memUsed)}${R}  free ${V}${fmtBytes(mem.free)}${R}  (${pct(memUsed, mem.total)}%)`] : []),
        ...(d.disk1 ? [`  ${L}NAS Disk (sda1):${R}  total ${V}${fmtBytes(d.disk1.total)}${R}  used ${V}${fmtBytes(d.disk1.used)}${R}  free ${V}${fmtBytes(d.disk1.free)}${R}  (${pct(d.disk1.used, d.disk1.total)}%)`] : []),
        ...(d.disk ? [`  ${L}System Disk:${R}      total ${V}${fmtBytes(d.disk.total)}${R}  used ${V}${fmtBytes(d.disk.used)}${R}  free ${V}${fmtBytes(d.disk.free)}${R}  (${pct(d.disk.used, d.disk.total)}%)`] : []),
        "", `${C.yellow}══════════════════════════════════════════════${R}`, ""];
      term.write(lines.join("\r\n"));
    } catch (err) { term.write(`\r\n\x1b[31mCannot get system info: ${err.message}\x1b[0m\r\n`); }
  }

  async function fetchAndDisplayUpsInfo() {
    term.write(`\r\n${C.yellow}Fetching UPS info…${C.reset}\r\n`);
    try {
      const r = await fetch("/api/terminal/ups-info");
      const d = await r.json();
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(d.error || `HTTP ${r.status}`);
      const L = C.cyan, V = C.green, R = C.reset;
      if (!d.connected) {
        term.write(`\r\n${C.yellow}══════════════════════════════════════════════${R}\r\n${C.yellow}  UPS System${R}\r\n${C.yellow}══════════════════════════════════════════════${R}\r\n`);
        term.write(`\r\n  \x1b[31mNo UPS device detected${R}\r\n  \x1b[33mPlease ensure NUT (upsd) or apcupsd is installed and a USB UPS is connected${R}\r\n\r\n`);
        return;
      }
      const p = d.batteryPct ?? null, barLen = 20;
      const filled = p != null ? Math.round((p / 100) * barLen) : 0;
      const barColor = p != null && p > 50 ? C.green : p != null && p > 20 ? C.yellow : "\x1b[31m";
      const bar = p != null ? `${barColor}${"█".repeat(filled)}${C.reset}${"░".repeat(barLen - filled)} ${p.toFixed(0)}%` : "N/A";
      const lines = ["", `${C.yellow}══════════════════════════════════════════════${R}`, `${C.yellow}  UPS System${R}`, `${C.yellow}══════════════════════════════════════════════${R}`, "",
        `  ${L}Model:${R}             ${V}${d.model || "Unknown"}${R}`,
        ...(d.manufacturer ? [`  ${L}Manufacturer:${R}      ${V}${d.manufacturer}${R}`] : []),
        `  ${L}Status:${R}            ${V}${d.statusLabel ?? d.status ?? "Unknown"}${R}`, "",
        `  ${L}Battery:${R}           ${bar}`,
        ...(d.runtimeMin != null ? [`  ${L}Runtime:${R}           ${V}${d.runtimeMin} min${R}`] : []),
        ...(d.loadPct != null ? [`  ${L}Load:${R}              ${V}${d.loadPct.toFixed(0)}%${R}`] : []),
        ...(d.inputVoltage != null ? [`  ${L}Input V:${R}           ${V}${d.inputVoltage.toFixed(1)} V${R}`] : []),
        ...(d.outputVoltage != null ? [`  ${L}Output V:${R}          ${V}${d.outputVoltage.toFixed(1)} V${R}`] : []),
        ...(d.batteryVoltage != null ? [`  ${L}Battery V:${R}         ${V}${d.batteryVoltage.toFixed(1)} V${R}`] : []),
        ...(d.temperature != null ? [`  ${L}Temp:${R}              ${V}${d.temperature.toFixed(1)} °C${R}`] : []), "",
        `  \x1b[2mDriver: ${d.driver === "nut" ? "NUT (Network UPS Tools)" : "apcupsd"}${R}`, "",
        `${C.yellow}══════════════════════════════════════════════${R}`, ""];
      term.write(lines.join("\r\n"));
    } catch (err) { term.write(`\r\n\x1b[31mCannot get UPS info: ${err.message}\x1b[0m\r\n`); }
  }

  function navHistory(delta) {
    if (lineHist.length === 0) { send(delta === 1 ? "\x1b[A" : "\x1b[B"); return; }
    if (histIdx === -1) savedLine = line;
    const next = histIdx + delta;
    let target;
    if (next < 0) { histIdx = -1; target = savedLine; }
    else if (next >= lineHist.length) return;
    else { histIdx = next; target = lineHist[next]; }
    send("\x15"); send(target); line = target;
  }

  term.onData((data) => {
    if (data === "\r") {
      const raw = line.trim(), cmd = raw.toLowerCase();
      line = ""; histIdx = -1; savedLine = "";
      if (raw) { lineHist.unshift(raw); lineHist.splice(100); }
      const linuxCmd = winToLinux(cmd, raw);
      const shellCmd = linuxCmd ?? raw;
      const shellHead = shellCmd.split(/\s+/)[0].toLowerCase();
      const progCmd = shellHead === "cp" || shellHead === "rm" ? withProgress(shellCmd) : null;
      if (progCmd !== null) { send("\x15"); send(progCmd + "\r"); }
      else if (linuxCmd !== null) { send("\x15"); send(linuxCmd + "\r"); }
      else if (cmd === "command" || cmd === "help") { term.write("\r\n"); term.write(HELP_TEXT); send("\x15\r"); }
      else if (cmd === "clear" || cmd === "cls") { term.clear(); send("\x15\r"); }
      else if (cmd === "systeminfo") { fetchAndDisplaySystemInfo(); send("\x15\r"); }
      else if (cmd === "upsinfo") { fetchAndDisplayUpsInfo(); send("\x15\r"); }
      else if (cmd === "restart cmd") { reconnect(); }
      else if (cmd.startsWith("explorer ")) {
        const p = raw.slice(9).trim();
        if (p) { try { const ch = new BroadcastChannel(TERM_BUS); ch.postMessage({ type: "open-path", path: p }); ch.close(); } catch {} term.write(`\r\n${C.cyan}Opening ${p} in Vaultix…${C.reset}\r\n`); }
        send("\x15\r");
      } else if (/^[a-z0-9]+\.app$/.test(cmd)) {
        const app = cmd.replace(/\.app$/, "");
        try { const ch = new BroadcastChannel(TERM_BUS); ch.postMessage({ type: "open-app", app }); ch.close(); } catch {}
        term.write(`\r\n${C.cyan}Launching ${app}…${C.reset}\r\n`);
        send("\x15\r");
      } else send(data);
    } else if (data === "\x1b[A") navHistory(1);
    else if (data === "\x1b[B") navHistory(-1);
    else if (data === "\x7f") { if (line.length > 0) line = line.slice(0, -1); send(data); }
    else if (data === "\x03") doCtrlC();
    else if (data === "\x04") session.onExit?.();
    else if (data === "\x0c") doCtrlL();
    else if (data.startsWith("\x1b")) send(data);
    else { histIdx = -1; line += data; send(data); }
  });

  connect();
  return session;
}

// ── Tab / window chrome ─────────────────────────────────────
function renderTabs() {
  const host = $("tmTabs");
  host.innerHTML = tabs.map((id) => {
    const s = sessions.get(id);
    const active = id === activeId;
    return `<div class="tm-tab${active ? " active" : ""}" data-id="${id}" draggable="true" title="${s?.title ?? "Terminal"}">
      <span class="tm-tab-icon">▸</span><span class="tm-tab-label">${s?.title ?? "Terminal"}</span>
      <button class="tm-tab-close" data-close="${id}">✕</button>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
  host.querySelectorAll(".tm-tab").forEach((el) => {
    const id = el.dataset.id;
    el.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => { if (!e.target.closest(".tm-tab-close")) activate(id); });
    el.addEventListener("dragstart", (e) => { e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move"; dragId = id; droppedOnStrip = false; });
    el.addEventListener("dragend", () => { if (dragId && !droppedOnStrip) tearOut(dragId); dragId = null; });
  });
  host.querySelectorAll(".tm-tab-close").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); closeTab(btn.dataset.close); }));
}

let dragId = null, droppedOnStrip = false;
$("tmTabstrip").addEventListener("dragover", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = "move"; });
$("tmTabstrip").addEventListener("drop", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); droppedOnStrip = true; });

function activate(id) {
  activeId = id;
  sessions.forEach((s, sid) => { s.el.style.display = sid === id ? "block" : "none"; });
  renderTabs();
  const s = sessions.get(id);
  if (s) { s.refit(); s.focus(); }
}
function newTab() {
  const s = createSession();
  s.onExit = () => closeTab(s.id);
  sessions.set(s.id, s);
  $("tmBody").appendChild(s.el);
  tabs.push(s.id);
  activate(s.id);
}
function closeTab(id) {
  const s = sessions.get(id);
  if (s) { s.dispose(); s.el.remove(); sessions.delete(id); }
  const idx = tabs.indexOf(id);
  if (idx !== -1) tabs.splice(idx, 1);
  if (activeId === id) activeId = tabs[Math.max(0, idx - 1)] ?? null;
  if (tabs.length === 0) { exitAll(); return; }
  renderTabs();
  activate(activeId);
}
function exitAll() {
  if (window.opener) window.close();
  else window.location.href = "/home";
}

function popOutOS() {
  const scr = window.screen;
  const left = Math.round(scr.availLeft ?? 0), top = Math.round(scr.availTop ?? 0);
  const w = Math.round(scr.availWidth), h = Math.round(scr.availHeight);
  return window.open(`/tools/terminal?v=${Date.now()}`, "_blank", `popup=yes,toolbar=no,menubar=no,location=no,status=no,resizable=yes,width=${w},height=${h},left=${left},top=${top}`);
}
function tearOut(id) {
  const w = popOutOS();
  if (w) closeTab(id);
  else alert("彈出視窗被瀏覽器攔截了，請允許此網站的彈出視窗後再試一次。\nPop-up was blocked — allow pop-ups for this site, then try again.");
}
$("tmNewWindowBtn").addEventListener("click", popOutOS);

function putBack() {
  const ch = new BroadcastChannel(TERM_BUS);
  ch.postMessage({ type: "new-tab" });
  setTimeout(() => { ch.close(); window.close(); }, 250);
}
$("tmPutBackBtn").addEventListener("click", putBack);
$("tmPutBackPill").addEventListener("click", putBack);

const bus = new BroadcastChannel(TERM_BUS);
bus.onmessage = (e) => { if (e.data?.type === "new-tab") newTab(); };

$("tmNewTab").addEventListener("click", newTab);
$("tmCopyBtn").addEventListener("click", () => sessions.get(activeId)?.copySelection());
$("tmPasteBtn").addEventListener("click", () => navigator.clipboard.readText().then((t) => t && sessions.get(activeId)?.sendText(t)).catch(() => {}));

const MOBILE_KEYS = {
  up: (s) => s.historyUp(), down: (s) => s.historyDown(), tab: (s) => s.sendTab(),
  ctrlc: (s) => s.sendCtrlC(), ctrlv: (s) => navigator.clipboard.readText().then((t) => t && s.sendText(t)).catch(() => {}),
  ctrll: (s) => s.sendCtrlL(), ctrld: (s) => s.sendCtrlD(),
};
$("tmMobileBar").querySelectorAll("button").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  const s = sessions.get(activeId);
  if (s) MOBILE_KEYS[btn.dataset.k]?.(s);
}));

new ResizeObserver(() => sessions.get(activeId)?.refit()).observe($("tmBody"));

newTab();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/timeline.js
// Media Timeline — Python port of components/timeline.tsx (category 4, batch 4b).
(function () {
  const main = document.getElementById('tlMain');
  const lightbox = document.getElementById('tlLightbox');
  let fullImg = null;

  const MONTHS = ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July',
                  'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'];

  function formatDate(dateStr) {
    const d = new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00');
    return MONTHS[d.getMonth()] + ' ' + d.getDate() + ', ' + d.getFullYear();
  }

  function todayStr() { return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
  function yesterdayStr() { return new Date(Date.now() - 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10); }

  function dateLabel(date) {
    if (date === todayStr()) return 'Today';
    if (date === yesterdayStr()) return 'Yesterday';
    return formatDate(date);
  }

  function load() {
    main.innerHTML = '<div class="viewer-loading">Loading…</div>';
    fetch('/api/photo/timeline')
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) { render(d.groups || []); })
      .catch(function () { main.innerHTML = '<div class="viewer-error">Failed to load</div>'; });
  }

  function render(groups) {
    if (groups.length === 0) {
      main.innerHTML = '<div class="tl-empty"><p>No media files found</p><p class="tl-empty-sub">Upload photos or videos to view them here</p></div>';
      return;
    }
    const total = groups.reduce(function (s, g) { return s + g.items.length; }, 0);
    let html = '<div class="tl-wrap"><p class="tl-total">' + total + ' media files</p>';
    groups.forEach(function (g) {
      html += '<section><h2 class="tl-date">' + dateLabel(g.date) +
        '<span class="tl-date-count">' + g.items.length + ' items</span></h2><div class="tl-grid">' +
        g.items.map(function (item) {
          return '<button type="button" class="tl-item" data-path="' + item.path + '" data-name="' + item.name +
            '" data-video="' + (item.is_video ? '1' : '0') + '" data-url="' + item.download_url + '">' +
            (item.is_video
              ? '<div class="tl-video-thumb"><span class="tl-video-icon">▶</span><span class="tl-video-ext">' + item.name.split('.').pop().toUpperCase() + '</span></div>'
              : '<img src="' + item.download_url + '" alt="' + item.name + '" loading="lazy">') +
            '<div class="tl-item-name">' + item.name + '</div></button>';
        }).join('') +
        '</div></section>';
    });
    html += '</div>';
    main.innerHTML = html;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(main.querySelectorAll('.tl-item'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () {
        if (btn.dataset.video === '1') { window.open(btn.dataset.url, '_blank'); }
        else { openLightbox(btn.dataset.url, btn.dataset.name); }
      };
    });
  }

  function openLightbox(url, name) {
    fullImg = url;
    lightbox.classList.remove('hidden');
    lightbox.innerHTML =
      '<div class="tl-lightbox-inner" id="tlLightboxInner">' +
        '<button type="button" class="viewer-close tl-lightbox-close" id="tlLightboxClose">×</button>' +
        '<p class="tl-lightbox-name">' + name + '</p>' +
        '<img src="' + url + '" alt="' + name + '" class="tl-lightbox-img">' +
      '</div>';
    document.getElementById('tlLightboxClose').onclick = closeLightbox;
    document.getElementById('tlLightboxInner').onclick = function (e) { if (e.target.id === 'tlLightboxInner') closeLightbox(); };
  }

  function closeLightbox() {
    fullImg = null;
    lightbox.classList.add('hidden');
    lightbox.innerHTML = '';
  }

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      if (fullImg) { closeLightbox(); return; }
      window.location.href = '/home';
    }
  });

  document.getElementById('tlRefreshBtn').onclick = load;
  load();
})();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/tools_remote_desktop.js
// Remote Desktop — behind /tools/remote-desktop. Talks directly to the
// user-configured agent URL, never to this NAS's own backend.
const AGENT_URL_KEY = "nas_remote_desktop_url";
const AGENT_ACCOUNT_KEY = "nas_remote_desktop_account";
const BUTTON_NAMES = ["left", "middle", "right"];

$("rdAgentUrl").value = localStorage.getItem(AGENT_URL_KEY) || "https://";
$("rdAccount").value = localStorage.getItem(AGENT_ACCOUNT_KEY) || "";

let ws = null, info = null;
function httpBase(url) { return url.replace(/\/+$/, ""); }
function wsBase(url) { return httpBase(url).replace(/^http/, "ws"); }
function send(msg) { if (ws?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) ws.send(JSON.stringify(msg)); }

function showError(msg) {
  const el = $("rdError");
  el.textContent = msg;
  el.classList.remove("hidden");
}

$("rdConnect").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const agentUrl = $("rdAgentUrl").value.trim();
  const account = $("rdAccount").value.trim();
  const password = $("rdPassword").value;
  $("rdError").classList.add("hidden");
  $("rdConnect").disabled = true;
  $("rdConnect").textContent = "Connecting…";
  try {
    const base = httpBase(agentUrl);
    const fd = new URLSearchParams();
    fd.set("account", account);
    fd.set("password", password);
    const res = await fetch(`${base}/api/login`, { method: "POST", body: fd, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" } });
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);

    localStorage.setItem(AGENT_URL_KEY, agentUrl);
    localStorage.setItem(AGENT_ACCOUNT_KEY, account);
    $("rdPassword").value = "";
    info = data;

    ws = new WebSocket(`${wsBase(agentUrl)}/ws/remote?token=${encodeURIComponent(data.token)}`);
    ws.binaryType = "arraybuffer";
    ws.onopen = () => {
      $("connectView").classList.add("hidden");
      $("sessionView").classList.remove("hidden");
      $("btnDisconnect").classList.remove("hidden");
      $("rdScale").innerHTML = info.scale_options.map((o) => `<option value="${o}"${o === info.scale ? " selected" : ""}>${Math.round(o * 100)}%</option>`).join("");
      $("rdCanvas").focus();
    };
    ws.onclose = () => disconnect();
    ws.onerror = () => toast("Connection to agent dropped", "error");
    ws.onmessage = async (evt) => {
      if (!(evt.data instanceof ArrayBuffer)) return;
      const blob = new Blob([evt.data], { type: "image/jpeg" });
      const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(blob);
      const canvas = $("rdCanvas");
      if (canvas.width !== bitmap.width || canvas.height !== bitmap.height) { canvas.width = bitmap.width; canvas.height = bitmap.height; }
      canvas.getContext("2d").drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0);
      bitmap.close();
    };
  } catch (err) {
    showError(err.message || "Failed to connect");
  }
  $("rdConnect").disabled = false;
  $("rdConnect").textContent = "Connect";
});

function disconnect() {
  ws?.close();
  ws = null; info = null;
  $("connectView").classList.remove("hidden");
  $("sessionView").classList.add("hidden");
  $("btnDisconnect").classList.add("hidden");
}
$("btnDisconnect").addEventListener("click", disconnect);

function canvasFraction(e) {
  const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  return { x: Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width)), y: Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height)) };
}
const canvas = $("rdCanvas");
canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => send({ type: "mousemove", ...canvasFraction(e) }));
canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => { canvas.focus(); send({ type: "mousedown", button: BUTTON_NAMES[e.button] || "left" }); });
canvas.addEventListener("mouseup", (e) => send({ type: "mouseup", button: BUTTON_NAMES[e.button] || "left" }));
canvas.addEventListener("wheel", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); send({ type: "wheel", deltaY: e.deltaY }); }, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); send({ type: "keydown", code: e.code }); });
canvas.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); send({ type: "keyup", code: e.code }); });
canvas.addEventListener("contextmenu", (e) => e.preventDefault());

// win+shift+S is grabbed by the controlling machine's own OS before the
// browser ever sees it, so raw key-forwarding can't reach this one.
$("rdScreenshot").addEventListener("click", () => { send({ type: "screenshot" }); toast(`Snip & Sketch triggered on ${info?.goal_desktop || "goal_desktop"}`); });
$("rdImeLeft").addEventListener("click", () => send({ type: "ime_toggle", side: "left" }));
$("rdImeRight").addEventListener("click", () => send({ type: "ime_toggle", side: "right" }));
$("rdScale").addEventListener("change", (e) => send({ type: "set_scale", value: parseFloat(e.target.value) }));

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/trash.js
(function () {
  const container = document.getElementById('trash-list-container');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('trash-count');
  const btnRefresh = document.getElementById('btn-refresh');
  const btnEmptyAll = document.getElementById('btn-empty-all');

  let items = [];
  let busyId = null;

  function formatSize(bytes) {
    if (bytes === undefined || bytes === null) return '';
    if (bytes < 1024) return bytes + ' B';
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';
    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' GB';
  }

  async function loadTrash() {
    container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <div class="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-orange-500"></div>
      </div>
    `;

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/trash');
      if (res.status === 401) {
        location.href = '/login';
        return;
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      items = data.items || [];
      countEl.innerText = items.length;
      renderList();
    } catch (e) {
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="p-8 text-center text-red-400">載入回收桶失敗</div>
      `;
    }
  }

  function renderList() {
    if (items.length === 0) {
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-slate-500 gap-2">
          <svg class="w-12 h-12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1" d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16" />
          </svg>
          <p class="text-sm">回收桶是空的</p>
        </div>
      `;
      btnEmptyAll.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }

    btnEmptyAll.style.display = 'inline-block';

    const html = `
      <ul class="divide-y divide-slate-800">
        ${items.map(item => {
          const isDir = item.type === 'folder';
          const busy = busyId === item.trashName;
          const deletedDate = item.deletedAt
            ? new Date(item.deletedAt).toLocaleString('zh-TW', { month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
            : '—';

          return `
            <li class="flex items-center gap-3 px-5 py-3 hover:bg-slate-800/60 transition-colors">
              <div class="shrink-0">
                ${isDir
                  ? `<svg class="w-8 h-8 text-amber-400/70" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20"><path d="M2 6a2 2 0 012-2h5l2 2h5a2 2 0 012 2v6a2 2 0 01-2 2H4a2 2 0 01-2-2V6z" /></svg>`
                  : `<svg class="w-8 h-8 text-slate-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z" /></svg>`
                }
              </div>

              <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <p class="text-white text-sm font-medium truncate">${item.name}</p>
                <p class="text-slate-500 text-xs truncate mt-0.5">原位置: ${item.originalPath || '根目錄'}</p>
                <p class="text-slate-600 text-xs mt-0.5">
                  刪除時間: ${deletedDate}
                  ${item.size !== undefined ? `<span class="ml-2">${formatSize(item.size)}</span>` : ''}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div class="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                <button
                  class="btn-restore text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white disabled:opacity-40 transition-colors"
                  data-trashname="${item.trashName}"
                  ${busy ? 'disabled' : ''}
                >
                  ${busy ? '處理中…' : '還原'}
                </button>
                <button
                  class="btn-delete text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-700 hover:bg-red-700 text-slate-300 hover:text-white disabled:opacity-40 transition-colors"
                  data-trashname="${item.trashName}"
                  data-name="${item.name}"
                  ${busy ? 'disabled' : ''}
                >
                  永久刪除
                </button>
              </div>
            </li>
          `;
        }).join('')}
      </ul>
    `;

    container.innerHTML = html;

    document.querySelectorAll('.btn-restore').forEach(btn => {
      btn.onclick = async (e) => {
        const trashName = e.target.dataset.trashname;
        busyId = trashName;
        renderList();
        try {
          const res = await fetch('/api/trash/restore', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ trashName })
          });
          if (res.ok) {
            await loadTrash();
          } else {
            const err = await res.json();
            alert(err.message || '還原失敗');
          }
        } catch {
          alert('還原網路請求失敗');
        } finally {
          busyId = null;
          renderList();
        }
      };
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.btn-delete').forEach(btn => {
      btn.onclick = async (e) => {
        const trashName = e.target.dataset.trashname;
        const name = e.target.dataset.name;
        if (!confirm(`確定要永久刪除「${name}」？此操作無法復原。`)) return;

        busyId = trashName;
        renderList();
        try {
          const res = await fetch(`/api/trash/item?trashName=${encodeURIComponent(trashName)}`, {
            method: 'DELETE'
          });
          if (res.ok) {
            await loadTrash();
          } else {
            const err = await res.json();
            alert(err.message || '刪除失敗');
          }
        } catch {
          alert('刪除網路請求失敗');
        } finally {
          busyId = null;
          renderList();
        }
      };
    });
  }

  btnRefresh.onclick = loadTrash;

  btnEmptyAll.onclick = async () => {
    if (items.length === 0) return;
    if (!confirm(`確定要清空回收桶內的 ${items.length} 個項目？此操作無法復原。`)) return;

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/trash/all', { method: 'DELETE' });
      if (res.ok) {
        items = [];
        countEl.innerText = '0';
        renderList();
      } else {
        const err = await res.json();
        alert(err.message || '清空失敗');
      }
    } catch {
      alert('清空網路請求失敗');
    }
  };

  loadTrash();
})();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/video_app.js
// Video folder browser — Python port of components/VideoApp.tsx (category 4,
// batch 4d). Opens static/video_player.js as the full-screen player.
(function () {
  let path = '';
  let folders = [], videos = [];

  const sidebar = document.getElementById('vdSidebar');
  const breadcrumb = document.getElementById('vdBreadcrumb');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('vdCount');
  const backBtn = document.getElementById('vdBackBtn');
  const listWrap = document.getElementById('vdListWrap');

  function esc(s) { return (s || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;'); }

  function fmtSize(b) {
    if (!b) return '';
    if (b < 1024 * 1024) return (b / 1024).toFixed(0) + ' KB';
    if (b < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return (b / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' MB';
    return (b / 1024 / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2) + ' GB';
  }

  function load(dir) {
    listWrap.innerHTML = '<div class="viewer-loading">Loading…</div>';
    fetch('/api/video/list?path=' + encodeURIComponent(dir))
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        folders = d.folders || []; videos = d.videos || [];
        renderBreadcrumb(); renderSidebar(); renderList();
        countEl.textContent = videos.length + ' videos';
        backBtn.style.display = path ? '' : 'none';
      })
      .catch(function () { folders = []; videos = []; listWrap.innerHTML = '<div class="viewer-error">Failed to load</div>'; });
  }

  function renderBreadcrumb() {
    const parts = path.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    let html = '<button type="button" class="vd-crumb" data-path="">All Videos</button>';
    const acc = [];
    parts.forEach(function (p) {
      acc.push(p);
      html += '<span class="vd-crumb-sep">/</span><button type="button" class="vd-crumb" data-path="' + acc.join('/') + '">' + esc(p) + '</button>';
    });
    breadcrumb.innerHTML = html;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(breadcrumb.querySelectorAll('.vd-crumb'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { path = btn.dataset.path; load(path); };
    });
  }

  function renderSidebar() {
    sidebar.innerHTML =
      (path ? '<button type="button" class="vd-sidebar-up" id="vdUpBtn">↑ 上一層</button>' : '') +
      '<p class="vd-sidebar-label">Folders</p>' +
      (folders.length
        ? folders.map(function (f) { return '<button type="button" class="vd-sidebar-folder" data-name="' + esc(f.name) + '">📁 ' + esc(f.name) + '</button>'; }).join('')
        : (path ? '' : '<p class="vd-sidebar-empty">沒有子資料夾</p>'));
    if (path) document.getElementById('vdUpBtn').onclick = goBack;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(sidebar.querySelectorAll('.vd-sidebar-folder'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { path = path ? path + '/' + btn.dataset.name : btn.dataset.name; load(path); };
    });
  }

  function goBack() {
    const idx = path.lastIndexOf('/');
    path = idx === -1 ? '' : path.slice(0, idx);
    load(path);
  }

  function renderList() {
    if (videos.length === 0) {
      listWrap.innerHTML = '<div class="vd-empty">No videos in this folder</div>';
      return;
    }
    listWrap.innerHTML = '<ul class="vd-list">' + videos.map(function (v, i) {
      return '<li><button type="button" class="vd-row" data-idx="' + i + '">' +
        '<span class="vd-row-icon">▶</span>' +
        '<span class="vd-row-info"><p class="vd-row-name">' + esc(v.name) + '</p>' +
        '<p class="vd-row-sub">' + esc(v.name.split('.').pop().toUpperCase()) + (v.size ? ' · ' + fmtSize(v.size) : '') + '</p></span>' +
        '</button></li>';
    }).join('') + '</ul>';
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(listWrap.querySelectorAll('.vd-row'), function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () { openPlayer(parseInt(btn.dataset.idx, 10)); };
    });
  }

  let playerHandle = null;

  function openPlayer(idx) {
    const v = videos[idx];
    if (playerHandle) playerHandle.destroy();
    playerHandle = window.VideoPlayer.open({
      src: v.download_url, name: v.name, filePath: v.path,
      onClose: function () { playerHandle = null; },
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && !playerHandle) window.location.href = '/home';
  });

  backBtn.onclick = goBack;
  load('');
})();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/video_player.js
// Full-screen video player — Python port of viewers/VideoPlayer.tsx (category
// 4, batch 4d). Exposes window.VideoPlayer.open({src, name, filePath, onClose})
// mounting into #vdPlayerRoot. See video_app.py's docstring for the one
// known pre-existing gap (AI auto-subtitle backend was never implemented).
(function () {
  const SPEEDS = [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 3];
  const SAVE_INTERVAL_S = 5;
  const RESUME_THRESHOLD_S = 10;

  function formatTime(s) {
    const h = Math.floor(s / 3600), m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60), sec = Math.floor(s % 60);
    if (h > 0) return h + ':' + String(m).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(sec).padStart(2, '0');
    return m + ':' + String(sec).padStart(2, '0');
  }

  function srtToVtt(srt) {
    const text = srt.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').replace(/\r/g, '\n');
    const blocks = text.split(/\n{2,}/);
    const vttBlocks = blocks.map(function (block) {
      const lines = block.trim().split('\n');
      if (/^\d+$/.test(lines[0])) lines.shift();
      return lines.map(function (l) { return l.replace(/(\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}),(\d{3})/g, '$1.$2'); }).join('\n');
    }).filter(function (b) { return b.indexOf('-->') !== -1; });
    return 'WEBVTT\n\n' + vttBlocks.join('\n\n');
  }

  function esc(s) { return (s || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;'); }

  // Build a sibling download URL (same token, different `path` query param) —
  // used for subtitle auto-detect (basename + .vtt/.srt) without needing a
  // new server endpoint, mirroring the original's downloadUrl(base + ext).
  function siblingUrl(srcUrl, newPath) {
    const u = new URL(srcUrl, window.location.origin);
    const token = u.searchParams.get('token');
    u.searchParams.set('path', newPath);
    if (token) u.searchParams.set('token', token);
    return u.toString();
  }

  function open(opts) {
    const root = document.getElementById('vdPlayerRoot');
    const src = opts.src, name = opts.name, filePath = opts.filePath || null;
    const onCloseCallback = opts.onClose || function () {};
    function onClose() { destroy(); onCloseCallback(); }

    let hint = null, hintTimer = null;
    let resumeAt = null;
    let speed = 1, showSpeedMenu = false, showInfo = false;
    let subtitleUrl = null, subtitleBlobUrl = null, subtitleOn = true, subtitleStatus = 'idle', subtitleName = '', showSubMenu = false;
    let aiSubLang = 'zh-TW', aiSubStatus = 'idle', aiSubProgress = 0, aiPollTimer = null;
    let introEnd = null, introStatus = 'idle', showIntroBtn = false, introAccel = false;
    let metaHandle = null;
    let lastSaved = 0;

    const progressKey = filePath ? 'nas_vp_' + filePath : null;
    const introKey = filePath ? 'nas_intro_' + filePath : null;

    root.classList.remove('hidden');
    root.innerHTML =
      '<div class="vp-overlay">' +
        '<div class="vp-header">' +
          '<span class="vp-name">' + esc(name) + '</span>' +
          '<div class="vp-header-controls" id="vpControls"></div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="vp-body">' +
          '<div class="vp-video-wrap" id="vpVideoWrap">' +
            '<video id="vpVideo" class="vp-video" controls controlslist="nodownload noplaybackrate noremoteplayback" disablepictureinpicture autoplay></video>' +
            '<div id="vpHint" class="vp-hint hidden"></div>' +
            '<div id="vpIntroBtns" class="vp-intro-btns hidden"></div>' +
            '<div id="vpResume" class="vp-resume hidden"></div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div id="vpMetaContainer"></div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    const video = document.getElementById('vpVideo');
    const controlsEl = document.getElementById('vpControls');
    const hintEl = document.getElementById('vpHint');
    const introBtnsEl = document.getElementById('vpIntroBtns');
    const resumeEl = document.getElementById('vpResume');
    const videoWrap = document.getElementById('vpVideoWrap');
    video.src = src;

    function showHint(text) {
      if (hintTimer) clearTimeout(hintTimer);
      hint = text;
      hintEl.textContent = text;
      hintEl.classList.remove('hidden');
      hintTimer = setTimeout(function () { hintEl.classList.add('hidden'); hint = null; }, 900);
    }

    function applySpeed(s) {
      video.playbackRate = s;
      speed = s;
      showHint(s + '×');
      showSpeedMenu = false;
      renderControls();
    }

    function loadSubtitleContent(content, label) {
      const vtt = content.indexOf('WEBVTT') !== -1 ? content : srtToVtt(content);
      if (subtitleBlobUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(subtitleBlobUrl);
      const blob = new Blob([vtt], { type: 'text/vtt' });
      subtitleBlobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      subtitleUrl = subtitleBlobUrl;
      subtitleName = label;
      subtitleStatus = 'found';
      subtitleOn = true;
      mountTrack();
      renderControls();
    }

    function mountTrack() {
      const old = video.querySelector('track');
      if (old) old.remove();
      if (!subtitleUrl) return;
      const track = document.createElement('track');
      track.src = subtitleUrl; track.kind = 'subtitles'; track.label = '字幕'; track.default = true;
      video.appendChild(track);
      track.addEventListener('load', function () { if (track.track) track.track.mode = subtitleOn ? 'showing' : 'hidden'; });
    }

    // ── subtitle auto-detect ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (filePath) {
      subtitleStatus = 'loading';
      const base = filePath.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '');
      (function detect(exts) {
        if (!exts.length) { subtitleStatus = 'notfound'; renderControls(); return; }
        const ext = exts[0];
        fetch(siblingUrl(src, base + ext))
          .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.text(); })
          .then(function (text) { loadSubtitleContent(text, base.split('/').pop() + ext); })
          .catch(function () { detect(exts.slice(1)); });
      })(['.vtt', '.srt']);
    }

    // ── intro detection (canvas frame-diff) ─────────────────────────────
    function seekTo(vid, t) {
      return new Promise(function (resolve) {
        vid.addEventListener('seeked', function onSeeked() { vid.removeEventListener('seeked', onSeeked); resolve(); }, { once: true });
        vid.currentTime = t;
        setTimeout(resolve, 2500);
      });
    }

    function analyzeIntro() {
      const dur = video.duration;
      if (!dur || dur < 30) { introStatus = 'notfound'; renderControls(); return; }

      if (introKey) {
        try {
          const c = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(introKey) || 'null');
          if (c && 'end' in c) {
            if (c.end === null) { introStatus = 'notfound'; renderControls(); return; }
            introEnd = c.end; introStatus = 'found'; renderControls(); return;
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      introStatus = 'loading'; renderControls();

      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = 96; canvas.height = 54;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      if (!ctx) { introStatus = 'notfound'; renderControls(); return; }

      const vid = document.createElement('video');
      vid.src = src; vid.muted = true; vid.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'; vid.preload = 'metadata';
      vid.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;width:1px;height:1px;top:-9999px';
      document.body.appendChild(vid);

      new Promise(function (res, rej) {
        vid.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', function () { res(); }, { once: true });
        vid.addEventListener('error', function () { rej(new Error('load error')); }, { once: true });
        setTimeout(function () { rej(new Error('timeout')); }, 15000);
      }).then(function () {
        const maxScan = Math.min(dur, 300);
        const step = 5;
        const N = Math.floor(maxScan / step);
        const diffs = [];
        let prev = null;
        let i = 0;

        function nextFrame() {
          if (i > N) return Promise.resolve();
          return seekTo(vid, i * step).then(function () {
            ctx.drawImage(vid, 0, 0, 96, 54);
            const data = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, 96, 54).data;
            if (prev) {
              let d = 0;
              for (let j = 0; j < data.length; j += 4) {
                d += Math.abs(data[j] - prev[j]) + Math.abs(data[j + 1] - prev[j + 1]) + Math.abs(data[j + 2] - prev[j + 2]);
              }
              diffs.push(d / (96 * 54 * 3));
            } else { diffs.push(0); }
            prev = new Uint8ClampedArray(data);
            i += 1;
            return nextFrame();
          });
        }

        return nextFrame().then(function () {
          const W = 3;
          const sm = diffs.map(function (_, idx) {
            const sl = diffs.slice(Math.max(0, idx - W), idx + W + 1);
            return sl.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0) / sl.length;
          });
          const mean = sm.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0) / sm.length;
          const std = Math.sqrt(sm.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + Math.pow(b - mean, 2); }, 0) / sm.length);
          const thr = mean + 0.4 * std;
          const cap = Math.floor(sm.length * 0.85);
          let lastHigh = -1;
          for (let k = 0; k < cap; k++) if (sm[k] >= thr) lastHigh = k;
          if (lastHigh < 2) throw new Error('no peak');
          const end = Math.min((lastHigh + 2) * step, maxScan);
          if (end < 15 || end > 260) throw new Error('range invalid');
          introEnd = end;
          introStatus = 'found';
          if (introKey) localStorage.setItem(introKey, JSON.stringify({ end: end }));
        });
      }).catch(function () {
        introStatus = 'notfound';
        if (introKey) localStorage.setItem(introKey, JSON.stringify({ end: null }));
      }).finally(function () {
        document.body.removeChild(vid);
        renderControls(); renderIntroBtns();
      });
    }

    function skipIntro() {
      if (introEnd === null) return;
      video.currentTime = introEnd;
      if (introAccel) { video.playbackRate = speed; introAccel = false; }
      showIntroBtn = false;
      showHint('⏭ 跳過片頭');
      renderIntroBtns();
    }

    function startIntroAccel() {
      video.playbackRate = 3;
      introAccel = true;
      showHint('⏩ 片頭 3×');
      renderIntroBtns();
    }

    function resetIntro() {
      introEnd = null; introStatus = 'idle'; showIntroBtn = false; introAccel = false;
      if (introKey) localStorage.removeItem(introKey);
      renderControls(); renderIntroBtns();
    }

    // ── progress / resume ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function saveProgress() {
      if (!progressKey || video.readyState < 1 || video.currentTime < 1) return;
      localStorage.setItem(progressKey, JSON.stringify({ t: video.currentTime }));
    }

    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', function () {
      if (progressKey) {
        try {
          const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(progressKey) || 'null');
          if (saved && saved.t && saved.t > RESUME_THRESHOLD_S) { resumeAt = saved.t; renderResume(); }
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      if (introKey) {
        try {
          const c = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(introKey) || 'null');
          if (c && c.end !== null && c.end !== undefined) { introEnd = c.end; introStatus = 'found'; renderControls(); }
        } catch (e) {}
      }
    });

    video.addEventListener('timeupdate', function () {
      if (introEnd !== null) {
        const shouldShow = video.currentTime > 0 && video.currentTime < introEnd;
        if (shouldShow !== showIntroBtn) { showIntroBtn = shouldShow; renderIntroBtns(); }
        if (introAccel && video.currentTime >= introEnd) {
          video.playbackRate = speed; introAccel = false; showIntroBtn = false;
          showHint('✓ 片頭結束'); renderIntroBtns();
        }
      }
      if (progressKey && Math.abs(video.currentTime - lastSaved) >= SAVE_INTERVAL_S) {
        lastSaved = video.currentTime;
        localStorage.setItem(progressKey, JSON.stringify({ t: video.currentTime }));
      }
    });

    video.addEventListener('ended', function () { if (progressKey) localStorage.removeItem(progressKey); });

    function renderResume() {
      if (resumeAt === null) { resumeEl.classList.add('hidden'); resumeEl.innerHTML = ''; return; }
      resumeEl.classList.remove('hidden');
      resumeEl.innerHTML =
        '<span class="vp-resume-text">上次播到 <strong>' + formatTime(resumeAt) + '</strong></span>' +
        '<button type="button" class="vp-resume-continue" id="vpResumeContinue">繼續</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="vp-resume-restart" id="vpResumeRestart">從頭</button>';
      document.getElementById('vpResumeContinue').onclick = function () {
        video.currentTime = resumeAt; video.play().catch(function () {}); resumeAt = null; renderResume();
      };
      document.getElementById('vpResumeRestart').onclick = function () { resumeAt = null; renderResume(); };
    }

    function renderIntroBtns() {
      if (!showIntroBtn || introEnd === null) { introBtnsEl.classList.add('hidden'); introBtnsEl.innerHTML = ''; return; }
      introBtnsEl.classList.remove('hidden');
      introBtnsEl.innerHTML =
        '<button type="button" class="vp-intro-skip" id="vpSkipIntroBtn">⏭ 跳過片頭</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="vp-intro-accel' + (introAccel ? ' active' : '') + '" id="vpAccelBtn">' +
          (introAccel ? '3× 加速中 — 點擊跳過' : '⏩ 3× 加速片頭') + '</button>';
      document.getElementById('vpSkipIntroBtn').onclick = skipIntro;
      document.getElementById('vpAccelBtn').onclick = introAccel ? skipIntro : startIntroAccel;
    }

    // ── AI auto-subtitle (known pre-existing gap: backend never implemented) ──
    function startAiSubtitle() {
      if (!filePath || aiSubStatus === 'running') return;
      aiSubStatus = 'running'; aiSubProgress = 5; renderControls();
      fetch('/api/video/subtitle', {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF': '1' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ path: filePath, lang: aiSubLang }),
      }).then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.json(); })
        .then(function (d) {
          if (aiPollTimer) clearInterval(aiPollTimer);
          aiPollTimer = setInterval(function () {
            fetch('/api/video/subtitle/' + d.jobId).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (job) {
              aiSubProgress = job.progress || 0;
              if (job.status === 'done') {
                clearInterval(aiPollTimer);
                aiSubStatus = 'done';
                const label = aiSubLang === 'zh-TW' ? '繁中' : aiSubLang === 'zh-CN' ? '簡中' : 'English';
                loadSubtitleContent(job.srt, 'AI字幕 (' + label + ')');
              } else if (job.status === 'error') { clearInterval(aiPollTimer); aiSubStatus = 'error'; renderControls(); }
              else { renderControls(); }
            }).catch(function () { clearInterval(aiPollTimer); aiSubStatus = 'error'; renderControls(); });
          }, 2000);
        }).catch(function () { aiSubStatus = 'error'; renderControls(); });
    }

    // ── header controls ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function renderControls() {
      let html = '';
      if (filePath) {
        html += '<button type="button" class="vp-ctl-btn' + (showInfo ? ' active' : '') + '" id="vpInfoBtn" title="媒體資訊 (I)">ℹ 資訊</button>';
      }
      html += '<div class="vp-menu-wrap">' +
        '<button type="button" class="vp-ctl-btn' + (subtitleUrl && subtitleOn ? ' active' : '') + '" id="vpSubBtn" title="字幕 (C)">CC 字幕' +
        (subtitleStatus === 'loading' ? '<span class="vp-dot vp-dot-yellow"></span>' : '') +
        (subtitleUrl && subtitleOn ? '<span class="vp-dot vp-dot-white"></span>' : '') + '</button>';
      if (showSubMenu) html += renderSubMenu();
      html += '</div>';

      if (filePath) {
        html += '<div class="vp-intro-detect-wrap">' +
          '<button type="button" class="vp-intro-detect-btn' + (introStatus === 'found' ? ' found' : '') + '" id="vpIntroDetectBtn"' +
          (introStatus === 'loading' ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' +
          (introStatus === 'loading' ? '偵測中…' : introStatus === 'found' ? formatTime(introEnd) : introStatus === 'notfound' ? '未偵測到' : '偵測片頭') +
          '</button>' +
          (introStatus === 'found' ? '<button type="button" class="vp-intro-reset-btn" id="vpIntroResetBtn">×</button>' : '') +
        '</div>';
      }

      html += '<div class="vp-menu-wrap">' +
        '<button type="button" class="vp-ctl-btn' + (speed !== 1 ? ' active-orange' : '') + '" id="vpSpeedBtn" title="播放速度 ([ / ])">' + speed + '×</button>';
      if (showSpeedMenu) html += renderSpeedMenu();
      html += '</div>';

      html += '<span class="vp-key-hint">← → ±5s · ↑↓ 音量 · M 靜音 · 空格 播放</span>';
      html += '<button type="button" class="viewer-close" id="vpCloseBtn">×</button>';

      controlsEl.innerHTML = html;

      const infoBtn = document.getElementById('vpInfoBtn');
      if (infoBtn) infoBtn.onclick = function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); showInfo = !showInfo; showSpeedMenu = false; showSubMenu = false; renderControls(); renderMeta(); };
      document.getElementById('vpSubBtn').onclick = function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); showSubMenu = !showSubMenu; showSpeedMenu = false; renderControls(); };
      document.getElementById('vpSpeedBtn').onclick = function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); showSpeedMenu = !showSpeedMenu; showSubMenu = false; renderControls(); };
      document.getElementById('vpCloseBtn').onclick = onClose;
      const introDetectBtn = document.getElementById('vpIntroDetectBtn');
      if (introDetectBtn) introDetectBtn.onclick = function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); if (introStatus !== 'found') analyzeIntro(); };
      const introResetBtn = document.getElementById('vpIntroResetBtn');
      if (introResetBtn) introResetBtn.onclick = function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); resetIntro(); };

      if (showSubMenu) wireSubMenu();
      if (showSpeedMenu) wireSpeedMenu();
    }

    function renderSubMenu() {
      let html = '<div class="vp-menu" id="vpSubMenu">' +
        '<p class="vp-menu-label">字幕設定</p>' +
        '<div class="vp-sub-status">' +
          (subtitleStatus === 'loading' ? '搜尋字幕中…' : subtitleStatus === 'found' ? '<span class="vp-ok">✓ ' + esc(subtitleName) + '</span>' : subtitleStatus === 'notfound' ? '未找到同名字幕檔' : '等待中') +
        '</div>';
      if (subtitleUrl) {
        html += '<div class="vp-toggle-row"><span>顯示字幕</span><button type="button" class="vp-toggle' + (subtitleOn ? ' on' : '') + '" id="vpSubToggle"></button></div>';
      }
      html += '<button type="button" class="vp-menu-btn" id="vpSubLocalBtn">載入本地字幕 (.srt / .vtt)</button>' +
        '<input type="file" id="vpSubFileInput" accept=".srt,.vtt" class="hidden">';
      if (filePath) {
        html += '<div class="vp-ai-sub">' +
          '<p class="vp-menu-label">AI 自動字幕</p>' +
          '<div class="vp-lang-tabs">' +
            ['zh-TW:繁中', 'zh-CN:簡中', 'en:English'].map(function (pair) {
              const parts = pair.split(':');
              return '<button type="button" class="vp-lang-tab' + (aiSubLang === parts[0] ? ' active' : '') + '" data-lang="' + parts[0] + '">' + parts[1] + '</button>';
            }).join('') +
          '</div>' +
          (aiSubStatus === 'running' ? '<div class="vp-ai-progress"><div class="vp-ai-progress-row"><span>Whisper 辨識中...</span><span>' + aiSubProgress + '%</span></div><div class="vp-ai-bar"><div class="vp-ai-bar-fill" style="width:' + aiSubProgress + '%"></div></div></div>' : '') +
          (aiSubStatus === 'error' ? '<p class="vp-ai-error">生成失敗，請確認已安裝 Whisper</p>' : '') +
          '<button type="button" class="vp-ai-btn" id="vpAiSubBtn"' + (aiSubStatus === 'running' ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' +
            (aiSubStatus === 'running' ? '辨識中 ' + aiSubProgress + '%' : '🤖 AI 自動生成字幕') + '</button>' +
          '<p class="vp-ai-hint">使用 Whisper 語音辨識，首次執行需下載模型</p>' +
        '</div>';
      }
      html += '<p class="vp-menu-footer">支援 SubRip (.srt) 及 WebVTT (.vtt)。自動偵測同名字幕檔，或按 C 鍵快速切換。</p></div>';
      return html;
    }

    function wireSubMenu() {
      const menu = document.getElementById('vpSubMenu');
      menu.onclick = function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); };
      const toggle = document.getElementById('vpSubToggle');
      if (toggle) toggle.onclick = function () { subtitleOn = !subtitleOn; const t = video.querySelector('track'); if (t && t.track) t.track.mode = subtitleOn ? 'showing' : 'hidden'; renderControls(); };
      document.getElementById('vpSubLocalBtn').onclick = function () { document.getElementById('vpSubFileInput').click(); };
      document.getElementById('vpSubFileInput').onchange = function (e) {
        const f = e.target.files[0]; if (!f) return;
        f.text().then(function (text) { loadSubtitleContent(text, f.name); });
        e.target.value = '';
      };
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(menu.querySelectorAll('.vp-lang-tab'), function (btn) {
        btn.onclick = function () { aiSubLang = btn.dataset.lang; renderControls(); };
      });
      const aiBtn = document.getElementById('vpAiSubBtn');
      if (aiBtn) aiBtn.onclick = startAiSubtitle;
    }

    function renderSpeedMenu() {
      let html = '<div class="vp-menu vp-speed-menu" id="vpSpeedMenu"><p class="vp-menu-label">播放速度</p>';
      SPEEDS.forEach(function (s) {
        html += '<button type="button" class="vp-speed-opt' + (speed === s ? ' active' : '') + '" data-speed="' + s + '">' + (s === 1 ? '1× 正常' : s + '×') + '</button>';
      });
      html += '<p class="vp-menu-footer">[ 減速 · ] 加速</p></div>';
      return html;
    }

    function wireSpeedMenu() {
      const menu = document.getElementById('vpSpeedMenu');
      menu.onclick = function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); };
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(menu.querySelectorAll('.vp-speed-opt'), function (btn) {
        btn.onclick = function () { applySpeed(parseFloat(btn.dataset.speed)); };
      });
    }

    function renderMeta() {
      const container = document.getElementById('vpMetaContainer');
      if (showInfo && filePath) {
        container.classList.add('vp-meta-visible');
        metaHandle = window.MetaPanel.mount(container, filePath, function () { showInfo = false; renderControls(); renderMeta(); });
      } else {
        container.classList.remove('vp-meta-visible');
        if (metaHandle) { metaHandle.destroy(); metaHandle = null; }
        container.innerHTML = '';
      }
    }

    // ── keyboard shortcuts ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    function onKeydown(e) {
      switch (e.key) {
        case 'Escape': onClose(); break;
        case 'ArrowRight': e.preventDefault(); video.currentTime = Math.min(video.duration || 0, video.currentTime + 5); showHint('▶▶ +5 秒'); break;
        case 'l': case 'L': e.preventDefault(); video.currentTime = Math.min(video.duration || 0, video.currentTime + 10); showHint('▶▶ +10 秒'); break;
        case '.': e.preventDefault(); video.currentTime = Math.min(video.duration || 0, video.currentTime + 1 / 30); break;
        case 'ArrowLeft': e.preventDefault(); video.currentTime = Math.max(0, video.currentTime - 5); showHint('◀◀ -5 秒'); break;
        case 'j': case 'J': e.preventDefault(); video.currentTime = Math.max(0, video.currentTime - 10); showHint('◀◀ -10 秒'); break;
        case ',': e.preventDefault(); video.currentTime = Math.max(0, video.currentTime - 1 / 30); break;
        case 'ArrowUp': e.preventDefault(); video.volume = Math.min(1, Math.round((video.volume + 0.05) * 100) / 100); showHint('🔊 ' + Math.round(video.volume * 100) + '%'); break;
        case 'ArrowDown': e.preventDefault(); video.volume = Math.max(0, Math.round((video.volume - 0.05) * 100) / 100); showHint('🔉 ' + Math.round(video.volume * 100) + '%'); break;
        case 'm': case 'M': video.muted = !video.muted; showHint(video.muted ? '🔇 靜音' : '🔊 取消靜音'); break;
        case 'f': case 'F':
          if (!document.fullscreenElement) { video.requestFullscreen(); showHint('全螢幕'); }
          else { document.exitFullscreen(); showHint('退出全螢幕'); }
          break;
        case ' ':
          e.preventDefault();
          if (e.repeat) break;
          if (video.paused) { video.play().catch(function () {}); showHint('▶ 播放'); }
          else { video.pause(); showHint('⏸ 暫停'); }
          break;
        case ']': { e.preventDefault(); const idx = SPEEDS.indexOf(speed); applySpeed(SPEEDS[Math.min(idx + 1, SPEEDS.length - 1)]); break; }
        case '[': { e.preventDefault(); const idx = SPEEDS.indexOf(speed); applySpeed(SPEEDS[Math.max(idx - 1, 0)]); break; }
        case 'c': case 'C':
          if (subtitleUrl) { subtitleOn = !subtitleOn; const t = video.querySelector('track'); if (t && t.track) t.track.mode = subtitleOn ? 'showing' : 'hidden'; showHint(subtitleOn ? '字幕 開' : '字幕 關'); renderControls(); }
          break;
        case 'i': case 'I':
          if (filePath) { showInfo = !showInfo; renderControls(); renderMeta(); }
          break;
      }
    }

    function closeMenus() { if (showSpeedMenu || showSubMenu) { showSpeedMenu = false; showSubMenu = false; renderControls(); } }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown);
    document.addEventListener('click', closeMenus);
    videoWrap.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === videoWrap) onClose(); });

    function destroy() {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown);
      document.removeEventListener('click', closeMenus);
      if (hintTimer) clearTimeout(hintTimer);
      if (aiPollTimer) clearInterval(aiPollTimer);
      if (subtitleBlobUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(subtitleBlobUrl);
      saveProgress();
      root.classList.add('hidden');
      root.innerHTML = '';
    }

    renderControls();
    return { destroy: destroy };
  }

  window.VideoPlayer = { open: open };
})();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/viewers.js
// Inline file viewers (PDF / plain text) — see viewers.py docstring for scope.
// Exposes window.VaultixViewers.{openPdf,openText}, called from files.html.
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('viewerModalRoot');
  let keyHandler = null;

  function closeModal() {
    root.classList.add('hidden');
    root.innerHTML = '';
    if (keyHandler) { document.removeEventListener('keydown', keyHandler); keyHandler = null; }
  }

  function openPdf(src, name) {
    closeModal();
    root.classList.remove('hidden');
    root.innerHTML =
      '<div class="viewer-overlay">' +
        '<div class="viewer-toolbar">' +
          '<span class="viewer-name">📄 ' + name + '</span>' +
          '<div class="viewer-actions">' +
            '<a href="' + src + '" download="' + name + '" class="btn-small">下載</a>' +
            '<button class="viewer-close" id="viewerCloseBtn">×</button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="viewer-body" id="viewerPdfBody"><div class="viewer-loading">Loading PDF…</div></div>' +
      '</div>';

    document.getElementById('viewerCloseBtn').onclick = closeModal;
    keyHandler = function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal(); };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', keyHandler);

    fetch(src)
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status); return r.blob(); })
      .then(function (blob) {
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([blob], { type: 'application/pdf' }));
        document.getElementById('viewerPdfBody').innerHTML =
          '<iframe src="' + url + '#toolbar=1&navpanes=0" class="viewer-iframe" title="' + name + '"></iframe>';
      })
      .catch(function (e) {
        document.getElementById('viewerPdfBody').innerHTML =
          '<div class="viewer-error">Cannot load PDF: ' + e.message + '<br>' +
          '<a href="' + src + '" download="' + name + '">Download instead</a></div>';
      });
  }

  function openText(path, name) {
    closeModal();
    root.classList.remove('hidden');
    let original = '';
    let dirty = false;

    root.innerHTML =
      '<div class="viewer-overlay viewer-text-overlay">' +
        '<div class="viewer-toolbar">' +
          '<span class="viewer-name">📝 ' + name +
            ' <span id="viewerDirtyDot" class="viewer-dirty hidden">● 未儲存</span></span>' +
          '<div class="viewer-actions">' +
            '<button id="viewerSaveBtn" class="btn-small" disabled>Ctrl+S 儲存</button>' +
            '<button class="viewer-close" id="viewerCloseBtn">×</button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="viewer-body">' +
          '<div class="viewer-loading" id="viewerTextLoading">Loading…</div>' +
          '<textarea id="viewerTextArea" class="viewer-textarea hidden" spellcheck="false"></textarea>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    const ta = document.getElementById('viewerTextArea');
    const saveBtn = document.getElementById('viewerSaveBtn');
    const dot = document.getElementById('viewerDirtyDot');

    function markDirty() {
      dirty = ta.value !== original;
      saveBtn.disabled = !dirty;
      dot.classList.toggle('hidden', !dirty);
    }

    function doClose() {
      if (dirty && !confirm('有未儲存的變更，確定要關閉？')) return;
      closeModal();
    }

    function doSave() {
      if (saveBtn.disabled) return;
      saveBtn.disabled = true;
      saveBtn.textContent = '儲存中…';
      fetch('/api/viewer/text?path=' + encodeURIComponent(path), {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8', 'X-CSRF': '1' },
        body: ta.value,
      })
        .then(function (r) {
          if (!r.ok) return r.json().catch(function () { return {}; }).then(function (d) { throw new Error(d.error || '儲存失敗'); });
          original = ta.value;
          saveBtn.textContent = 'Ctrl+S 儲存';
          markDirty();
        })
        .catch(function (e) {
          alert(e.message);
          saveBtn.textContent = 'Ctrl+S 儲存';
          markDirty();
        });
    }

    document.getElementById('viewerCloseBtn').onclick = doClose;
    saveBtn.onclick = doSave;
    keyHandler = function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && !dirty) closeModal();
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 's') { e.preventDefault(); doSave(); }
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', keyHandler);

    fetch('/api/viewer/text?path=' + encodeURIComponent(path))
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status); return r.text(); })
      .then(function (text) {
        original = text;
        ta.value = text;
        document.getElementById('viewerTextLoading').classList.add('hidden');
        ta.classList.remove('hidden');
        ta.addEventListener('input', markDirty);
        ta.focus();
      })
      .catch(function (e) {
        document.getElementById('viewerTextLoading').textContent = '無法載入檔案: ' + e.message;
      });
  }

  window.VaultixViewers = { openPdf: openPdf, openText: openText };
})();

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/frontend-py/static/webauthn_native.js
// Shared WebAuthn ceremony helper — native navigator.credentials.create()/get(),
// no client-side library (project policy since category 5's mammoth/openpyxl
// decision: no client-side JS libraries for anything server-side Python can do
// instead, and this needs zero server involvement per call). Mirrors the JSON
// shapes @simplewebauthn/browser's startRegistration()/startAuthentication()
// produce — the same WebAuthn-spec "PublicKeyCredential to JSON" conversion
// that py_webauthn (used server-side) parses, so the wire format matches
// without either side needing to know a library was swapped out.
const WebAuthnNative = (() => {
  function b64urlToBuf(s) {
    const pad = s.length % 4 ? "=".repeat(4 - (s.length % 4)) : "";
    const bin = atob((s + pad).replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/"));
    const buf = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) buf[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
    return buf.buffer;
  }
  function bufToB64url(buf) {
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(buf);
    let bin = "";
    for (const b of bytes) bin += String.fromCharCode(b);
    return btoa(bin).replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_").replace(/=+$/, "");
  }

  function supported() {
    return !!(window.PublicKeyCredential && navigator.credentials);
  }

  async function startRegistration(optionsJSON) {
    const options = { ...optionsJSON };
    options.challenge = b64urlToBuf(optionsJSON.challenge);
    options.user = { ...optionsJSON.user, id: b64urlToBuf(optionsJSON.user.id) };
    if (optionsJSON.excludeCredentials) {
      options.excludeCredentials = optionsJSON.excludeCredentials.map((c) => ({ ...c, id: b64urlToBuf(c.id) }));
    }
    const cred = await navigator.credentials.create({ publicKey: options });
    if (!cred) throw new Error("No credential returned");
    return {
      id: cred.id,
      rawId: bufToB64url(cred.rawId),
      type: cred.type,
      response: {
        clientDataJSON: bufToB64url(cred.response.clientDataJSON),
        attestationObject: bufToB64url(cred.response.attestationObject),
        transports: cred.response.getTransports ? cred.response.getTransports() : [],
      },
      clientExtensionResults: cred.getClientExtensionResults(),
      authenticatorAttachment: cred.authenticatorAttachment || undefined,
    };
  }

  async function startAuthentication(optionsJSON) {
    const options = { ...optionsJSON };
    options.challenge = b64urlToBuf(optionsJSON.challenge);
    if (optionsJSON.allowCredentials) {
      options.allowCredentials = optionsJSON.allowCredentials.map((c) => ({ ...c, id: b64urlToBuf(c.id) }));
    }
    const cred = await navigator.credentials.get({ publicKey: options });
    if (!cred) throw new Error("No credential returned");
    return {
      id: cred.id,
      rawId: bufToB64url(cred.rawId),
      type: cred.type,
      response: {
        clientDataJSON: bufToB64url(cred.response.clientDataJSON),
        authenticatorData: bufToB64url(cred.response.authenticatorData),
        signature: bufToB64url(cred.response.signature),
        userHandle: cred.response.userHandle ? bufToB64url(cred.response.userHandle) : undefined,
      },
      clientExtensionResults: cred.getClientExtensionResults(),
    };
  }

  return { supported, startRegistration, startAuthentication };
})();

async function reqJSON(url, opts) {
  const r = await fetch(url, { headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" }, ...opts });
  const data = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${r.status}`);
  return data;
}
const getJSON = (url) => reqJSON(url);
const postJSON = (url, body) => reqJSON(url, {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF": "1" },
  body: JSON.stringify(body ?? {}),
});

function toast(msg, kind = "info") {
  const host = $("toastHost");
  if (!host) return;
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = `toast toast-${kind}`;
  el.textContent = msg;
  host.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(() => el.classList.add("toast-out"), 2200);
  setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 2600);
}

async function copyText(text, label) {
  try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); toast(`${label} 已複製`); }
  catch { toast("複製失敗", "error"); }
}

// ── Status dropdown (ufwWidget) ─────────────────────────────
const DOT_CLASS = { active: "dot-active", inactive: "dot-inactive", error: "dot-error", loading: "dot-loading" };
function setDot(key, status, text) {
  const dot = $(`dot-${key}`), label = $(`text-${key}`);
  if (!dot) return;
  dot.className = `dot ${DOT_CLASS[status] || "dot-error"}`;
  if (label) label.textContent = text;
}
function recomputeOverall() {
  const dots = document.querySelectorAll("#statusDropdown .dot");
  const cls = Array.from(dots).map((d) => d.className);
  const overall = $("dotOverall");
  if (!overall) return;
  if (cls.some((c) => c.includes("dot-loading"))) overall.className = "dot dot-loading";
  else if (cls.every((c) => c.includes("dot-active"))) overall.className = "dot dot-active";
  else if (cls.some((c) => c.includes("dot-error"))) overall.className = "dot dot-error";
  else overall.className = "dot dot-inactive";
}
async function pollStatus() {
  const isAdmin = document.querySelector('[data-key="security"]') !== null;
  try {
    const d = await getJSON("/api/widgets/status");
    setDot("ufw", d.ufw.active ? "active" : "inactive", d.ufw.detail);
    if (isAdmin && d.security) {
      setDot("security", d.security.fail > 0 ? "error" : "active", d.security.detail);
      setDot("fail2ban", d.fail2ban.ok ? "active" : "inactive", d.fail2ban.detail);
      for (const k of ["docker", "ftp", "sftp", "smb", "webdav"]) {
        setDot(k, d.services[k] ? "active" : "inactive", d.services[k + "_detail"]);
      }
      setDot("pm2", d.services.pm2_ok ? "active" : "error", d.services.pm2_detail);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    setDot("ufw", "error", `UFW: ${err.message}`);
  }
  // Any row this poll never touched (e.g. a status key with no backend
  // signal wired up yet) shouldn't stay stuck on a spinner forever.
  document.querySelectorAll("#statusDropdown .dot-loading").forEach((dot) => {
    dot.className = "dot dot-inactive";
    const label = $(`text-${dot.id.slice(4)}`);
    if (label) label.textContent = label.textContent.replace(/^Checking (.+)\.\.\.$/, "$1: unavailable");
  });
  recomputeOverall();
}
