// ── Login / system notifications bell ───────────────────────
const IS_ADMIN_PAGE = document.querySelector('[data-key="security"]') !== null;
let notifEvents = [], notifAlerts = [], notifKnownIds = new Set(), notifKnownAlertIds = new Set(), notifFirstLoad = true;

function notifCountryFlag(code) {
  if (!code || code.length !== 2) return "🌐";
  const A = 0x1F1E6;
  return [...code.toUpperCase()].map((c) => String.fromCodePoint(A + c.charCodeAt(0) - 65)).join("");
}
function notifLocationText(e) {
  if (!e.country) return e.ip ? "Private / LAN" : "Unknown location";
  return e.city ? `${e.city}, ${e.country}` : e.country;
}
function notifTimeAgo(iso) {
  const min = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime()) / 60000);
  if (min < 1) return "just now";
  if (min < 60) return `${min}m ago`;
  const hr = Math.floor(min / 60);
  if (hr < 24) return `${hr}h ago`;
  return `${Math.floor(hr / 24)}d ago`;
}
function notifAlertIcon(level) { return level === "critical" ? "🔴" : level === "warning" ? "🟡" : "ℹ️"; }

async function fetchNotifications() {
  try {
    const data = await getJSON("/api/widgets/notifications/logins?limit=20");
    const list = data.events || [];
    if (!notifFirstLoad) {
      for (const e of list) {
        if (e.isNewDevice && !notifKnownIds.has(e.id)) toast(`🆕 New login: ${e.device || "Unknown device"} · ${notifLocationText(e)}`);
      }
    }
    list.forEach((e) => notifKnownIds.add(e.id));
    notifEvents = list;
  } catch (err) { console.error("[notif] logins failed:", err.message); }

  if (IS_ADMIN_PAGE) {
    try {
      const data = await getJSON("/api/widgets/notifications/system?limit=20");
      const list = data.alerts || [];
      if (!notifFirstLoad) {
        for (const a of list) {
          if (!a.seen && !notifKnownAlertIds.has(a.id)) toast(`${notifAlertIcon(a.level)} ${a.source}: ${a.message}`);
        }
      }
      list.forEach((a) => notifKnownAlertIds.add(a.id));
      notifAlerts = list;
    } catch (err) { console.error("[notif] system failed:", err.message); }
  }
  notifFirstLoad = false;
  renderNotifications();
}

function renderNotifications() {
  const merged = [
    ...notifEvents.map((e) => ({ kind: "login", key: `login-${e.id}`, createdAt: e.createdAt, data: e })),
    ...notifAlerts.map((a) => ({ kind: "system", key: `system-${a.id}`, createdAt: a.createdAt, data: a })),
  ].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt) - new Date(a.createdAt));
  const unseen = notifEvents.filter((e) => !e.seen).length + notifAlerts.filter((a) => !a.seen).length;
  const badge = $("notifBadge");
  badge.classList.toggle("hidden", unseen === 0);
  badge.textContent = unseen > 9 ? "9+" : unseen;
  $("notifCount").textContent = merged.length ? `${merged.length} notification${merged.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : "";

  const host = $("notifList");
  host.innerHTML = merged.length ? merged.map((item) => {
    const icon = item.kind === "login" ? (item.data.isNewDevice ? "🆕" : "🔑") : notifAlertIcon(item.data.level);
    const title = item.kind === "login" ? (item.data.device || "Unknown device") : item.data.message;
    const sub = item.kind === "login"
      ? `${notifCountryFlag(item.data.countryCode)} ${notifLocationText(item.data)}`
      : item.data.source;
    return `<div class="notif-item" data-kind="${item.kind}" data-id="${item.data.id}">
      <span class="notif-icon">${icon}</span>
      <div class="notif-body"><div class="notif-title">${title}</div><div class="hint">${sub}</div></div>
      <span class="hint notif-time">${notifTimeAgo(item.data.createdAt)}</span>
      <button class="notif-del">✕</button>
    </div>`;
  }).join("") : '<p class="hint" style="padding:12px;text-align:center">No notifications yet</p>';
  host.querySelectorAll(".notif-item").forEach((el) => el.querySelector(".notif-del").addEventListener("click", () => deleteNotif(el.dataset.kind, Number(el.dataset.id))));
}

async function deleteNotif(kind, id) {
  if (kind === "login") { notifEvents = notifEvents.filter((e) => e.id !== id); }
  else { notifAlerts = notifAlerts.filter((a) => a.id !== id); }
  renderNotifications();
  const path = kind === "login" ? "/api/widgets/notifications/logins" : "/api/widgets/notifications/system";
  try { await fetch(path, { method: "DELETE", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF": "1" }, body: JSON.stringify({ ids: [id] }) }); }
  catch (err) { console.error("[notif] delete failed:", err.message); }
}

$("notifClearAll")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  if (!notifEvents.length && !notifAlerts.length) return;
  if (!confirm("清除全部通知？此動作無法復原。 / Clear all notifications? This cannot be undone.")) return;
  const loginIds = notifEvents.map((e) => e.id), alertIds = notifAlerts.map((a) => a.id);
  notifEvents = []; notifAlerts = [];
  renderNotifications();
  try {
    if (loginIds.length) await fetch("/api/widgets/notifications/logins", { method: "DELETE", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF": "1" }, body: JSON.stringify({ ids: loginIds }) });
    if (alertIds.length) await fetch("/api/widgets/notifications/system", { method: "DELETE", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF": "1" }, body: JSON.stringify({ ids: alertIds }) });
  } catch (err) { console.error("[notif] clear all failed:", err.message); }
});

async function markAllNotifSeen() {
  const unseenIds = notifEvents.filter((e) => !e.seen).map((e) => e.id);
  const unseenAlertIds = notifAlerts.filter((a) => !a.seen).map((a) => a.id);
  if (!unseenIds.length && !unseenAlertIds.length) return;
  notifEvents = notifEvents.map((e) => ({ ...e, seen: true }));
  notifAlerts = notifAlerts.map((a) => ({ ...a, seen: true }));
  try {
    if (unseenIds.length) await postJSON("/api/widgets/notifications/logins/ack", { ids: unseenIds });
    if (unseenAlertIds.length) await postJSON("/api/widgets/notifications/system/ack", { ids: unseenAlertIds });
  } catch {}
}
$("btnNotif")?.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  const dropdown = $("notifDropdown");
  const opening = dropdown.classList.contains("hidden");
  dropdown.classList.toggle("hidden");
  if (opening) { markAllNotifSeen(); renderNotifications(); }
});
document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  if (!$("notifWrap")?.contains(e.target)) $("notifDropdown")?.classList.add("hidden");
});
fetchNotifications();
setInterval(fetchNotifications, 45000);

// ── Draggable windows (DragWindow / NetworkWidget / DiskWidget) ─
function makeDraggable(el) {
  const handle = el.querySelector(".drag-handle");
  handle.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
    if (e.target.closest("button")) return;
    const startX = e.clientX, startY = e.clientY;
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    function onMove(ev) {
      const w = rect.width;
      el.style.left = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerWidth - w, rect.left + ev.clientX - startX)) + "px";
      el.style.top = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 80, rect.top + ev.clientY - startY)) + "px";
    }
    function onUp() { window.removeEventListener("mousemove", onMove); window.removeEventListener("mouseup", onUp); }
    window.addEventListener("mousemove", onMove);
    window.addEventListener("mouseup", onUp);
  });
}
document.querySelectorAll(".drag-window").forEach(makeDraggable);
document.querySelectorAll(".drag-close").forEach((b) =>
  b.addEventListener("click", () => $(`win-${b.dataset.win}`)?.classList.add("hidden")));

function toggleWin(id, centered) {
  const el = $(`win-${id}`);
  if (!el) return;
  if (el.classList.contains("hidden") && el.style.left.startsWith("-")) {
    el.style.left = centered
      ? Math.round(window.innerWidth / 2 - el.offsetWidth / 2) + "px"
      : (window.innerWidth - el.offsetWidth - 20) + "px";
    if (centered) el.style.top = Math.round(window.innerHeight / 2 - 180) + "px";
  }
  el.classList.toggle("hidden");
  if (id === "vaultixid" && !el.classList.contains("hidden")) vidLoad();
}
$("btnNetwork")?.addEventListener("click", () => toggleWin("network"));
$("btnSysinfo")?.addEventListener("click", () => toggleWin("sysinfo"));

// ── Vaultix ID ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
const VID_ADJ = ["Stellar","Cosmic","Nova","Quantum","Nebula","Aurora","Nexus","Phantom","Echo","Flux",
  "Neon","Apex","Delta","Hyper","Zenith","Cipher","Pixel","Shadow","Vortex","Crystal","Iron","Void",
  "Onyx","Azure","Ember","Frost","Lunar","Solar","Binary","Vector"];
const VID_NOUN = ["Wolf","Falcon","Storm","Blade","Forge","Shard","Pulse","Drift","Surge","Glitch",
  "Orbit","Core","Node","Grid","Spark","Link","Hawk","Raven","Drake","Titan","Comet","Quasar",
  "Reactor","Prism","Ghost","Specter","Rogue","Cipher","Engine","Nexus"];
function vidRandomId() {
  const adj = VID_ADJ[Math.floor(Math.random() * VID_ADJ.length)];
  const noun = VID_NOUN[Math.floor(Math.random() * VID_NOUN.length)];
  return `${adj}${noun}${Math.floor(Math.random() * 900) + 100}`;
}
function vidValidate(id) {
  if (!id || id.length < 4) return "長度至少 4 個字元";
  if (id.length > 30) return "長度不超過 30 個字元";
  if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/.test(id)) return "只允許英文、數字、底線、連字號";
  if (/^[A-Z]\d{9}$/.test(id)) return "不可使用身分證號碼格式";
  if (/^0?9\d{8}$/.test(id)) return "不可使用手機號碼格式";
  if (/^(?:\+?886)?\d{9,10}$/.test(id)) return "不可使用電話號碼格式";
  if (/^(19|20)\d{2}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])$/.test(id)) return "不可使用生日格式";
  if (/^\d{7,}$/.test(id)) return "不可使用純數字（7位以上）";
  return null;
}
let vidCurrentId = null;
let vidLoaded = false;
function vidRenderCurrent() {
  $("vidCurrent").innerHTML = vidCurrentId
    ? `<span class="vid-value">${vidCurrentId}</span><button class="icon-btn" id="vidCopy" title="複製">${ICON_CLIPBOARD}</button>`
    : '<span class="hint">尚未設定</span>';
  $("vidLabel").textContent = vidCurrentId ? "修改 ID" : "設定 ID";
  $("vidCopy")?.addEventListener("click", () => copyText(vidCurrentId, "Vaultix ID"));
}
async function vidLoad() {
  if (vidLoaded) return;
  vidLoaded = true;
  try {
    const d = await getJSON("/api/widgets/vaultix-id");
    vidCurrentId = d.vaultixId || null;
    $("vidInput").value = vidCurrentId || "";
  } catch {}
  vidRenderCurrent();
  vidUpdateSaveState();
}
function vidUpdateSaveState() {
  const v = $("vidInput").value.trim();
  $("vidSave").disabled = !v || v === vidCurrentId;
}
$("vidInput")?.addEventListener("input", () => { $("vidError")?.classList.add("hidden"); vidUpdateSaveState(); });
$("vidInput")?.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") $("vidSave")?.click(); });
$("vidRandom")?.addEventListener("click", () => { $("vidInput").value = vidRandomId(); $("vidError")?.classList.add("hidden"); vidUpdateSaveState(); });
$("vidSave")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const v = $("vidInput").value.trim();
  const err = vidValidate(v);
  const errEl = $("vidError");
  if (err) { errEl.textContent = err; errEl.classList.remove("hidden"); return; }
  errEl.classList.add("hidden");
  $("vidSave").disabled = true;
  try {
    await postJSON("/api/widgets/vaultix-id", { vaultixId: v });
    vidCurrentId = v;
    vidRenderCurrent();
    toast("Vaultix ID 已儲存");
  } catch (e) {
    const msg = e.message || "";
    if (/409|duplicate|已被/i.test(msg)) { errEl.textContent = "此 ID 已被使用，請換一個"; errEl.classList.remove("hidden"); }
    else toast(msg, "error");
  }
  vidUpdateSaveState();
});

function fmtBps(v) {
  if (v >= 1e9) return (v / 1e9).toFixed(2) + " GB/s";
  if (v >= 1e6) return (v / 1e6).toFixed(1) + " MB/s";
  if (v >= 1e3) return (v / 1e3).toFixed(0) + " KB/s";
  return Math.round(v) + " B/s";
}
let rxHist = [], txHist = [];
async function pollNetwork() {
  if ($("win-network")?.classList.contains("hidden")) return;
  try {
    const d = await getJSON("/api/widgets/network");
    $("netRx").textContent = fmtBps(d.totalRx);
    $("netTx").textContent = fmtBps(d.totalTx);
    rxHist = [...rxHist.slice(-29), d.totalRx];
    txHist = [...txHist.slice(-29), d.totalTx];
    const max = Math.max(...rxHist, ...txHist, 1024);
    $("netSpark").innerHTML = rxHist.map((rx, i) => {
      const tx = txHist[i] ?? 0;
      return `<div class="spark-col"><div class="spark-rx" style="height:${Math.round((rx / max) * 44)}px"></div>` +
             `<div class="spark-tx" style="height:${Math.round((tx / max) * 44)}px"></div></div>`;
    }).join("");
    $("netIfaces").innerHTML = Object.entries(d.interfaces || {}).map(([name, v]) =>
      `<div class="iface-row"><span class="iface-name">${name}</span><span class="iface-rx">${fmtBps(v.rx)}</span><span class="iface-tx">${fmtBps(v.tx)}</span></div>`
    ).join("");
  } catch {}
}

function fmtBytes(b) {
  if (b >= 1099511627776) return (b / 1099511627776).toFixed(1) + " TB";
  if (b >= 1073741824) return (b / 1073741824).toFixed(1) + " GB";
  if (b >= 1048576) return (b / 1048576).toFixed(0) + " MB";
  return Math.round(b / 1024) + " KB";
}
function fmtUptime(sec) {
  const d = Math.floor(sec / 86400), h = Math.floor((sec % 86400) / 3600), m = Math.floor((sec % 3600) / 60);
  if (d > 0) return `${d}d ${h}h`;
  if (h > 0) return `${h}h ${m}m`;
  return `${m}m`;
}
function barRow(label, used, total, warnAt = 75, dangerAt = 90) {
  const pct = total > 0 ? Math.min(100, (used / total) * 100) : 0;
  const cls = pct > dangerAt ? "bar-danger" : pct > warnAt ? "bar-warn" : "bar-ok";
  return `<div class="bar-row"><div class="bar-head"><span>${label}</span><span>${fmtBytes(used)} / ${fmtBytes(total)}</span></div>` +
         `<div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill ${cls}" style="width:${pct}%"></div></div></div>`;
}
async function pollSysinfo() {
  if ($("win-sysinfo")?.classList.contains("hidden")) return;
  try {
    const d = await getJSON("/api/widgets/sysinfo");
    let html = "";
    if (d.disk) html += barRow("Disk Space", d.disk.used, d.disk.total);
    if (d.disk1) html += barRow("sda1", d.disk1.used, d.disk1.total);
    html += barRow("Memory", d.memory.total - d.memory.free, d.memory.total);
    $("sysBars").innerHTML = html;
    $("sysMeta").innerHTML = `<div class="meta-row"><span>Hostname</span><span>${d.hostname}</span></div>` +
      `<div class="meta-row"><span>IP Address</span><span>${d.ip}</span></div>` +
      `<div class="meta-row"><span>Uptime</span><span>${fmtUptime(d.uptime)}</span></div>`;
  } catch {}
}

function svcRowHtml(app) {
  const running = app.State === "running";
  const dot = running ? "svc-dot-on" : "svc-dot-off";
  return `<li class="svc-row" data-id="${app.ID}">
    <span class="svc-dot ${dot}"></span>
    <div class="svc-info"><div class="svc-name">${app.Names}</div><div class="svc-image">${app.Image}</div></div>
    <div class="svc-actions">
      ${running
        ? `<button class="btn-mini" data-act="restart">Restart</button><button class="btn-mini btn-mini-danger" data-act="stop">Stop</button>`
        : `<button class="btn-mini btn-mini-primary" data-act="start">Start</button>`}
    </div></li>`;
}
async function loadServices() {
  const list = $("svcList");
  if (!list) return;
  list.innerHTML = '<li class="hint">載入中...</li>';
  try {
    const d = await getJSON("/api/widgets/apps");
    if (d.unavailable) { list.innerHTML = `<li class="hint">Docker 服務無法使用</li>`; return; }
    list.innerHTML = d.apps.length ? d.apps.map(svcRowHtml).join("") : '<li class="hint">沒有系統服務</li>';
    list.querySelectorAll("[data-act]").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      const id = btn.closest(".svc-row").dataset.id;
      btn.disabled = true;
      try { await postJSON(`/api/widgets/apps/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/control`, { action: btn.dataset.act }); toast("完成"); await loadServices(); }
      catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
      finally { btn.disabled = false; }
    }));
  } catch (err) { list.innerHTML = `<li class="hint">${err.message}</li>`; }
}

// ── Background picker ────────────────────────────────────────
let bgPath = "";
function bgCrumbHtml() {
  const segs = bgPath ? bgPath.split("/").filter(Boolean) : [];
  let html = `<button class="crumb-btn" data-path="">根目錄</button>`;
  let acc = [];
  for (const s of segs) { acc.push(s); html += ` / <button class="crumb-btn" data-path="${acc.join("/")}">${s}</button>`; }
  return html;
}
async function loadBgDir() {
  $("bgCrumb").innerHTML = bgCrumbHtml();
  $("bgCrumb").querySelectorAll(".crumb-btn").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => { bgPath = b.dataset.path; loadBgDir(); }));
  const grid = $("bgGrid");
  grid.innerHTML = '<p class="hint">載入中...</p>';
  try {
    const d = await getJSON(`/api/widgets/browse?path=${encodeURIComponent(bgPath)}`);
    if (!d.folders.length && !d.images.length) { grid.innerHTML = '<p class="hint">此資料夾沒有圖片</p>'; return; }
    grid.innerHTML = `<div class="bg-grid">` +
      d.folders.map((f) => `<button class="bg-folder" data-folder="${f}">${ICON_FOLDER_AMBER}<span>${f}</span></button>`).join("") +
      d.images.map((i) => `<button class="bg-image" data-url="${i.url}" data-path="${i.path}"><img src="${i.url}" loading="lazy"/><span>${i.name}</span></button>`).join("") +
      `</div>`;
    grid.querySelectorAll(".bg-folder").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => { bgPath = bgPath ? `${bgPath}/${b.dataset.folder}` : b.dataset.folder; loadBgDir(); }));
    grid.querySelectorAll(".bg-image").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => applyHomeBg(b.dataset.url)));
  } catch (err) { grid.innerHTML = `<p class="hint">${err.message}</p>`; }
}
async function applyHomeBg(css) {
  try {
    await postJSON("/api/widgets/prefs", { home_bg_css: css || null });
    const layer = $("bgLayer");
    if (css) { layer.style.backgroundImage = css.startsWith("/") || css.startsWith("http") ? `url('${css}')` : ""; layer.style.background = css.startsWith("/") || css.startsWith("http") ? "" : css; }
    else { layer.style.backgroundImage = ""; layer.style.background = ""; }
    closeModal("modalBackground");
    toast("背景已更新");
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
}

// ── Profile panel ────────────────────────────────────────────
const SESSION_TIMEOUT_KEY = "nas_session_timeout";
const TIMEOUT_OPTIONS = [[0, "永不"], [15, "15 分鐘"], [30, "30 分鐘"], [60, "1 小時"], [120, "2 小時"], [480, "8 小時"], [1440, "24 小時"]];

// ── Idle auto-logout enforcement — Python port of AuthContext.tsx's
// resetLogoutTimer()/activity-tracking useEffect (category 1, 核心殼層).
// The *setting* (SESSION_TIMEOUT_KEY above) was already ported in category
// 9's profile-modal "security" tab; this is the missing enforcement half —
// without it the dropdown just saved a number nobody ever acted on. Scoped
// to /home (the only page widgets.js loads on), matching where the user
// actually spends most of their session; other authenticated pages already
// rely on their own per-page login redirect if the JWT cookie expires.
let _idleTimer = null;
let _lastActivity = Date.now();
function resetIdleLogoutTimer() {
  if (_idleTimer) clearTimeout(_idleTimer);
  const mins = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(SESSION_TIMEOUT_KEY) ?? "0");
  if (!mins || mins <= 0) return;
  _idleTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
    try { await fetch("/logout", { method: "POST", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" } }); } catch {}
    location.href = "/login";
  }, mins * 60 * 1000);
}
["mousemove", "keydown", "click", "touchstart", "scroll"].forEach((ev) =>
  window.addEventListener(ev, () => {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - _lastActivity > 10000) { _lastActivity = now; resetIdleLogoutTimer(); }
  }, { passive: true }));
resetIdleLogoutTimer();
$("btnProfile")?.addEventListener("click", () => { openModal("modalProfile"); renderTimeoutGrid(); renderHelloDevices(); });
document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach((tab) => tab.addEventListener("click", () => {
  document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach((t) => t.classList.remove("active"));
  document.querySelectorAll(".tab-pane").forEach((p) => p.classList.remove("active"));
  tab.classList.add("active");
  document.querySelector(`.tab-pane[data-pane="${tab.dataset.tab}"]`)?.classList.add("active");
}));
function renderTimeoutGrid() {
  const grid = $("timeoutGrid");
  if (!grid) return;
  const current = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(SESSION_TIMEOUT_KEY) ?? "0");
  grid.innerHTML = TIMEOUT_OPTIONS.map(([v, label]) =>
    `<button class="timeout-opt${v === current ? " active" : ""}" data-v="${v}">${label}</button>`).join("");
  grid.querySelectorAll(".timeout-opt").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const v = parseInt(b.dataset.v);
    if (v) localStorage.setItem(SESSION_TIMEOUT_KEY, String(v)); else localStorage.removeItem(SESSION_TIMEOUT_KEY);
    renderTimeoutGrid();
  }));
}
// ── Windows Hello / WebAuthn enrollment (settings-page half of
// win_auth_login.py — the login-page half lives in login.html) ─────────
async function renderHelloDevices() {
  const list = $("helloDeviceList");
  if (!list) return;
  list.innerHTML = `<p class="hint">載入中...</p>`;
  try {
    const d = await getJSON("/api/2fa/webauthn/devices");
    if (!d.devices?.length) { list.innerHTML = `<p class="hint">尚未綁定任何裝置</p>`; return; }
    list.innerHTML = d.devices.map((dev) => `
      <div class="hello-device-row" data-id="${dev.credential_id ?? ""}">
        <span class="hello-device-label">${ICON_LOCK}${dev.label || "Windows Hello"}</span>
        <button type="button" class="link-btn hello-remove-btn">移除</button>
      </div>`).join("");
    list.querySelectorAll(".hello-remove-btn").forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      const row = btn.closest(".hello-device-row");
      try {
        await reqJSON("/api/2fa/webauthn/remove", {
          method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF": "1" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ credential_id: row.dataset.id }),
        });
        toast("已移除裝置");
        renderHelloDevices();
      } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
    }));
  } catch {
    list.innerHTML = `<p class="hint">無法載入裝置清單</p>`;
  }
}
$("btnHelloRegister")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const btn = $("btnHelloRegister");
  if (!window.WebAuthnNative?.supported()) { toast("此瀏覽器不支援 Windows Hello", "error"); return; }
  btn.disabled = true;
  try {
    const options = await getJSON("/api/2fa/webauthn/register/options");
    const credential = await WebAuthnNative.startRegistration(options);
    await reqJSON("/api/2fa/webauthn/register/verify", {
      method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF": "1" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ credential, label: navigator.platform || "Windows Hello" }),
    });
    toast("裝置已綁定");
    renderHelloDevices();
  } catch (err) {
    toast(err.name === "NotAllowedError" ? "已取消或逾時" : err.message, "error");
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false;
  }
});

$("avatarInput")?.addEventListener("change", async (e) => {
  const file = e.target.files?.[0]; if (!file) return;
  e.target.value = "";
  const form = new FormData(); form.append("avatar", file);
  try {
    const r = await fetch("/api/widgets/avatar", { method: "POST", headers: { "X-CSRF": "1" }, body: form });
    const d = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(d.error || `HTTP ${r.status}`);
    toast("頭像已更新"); setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 600);
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
});

$("btnChangePw")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const cur = $("currentPw").value, nw = $("newPw").value, cf = $("confirmPw").value;
  if (!cur || !nw || !cf) return toast("請填寫所有欄位", "error");
  if (nw !== cf) return toast("兩次輸入的密碼不一致", "error");
  if (nw.length < 8) return toast("新密碼至少需要 8 個字元", "error");
  try {
    await postJSON("/api/widgets/password", { currentPassword: cur, newPassword: nw });
    toast("密碼已更新"); $("currentPw").value = ""; $("newPw").value = ""; $("confirmPw").value = "";
  } catch (err) { toast(err.message, "error"); }
});

    (function () {

      const queryInput = document.getElementById('filterQuery');
      const categorySelect = document.getElementById('filterCategory');
      const applyBtn = document.getElementById('filterApplyBtn');

      // the user must press "套用篩選". This does not affect browsing
      // "全部" / other category pills, which are plain link navigation.
      queryInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') e.preventDefault();
      });

      function applyFilter() {
        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('path', {{ path | tojson }});
        params.set('cat', categorySelect.value);
        const q = queryInput.value.trim();
        if (q) params.set('q', q);
        window.location.href = '/files?' + params.toString();
      }

      applyBtn.addEventListener('click', applyFilter);
      clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        queryInput.value = '';
        categorySelect.value = 'all';
        applyFilter();
      });
    })();

  <script>
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
    const errEl = $("error");
    let twofa = { mode: null, tempToken: null, ticket: null, totp: false, webauthn: false };

    function showError(msg) { errEl.textContent = msg; errEl.classList.remove("hidden"); }
    function clearError() { errEl.classList.add("hidden"); errEl.textContent = ""; }

    async function postJSON(url, body) {
      const r = await fetch(url, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF": "1" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });
      const data = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${r.status}`);
      return data;
    }

    $("loginForm").addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      clearError();
      $("loginBtn").disabled = true;
      try {
        const data = await postJSON("/api/login", {
          username: $("username").value.trim(),
          password: $("password").value,
        });
        if (data.requiresTwoFactor) {
          twofa = {
            mode: data.method || "node", tempToken: data.tempToken, ticket: data.ticket,
            // Node's legacy 2FA fallback only ever offers a TOTP code, so
            // default totp=true there; the Python-native path (win_auth_login.py)
            // tells us exactly which methods this user actually enrolled.
            totp: data.method === "python" ? !!data.totp : true,
            webauthn: data.method === "python" && !!data.webauthn,
          };
          renderTwoFaOptions();
          $("loginForm").classList.add("hidden");
          $("twofaForm").classList.remove("hidden");
        } else {
          location.href = data.next || "/home";
        }
      } catch (err) {
        showError(err.message);
      } finally {
        $("loginBtn").disabled = false;
      }
    });

    function renderTwoFaOptions() {
      const helloAvailable = twofa.webauthn && WebAuthnNative.supported();
      $("helloBtn").classList.toggle("hidden", !helloAvailable);
      $("helloDivider").classList.toggle("hidden", !(helloAvailable && twofa.totp));
      $("codeGroup").classList.toggle("hidden", !twofa.totp);
      if (twofa.totp) $("code").focus(); else if (helloAvailable) $("helloBtn").focus();
    }

    $("helloBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
      clearError();
      $("helloBtn").disabled = true;
      try {
        const options = await postJSON("/api/2fa/webauthn/login/options", { ticket: twofa.ticket });
        const credential = await WebAuthnNative.startAuthentication(options);
        const data = await postJSON("/api/2fa/webauthn/login/verify", { ticket: twofa.ticket, credential });
        location.href = data.next || "/home";
      } catch (err) {
        showError(err.name === "NotAllowedError" ? "已取消或逾時 / Canceled or timed out" : err.message);
      } finally {
        $("helloBtn").disabled = false;
      }
    });

    $("twofaForm").addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      clearError();
      $("twofaBtn").disabled = true;
      try {
        const code = $("code").value.replace(/\s/g, "");
        const data = twofa.mode === "python"
          ? await postJSON("/api/2fa/totp/login", { ticket: twofa.ticket, code })
          : await postJSON("/api/2fa/verify", { tempToken: twofa.tempToken, code });
        location.href = data.next || "/home";
      } catch (err) {
        showError(err.message);
      } finally {
        $("twofaBtn").disabled = false;
      }
    });

    $("backBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
      clearError();
      twofa = { mode: null, tempToken: null, ticket: null, totp: false, webauthn: false };
      $("twofaForm").classList.add("hidden");
      $("loginForm").classList.remove("hidden");
      $("username").focus();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

        <img id="qrImg" alt="QR" style="width:180px;height:180px;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:6px" />
        <p class="hint" style="word-break:break-all">金鑰:<code id="secret"></code></p>
        <label>輸入驗證碼 / Code

  <script>
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
    let timer = null;

    function msg(text, ok) {
      const el = $("msg");
      el.textContent = text;
      el.classList.remove("hidden");
      el.style.color = ok ? "#4ade80" : "";
    }
    async function postJSON(url, body) {
      const r = await fetch(url, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF": "1" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body || {}),
      });
      const d = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(d.error || `HTTP ${r.status}`);
      return d;
    }

    async function refresh() {
      try {
        const r = await fetch("/api/2fa/status");
        const s = await r.json();
        $("status").innerHTML = "TOTP:" + (s.totp ? " ✅ 已啟用" : " ⛔ 未設定")
          + " ｜ 指紋/Hello:" + (s.webauthn ? " ✅" : " ⛔");
        $("disableBtn").classList.toggle("hidden", !s.totp);
      } catch (e) { $("status").textContent = "無法讀取狀態:" + e.message; }
    }

    function startCountdown(sec) {
      clearInterval(timer);
      let left = sec;
      $("countdown").textContent = left;
      timer = setInterval(() => {
        left -= 1;
        $("countdown").textContent = left;
        if (left <= 0) { clearInterval(timer); setup(); }  // auto-refresh QR on expiry
      }, 1000);
    }

    async function setup() {
      try {
        const d = await postJSON("/api/2fa/totp/provision");
        $("qrImg").src = d.qr;
        $("secret").textContent = d.secret;
        $("qrBox").classList.remove("hidden");
        startCountdown(d.expires_in || 180);
      } catch (e) { msg(e.message, false); }
    }

    $("setupBtn").addEventListener("click", setup);

    $("enableBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
      try {
        await postJSON("/api/2fa/totp/enable", { code: $("code").value.replace(/\s/g, "") });
        clearInterval(timer);
        $("qrBox").classList.add("hidden");
        msg("TOTP 已啟用 ✅", true);
        refresh();
      } catch (e) { msg(e.message, false); }
    });

    $("disableBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
      try {
        await postJSON("/api/2fa/totp/disable");
        msg("TOTP 已停用", true);
        refresh();
      } catch (e) { msg(e.message, false); }
    });

    refresh();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

"""Private Album — Python port of components/Locker.tsx (sub-batch 8c of

static/webauthn_native.js.

Backend contract: fingerprint/TOTP/mobile-pairing routes under /api/locker/*
were fully ported to server.py in the retirement initiative's Phase 1 (6
WebAuthn routes) and an earlier flat-numbered batch (unlock + mobile-signal,
see [[server_py_migration_progress]] batch 9's mobile-signal note) — this
module proxies them 1:1, no new auth/crypto logic on the Python side. File
listing/upload/delete reuse the generic /api/files* routes, same as every
other file-browsing page in this app.

Scope decision (not guessed upfront, made after reading Locker.tsx in full):
only the WebAuthn ceremony (base64url conversion + credentials.create/get)
is factored into a shared static/webauthn_native.js — it's pure client-side
crypto with zero backend-route dependency, so it's safe to share before
Reels.tsx/TelegramReels.tsx (sub-batch 8d) are even read. The lock-screen
markup, auto-lock timer, and media grid/lightbox stay local to this module;

# ── proxy: WebAuthn / TOTP unlock / mobile pairing (backend /api/locker/*) ──
def _no_login():
    return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)


@router.get("/api/locker/webauthn/status")
async def lk_webauthn_status(request: Request):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    return await node_json("GET", "/api/locker/webauthn/status", tok)

# ── proxy: file listing/upload/delete (backend /api/files*) ────────────
def _ext(name: str) -> str:
    return name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower() if "." in name else ""


@router.get("/api/locker/files")
async def lk_files(request: Request, path: str = DEFAULT_PATH):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()

    # Best-effort folder creation, mirroring the original's ensureFolder() —
    # a fresh install won't have sda1/Private yet.
    parts = path.split("/")
    name = parts.pop()
    parent = "/".join(parts)
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:
            await client.post(f"{NODE_API}/api/files/mkdir",
                               headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}"},
                               json={"path": parent, "name": name})
    except httpx.RequestError:
        pass

    try:
        r = await node_get(f"/api/files?path={quote(path)}", tok)
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status_code=r.status_code)

    items = []
    for i in r.json().get("items", []):
        if i.get("type") != "file":
            continue
        ext = _ext(i["name"])
        is_video = ext in VIDEO_EXTS
        if ext not in IMAGE_EXTS and not is_video:
            continue
        rel = f"{path}/{i['name']}"
        items.append({
            "name": i["name"], "isVideo": is_video,
            "url": f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/api/files/download?path={quote(rel)}&token={tok}",
        })
    return JSONResponse({"items": items})


@router.post("/api/locker/upload")
async def lk_upload(request: Request, files: list[UploadFile] = File(...), path: str = ""):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    ok, fail = 0, 0
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30) as client:
        for f in files:
            try:
                r = await client.post(
                    f"{NODE_API}/api/files/upload",
                    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}"},
                    data={"path": path},
                    files={"files": (f.filename, await f.read(), f.content_type)},
                )
                if r.status_code in (200, 201):
                    ok += 1
                else:
                    fail += 1
            except httpx.RequestError:
                fail += 1
    return JSONResponse({"ok": ok, "fail": fail})

        return _no_login()
    return await node_json("DELETE", f"/api/files?path={quote(path)}", tok)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/login.py
# 根據現有的庫格式進行敘寫，不可任意變更或刪除
# 註解統一為需求內容，不可刪除
import os, sys, sqlite3, httpx, hmac, hashlib, bcrypt, win_auth_login

# 資料庫位置: websites/backend/data/users.db
DB_PATH = os.path.normpath.join("..", "..", "..", "users.db").encode('utf-8')

user = ""   # 從 user.db 讀取使用者
pwd = ""    # 從 user.db 讀取密碼

def main():
    # 
    # HTML 語法
    """
    """
def _mix_pwd_pepper(plain_pwd: str) -> bytes:
    """
    將用戶密碼參雜 pepper salt(use HMAC-SHA256)
    """
    return hmac.new(DB_PATH, plain_pwd.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest().encode('utf-8')
def hash_pwd(plain_pwd: str) -> str:
    """
    註冊/修改密碼 add pepper + random slat and print bcrypt
    """
    # pwd add papper
    peppered_bytes = _mix_pwd_pepper(plain_pwd)
    # bcrypt auto print random salt (Const Factor default 12)
    salt = bcrypt.gensalt(rounds=12)
    hashed = bcrypt.hashpw(peppered_bytes, salt)

    return hashed.decode('utf-8')

def check(plain_pwd: str, hashed_pwd_str: str) -> bool:
    """
    """
    peppered_bytes = _mix_pwd_pepper(plain_pwd)

    return bcrypt.checkpw(peppered_bytes, hashed_pwd_str.encode('utf-8'))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/mail.py
"""Mail — external IMAP/SMTP webmail client (new frontend-py feature, 2026-08-06).

Lets a logged-in NAS user connect their own external mailbox (Gmail app
password, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, or any standard IMAP/SMTP host) and
read/send mail from the NAS web UI. Unlike every other frontend-py module,
this does NOT proxy through the Node backend — mail has nothing to do with
NAS file storage, so it talks directly to the user's mail provider over
IMAP/SMTP.

Credentials (the IMAP/SMTP password or app password) are encrypted at rest
with Fernet, same pattern as pwd_2FA_check.py's TOTP secret storage (key
priority: MAIL_KEY env var > mail.db.key file, auto-created chmod 600).
Stored in a local SQLite DB (mail.db), one row per (owner, mailbox), scoped
by `owner = username` on every query — a user can only ever see/touch their
own mail accounts, checked at the SQL layer, not just hidden in the UI.

imaplib/smtplib are blocking stdlib — every call here runs inside
asyncio.to_thread() so the FastAPI event loop is never blocked by a slow
mail server.

Security note on HTML email bodies: email HTML is one of the most hostile
content types a browser ever renders (tracking pixels, disguised phishing
links, and outright XSS payloads are routine in real-world mail). Rather
than hand-rolling a sanitizer, the HTML body is rendered inside a
`sandbox=""` <iframe srcdoc>` in mail.js — an empty sandbox strips script
execution, form submission, top-navigation and same-origin access
entirely, so even an unfiltered <script> or onerror= in the source HTML
is inert. No new dependency needed for this.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
# 不可變更此庫的格式
import asyncio, email, imaplib, json, os, re, smtplib, sqlite3, time
from email.header import decode_header, make_header
from email.message import EmailMessage
from email.message import Message as EmailMsg
from email.utils import getaddresses
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote

from cryptography.fernet import Fernet
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request, UploadFile, File, Form
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, RedirectResponse, Response

from admin_shell import page_shell, token as _token, username as _username

router = APIRouter()

BASE = Path(__file__).parent
DB_PATH = os.getenv("MAIL_DB", str(BASE / "mail.db"))

# Well-known provider presets so the "add account" form can auto-fill
# host/port from the email domain — user only has to paste the address.
PRESETS: dict[str, dict] = {
    "gmail.com": {"imap_host": "imap.gmail.com", "imap_port": 993, "smtp_host": "smtp.gmail.com", "smtp_port": 587},
    "outlook.com": {"imap_host": "outlook.office365.com", "imap_port": 993, "smtp_host": "smtp.office365.com", "smtp_port": 587},
    "hotmail.com": {"imap_host": "outlook.office365.com", "imap_port": 993, "smtp_host": "smtp.office365.com", "smtp_port": 587},
    "live.com": {"imap_host": "outlook.office365.com", "imap_port": 993, "smtp_host": "smtp.office365.com", "smtp_port": 587},
    "yahoo.com": {"imap_host": "imap.mail.yahoo.com", "imap_port": 993, "smtp_host": "smtp.mail.yahoo.com", "smtp_port": 587},
    "icloud.com": {"imap_host": "imap.mail.me.com", "imap_port": 993, "smtp_host": "smtp.mail.me.com", "smtp_port": 587},
    "me.com": {"imap_host": "imap.mail.me.com", "imap_port": 993, "smtp_host": "smtp.mail.me.com", "smtp_port": 587},
}

_TRASH_HINTS = ("trash", "deleted", "垃圾桶", "已刪除", "bin")


# ── at-rest encryption for mailbox passwords ─────────────
def _load_key() -> bytes:
    env = os.environ.get("MAIL_KEY")
    if env:
        return env.encode()
    key_path = DB_PATH + ".key"
    if os.path.exists(key_path):
        return open(key_path, "rb").read()
    key = Fernet.generate_key()
    with open(key_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(key)
    try:
        os.chmod(key_path, 0o600)
    except OSError:
        pass
    return key


_fernet = Fernet(_load_key())


def _db() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn


def _init_db() -> None:
    with _db() as db:
        db.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mail_accounts (
                id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                owner      TEXT NOT NULL,
                label      TEXT NOT NULL,
                email_addr TEXT NOT NULL,
                imap_host  TEXT NOT NULL,
                imap_port  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 993,
                smtp_host  TEXT NOT NULL,
                smtp_port  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 587,
                login_user TEXT NOT NULL,
                secret     TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
            )
        """)
        # Self-hosted mail (2026-08-07): a mailbox is either 'external' (the
        # original IMAP/SMTP-client feature above, unchanged) or 'local' (a
        # user@<own-domain> mailbox hosted on this Pi's own Postfix/Dovecot,
        # see admin_mailserver.py) — same table, same IMAP/SMTP code paths,
        # just a different host. Added via ALTER so existing installs migrate
        # in place without losing accounts already saved.
        try:
            db.execute("ALTER TABLE mail_accounts ADD COLUMN type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'external'")
        except sqlite3.OperationalError:
            pass  # column already exists


_init_db()


# ── auth helper (bare login check — mail is a normal-user tool, not
#    admin-only, same convention as downloader.py/admin_todo.py) ──
def _require_user(request: Request) -> str | JSONResponse:
    tok = _token(request)
    user = _username(tok) if tok else None
    if not user:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    return user


def _get_owned_account(acct_id: int, owner: str) -> dict | None:
    with _db() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM mail_accounts WHERE id = ? AND owner = ?", (acct_id, owner)).fetchone()
    if not row:
        return None
    d = dict(row)
    d["password"] = _fernet.decrypt(d.pop("secret").encode()).decode()
    return d


def _short_err(e: Exception) -> str:
    s = str(e).strip()
    return (s[:200] if s else e.__class__.__name__)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  MIME / IMAP helpers (pure, no network)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def _decode_mime(s: str | None) -> str:
    if not s:
        return ""
    try:
        return str(make_header(decode_header(s)))
    except Exception:
        return s


def _quote_folder(name: str) -> str:
    return '"' + name.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"') + '"'


_LIST_RE = re.compile(r'^\((?P<flags>[^)]*)\)\s+"(?P<delim>[^"]*)"\s+(?P<name>.+)$')


def _parse_list_line(raw: bytes) -> str | None:
    line = raw.decode(errors="replace")
    m = _LIST_RE.match(line)
    if not m:
        return None
    name = m.group("name").strip()
    if name.startswith('"') and name.endswith('"'):
        name = name[1:-1].replace('\\"', '"').replace("\\\\", "\\")
    return name or None


def _find_trash_folder(folders: list[str]) -> str | None:
    for f in folders:
        low = f.lower()
        if any(h in low for h in _TRASH_HINTS):
            return f
    return None


def _leaf_parts(msg: EmailMsg):
    """Yield (index, part) for every non-multipart part, in a stable order
    shared by both the body/attachment extractor and the attachment
    downloader — the index handed to the browser must mean the same thing
    both times."""
    if msg.is_multipart():
        idx = 0
        for part in msg.walk():
            if part.is_multipart():
                continue
            yield idx, part
            idx += 1
    else:
        yield 0, msg


def _decoded_payload(part: EmailMsg) -> bytes:
    """part.get_payload(decode=True) is typed by typeshed as
    _EncodedPayloadType | Any (bytes for a leaf part, but the stub also
    allows the multipart/str cases that can't happen here since callers
    only pass non-multipart leaf parts) — narrow it for real instead of
    `or b""`, which leaves the union (and the Message-typed member) intact
    for the type checker."""
    payload = part.get_payload(decode=True)
    return payload if isinstance(payload, bytes) else b""


def _extract_body_and_attachments(msg: EmailMsg) -> tuple[str | None, str | None, list[dict]]:
    text, html, attachments = None, None, []
    for idx, part in _leaf_parts(msg):
        content_type = part.get_content_type()
        disp = str(part.get("Content-Disposition") or "")
        filename = part.get_filename()
        if filename:
            payload = _decoded_payload(part)
            attachments.append({
                "index": idx, "filename": _decode_mime(filename),
                "size": len(payload), "content_type": content_type,
            })
        elif content_type == "text/plain" and text is None and "attachment" not in disp:
            payload = _decoded_payload(part)
            text = payload.decode(part.get_content_charset() or "utf-8", errors="replace")
        elif content_type == "text/html" and html is None and "attachment" not in disp:
            payload = _decoded_payload(part)
            html = payload.decode(part.get_content_charset() or "utf-8", errors="replace")
    return text, html, attachments


def _split_addrs(s: str) -> list[str]:
    return [addr for _, addr in getaddresses([s or ""]) if addr]


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  Blocking IMAP/SMTP calls — always run via asyncio.to_thread
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def _imap_connect_sync(acct: dict) -> imaplib.IMAP4:
    host, port = acct["imap_host"], int(acct["imap_port"])
    if port == 993:
        imap = imaplib.IMAP4_SSL(host, port, timeout=20)
    else:
        imap = imaplib.IMAP4(host, port, timeout=20)
        try:
            imap.starttls()
        except (imaplib.IMAP4.error, OSError):
            pass  # some legacy servers on non-993 ports are plaintext-only
    imap.login(acct["login_user"], acct["password"])
    return imap


def _imap_logout(imap: imaplib.IMAP4) -> None:
    try:
        imap.logout()
    except Exception:
        pass


def _select_folder(imap: imaplib.IMAP4, folder: str) -> None:
    typ, data = imap.select(_quote_folder(folder))
    if typ != "OK":
        detail = data[0].decode(errors="replace") if data and data[0] else "unknown error"
        raise RuntimeError(f"無法開啟資料夾 {folder}: {detail}")


def _run_imap(acct: dict, fn, retries: int = 1):
    """Connect, run fn(imap), logout — retry once on transient IMAP/network
    failures. Every call here opens a fresh connection (no pooling), and
    Gmail occasionally answers SELECT/LOGIN with a transient NO under load;
    without this the UI reads as "unstable" even though a retry a moment
    later would have succeeded."""
    last_exc: Exception | None = None
    for attempt in range(retries + 1):
        imap = None
        try:
            imap = _imap_connect_sync(acct)
            return fn(imap)
        except (imaplib.IMAP4.error, OSError, RuntimeError) as e:
            last_exc = e
            if attempt < retries:
                time.sleep(0.5)
                continue
            raise
        finally:
            if imap is not None:
                _imap_logout(imap)
    assert last_exc is not None  # pragma: no cover — loop always returns or raises above
    raise last_exc


def _smtp_send_sync(acct: dict, msg: EmailMessage, all_rcpts: list[str]) -> None:
    host, port = acct["smtp_host"], int(acct["smtp_port"])
    if port == 465:
        with smtplib.SMTP_SSL(host, port, timeout=20) as s:
            s.login(acct["login_user"], acct["password"])
            s.send_message(msg, to_addrs=all_rcpts)
    else:
        with smtplib.SMTP(host, port, timeout=20) as s:
            s.starttls()
            s.login(acct["login_user"], acct["password"])
            s.send_message(msg, to_addrs=all_rcpts)


def _test_login_sync(acct: dict) -> None:
    """Fail fast at account-creation time rather than saving a broken
    account and only discovering it's wrong the first time it's used."""
    imap = _imap_connect_sync(acct)
    try:
        _select_folder(imap, "INBOX")
    finally:
        _imap_logout(imap)
    host, port = acct["smtp_host"], int(acct["smtp_port"])
    if port == 465:
        with smtplib.SMTP_SSL(host, port, timeout=15) as s:
            s.login(acct["login_user"], acct["password"])
    else:
        with smtplib.SMTP(host, port, timeout=15) as s:
            s.starttls()
            s.login(acct["login_user"], acct["password"])


def _list_folders(imap: imaplib.IMAP4) -> list[str]:
    typ, data = imap.list()
    names: list[str] = []
    if typ == "OK":
        for raw in data or []:
            if not raw or not isinstance(raw, bytes):
                continue
            name = _parse_list_line(raw)
            if name:
                names.append(name)
    if "INBOX" not in names:
        names.insert(0, "INBOX")
    return names


def _fetch_folders_sync(acct: dict) -> list[str]:
    return _run_imap(acct, _list_folders)


def _fetch_message_list_sync(acct: dict, folder: str, offset: int, limit: int) -> tuple[int, list[dict]]:
    def _run(imap: imaplib.IMAP4) -> tuple[int, list[dict]]:
        _select_folder(imap, folder)
        # charset=None is the documented imaplib convention (see stdlib docs
        # for IMAP4.search); the uid() stub over-narrows *args to str.
        typ, data = imap.uid("search", None, "ALL")  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        if typ != "OK":
            raise RuntimeError("SEARCH failed")
        uids = [int(x) for x in data[0].split()] if data and data[0] else []
        uids.sort(reverse=True)  # newest first (UIDs increase monotonically)
        total = len(uids)
        page = uids[offset:offset + limit]
        if not page:
            return total, []

        uid_set = ",".join(str(u) for u in page)
        typ, data = imap.uid("fetch", uid_set, "(FLAGS BODY.PEEK[HEADER.FIELDS (FROM SUBJECT DATE)])")
        if typ != "OK":
            raise RuntimeError("FETCH failed")

        results: dict[int, dict] = {}
        for item in data:
            if not isinstance(item, tuple):
                continue
            meta, header_bytes = item
            meta_s = meta.decode(errors="replace")
            uid_m = re.search(r"UID (\d+)", meta_s)
            if not uid_m:
                continue
            uid = int(uid_m.group(1))
            flags_m = re.search(r"FLAGS \(([^)]*)\)", meta_s)
            flags = flags_m.group(1).split() if flags_m else []
            hdr = email.message_from_bytes(header_bytes)
            results[uid] = {
                "uid": uid,
                "from": _decode_mime(hdr.get("From")),
                "subject": _decode_mime(hdr.get("Subject")) or "(no subject)",
                "date": hdr.get("Date") or "",
                "seen": "\\Seen" in flags,
            }
        items = [results[u] for u in page if u in results]
        return total, items
    return _run_imap(acct, _run)


def _fetch_message_detail_sync(acct: dict, folder: str, uid: int) -> dict | None:
    def _run(imap: imaplib.IMAP4) -> dict | None:
        _select_folder(imap, folder)
        typ, data = imap.uid("fetch", str(uid), "(FLAGS BODY.PEEK[])")
        if typ != "OK" or not data or not isinstance(data[0], tuple):
            return None
        meta, raw = data[0]
        flags_m = re.search(r"FLAGS \(([^)]*)\)", meta.decode(errors="replace"))
        flags = flags_m.group(1).split() if flags_m else []
        msg = email.message_from_bytes(raw)
        text, html, attachments = _extract_body_and_attachments(msg)
        return {
            "uid": uid,
            "from": _decode_mime(msg.get("From")),
            "to": _decode_mime(msg.get("To")),
            "cc": _decode_mime(msg.get("Cc")),
            "subject": _decode_mime(msg.get("Subject")) or "(no subject)",
            "date": msg.get("Date") or "",
            "seen": "\\Seen" in flags,
            "text": text,
            "html": html,
            "attachments": attachments,
        }
    return _run_imap(acct, _run)


def _fetch_attachment_sync(acct: dict, folder: str, uid: int, idx: int) -> tuple[str, str, bytes] | None:
    def _run(imap: imaplib.IMAP4) -> tuple[str, str, bytes] | None:
        _select_folder(imap, folder)
        typ, data = imap.uid("fetch", str(uid), "(BODY.PEEK[])")
        if typ != "OK" or not data or not isinstance(data[0], tuple):
            return None
        _meta, raw = data[0]
        msg = email.message_from_bytes(raw)
        for i, part in _leaf_parts(msg):
            if i == idx and part.get_filename():
                payload = _decoded_payload(part)
                return _decode_mime(part.get_filename()), part.get_content_type(), payload
        return None
    return _run_imap(acct, _run)


def _set_flag_sync(acct: dict, folder: str, uid: int, flag: str, add: bool) -> None:
    def _run(imap: imaplib.IMAP4) -> None:
        _select_folder(imap, folder)
        imap.uid("STORE", str(uid), "+FLAGS" if add else "-FLAGS", f"({flag})")
    _run_imap(acct, _run)


def _delete_message_sync(acct: dict, folder: str, uid: int) -> None:
    def _run(imap: imaplib.IMAP4) -> None:
        _select_folder(imap, folder)
        already_trash = any(h in folder.lower() for h in _TRASH_HINTS)
        if not already_trash:
            trash = _find_trash_folder(_list_folders(imap))
            if trash:
                typ, _d = imap.uid("MOVE", str(uid), _quote_folder(trash))
                if typ == "OK":
                    return
        imap.uid("STORE", str(uid), "+FLAGS", "(\\Deleted)")
        imap.expunge()
    _run_imap(acct, _run)

            "SELECT id, label, email_addr, imap_host, imap_port, smtp_host, smtp_port, login_user, type "

@router.post("/api/mail/accounts")
async def accounts_create(request: Request):
    user = _require_user(request)
    if isinstance(user, JSONResponse):
        return user
    body = await request.json()
    acct_type = (body.get("type") or "external").strip()
    if acct_type not in ("external", "local"):
        return JSONResponse({"error": "無效的帳號類型"}, status_code=400)

    email_addr = (body.get("email_addr") or "").strip()
    label = (body.get("label") or "").strip() or email_addr
    password = body.get("password") or ""

    if acct_type == "local":
        # Self-hosted mailbox: host/port are never taken from the client —
        # always 127.0.0.1 (mail.py's IMAP/SMTP client talks to Dovecot/
        # Postfix on the same machine, never exposed to the internet). The
        # user must have already provisioned their own local_mailboxes row
        # via the "Mail Server Setup" panel (admin_mailserver.py) — this
        # form only asks for the mailbox password they set there, then
        # reuses every existing IMAP/SMTP code path unchanged.
        login_user = email_addr
        imap_host = smtp_host = "127.0.0.1"
        imap_port, smtp_port = 143, 587
        if not (email_addr and password):
            return JSONResponse({"error": "請輸入信箱地址與密碼"}, status_code=400)
    else:
        imap_host = (body.get("imap_host") or "").strip()
        smtp_host = (body.get("smtp_host") or "").strip()
        login_user = (body.get("login_user") or email_addr).strip()
        try:
            imap_port = int(body.get("imap_port") or 993)
            smtp_port = int(body.get("smtp_port") or 587)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return JSONResponse({"error": "連接埠必須是數字"}, status_code=400)
        if not (email_addr and imap_host and smtp_host and login_user and password):
            return JSONResponse({"error": "請完整填寫帳號資訊"}, status_code=400)

    acct = {"email_addr": email_addr, "imap_host": imap_host, "imap_port": imap_port,
            "smtp_host": smtp_host, "smtp_port": smtp_port, "login_user": login_user, "password": password}
    try:
        await asyncio.to_thread(_test_login_sync, acct)
    except Exception as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"連線失敗: {_short_err(e)}"}, status_code=400)

    with _db() as db:
        cur = db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO mail_accounts (owner, label, email_addr, imap_host, imap_port, smtp_host, smtp_port, "
            "login_user, secret, type, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (user, label, email_addr, imap_host, imap_port, smtp_host, smtp_port, login_user,
             _fernet.encrypt(password.encode()).decode(), acct_type, time.time()),
        )
        acct_id = cur.lastrowid
    return JSONResponse({"ok": True, "id": acct_id})


@router.delete("/api/mail/accounts/{acct_id}")
async def accounts_delete(acct_id: int, request: Request):
    user = _require_user(request)
    if isinstance(user, JSONResponse):
        return user
    with _db() as db:
        cur = db.execute("DELETE FROM mail_accounts WHERE id = ? AND owner = ?", (acct_id, user))
    if cur.rowcount == 0:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "找不到帳號"}, status_code=404)
    return JSONResponse({"ok": True})

@router.get("/api/mail/accounts/{acct_id}/messages/{uid}/attachments/{idx}")
async def message_attachment(acct_id: int, uid: int, idx: int, request: Request, folder: str = "INBOX"):
    user = _require_user(request)
    if isinstance(user, JSONResponse):
        return user
    acct = _get_owned_account(acct_id, user)
    if not acct:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "找不到帳號"}, status_code=404)
    try:
        result = await asyncio.to_thread(_fetch_attachment_sync, acct, folder, uid, idx)
    except Exception as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"連線失敗: {_short_err(e)}"}, status_code=502)
    if result is None:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "找不到附件"}, status_code=404)
    filename, content_type, data = result
    ascii_name = filename.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode() or "attachment"
    return Response(
        content=data, media_type=content_type or "application/octet-stream",
        headers={"Content-Disposition": f"attachment; filename=\"{ascii_name}\"; filename*=UTF-8''{quote(filename)}"},
    )


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  Send
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
@router.post("/api/mail/send")
async def mail_send(
    request: Request,
    account_id: int = Form(...),
    to: str = Form(...),
    cc: str = Form(""),
    bcc: str = Form(""),
    subject: str = Form(""),
    body: str = Form(""),
    files: list[UploadFile] = File(default=[]),
):
    user = _require_user(request)
    if isinstance(user, JSONResponse):
        return user
    acct = _get_owned_account(account_id, user)
    if not acct:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "找不到帳號"}, status_code=404)

    to_list = _split_addrs(to)
    if not to_list:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "請輸入收件人"}, status_code=400)
    cc_list = _split_addrs(cc)
    bcc_list = _split_addrs(bcc)

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = acct["email_addr"]
    msg["To"] = ", ".join(to_list)
    if cc_list:
        msg["Cc"] = ", ".join(cc_list)
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg.set_content(body or "")

    for f in files:
        if not f.filename:
            continue
        data = await f.read()
        if not data:
            continue
        content_type = f.content_type or "application/octet-stream"
        maintype, _, subtype = content_type.partition("/")
        msg.add_attachment(data, maintype=maintype or "application", subtype=subtype or "octet-stream", filename=f.filename)

    all_rcpts = to_list + cc_list + bcc_list
    try:
        await asyncio.to_thread(_smtp_send_sync, acct, msg, all_rcpts)
    except Exception as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"寄送失敗: {_short_err(e)}"}, status_code=502)
    return JSONResponse({"ok": True})

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/music.py
"""Music player — Python port of components/music.tsx (category 4, batch 4c,
the largest single file in this category at 1315 lines).

Player controls, ID3v2 tag parsing (client-side, binary — no reason to move
this server-side, it already works today by fetching the first 1MB of the
audio file in the browser and parsing it there), LRC lyric loading/parsing/
scroll-sync, the interactive lyric-pairing timestamp tool, and the LRC table
editor are all ported into static/music.js essentially line-for-line. This
module only supplies the folder listing / URL-building the client needs.

LRC save reuses viewers.py's GET/PUT /api/viewer/text verbatim — an .lrc
file is a plain text file, no new endpoint needed, same one-directional
reuse pattern as photo.py's /api/media/meta (which video_app.py, batch 4d,
will in turn reuse unchanged).
"""
import player
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, RedirectResponse

from admin_shell import NODE_PUBLIC_URL, node_get, token as _token, username as _username

router = APIRouter()

AUDIO_EXTS = {".mp3", ".wav", ".flac", ".aac", ".ogg", ".m4a", ".opus", ".wma"}
IMG_EXTS = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp", ".gif", ".bmp"}
# Central album-art / lyrics folders — matched to tracks by base filename,
# same constants (and same caveat about the historical 音樂→Music rename) as
# the original tsx.
MUSIC_IMG_DIR = "sda1/Music/img"
MUSIC_LYRIC_DIR = "sda1/Music/lyrics"

yt_music = "https://music.youtube.com/"

def _is_audio(name: str) -> bool:
    return Path(name).suffix.lower() in AUDIO_EXTS


def _base_name(name: str) -> str:
    return name.rsplit(".", 1)[0] if "." in name else name


def _download_url(path: str, tok: str) -> str:
    return f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/api/files/download?path={quote(path)}&token={tok}"


def _no_login():
    return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
