@router.get("/api/music/list")
async def music_list(request: Request, path: str = ""):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    r = await node_get(f"/api/files?path={quote(path)}", tok)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status_code=r.status_code)
    items = r.json().get("items", [])
    folders = [{"name": i["name"]} for i in items if i.get("type") == "folder"]
    tracks, lrcs = [], []
    folder_cover = None
    for i in items:
        if i.get("type") != "file":
            continue
        name = i["name"]
        rel = f"{path}/{name}" if path else name
        if _is_audio(name):
            tracks.append({
                "name": name, "path": rel, "size": i.get("size"),
                "download_url": _download_url(rel, tok),
                "lrc_url": _download_url(f"{MUSIC_LYRIC_DIR}/{_base_name(name)}.lrc", tok),
            })
        elif name.lower().endswith(".lrc"):
            lrcs.append({"name": name, "path": rel})
        elif name.lower() == "photo.jpg" and folder_cover is None:
            folder_cover = _download_url(rel, tok)
    return JSONResponse({"folders": folders, "tracks": tracks, "lrcs": lrcs, "folder_cover": folder_cover})


@router.get("/api/music/covers")
async def music_covers(request: Request):
    """One-shot listing of the central album-art folder, indexed by base
    filename (lowercased) — matches the original's startup effect."""
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    r = await node_get(f"/api/files?path={quote(MUSIC_IMG_DIR)}", tok)
    covers = {}
    if r.status_code == 200:
        for i in r.json().get("items", []):
            if i.get("type") == "file" and Path(i["name"]).suffix.lower() in IMG_EXTS:
                covers[_base_name(i["name"]).lower()] = _download_url(f"{MUSIC_IMG_DIR}/{i['name']}", tok)
    return JSONResponse({"covers": covers})

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/notification.py
"""
Vaultix NAS — device login notifications (Python side)

Source of truth for "new device login" detection lives in the Node backend
(backend/server.js): /api/login and /api/2fa/verify call recordLoginEvent()
on every successful sign-in, which resolves the device (User-Agent) and the
IP's country/city/GPS (ip-api.com, shared with the fail2ban geo lookup) and
writes a row into the `login_events` MariaDB table. The live notification
bell today ships in the React app
(frontend/src/components/widgets/LoginNotifications.tsx), which polls the
two endpoints below directly.

This module is the Python-side client for that same data, written in the
"browser -> FastAPI -> httpx -> Node backend" proxy style already used by
frontend-py/app.py. It is not imported by anything yet — plug it into
frontend-py/app.py (a couple of routes that call fetch_login_events() /
acknowledge_login_events() and render a bell in home.html) once the Python
frontend takes over this page.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass

import httpx

NODE_API = os.getenv("NODE_API", "http://127.0.0.1:3000").rstrip("/")


@dataclass
class LoginEvent:
    id: int
    ip: str | None
    device: str | None
    country: str | None
    country_code: str | None
    city: str | None
    is_new_device: bool
    seen: bool
    created_at: str | None

    @classmethod
    def from_json(cls, raw: dict) -> "LoginEvent":
        return cls(
            id=raw["id"],
            ip=raw.get("ip"),
            device=raw.get("device"),
            country=raw.get("country"),
            country_code=raw.get("countryCode"),
            city=raw.get("city"),
            is_new_device=bool(raw.get("isNewDevice")),
            seen=bool(raw.get("seen")),
            created_at=raw.get("createdAt"),
        )

    @property
    def location(self) -> str:
        if self.country and self.city:
            return f"{self.city}, {self.country}"
        if self.country:
            return self.country
        return "Private / LAN" if self.ip else "Unknown location"

    @property
    def summary(self) -> str:
        tag = "New device" if self.is_new_device else "Login"
        return f"{tag}: {self.device or 'Unknown device'} · {self.location}"


async def fetch_login_events(token: str, limit: int = 20) -> list[LoginEvent]:
    """Recent login notifications for the logged-in user, newest first."""
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10) as client:
        r = await client.get(
            f"{NODE_API}/api/notifications/logins",
            params={"limit": limit},
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
        )
    r.raise_for_status()
    return [LoginEvent.from_json(item) for item in r.json().get("events", [])]


async def acknowledge_login_events(token: str, ids: list[int] | None = None) -> None:
    """Mark notifications as seen so the bell badge count clears.

    ids=None marks every currently-unseen event as seen (same as the Node
    endpoint's default behaviour when no ids are supplied).
    """
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10) as client:
        r = await client.post(
            f"{NODE_API}/api/notifications/logins/ack",
            json={"ids": ids} if ids else {},
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
        )
    r.raise_for_status()


async def unseen_count(token: str) -> int:
    events = await fetch_login_events(token)
    return sum(1 for e in events if not e.seen)


@dataclass
class SystemAlert:
    id: int
    level: str
    source: str
    message: str
    seen: bool
    created_at: str | None

    @classmethod
    def from_json(cls, raw: dict) -> "SystemAlert":
        return cls(
            id=raw["id"],
            level=raw.get("level", "info"),
            source=raw.get("source", ""),
            message=raw.get("message", ""),
            seen=bool(raw.get("seen")),
            created_at=raw.get("createdAt"),
        )


async def fetch_system_alerts(token: str, limit: int = 20) -> list[SystemAlert]:
    """Admin-only infra alerts (e.g. the Tailscale Funnel watchdog), same
    feed the React notification bell shows via GET /api/notifications/system.
    """
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10) as client:
        r = await client.get(
            f"{NODE_API}/api/notifications/system",
            params={"limit": limit},
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
        )
    r.raise_for_status()
    return [SystemAlert.from_json(item) for item in r.json().get("alerts", [])]


async def acknowledge_system_alerts(token: str, ids: list[int] | None = None) -> None:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10) as client:
        r = await client.post(
            f"{NODE_API}/api/notifications/system/ack",
            json={"ids": ids} if ids else {},
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
        )
    r.raise_for_status()


@dataclass
class ServiceHealth:
    name: str
    ok: bool
    detail: str


# The 8 services surfaced by the React UfwWidget
# (frontend/src/components/widgets/ufwWidget.tsx): ufw, fail2ban, docker,
# pm2, ftp, sftp, smb, webdav.
_SERVICE_KEYS = ('docker', 'ftp', 'sftp', 'samba', 'webdav')
_SERVICE_LABELS = {'samba': 'smb'}


async def fetch_service_health(token: str) -> list[ServiceHealth]:
    """Check ufw / fail2ban / docker / pm2 / ftp / sftp / smb / webdav and
    report each service's actual status.

    This replaces an earlier scratch draft (a `notification.py` at the repo
    root, never wired into anything) whose condition was backwards:

        network = ["ufw", "fail2ban", "docker", "pm2", "ftp", "sftp", "smb", "webdav"]
        if network == True:   # network is a list of names, never a bool
            email.sendmessage(network[i])   # i was never defined either

    `network == True` can never be true, so the "send email" branch was
    dead code, and even if it ran, `network[i]` referenced an undefined
    index instead of iterating the list. The correct check has to look at
    each service's *own* status individually, not the list itself.
    """
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10) as client:
        ufw = (await client.get(f"{NODE_API}/api/ufw/status", headers=headers)).json()
        f2b = (await client.get(f"{NODE_API}/api/system/fail2ban", headers=headers)).json()
        svc = (await client.get(f"{NODE_API}/api/system/services", headers=headers)).json()

    results = [ServiceHealth('ufw', bool(ufw.get('active')), ufw.get('detail') or '')]

    if f2b.get('unavailable'):
        results.append(ServiceHealth('fail2ban', False, f2b.get('reason') or 'unavailable'))
    else:
        jails = f2b.get('jails', [])
        banned = sum(j.get('banned', 0) for j in jails)
        results.append(ServiceHealth('fail2ban', True, f'{len(jails)} jail(s), {banned} banned'))

    for key in _SERVICE_KEYS:
        val = svc.get(key)
        label = _SERVICE_LABELS.get(key, key)
        results.append(ServiceHealth(label, bool(val), 'running' if val else 'down'))

    pm2 = svc.get('pm2') or {}
    online, total = pm2.get('online', 0), pm2.get('total', 0)
    results.append(ServiceHealth('pm2', total > 0 and online == total, f'{online}/{total} online'))

    return results


async def unhealthy_services(token: str) -> list[ServiceHealth]:
    """Services that currently have a problem — the corrected version of
    the pseudocode's "if network has a problem, notify" check.

    Actually sending email stays server-side (backend/server.js already has
    nodemailer + sendAlertEmail() wired into system_alerts, see
    patch_funnel_watchdog_notify_email.py) so credentials are never handled
    here. This just surfaces which services are unhealthy so a Python
    frontend page can display them / decide whether to poll
    fetch_system_alerts() for a corresponding admin notification.
    """
    return [s for s in await fetch_service_health(token) if not s.ok]

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/OCR.py
"""
OCR Module — Optical Character Recognition
Uses Tesseract via pytesseract + Pillow for image preprocessing.

Requirements:
    pip install pytesseract pillow opencv-python
    Install Tesseract: https://github.com/UB-Mannheim/tesseract/wiki
    Add Tesseract to PATH or set pytesseract.pytesseract.tesseract_cmd below.
"""

import pytesseract
from PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter
import cv2
import numpy as np
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# If Tesseract is not in PATH, uncomment and set the path:
# pytesseract.pytesseract.tesseract_cmd = r"C:\Program Files\Tesseract-OCR\tesseract.exe"


def preprocess_image(image_path: str) -> Image.Image:
    """Enhance image for better OCR accuracy."""
    img = cv2.imread(image_path)
    if img is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Could not read image (unsupported format or corrupt file): {image_path}")
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)

    # Denoise
    denoised = cv2.fastNlMeansDenoising(gray, h=10)

    # Adaptive threshold — handles uneven lighting
    thresh = cv2.adaptiveThreshold(
        denoised, 255,
        cv2.ADAPTIVE_THRESH_GAUSSIAN_C,
        cv2.THRESH_BINARY, 11, 2
    )

    return Image.fromarray(thresh)


def extract_text(image_path: str, lang: str = "eng+chi_tra") -> str:
    """
    Extract text from an image file.

    Args:
        image_path: Path to the image (PNG, JPG, BMP, etc.)
        lang: Tesseract language code(s). Default: English + Traditional Chinese.
               Use "eng" for English only.
    Returns:
        Extracted text string.
    """
    path = Path(image_path)
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Image not found: {image_path}")

    processed = preprocess_image(image_path)

    config = "--oem 3 --psm 6"  # LSTM engine, assume uniform block of text
    text = pytesseract.image_to_string(processed, lang=lang, config=config)
    return text.strip()


def extract_with_confidence(image_path: str, lang: str = "eng+chi_tra") -> list[dict]:
    """
    Extract text with per-word confidence scores.

    Returns:
        List of dicts with keys: text, conf, left, top, width, height
    """
    path = Path(image_path)
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Image not found: {image_path}")

    processed = preprocess_image(image_path)
    config = "--oem 3 --psm 6"
    data = pytesseract.image_to_data(processed, lang=lang, config=config,
                                     output_type=pytesseract.Output.DICT)

    results = []
    for i, word in enumerate(data["text"]):
        conf = int(data["conf"][i])
        if word.strip() and conf > 0:
            results.append({
                "text": word,
                "conf": conf,
                "left": data["left"][i],
                "top": data["top"][i],
                "width": data["width"][i],
                "height": data["height"][i],
            })
    return results


def batch_extract(folder_path: str, lang: str = "eng+chi_tra") -> dict[str, str]:
    """
    Run OCR on all images in a folder.

    Returns:
        Dict mapping filename → extracted text.
    """
    folder = Path(folder_path)
    if not folder.is_dir():
        raise NotADirectoryError(f"Not a directory: {folder_path}")

    extensions = {".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".bmp", ".tiff", ".tif"}
    results = {}
    for file in sorted(folder.iterdir()):
        if file.suffix.lower() in extensions:
            try:
                results[file.name] = extract_text(str(file), lang=lang)
                print(f"[OK] {file.name}")
            except Exception as e:
                results[file.name] = f"[ERROR] {e}"
                print(f"[FAIL] {file.name}: {e}")
    return results


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: python OCR.py <image_path> [lang]")
        print("  lang default: eng+chi_tra (English + Traditional Chinese)")
        sys.exit(1)

    image = sys.argv[1]
    language = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "eng+chi_tra"

    print(f"Processing: {image}  lang={language}\n")
    try:
        text = extract_text(image, lang=language)
        print("=== Extracted Text ===")
        print(text)

        print("\n=== Word Confidence ===")
        words = extract_with_confidence(image, lang=language)
        for w in words:
            print(f"  [{w['conf']:3d}%] {w['text']}")
    except FileNotFoundError as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/office_workspace.py
"""Office Cowork Workspace — Python port of components/OfficeCollabWorkspace.tsx
(category 5 of the tsx->Python migration, see websites/CLAUDE.md "前端 Python+HTML
遷移拆分清單"). Self-contained module (own copies of the small NODE_API/token
helpers, same one-directional pattern as widgets.py/builtin_apps.py) so app.py
can `include_router(office_workspace.router)` without any circular import.

Scope decisions confirmed with the user 2026-08-01:
- Word/Excel are read+written server-side with real Python libraries (mammoth
  for docx->html, openpyxl for xlsx<->grid) instead of shipping mammoth.js/
  xlsx.js to the browser — no client-side parsing library, no CDN dependency.
- Editing is intentionally simplified ("先求堪用"): Word gets a plain
  contentEditable area with browser-native bold/italic/underline/list commands
  (no ~30-button toolbar, no page-layout/header-footer/table-insert UI); Excel
  gets direct cell editing + append-row/append-column (no right-click
  insert/delete-at-position context menu). Both match the original's actual
  save behavior: Word always saves as a new .html (never regenerates a real
  .docx — that's what the original did too), Excel always saves as a real
  .xlsx via openpyxl (matching the original's real xlsx regeneration).
- ONLYOFFICE integration is skipped (optional external Docker service, not
  set up); PDF gets a blob-fetch iframe preview, PowerPoint is download-only
  (both match the original exactly, since neither needs client parsing libs).

The WebDAV "open in desktop Office" + collaboration presence/tasks/notes
sidebar over the existing `/api/collab` WebSocket are ported in full — those
are the actual point of "Office Cowork".
"""
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import PurePosixPath
from urllib.parse import quote, urlparse

import bleach
import httpx
import mammoth
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, RedirectResponse
from openpyxl import Workbook, load_workbook

NODE_API = os.getenv("NODE_API", "http://127.0.0.1:3000").rstrip("/")
NODE_PUBLIC_URL = os.getenv("NODE_PUBLIC_URL", "https://raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net").rstrip("/")
COOKIE_NAME = "nas_jwt"

CATEGORY = {".docx": "doc", ".xlsx": "sheet", ".pptx": "slide", ".pdf": "pdf"}
CATEGORY_LABEL = {"doc": ("Word", "ms-word"), "sheet": ("Excel", "ms-excel"),
                   "slide": ("PowerPoint", "ms-powerpoint"), "pdf": ("PDF", "")}

router = APIRouter()


# ── auth/token helpers (self-contained copies, see module docstring) ──────
def _token(request: Request) -> str | None:
    return request.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)


def _username(token: str) -> str | None:
    import base64
    try:
        payload_b64 = token.split(".")[1]
        payload_b64 += "=" * (-len(payload_b64) % 4)
        return json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(payload_b64)).get("username")
    except Exception:
        return None


async def _node_get(path: str, token: str) -> httpx.Response:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:
        return await client.get(f"{NODE_API}{path}", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})


async def _node_upload(filename: str, content: bytes, content_type: str, target_dir: str, token: str) -> httpx.Response:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30) as client:
        return await client.post(
            f"{NODE_API}/api/files/upload",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
            data={"path": target_dir},
            files={"files": (filename, content, content_type)},
        )


def _parent_dir(rel_path: str) -> str:
    return rel_path.rsplit("/", 1)[0] if "/" in rel_path else ""


# ── document conversion ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
_ALLOWED_TAGS = ["p", "br", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6", "strong", "b", "em", "i", "u", "s",
                  "ul", "ol", "li", "table", "thead", "tbody", "tr", "td", "th", "a", "img", "blockquote", "sub", "sup"]
_ALLOWED_ATTRS = {"a": ["href", "title", "target", "rel"], "img": ["src", "alt"]}


def sanitize_html(html: str) -> str:
    return bleach.clean(html, tags=_ALLOWED_TAGS, attributes=_ALLOWED_ATTRS, strip=True)


def docx_to_html(data: bytes) -> str:
    if not data:
        return "<p>(文件是空的)</p>"
    result = mammoth.convert_to_html(io.BytesIO(data))
    return sanitize_html(result.value or "<p>(文件是空的)</p>")


def xlsx_sheet_names(data: bytes) -> list[str]:
    if not data:
        return ["Sheet1"]
    wb = load_workbook(io.BytesIO(data), data_only=True)
    return wb.sheetnames


def xlsx_to_grid(data: bytes, sheet_name: str) -> list[list[str]]:
    if not data:
        return [[""]]
    wb = load_workbook(io.BytesIO(data), data_only=True)
    ws = wb[sheet_name] if sheet_name in wb.sheetnames else wb.worksheets[0]
    grid = [["" if c.value is None else str(c.value) for c in row] for row in ws.iter_rows()]
    return grid or [[""]]


def grid_to_xlsx_bytes(grid: list[list[str]], sheet_name: str) -> bytes:
    # Strip trailing empty rows/cols before saving, same as the original.
    rows = [r[:] for r in grid]
    while rows and all(c == "" for c in rows[-1]):
        rows.pop()
    rows = [r[: max((i for i, c in enumerate(r) if c != ""), default=-1) + 1] for r in rows]

    wb = Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = (sheet_name or "Sheet1")[:31]
    for row in rows:
        ws.append(row)
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    wb.save(buf)
    return buf.getvalue()


# ── WebDAV helpers (adapted from components_py/pannel/office/office_common.py —
# same self-test that catches the historical "Office silently didn't upload"
# incident; kept here as a self-contained copy, see module docstring) ──────
def webdav_url(rel_path: str) -> str:
    segments = "/".join(quote(p) for p in rel_path.strip("/").split("/") if p)
    return f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/webdav/{segments}"


async def check_webdav_ready() -> dict:
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=5) as client:
            r = await client.request("OPTIONS", f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/webdav/")
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"無法連線 WebDAV: {e}"}
    allow = {m.strip().upper() for m in r.headers.get("allow", "").split(",")}
    missing = {"LOCK", "UNLOCK", "PUT"} - allow
    if missing:
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"WebDAV 缺少方法: {', '.join(sorted(missing))}（會導致 Office 回報「已封鎖」且編輯不會上傳）"}
    return {"ok": True}


def collab_ws_url(token: str) -> str:
    parsed = urlparse(NODE_PUBLIC_URL)
    scheme = "wss" if parsed.scheme == "https" else "ws"
    return f"{scheme}://{parsed.netloc}/api/collab?token={quote(token)}"


# ── HTML builders (raw string, per the 2026-08-01 no-Jinja2-for-new-code policy) ──
def _esc(s: str) -> str:
    return (s or "").replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;").replace('"', "&quot;")


def _sidebar(docs: list[dict], active_path: str) -> str:
    if not docs:
        return '<p class="hint" style="padding:12px">此資料夾沒有 Office 檔案</p>'
    rows = []
    for d in docs:
        label = CATEGORY_LABEL[d["category"]][0]
        active = " active" if d["path"] == active_path else ""
        rows.append(
            f'<a class="office-doc-row{active}" href="/office/edit?path={quote(d["path"])}">'
            f'<span class="office-doc-name">{_esc(d["name"])}</span>'
            f'<span class="office-doc-meta">{label}</span></a>'
        )
    return "".join(rows)


def _toolbar_html(category: str) -> str:
    if category != "doc":
        return ""
    return """
    <div class="office-toolbar hidden" id="wordToolbar">
      <button class="btn-mini" data-cmd="bold"><b>B</b></button>
      <button class="btn-mini" data-cmd="italic"><i>I</i></button>
      <button class="btn-mini" data-cmd="underline"><u>U</u></button>
      <button class="btn-mini" data-cmd="insertUnorderedList">• List</button>
      <button class="btn-mini" data-cmd="insertOrderedList">1. List</button>
    </div>
    """


def _doc_area(doc: dict, html: str, sheet_names: list[str], active_sheet: str, grid: list[list[str]]) -> str:
    category = doc["category"]
    if category == "pdf":
        return '<div id="pdfHost" class="office-pdf-host"><p class="hint">載入中...</p></div>'
    if category == "slide":
        return ('<div class="office-empty"><p>PowerPoint 無法在瀏覽器預覽</p>'
                '<p class="hint">請下載後用桌面版 PowerPoint 開啟</p></div>')
    if category == "sheet":
        tabs = "".join(
            f'<a class="sheet-tab{" active" if s == active_sheet else ""}" '
            f'href="/office/edit?path={quote(doc["path"])}&sheet={quote(s)}">{_esc(s)}</a>'
            for s in sheet_names
        )
        rows = "".join(
            "<tr>" + "".join(f'<td data-r="{ri}" data-c="{ci}"><span class="cell-text">{_esc(cell)}</span></td>'
                              for ci, cell in enumerate(row)) + "</tr>"
            for ri, row in enumerate(grid)
        )
        return f"""
    <div class="sheet-tabs">{tabs}</div>
    <div class="sheet-scroll"><table class="sheet-table" id="sheetTable">{rows}</table></div>
    <div class="sheet-actions hidden" id="sheetActions">
      <button class="btn-secondary" id="btnAddRow">+ 列</button>
      <button class="btn-secondary" id="btnAddCol">+ 欄</button>
    </div>
    """
    # doc (Word)
    return f'<div id="docArea" class="office-doc-surface">{html}</div>'


def page_html(*, username: str, path: str, docs: list[dict], doc: dict | None,
              html: str, sheet_names: list[str], active_sheet: str, grid: list[list[str]],
              webdav: dict, collab_url: str, download_url: str, error: str = "") -> str:
    if not doc:
        empty_msg = f'<p style="color:var(--error)">{_esc(error)}</p>' if error else '<p class="hint">從左側清單挑選一個檔案</p>'
        body = f'<div class="office-empty"><p>沒有開啟中的 Office 檔案</p>{empty_msg}</div>'
        header_meta = ""
        toolbar = ""
        actions = ""
        collab_panel = ""
    else:
        category = doc["category"]
        label, scheme = CATEGORY_LABEL[category]
        open_url = f"{scheme}:ofe|u|{webdav_url(doc['path'])}" if scheme else ""
        header_meta = f"{label} · {doc.get('size_h', '-')}"
        toolbar = _toolbar_html(category)
        edit_toggle = (
            '<button class="btn-secondary" id="btnEditToggle">📝 編輯模式</button>'
            '<button class="btn-primary hidden" id="btnSave">💾 儲存</button>'
        ) if category in ("doc", "sheet") else ""
        webdav_warn = (
            f'<div class="office-warn">⚠️ {_esc(webdav["error"])}</div>' if not webdav.get("ok") else ""
        )
        actions = f"""
        <div class="office-actions">
          <a class="btn-primary" href="{download_url}" target="_blank">下載</a>
          {f'<a class="btn-secondary" href="{open_url}">用 {label} 開啟</a>' if open_url else ''}
          {f'<button class="btn-secondary" id="btnCopyWebdav" data-url="{webdav_url(doc["path"])}">複製 WebDAV 連結</button>' if scheme else ''}
          <button class="btn-secondary" id="btnCollabLink">建立協作連結</button>
          {edit_toggle}
        </div>
        {webdav_warn}
        """
        body = _doc_area(doc, html, sheet_names, active_sheet, grid)
        collab_panel = """
        <aside class="office-collab">
          <div class="collab-head">
            <span class="section-label">協作者</span>
            <span id="collabStatus" class="hint">連線中...</span>
          </div>
          <div id="collabUsers" class="collab-users"></div>
          <div class="collab-body">
            <section>
              <div class="collab-sec-head"><h4>待辦</h4><span id="taskCount" class="hint"></span></div>
              <form id="taskForm" class="collab-form">
                <input id="taskInput" placeholder="新增待辦事項"/>
                <button class="btn-primary" type="submit">新增</button>
              </form>
              <div id="taskList" class="collab-list"></div>
            </section>
            <section>

# ── routes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async def _list_docs(path: str, token: str) -> list[dict]:
    r = await _node_get(f"/api/files?path={quote(path)}", token)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return []
    items = r.json().get("items", [])
    docs = []
    for i in items:
        if i.get("type") != "file":
            continue
        ext = PurePosixPath(i["name"]).suffix.lower()
        category = CATEGORY.get(ext)
        if not category:
            continue
        rel = f"{path}/{i['name']}" if path else i["name"]
        docs.append({"name": i["name"], "path": rel, "category": category, "size": i.get("size")})
    return docs


@router.get("/office/edit", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def office_edit_page(request: Request, path: str = "", sheet: str = ""):
    token = _token(request)
    user = _username(token) if token else None
    if not user:
        return RedirectResponse("/login", status_code=302)

    folder = _parent_dir(path) if path else ""
    docs, doc, error = [], None, ""
    html_content, sheet_names, active_sheet, grid = "", [], "", []
    webdav, download_url, collab_url = {"ok": True}, "", ""

    try:
        docs = await _list_docs(folder, token)
        doc = next((d for d in docs if d["path"] == path), None) if path else None

        if doc and doc["category"] in ("doc", "sheet"):
            r = await _node_get(f"/api/files/download?path={quote(doc['path'])}&token={token}", token)
            data = r.content if r.status_code == 200 else b""
            if doc["category"] == "doc":
                html_content = docx_to_html(data)
            else:
                sheet_names = xlsx_sheet_names(data)
                active_sheet = sheet if sheet in sheet_names else (sheet_names[0] if sheet_names else "Sheet1")
                grid = xlsx_to_grid(data, active_sheet)

        if doc:
            webdav = await check_webdav_ready() if doc["category"] != "pdf" else {"ok": True}
            download_url = f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/api/files/download?path={quote(doc['path'])}&token={token}"
            collab_url = collab_ws_url(token)
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        error = f"無法連線後端: {e}"
        doc = None

    html = page_html(username=user, path=folder, docs=docs, doc=doc, html=html_content,
                      sheet_names=sheet_names, active_sheet=active_sheet, grid=grid,
                      webdav=webdav, collab_url=collab_url, download_url=download_url, error=error)
    return HTMLResponse(html)


@router.post("/office/edit/save-doc")
async def save_doc(request: Request):
    token = _token(request)
    if not token:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    body = await request.json()
    path, html = body.get("path", ""), body.get("html", "")
    if not path:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "缺少 path"}, status_code=400)
    safe_html = sanitize_html(html)
    doc = f"<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='utf-8'></head><body>{safe_html}</body></html>"
    filename = PurePosixPath(path).stem + ".html"
    try:
        r = await _node_upload(filename, doc.encode("utf-8"), "text/html;charset=utf-8", _parent_dir(path), token)
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    if r.status_code not in (200, 201):
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"上傳失敗 HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status_code=r.status_code)
    return JSONResponse({"ok": True, "savedAs": filename})


@router.post("/office/edit/save-sheet")
async def save_sheet(request: Request):
    token = _token(request)
    if not token:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    body = await request.json()
    path, sheet_name, grid = body.get("path", ""), body.get("sheetName", "Sheet1"), body.get("grid", [])
    if not path:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "缺少 path"}, status_code=400)
    try:
        data = grid_to_xlsx_bytes(grid, sheet_name)
    except Exception as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法產生 xlsx: {e}"}, status_code=400)
    filename = PurePosixPath(path).name
    try:
        r = await _node_upload(filename, data,
                                "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
                                _parent_dir(path), token)
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    if r.status_code not in (200, 201):
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"上傳失敗 HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status_code=r.status_code)
    return JSONResponse({"ok": True})


@router.post("/office/edit/share")
async def create_share(request: Request):
    token = _token(request)
    if not token:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    body = await request.json()
    path = body.get("path", "")
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:
            r = await client.post(f"{NODE_API}/api/shares",
                                   headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
                                   json={"path": path, "permission": "edit"})
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/pannel/office/excel.py
# Excel 檔案清單／開啟連結（透過 office_common 的 WebDAV 橋接連到桌面版 Excel）
# GET /office/excel?path=<資料夾>&token=<jwt>

import httpx
from aiohttp import web

from .office_common import NODE_API, NODE_PUBLIC_URL, check_webdav_ready, list_office_files

EXTS = {".xlsx"}


async def excel_files(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
    path = request.query.get("path", "")
    token = request.query.get("token", "")
    if not token:
        return web.json_response({"ok": False, "error": "未登入"}, status=401)

    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:
            r = await client.get(
                f"{NODE_API}/api/files",
                params={"path": path},
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
            )
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return web.json_response({"ok": False, "error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status=502)

    if r.status_code != 200:
        return web.json_response({"ok": False, "error": f"HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status=r.status_code)

    items = r.json().get("items", [])
    files = list_office_files(items, path, token, NODE_PUBLIC_URL, exts=EXTS)
    webdav = await check_webdav_ready(NODE_PUBLIC_URL)
    return web.json_response({"ok": True, "path": path, "files": files, "webdav": webdav})


def register(app: web.Application) -> None:
    app.router.add_get("/office/excel", excel_files)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/pannel/office/office_common.py
# 我希望可以能夠透過嫁接的形式連線到 microsoft office
# 所有檔案都可以打開到 word, excel, powerpoint.
# 之前連線成功過，但是疑似並未上傳導致資料遺失

"""
Shared "graft onto desktop Office via WebDAV" helpers for the office panel
(word.py / excel.py / powerpoint.py all import from here).

Office is not opened by download + re-upload. An `ms-word:ofe|u|<url>` style URI
hands desktop Office the Node backend's WebDAV endpoint (backend/webdav.js)
directly, so Office edits and PUTs the file straight onto the NAS.
"""

import os
from pathlib import PurePosixPath
from urllib.parse import quote

import httpx

# Same env vars / defaults as frontend-py/app.py, so both frontends agree on
# where the Node backend and its browser-facing (WebDAV-capable) URL are.
NODE_API = os.getenv("NODE_API", "http://127.0.0.1:3000").rstrip("/")
NODE_PUBLIC_URL = os.getenv("NODE_PUBLIC_URL", "https://raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net").rstrip("/")
WEBDAV_PREFIX = "/webdav"

# ext -> (display label, ms-office URI scheme)
OFFICE_EXT: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {
    ".docx": ("Word", "ms-word"),
    ".xlsx": ("Excel", "ms-excel"),
    ".pptx": ("PowerPoint", "ms-powerpoint"),
}


def office_app(ext: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    """(label, uri_scheme) for a file extension, or None if it isn't an Office file."""
    return OFFICE_EXT.get(ext.lower())


def webdav_url(rel_path: str, base: str = NODE_PUBLIC_URL) -> str:
    """Browser-facing WebDAV URL Office connects to. Quoted per path segment so
    spaces/CJK names (e.g. 文件/報告.docx) survive."""
    segments = "/".join(quote(p) for p in rel_path.strip("/").split("/") if p)
    return f"{base}{WEBDAV_PREFIX}/{segments}"


def open_uri(scheme: str, url: str) -> str:
    """`ms-word:ofe|u|<url>` — hands the file to desktop Office for direct WebDAV
    editing instead of triggering a plain download."""
    return f"{scheme}:ofe|u|{url}"


def list_office_files(items, path, token, node_public_url=NODE_PUBLIC_URL, exts=None):
    """Filter an `/api/files` listing down to Office documents with download/open
    links attached. `exts` (e.g. {".docx"}) lets word.py/excel.py/powerpoint.py
    each show only their own file type."""
    out = []
    for i in items:
        if i.get("type") != "file":
            continue
        ext = PurePosixPath(i["name"]).suffix.lower()
        app = office_app(ext)
        if not app or (exts and ext not in exts):
            continue
        label, scheme = app
        rel = f"{path}/{i['name']}" if path else i["name"]
        out.append({
            "name": i["name"],
            "label": label,
            "size": i.get("size"),
            "download_url": f"{node_public_url}/api/files/download?path={quote(rel)}&token={token}",
            "open_url": open_uri(scheme, webdav_url(rel, node_public_url)),
        })
    return out


async def check_webdav_ready(node_public_url: str = NODE_PUBLIC_URL, timeout: float = 5.0) -> dict:
    """
    Self-test the WebDAV bridge before handing a user an `open_url`.

    Root cause of the earlier "connected, but nothing was actually uploaded"
    data loss: the backend didn't answer WebDAV `LOCK`, so desktop Office
    silently opened a local, disconnected copy — edits never left the machine
    and looked "saved" right up until the file was closed. Confirming `LOCK`/
    `UNLOCK`/`PUT` are advertised here lets a panel warn the user up front
    instead of the file quietly failing to sync again.
    """
    url = f"{node_public_url}{WEBDAV_PREFIX}/"
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=timeout) as client:
            r = await client.request("OPTIONS", url)
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"無法連線 WebDAV: {e}"}

    allow = {m.strip().upper() for m in r.headers.get("allow", "").split(",")}
    missing = {"LOCK", "UNLOCK", "PUT"} - allow
    if missing:
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"WebDAV 缺少方法: {', '.join(sorted(missing))}（會導致 Office 回報「已封鎖」且編輯不會上傳）"}
    return {"ok": True}


async def verify_saved(rel_path: str, token: str, expected_size: int | None = None,
                        node_public_url: str = NODE_PUBLIC_URL, timeout: float = 10.0) -> dict:
    """
    Confirm a file is actually on the NAS after Office reports "saved".

    Office's WebDAV PUT finishes a moment after its own "saved" UI state, so a
    naive "it said saved" assumption is exactly how the earlier data loss went
    unnoticed. Re-checking the file through the normal authenticated API (not
    WebDAV) and comparing size lets a caller (e.g. a "close and verify" step)
    tell the user their edit truly made it to disk.
    """
    url = f"{node_public_url}/api/files/download?path={quote(rel_path)}&token={token}"
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=timeout) as client:
            r = await client.head(url)
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"無法確認上傳狀態: {e}"}

    if r.status_code != 200:
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"檔案不存在於 NAS（HTTP {r.status_code}）— 可能尚未上傳成功"}

    size = int(r.headers.get("content-length", -1))
    if expected_size is not None and size != expected_size:
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"檔案大小不符（NAS={size}，預期={expected_size}）— 上傳可能未完成"}

    return {"ok": True, "size": size}

"""Photo gallery + Media Timeline + MetaPanel — Python port of components/
photo.tsx, components/timeline.tsx and viewers/MetaPanel.tsx (category 4,
sub-batch 4b).

MetaPanel ships here (not with viewers.py's PDF/Text viewers from 4a) because
it's a side panel that only makes sense attached to a photo/video item, not a
generic file — photo.tsx is its first real consumer. viewers/VideoPlayer.tsx
(batch 4d) reuses the same /api/media/meta proxy + static/meta_panel.js
rather than re-implementing it, mirroring the established one-directional
reuse pattern (e.g. reels.py calling locker.py's webauthn endpoints).

# ── API: file listing (photo-filtered) ────────────────────
@router.get("/api/photo/list")
async def photo_list(request: Request, path: str = ""):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    r = await node_get(f"/api/files?path={quote(path)}", tok)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status_code=r.status_code)
    items = r.json().get("items", [])
    folders = [{"name": i["name"]} for i in items if i.get("type") == "folder"]
    photos = []
    for i in items:
        if i.get("type") != "file" or not _is_photo(i["name"]):
            continue
        rel = f"{path}/{i['name']}" if path else i["name"]
        photos.append({"name": i["name"], "path": rel, "size": i.get("size"),
                        "download_url": _download_url(rel, tok)})
    return JSONResponse({"folders": folders, "photos": photos})


# ── API: timeline (all photos/videos across the user's tree, grouped) ─────
@router.get("/api/photo/timeline")
async def photo_timeline(request: Request):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    r = await node_get("/api/files/timeline", tok)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status_code=r.status_code)
    groups = r.json().get("groups", [])
    for g in groups:
        for item in g.get("items", []):
            item["download_url"] = _download_url(item["path"], tok)
            item["is_video"] = Path(item["name"]).suffix.lower() in VIDEO_EXTS_TIMELINE
    return JSONResponse({"groups": groups})


# ── API: media metadata (tags/location/category/note) — MetaPanel ─────────
@router.get("/api/media/meta")
async def media_meta_get(request: Request, path: str):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    r = await node_get(f"/api/media/meta?path={quote(path)}", tok)
    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)


@router.post("/api/media/meta")
async def media_meta_save(request: Request):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    body = await request.json()
    return await node_json("POST", "/api/media/meta", tok, body)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/pwd_2FA_check.py
"""
pwd_2FA_check.py — Unified two-factor authentication for Vaultix NAS (Python frontend).
Module name `pwd_2FA_check` is a valid identifier → `from pwd_2FA_check import TwoFactor`.

FOUR verification methods, all in this one module:
    1. TOTP code         — authenticator-app code (Google Authenticator, Authy, …)
    2. QR code           — enrollment: renders the otpauth:// URI as a scannable QR
    3. Phone fingerprint ┐  both are WebAuthn *platform* authenticators — the SAME
    4. Windows Hello     ┘  server code path; the browser performs the biometric.

Design notes
------------
- Web-oriented: NO input(). Import the `TwoFactor` class into the FastAPI frontend
  (frontend-py/app.py) and wire each method to a route. The browser does the biometric
  for methods 3/4 via `navigator.credentials`; this module only issues challenges and
  verifies responses.
- Self-contained: TOTP secrets + WebAuthn credentials live in a local SQLite DB.
- Keyed by `username` (the caller passes the logged-in user).
- Enrollment QR / secret expires after `provision_ttl` seconds (default 180 = 3 min):
  a provisioned-but-not-yet-enabled secret can't be confirmed after it lapses.
- This is a SEPARATE 2FA store from the Node backend's own 2FA (by design, per the
  "Python owns 2FA" request). Existing Node enrollments do not carry over.

Dependencies:  pip install pyotp "qrcode[pil]" webauthn
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import io
import json
import os
import sqlite3
import time

import pyotp
import qrcode
from cryptography.fernet import Fernet

from webauthn import (
    generate_registration_options,
    verify_registration_response,
    generate_authentication_options,
    verify_authentication_response,
    options_to_json,
)
from webauthn.helpers import bytes_to_base64url, base64url_to_bytes
from webauthn.helpers.structs import (
    AuthenticatorSelectionCriteria,
    AuthenticatorAttachment,
    ResidentKeyRequirement,
    UserVerificationRequirement,
    PublicKeyCredentialDescriptor,
)


class TwoFactor:
    # NOTE: the user asked for 4-digit TOTP, but standard authenticator apps only
    # display 6 digits. Change to 4 ONLY if your app supports non-standard digits.
    TOTP_DIGITS = 6

    def __init__(
        self,
        db_path: str = "2fa.db",
        rp_id: str = "localhost",
        rp_name: str = "Vaultix NAS",
        origin: str = "http://localhost:8001",
        challenge_ttl: int = 300,
        provision_ttl: int = 180,   # enrollment QR/secret valid for 3 minutes
        secret_key: str | bytes | None = None,
    ):
        """
        rp_id      : the site's domain WITHOUT scheme/port, e.g. "raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net"
        origin     : full origin the browser sees, e.g. "https://raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net:8444"
        secret_key : Fernet key for encrypting TOTP secrets at rest (see _load_key).
        """
        self.db_path = db_path
        self.rp_id = rp_id
        self.rp_name = rp_name
        self.origin = origin
        self.challenge_ttl = challenge_ttl
        self.provision_ttl = provision_ttl
        self._fernet = Fernet(self._load_key(secret_key))
        self._challenges: dict[str, tuple[bytes, float]] = {}  # username -> (challenge, expiry)
        self._init_db()

    # ── at-rest encryption for TOTP secrets ──────────────
    def _load_key(self, secret_key) -> bytes:
        """Fernet key priority: explicit arg → env TFA_KEY → a key file beside the DB
        (auto-created, chmod 600). In-memory DBs get an ephemeral per-process key."""
        if secret_key:
            return secret_key.encode() if isinstance(secret_key, str) else secret_key
        env = os.environ.get("TFA_KEY")
        if env:
            return env.encode()
        key_path = None if self.db_path == ":memory:" else self.db_path + ".key"
        if key_path and os.path.exists(key_path):
            return open(key_path, "rb").read()
        key = Fernet.generate_key()
        if key_path:
            with open(key_path, "wb") as f:
                f.write(key)
            try:
                os.chmod(key_path, 0o600)
            except OSError:
                pass
        return key

    def _enc(self, secret: str) -> str:
        return self._fernet.encrypt(secret.encode()).decode()

    def _dec(self, token: str) -> str:
        return self._fernet.decrypt(token.encode()).decode()

    # ── storage ──────────────────────────────────────────
    def _db(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        return conn

    def _init_db(self) -> None:
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS totp (
                    username      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    secret        TEXT NOT NULL,
                    enabled       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    provisioned_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
                )
            """)
            db.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webauthn_creds (
                    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    username      TEXT NOT NULL,
                    credential_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,   -- base64url
                    public_key    TEXT NOT NULL,          -- base64url
                    sign_count    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    label         TEXT,
                    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                )
            """)

    # ── challenge cache (options → verify) ───────────────
    def _put_challenge(self, username: str, challenge: bytes) -> None:
        self._challenges[username] = (challenge, time.time() + self.challenge_ttl)

    def _pop_challenge(self, username: str) -> bytes:
        item = self._challenges.pop(username, None)
        if not item or item[1] < time.time():
            raise ValueError("challenge expired or missing — restart the flow")
        return item[0]

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    #  Method 1 & 2 — TOTP  (+ QR code for enrollment)
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    def totp_provision(self, username: str) -> dict:
        """Create/replace a TOTP secret (disabled until confirmed) and return the
        otpauth URI + a scannable QR code (PNG data-URI). Method 2 = the QR.
        The QR/secret must be confirmed within `provision_ttl` seconds."""
        secret = pyotp.random_base32()
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO totp (username, secret, enabled, provisioned_at) VALUES (?, ?, 0, ?) "
                "ON CONFLICT(username) DO UPDATE SET secret = excluded.secret, "
                "enabled = 0, provisioned_at = excluded.provisioned_at",
                (username, self._enc(secret), time.time()),
            )
        uri = pyotp.TOTP(secret, digits=self.TOTP_DIGITS).provisioning_uri(
            name=username, issuer_name=self.rp_name
        )
        return {"secret": secret, "uri": uri, "qr": self._qr_data_uri(uri),
                "expires_in": self.provision_ttl}

    def totp_enable(self, username: str, code: str) -> bool:
        """Confirm enrollment: verify the first code within the QR validity window,
        then mark enabled."""
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute(
                "SELECT secret, provisioned_at FROM totp WHERE username = ?", (username,)
            ).fetchone()
        if not row:
            return False
        if time.time() - row["provisioned_at"] > self.provision_ttl:
            return False  # QR expired — call totp_provision again
        if not pyotp.TOTP(self._dec(row["secret"]), digits=self.TOTP_DIGITS).verify(
            str(code).replace(" ", ""), valid_window=1
        ):
            return False
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute("UPDATE totp SET enabled = 1 WHERE username = ?", (username,))
        return True

    def totp_verify(self, username: str, code: str) -> bool:
        """Method 1 — verify a TOTP code at login (must be enabled)."""
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute(
                "SELECT secret, enabled FROM totp WHERE username = ?", (username,)
            ).fetchone()
        if not row or not row["enabled"]:
            return False
        return pyotp.TOTP(self._dec(row["secret"]), digits=self.TOTP_DIGITS).verify(
            str(code).replace(" ", ""), valid_window=1
        )

    def totp_disable(self, username: str) -> None:
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute("DELETE FROM totp WHERE username = ?", (username,))

    def totp_status(self, username: str) -> bool:
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute(
                "SELECT enabled FROM totp WHERE username = ?", (username,)
            ).fetchone()
        return bool(row and row["enabled"])

    @staticmethod
    def _qr_data_uri(data: str) -> str:
        img = qrcode.make(data)
        buf = io.BytesIO()
        img.save(buf, format="PNG")
        b64 = base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()
        return f"data:image/png;base64,{b64}"

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    #  Method 3 & 4 — WebAuthn  (phone fingerprint / Windows Hello)
    #  Same code path; both are *platform* authenticators. `label` lets the
    #  caller name the device (e.g. "iPhone", "Windows Hello").
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    def webauthn_register_options(self, username: str) -> str:
        """Return registration options (JSON string) for the browser to pass to
        navigator.credentials.create(). Platform authenticator = built-in biometric."""
        existing = self._get_creds(username)
        opts = generate_registration_options(
            rp_id=self.rp_id,
            rp_name=self.rp_name,
            user_name=username,
            user_id=username.encode(),
            exclude_credentials=[
                PublicKeyCredentialDescriptor(id=base64url_to_bytes(c["credential_id"]))
                for c in existing
            ],
            authenticator_selection=AuthenticatorSelectionCriteria(
                authenticator_attachment=AuthenticatorAttachment.PLATFORM,
                resident_key=ResidentKeyRequirement.PREFERRED,
                user_verification=UserVerificationRequirement.REQUIRED,
            ),
        )
        self._put_challenge(username, opts.challenge)
        return options_to_json(opts)

    def webauthn_register_verify(self, username: str, credential, label: str | None = None) -> bool:
        """Verify navigator.credentials.create() result and store the credential.
        `credential` = the JSON (str or dict) the browser returned."""
        challenge = self._pop_challenge(username)
        verification = verify_registration_response(
            credential=credential,
            expected_challenge=challenge,
            expected_rp_id=self.rp_id,
            expected_origin=self.origin,
            require_user_verification=True,
        )
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO webauthn_creds "
                "(username, credential_id, public_key, sign_count, label) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (
                    username,
                    bytes_to_base64url(verification.credential_id),
                    bytes_to_base64url(verification.credential_public_key),
                    verification.sign_count,
                    label,
                ),
            )
        return True

    def webauthn_auth_options(self, username: str) -> str:
        """Return authentication options (JSON string) for navigator.credentials.get()."""
        creds = self._get_creds(username)
        if not creds:
            raise ValueError("no registered authenticator for this user")
        opts = generate_authentication_options(
            rp_id=self.rp_id,
            allow_credentials=[
                PublicKeyCredentialDescriptor(id=base64url_to_bytes(c["credential_id"]))
                for c in creds
            ],
            user_verification=UserVerificationRequirement.REQUIRED,
        )
        self._put_challenge(username, opts.challenge)
        return options_to_json(opts)

    def webauthn_auth_verify(self, username: str, credential) -> bool:
        """Verify navigator.credentials.get() result at login; bump the sign counter."""
        challenge = self._pop_challenge(username)
        cred_dict = credential if isinstance(credential, dict) else json.loads(credential)
        row = self._get_cred_by_id(cred_dict["id"])
        if not row or row["username"] != username:
            return False
        verification = verify_authentication_response(
            credential=credential,
            expected_challenge=challenge,
            expected_rp_id=self.rp_id,
            expected_origin=self.origin,
            credential_public_key=base64url_to_bytes(row["public_key"]),
            credential_current_sign_count=row["sign_count"],
            require_user_verification=True,
        )
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute(
                "UPDATE webauthn_creds SET sign_count = ? WHERE credential_id = ?",
                (verification.new_sign_count, row["credential_id"]),
            )
        return True

    def webauthn_status(self, username: str) -> dict:
        creds = self._get_creds(username)
        return {
            "registered": len(creds) > 0,
            # credential_id included so the settings-page device list can
            # target a specific credential for webauthn_remove() — device
            # rows are otherwise indistinguishable when a user has more
            # than one enrolled (e.g. desktop + phone).
            "devices": [{"label": c["label"], "created_at": c["created_at"],
                         "credential_id": c["credential_id"]} for c in creds],
        }

    def webauthn_remove(self, username: str, credential_id: str) -> bool:
        """Delete one enrolled credential. Scoped to `username` so a caller can't
        remove another user's device by guessing/reusing a credential_id."""
        with self._db() as db:
            cur = db.execute(
                "DELETE FROM webauthn_creds WHERE username = ? AND credential_id = ?",
                (username, credential_id),
            )
            return cur.rowcount > 0

    def _get_creds(self, username: str) -> list[dict]:
        with self._db() as db:
            return [dict(r) for r in db.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM webauthn_creds WHERE username = ?", (username,)
            ).fetchall()]

    def _get_cred_by_id(self, credential_id: str) -> dict | None:
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM webauthn_creds WHERE credential_id = ?", (credential_id,)
            ).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row else None


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Quick offline self-test for the TOTP path (no browser needed).
    tf = TwoFactor(db_path=":memory:")
    info = tf.totp_provision("demo")
    print("otpauth URI:", info["uri"])
    code_now = pyotp.TOTP(info["secret"], digits=TwoFactor.TOTP_DIGITS).now()
    print("enable:", tf.totp_enable("demo", code_now))
    print("verify:", tf.totp_verify("demo", pyotp.TOTP(info["secret"], digits=TwoFactor.TOTP_DIGITS).now()))
    print("status:", tf.totp_status("demo"))

# ── proxy: per-app mobile pairing + file listing/upload ─────────────────
@router.get("/api/{app_id}/mobile-signal")
async def rp_mobile_signal(app_id: str, request: Request):
    if app_id not in APPS:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "not found"}, status_code=404)
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    return await node_json("GET", f"/api/{app_id}/mobile-signal", tok)


@router.get("/api/{app_id}/files")
async def rp_files(app_id: str, request: Request, path: str = ""):
    if app_id not in APPS:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "not found"}, status_code=404)
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    path = path or APPS[app_id]["defaultPath"]

    parts = path.split("/")
    name = parts.pop()
    parent = "/".join(parts)
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:
            await client.post(f"{NODE_API}/api/files/mkdir",
                               headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}"},
                               json={"path": parent, "name": name})
    except httpx.RequestError:
        pass

    try:
        r = await node_get(f"/api/files?path={quote(path)}", tok)
    except httpx.RequestError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status_code=r.status_code)

    items = []
    for i in r.json().get("items", []):
        if i.get("type") != "file":
            continue
        ext = i["name"].rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower() if "." in i["name"] else ""
        if ext not in VIDEO_EXTS:
            continue
        rel = f"{path}/{i['name']}"
        items.append({"name": i["name"], "url": f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/api/files/download?path={quote(rel)}&token={tok}"})
    return JSONResponse({"items": items})


@router.post("/api/{app_id}/upload")
async def rp_upload(app_id: str, request: Request, files: list[UploadFile] = File(...), path: str = ""):
    if app_id not in APPS:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "not found"}, status_code=404)
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    path = path or APPS[app_id]["defaultPath"]
    ok, fail = 0, 0
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30) as client:
        for f in files:
            try:
                r = await client.post(
                    f"{NODE_API}/api/files/upload",
                    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}"},
                    data={"path": path},
                    files={"files": (f.filename, await f.read(), f.content_type)},
                )
                ok += 1 if r.status_code in (200, 201) else 0
                fail += 0 if r.status_code in (200, 201) else 1
            except httpx.RequestError:
                fail += 1
    return JSONResponse({"ok": ok, "fail": fail})

@router.get("/api/share/{token_str}/download")
async def share_download_get(request: Request, token_str: str, path: str = "", shareJwt: str = ""):
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=60) as client:
        try:
            url = f"{NODE_API}/api/share/{quote(token_str)}/download?path={quote(path)}&shareJwt={quote(shareJwt)}"
            req = client.build_request("GET", url)
            r = await client.send(req, stream=True)
        except httpx.RequestError as e:
            return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)

    headers = {}
    for k in ("content-disposition", "content-type", "content-length"):
        if k in r.headers:
            headers[k] = r.headers[k]

    return StreamingResponse(
        r.aiter_bytes(),
        status_code=r.status_code,
        headers=headers
    )

    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/terminal.py
"""NAS Terminal — Python port of components/terminal.tsx (sub-batch 7c, the
last and by far the largest/most complex piece of category 7 — 864 lines of
xterm.js + WebSocket PTY session/tab/window management, versus the ~120-line
"link card" panels in 7a and the iframe panel in 7b).

Two deliberate departures from a line-for-line port, both documented here and
in Index/success rather than silently dropped:

1. **Vendored xterm.js, not reimplemented, not CDN-loaded.** frontend-py's
   policy since the tsx migration started is "no client-side third-party
   libraries" (native WebAuthn instead of @simplewebauthn/browser, mammoth/
   openpyxl server-side instead of browser docx/xlsx libraries) — but a
   terminal emulator is a different class of dependency. Reimplementing
   VT100/xterm escape-sequence parsing, cursor/selection handling, and
   scrollback from scratch is not a reasonable substitute, unlike a WebAuthn
   ceremony or a docx-to-HTML converter — it's infrastructure-level
   complexity closer to a media codec. static/vendor/xterm.js and
   xterm-addon-fit.js are copied as-is from the already-installed
   frontend/node_modules/@xterm/ packages (MIT licensed, see
   static/vendor/README.md) — not fetched from a CDN, so there's no new
   runtime network dependency and no build tooling introduced.

2. **Dock/float window modes dropped; every /tools/terminal load is treated
   as the tsx's `standalone` (torn-out) mode.** The original's dock/float
   distinction only makes sense layered over home.tsx's own UI (a backdrop
   over the file manager, a draggable floating window positioned relative to
   it) — home.tsx doesn't exist in frontend-py yet (category 3, not yet
   migrated), so there's no "main window" to dock into or float over, the
   same structural reason former modals became standalone pages throughout
   this migration (Locker, Reels, Downloader, etc.). What's kept, because
   it's the terminal's actual value and has a long bug-fix history in the
   project's CLAUDE.md (cache-busted pop-out URLs, the put-back race
   condition, full-screen pop-out sizing): tabs within a window, tearing a
   tab out to a genuinely new browser window (fresh session — a live
   WebSocket/PTY can't move across OS windows, same as the original), the
   "New window" button, and "Put back" via BroadcastChannel. Every
   /tools/terminal page now always shows put-back chrome (matching the
   original TerminalPage component, which was always standalone).

Auth model: the WS relay reads the JWT from the same HttpOnly cookie every
other page uses (nas_jwt) — unlike the original tsx, which had the JWT in
localStorage and could build `wss://backend/api/terminal?token=...` directly
from the browser. Since frontend-py's cookie is HttpOnly (invisible to JS),
the browser instead opens a same-origin WebSocket to this module's own
/api/terminal/ws, which relays bidirectionally to the real backend's
/api/terminal (reading the cookie server-side, same "no double-validation"
proxy pattern Node itself used for this exact route after the backend's own
full retirement to Python, see [[server_full_retirement_plan]] Phase 5c).
The backend enforces admin-only access itself (closes non-admin connections
with code 4003) — this module does not duplicate that check, matching the
project's established "don't double-validate" convention.
"""
import asyncio
from urllib.parse import quote

import websockets
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, RedirectResponse
from websockets.exceptions import ConnectionClosed

from admin_shell import NODE_API, COOKIE_NAME, node_json, token as _token, username as _username

router = APIRouter()

    html = """<!DOCTYPE html>

  <div class="tm-window">
    <div class="tm-tabstrip" id="tmTabstrip">
      <div class="tm-tabs" id="tmTabs"></div>
      <button class="tm-tab-add" id="tmNewTab" title="New tab">+</button>

def _upstream_ws_url(tok: str) -> str:
    base = NODE_API.replace("https://", "wss://").replace("http://", "ws://").rstrip("/")
    return f"{base}/api/terminal?token={quote(tok)}"


@router.websocket("/api/terminal/ws")
async def terminal_ws_relay(websocket: WebSocket):
    """Pure bidirectional relay to the real backend's /api/terminal — no
    business logic here, the backend owns auth/role-checking/the PTY itself."""
    tok = websocket.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)
    if not tok:
        await websocket.close(code=4001)
        return
    await websocket.accept()

    close_code, close_reason = 1000, ""
    try:
        async with websockets.connect(_upstream_ws_url(tok), open_timeout=10) as upstream:
            # Each direction swallows the OTHER side's own hang-up right where it
            # happens (browser gone / upstream gone are both expected, routine
            # termination conditions, not exceptional) so no task ever finishes
            # holding an unretrieved exception, regardless of which side closes
            # first or how asyncio happens to schedule the cleanup afterwards.
            upstream_closed = {"code": 1000, "reason": ""}

            async def browser_to_upstream():
                try:
                    while True:
                        data = await websocket.receive_text()
                        await upstream.send(data)
                except WebSocketDisconnect:
                    pass
                except ConnectionClosed as e:
                    upstream_closed["code"], upstream_closed["reason"] = e.code, e.reason or ""

            async def upstream_to_browser():
                try:
                    async for msg in upstream:
                        await websocket.send_text(msg)
                except ConnectionClosed as e:
                    upstream_closed["code"], upstream_closed["reason"] = e.code, e.reason or ""

            tasks = {asyncio.create_task(browser_to_upstream()), asyncio.create_task(upstream_to_browser())}
            done, pending = await asyncio.wait(tasks, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
            for t in pending:
                t.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
            close_code, close_reason = upstream_closed["code"], upstream_closed["reason"]
    except (WebSocketDisconnect, ConnectionClosed):
        pass
    except OSError:
        close_code, close_reason = 1011, "無法連線後端終端機服務"
    except Exception:
        close_code, close_reason = 1011, "終端機連線發生錯誤"
    try:
        await websocket.close(code=close_code, reason=close_reason)
    except Exception:
        pass

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/timeline.py
# 根據現有的庫結構進行續寫，嚴禁變更
# 註解不可刪除或變更
import json, subprocess, httpx, os
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, List, Optional
from fastapi import FastAPI, Header, HTTPException
from PIL import Image, ExifTags

VIDEO_EXTS = {'mp4', 'gif', 'wav', 'avi'}

def get_media_time(filepath: str) -> float:
    """

    """
    ext = filepath.split('.')[-1].lower() if '.' in filepath else ''

    # 1. read the photo EXIF
    if ext in {'jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'heic'}:
        try:
            with Image.open(filepath) as img:
                exif = img.getexif()
                if exif:
                    exif_ifd = exif.get_ifd(ExifTags.IFD.Exif)
                    dto = exif_ifd.get(ExifTags.Base.DateTimeOriginal) or exif.get(ExifTags.Base.DateTime)
                    if dto:
                        dt = datetime.strptime(str(dto), '%Y:%m:%d %H:%M:%S')
                        return dt.timestamp()
        except Exception:
            pass
    elif ext in VIDEO_EXTS:
        try:
            cmd = ['ffprobe', '-v', 'quiet', '-print_format', 'json', '-show_format', filepath]
            res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            data = json.loads(res.stdout)
            creation_time = data.get('format', {}).get('tags', {}).get('creation_time')
            if creation_time:
                dt = datetime.fromisoformat(creation_time.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
                return dt.timestamp()
        except Exception:
            pass

    # 3. Fallback to system file revise time
    return os.path.getmtime(filepath)

the agent itself isn't deployed anywhere yet — that's unchanged by this
port and not something a frontend rewrite can fix.
"""
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse

from admin_shell import token as _token, username as _username

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/tools/remote-desktop", response_class=HTMLResponse)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/trash_manager.py
"""Trash Bin Manager — Python port of Category 3 sub-batch 3b
(TrashPanel.tsx).

Provides API proxies for trash list, restore, single item deletion, and empty trash.
Also provides route /tools/trash serving standalone trash view.
"""

from urllib.parse import quote

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse
from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates

from admin_shell import NODE_API, token as _token

router = APIRouter()
templates = Jinja2Templates(directory="templates")


@router.get("/api/trash")
async def trash_list_get(request: Request):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:
        try:
            r = await client.get(
                f"{NODE_API}/api/trash",
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}"}
            )
        except httpx.RequestError as e:
            return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)


@router.post("/api/trash/restore")
async def trash_restore_post(request: Request):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    body = await request.json()
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30) as client:
        try:
            r = await client.post(
                f"{NODE_API}/api/trash/restore",
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
                json=body
            )
        except httpx.RequestError as e:
            return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)

    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30) as client:
        try:

    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/video_app.py
"""Video browser + full-screen player — Python port of components/VideoApp.tsx
(157 lines) and viewers/VideoPlayer.tsx (855 lines, the most feature-dense
single component ported so far: speed control, subtitle auto-detect/local-
upload/AI-generate, canvas-based intro detection with localStorage caching,
resume-playback, full keyboard shortcut set). Category 4, batch 4d.

MetaPanel reuse: the info side panel is the exact same shared component
from batch 4b (static/meta_panel.js + photo.py's /api/media/meta) — per
that batch's own docstring, this is its second, already-planned consumer.
No new Python import needed here since it's wired client-side (video_player.js
calls window.MetaPanel.mount(...) the same way photo.js does); the page
just needs to load meta_panel.js.

Known pre-existing gap (not introduced by this port): the original
VideoPlayer.tsx's "AI 自動生成字幕" button calls POST /api/video/subtitle +
GET /api/video/subtitle/{jobId} (Whisper transcription job). Grepping both
the live Pi server.py and the local backend/ mirror for "video/subtitle"
finds zero matches — this endpoint was never implemented on any backend,
in Node or Python. The button has therefore never worked in production; it
already fails today with the tsx's own catch-branch ("生成失敗，請確認已安裝
Whisper"). This module proxies the same path verbatim (thin proxy, like
every other batch) so behavior is unchanged — not a regression introduced
by the migration, and not a bug this batch is scoped to fix.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, RedirectResponse

from admin_shell import NODE_PUBLIC_URL, node_get, node_json, token as _token, username as _username

router = APIRouter()

VIDEO_EXTS = {".mp4", ".mkv", ".avi", ".mov", ".webm", ".flv", ".wmv", ".m4v", ".mpg", ".mpeg", ".ts", ".3gp"}


def _is_video(name: str) -> bool:
    return Path(name).suffix.lower() in VIDEO_EXTS


def _download_url(path: str, tok: str) -> str:
    return f"{NODE_PUBLIC_URL}/api/files/download?path={quote(path)}&token={tok}"


def _no_login():
    return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)


@router.get("/tools/video", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def video_page(request: Request):

    return """<!DOCTYPE html>

  <title>Video — Vaultix NAS</title>

</head>
<body class="shell vd-shell">
  <div class="vd-header">
    <div class="vd-header-left">
      <span class="vd-icon">🎬</span>
      <h2 class="vd-title">Video</h2>
      <nav class="vd-breadcrumb" id="vdBreadcrumb"></nav>
    </div>
    <div class="vd-header-right">

    </div>
