  </div>

  <div id="vdPlayerRoot" class="hidden"></div>
  <script src="/static/meta_panel.js"></script>
  <script src="/static/video_player.js"></script>
  <script src="/static/video_app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>"""


@router.get("/api/video/list")
async def video_list(request: Request, path: str = ""):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    r = await node_get(f"/api/files?path={quote(path)}", tok)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status_code=r.status_code)
    items = r.json().get("items", [])
    folders = [{"name": i["name"]} for i in items if i.get("type") == "folder"]
    videos = []
    for i in items:
        if i.get("type") != "file" or not _is_video(i["name"]):
            continue
        rel = f"{path}/{i['name']}" if path else i["name"]
        videos.append({"name": i["name"], "path": rel, "size": i.get("size"),
                        "download_url": _download_url(rel, tok)})
    return JSONResponse({"folders": folders, "videos": videos})


# ── AI auto-subtitle (Whisper) — thin proxy, see module docstring: this
# backend path has never been implemented on either the Node or Python
# backend, so this always 404s/errors exactly like production does today. ──
@router.post("/api/video/subtitle")
async def video_subtitle_start(request: Request):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    body = await request.json()
    return await node_json("POST", "/api/video/subtitle", tok, body)


@router.get("/api/video/subtitle/{job_id}")
async def video_subtitle_status(request: Request, job_id: str):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return _no_login()
    r = await node_get(f"/api/video/subtitle/{quote(job_id)}", tok)
    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/viewers.py
"""Inline file viewers — Python port of category 4 sub-batch 4a
(viewers/PDFview.tsx, viewers/TextEditor.tsx). Both are full-screen overlays
opened from the existing generic file browser (app.py's /files, built well
before this migration batch) rather than standalone routes, so this module
only adds the API endpoints they need + the modal markup/JS injected into
files.html.

PDFview needs no new backend endpoint: /files already builds a
download_url with a query-string ?token= (see app.py's files_page()), and
that link already works standalone in an <iframe>/blob fetch because the
real backend's _IdentityMiddleware accepts auth via ?token= as well as
Authorization: Bearer (confirmed against the Pi's live server.py, which is
ahead of the checked-in websites/backend/server.py mirror).

TextEditor needs a small save endpoint since /files has no PUT proxy yet.

MetaPanel (the third file in the original sub-batch) is a side panel that
only makes sense attached to a photo/video item, not the generic file
browser — its /api/media/meta proxy + markup ship with photo.py (batch 4b)
where it's actually used, not here.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, JSONResponse

from admin_shell import NODE_API, token as _token

router = APIRouter()

# Extensions considered safe to open in the plain-text editor. Office formats
# (.docx/.xlsx/.pptx) already have their own dedicated editor (category 5,
# office_workspace.py) and are deliberately excluded here.
TEXT_EXTS = {".txt", ".md", ".csv", ".log", ".json", ".yml", ".yaml",
             ".ini", ".conf", ".sh", ".py", ".js", ".css", ".html", ".xml"}
PDF_EXTS = {".pdf"}


def open_kind(name: str) -> str | None:
    """'pdf' | 'text' | None — which inline viewer (if any) a filename opens in."""
    ext = Path(name).suffix.lower()
    if ext in PDF_EXTS:
        return "pdf"
    if ext in TEXT_EXTS:
        return "text"
    return None


@router.get("/api/viewer/text")
async def viewer_text_get(request: Request, path: str):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:
        try:
            r = await client.get(f"{NODE_API}/api/files/download?path={quote(path)}",
                                  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}"})
        except httpx.RequestError as e:
            return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"HTTP {r.status_code}"}, status_code=r.status_code)
    return PlainTextResponse(r.text)


@router.put("/api/viewer/text")
async def viewer_text_put(request: Request, path: str):
    tok = _token(request)
    if not tok:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    body = await request.body()
    if len(body) > 20 * 1024 * 1024:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "內容過大（上限 20MB）"}, status_code=413)
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20) as client:
        try:
            r = await client.put(f"{NODE_API}/api/files/content?path={quote(path)}",
                                  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}",
                                           "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8"},
                                  content=body)
        except httpx.RequestError as e:
            return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法連線後端: {e}"}, status_code=502)
    data = r.json() if r.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json") else {}
    return JSONResponse(data, status_code=r.status_code)

    ("Amethyst", "linear-gradient(135deg,#150d2a 0%,#2d1a50 50%,#1a0d3a 100%)", "#2d1a50"),
]


def background_div(css: str) -> str:
    if not css:
        return '<div id="bgLayer" class="bg-layer"></div>'
    is_url = css.startswith("/") or css.startswith("http")
    style = f"background-image:url('{css}')" if is_url else f"background:{css}"
    return f'<div id="bgLayer" class="bg-layer" style="{style}"></div>'

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/components/win_auth_login.py
# 這個是適用於 windows hello 的 2FA 登入功能
# 根據這個庫的編寫格式進行續寫，嚴禁變更或刪除
"""
win_auth_login.py — Windows Hello 授權 2FA 登入（FastAPI router，掛在 app.py）

原始草稿寫的是 `microsoft.auth`（誤以為要串 Microsoft 帳號 OAuth）；經確認後
Windows Hello 走的是瀏覽器原生 WebAuthn（navigator.credentials），伺服器端完全
不需要呼叫任何 Microsoft/Azure API——瀏覽器偵測到 platform authenticator 時，
由「作業系統本身」跳出生物辨識視窗（指紋/臉部/PIN），這一步不歸伺服器管。
跟 pwd_2FA_check.py 文件裡講的一樣：「Phone fingerprint / Windows Hello 是
同一條 WebAuthn code path（都是 platform authenticator）」——這支檔案要做的
只是把 pwd_2FA_check.TwoFactor 已經寫好的 webauthn_* 方法，接成登入流程能用
的路由，並把每一次 Windows Hello 驗證嘗試記錄到本機 sqlite（審計用，出事才
查得到是哪個 IP / 哪台裝置在嘗試）。

路由（由 app.py `include_router()` 掛載）：
    綁定（設定頁 /security，需要已登入 cookie）：
        POST /api/2fa/webauthn/register/options
        POST /api/2fa/webauthn/register/verify
        POST /api/2fa/webauthn/remove
    登入（密碼驗證通過、app.py 簽發 ticket 之後，見 app.py `/api/login`）：
        POST /api/2fa/webauthn/login/options
        POST /api/2fa/webauthn/login/verify
    稽核（自己查自己最近的 Windows Hello 登入嘗試）：
        GET  /api/2fa/webauthn/login-log

與 app.py 的耦合刻意做成單向：這支檔案在模組最上層不 import app（app.py 會
import 這支檔案來掛路由，兩邊互相 import 在模組載入當下會循環匯入失敗）。真
的需要用到 app.py 的 ticket 存放區（_pending/_peek_ticket/_set_token_cookie，
密碼驗證通過後才會產生）與 _current_user 時，改在路由函式「呼叫當下」才
import app——那時 app.py 早就已經完整載入完成，不會有循環匯入問題，這是
Python 處理雙向依賴常見的合法寫法。
"""
import json
import os
import re
import sqlite3
import time
from pathlib import Path

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from pwd_2FA_check import TwoFactor

BASE = Path(__file__).parent

# 2FA config — 跟 app.py 用同一組環境變數，指向同一個 2fa.db（webauthn 憑證表
# 由 pwd_2FA_check.TwoFactor 管理；rp_id/origin 必須跟實際服務的網域一致，否則
# 瀏覽器的 WebAuthn 會直接拒絕，這點跟 app.py 保持完全一致）。
RP_ID = os.getenv("RP_ID", "localhost")
TFA_ORIGIN = os.getenv("TFA_ORIGIN", "http://localhost:8001")
TFA_DB = os.getenv("TFA_DB", str(BASE / "2fa.db"))
tf = TwoFactor(db_path=TFA_DB, rp_id=RP_ID, rp_name="Vaultix NAS", origin=TFA_ORIGIN)

# 本機稽核紀錄——獨立於 TwoFactor 的 2fa.db，只記錄「Windows Hello 這個方法」
# 的每次登入嘗試（成功/失敗/IP/地理位置/裝置），跟 Node 後端 login_events 的
# 精神一致，但範圍窄很多：只服務這一支檔案自己的稽核需求。
LOG_DB = os.getenv("WIN_HELLO_LOG_DB", str(BASE / "win_hello_login_log.db"))

router = APIRouter()


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  本機稽核紀錄（sqlite）
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def _log_db() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(LOG_DB)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS win_hello_attempts (
            id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            username   TEXT NOT NULL,
            success    INTEGER NOT NULL,
            ip         TEXT,
            city       TEXT,
            country    TEXT,
            device     TEXT,
            created_at REAL NOT NULL
        )
    """)
    return conn


def _client_ip(request: Request) -> str:
    # 跟 server.js 同一套慣例：Tailscale Funnel／反向代理後面優先信任 X-Forwarded-For。
    xff = request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for", "")
    if xff:
        return xff.split(",")[0].strip()
    return request.client.host if request.client else ""


_PRIVATE_IP_RE = re.compile(
    r"^(127\.|10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[0-1])\.|100\.6[4-9]\.|100\.[7-9]\d\.|100\.1[01]\d\.|::1$|localhost$)"
)


def _describe_device(user_agent: str) -> str:
    """輕量 User-Agent 解析（瀏覽器＋作業系統），跟 server.js 的 describeDevice() 同款規則。"""
    ua = user_agent or ""
    browser = "瀏覽器"
    for name, pattern in (("Edge", r"Edg/"), ("Chrome", r"Chrome/"), ("Firefox", r"Firefox/"), ("Safari", r"Safari/")):
        if re.search(pattern, ua):
            browser = name
            break
    os_name = "OS"
    for name, pattern in (("Windows", r"Windows"), ("macOS", r"Mac OS X"), ("Linux", r"Linux"),
                           ("Android", r"Android"), ("iOS", r"iPhone|iPad")):
        if re.search(pattern, ua):
            os_name = name
            break
    return f"{browser} / {os_name}"


async def _geo_lookup(ip: str) -> dict:
    """跟 server.js geoLookupBatch() 同一套免金鑰 ip-api.com 查詢；私有/內網位址
    直接跳過（必定查不到，且沒必要浪費額度）；查詢失敗完全不影響登入本身。"""
    if not ip or _PRIVATE_IP_RE.match(ip):
        return {}
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=3) as client:
            r = await client.get(f"http://ip-api.com/json/{ip}", params={"fields": "status,country,city"})
        data = r.json()
        if data.get("status") == "success":
            return {"country": data.get("country", ""), "city": data.get("city", "")}
    except httpx.RequestError:
        pass
    return {}


async def _log_attempt(username: str, request: Request, success: bool) -> None:
    ip = _client_ip(request)
    geo = await _geo_lookup(ip)
    device = _describe_device(request.headers.get("user-agent", ""))
    with _log_db() as db:
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO win_hello_attempts (username, success, ip, city, country, device, created_at) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (username, 1 if success else 0, ip, geo.get("city", ""), geo.get("country", ""), device, time.time()),
        )


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  綁定（設定頁）— 需要已登入 cookie
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
@router.post("/api/2fa/webauthn/register/options")
async def webauthn_register_options(request: Request):
    from app import _current_user   # 延遲匯入，見檔頭說明
    user = _current_user(request)
    if not user:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    try:
        return JSONResponse(json.loads(tf.webauthn_register_options(user)))
    except Exception as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"無法產生註冊選項: {e}"}, status_code=500)


@router.post("/api/2fa/webauthn/register/verify")
async def webauthn_register_verify(request: Request):
    from app import _current_user
    user = _current_user(request)
    if not user:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    body = await request.json()
    try:
        tf.webauthn_register_verify(user, body.get("credential"), label=body.get("label") or "Windows Hello")
    except Exception as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": f"驗證失敗，請重試: {e}"}, status_code=400)
    return JSONResponse({"ok": True})


@router.get("/api/2fa/webauthn/devices")
async def webauthn_devices(request: Request):
    from app import _current_user
    user = _current_user(request)
    if not user:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    return JSONResponse(tf.webauthn_status(user))


@router.post("/api/2fa/webauthn/remove")
async def webauthn_remove_route(request: Request):
    from app import _current_user
    user = _current_user(request)
    if not user:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    body = await request.json()
    credential_id = body.get("credential_id", "")
    if not credential_id or not tf.webauthn_remove(user, credential_id):
        return JSONResponse({"error": "找不到該裝置"}, status_code=404)
    return JSONResponse({"ok": True})


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  登入 — 密碼驗證通過後，用 app.py 簽發的 ticket 換 Windows Hello 挑戰
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
@router.post("/api/2fa/webauthn/login/options")
async def webauthn_login_options(request: Request):
    from app import _peek_ticket
    body = await request.json()
    item = _peek_ticket(body.get("ticket", ""))
    if not item:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "驗證階段已過期，請重新登入"}, status_code=400)
    username, _token, _expiry = item
    import json
    try:
        return JSONResponse(json.loads(tf.webauthn_auth_options(username)))
    except ValueError as e:
        return JSONResponse({"error": str(e)}, status_code=400)


@router.post("/api/2fa/webauthn/login/verify")
async def webauthn_login_verify(request: Request):
    from app import _peek_ticket, _pending, _set_token_cookie
    body = await request.json()
    ticket = body.get("ticket", "")
    item = _peek_ticket(ticket)
    if not item:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "驗證階段已過期，請重新登入"}, status_code=400)
    username, token, _expiry = item

    try:
        ok = tf.webauthn_auth_verify(username, body.get("credential"))
    except Exception:
        ok = False
    await _log_attempt(username, request, ok)
    if not ok:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "Windows Hello 驗證失敗"}, status_code=401)  # ticket 保持有效，可重試（同 TOTP 行為）

    _pending.pop(ticket, None)
    resp = JSONResponse({"ok": True, "next": "/home"})
    _set_token_cookie(resp, token)
    return resp


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  稽核 — 查自己最近的 Windows Hello 登入嘗試
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
@router.get("/api/2fa/webauthn/login-log")
async def webauthn_login_log(request: Request):
    from app import _current_user
    user = _current_user(request)
    if not user:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "未登入"}, status_code=401)
    with _log_db() as db:
        rows = db.execute(
            "SELECT success, ip, city, country, device, created_at FROM win_hello_attempts "
            "WHERE username = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20",
            (user,),
        ).fetchall()
    return JSONResponse({"attempts": [dict(r) for r in rows]})

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, useCallback, useRef, ReactNode } from 'react'
import { startAuthentication } from '@simplewebauthn/browser'
import { setToken, clearToken, getToken, backendBase, apiErrorMessage } from '../lib/api'

export const SESSION_TIMEOUT_KEY = 'nas_session_timeout'  // minutes, 0 = never

export interface AuthUser {
  uid: number
  username: string
  role: 'admin' | 'user'
  displayName: string | null
  avatarExt: string | null
}

interface JwtPayload {
  uid: number
  username: string
  role: 'admin' | 'user'
  exp: number
}

function decodeToken(token: string): JwtPayload | null {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(atob(token.split('.')[1])) as JwtPayload
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

export interface PendingTwoFactor {
  tempToken: string
  username: string
  methods: { totp: boolean; webauthn: boolean }
}

interface AuthContextValue {
  user: AuthUser | null
  loading: boolean
  pendingTwoFactor: PendingTwoFactor | null
  signIn: (username: string, password: string) => Promise<void>
  signInWithWebAuthn: () => Promise<void>
  completeTwoFactor: (code: string) => Promise<void>
  completeTwoFactorWebAuthn: () => Promise<void>
  cancelTwoFactor: () => void
  signOut: () => void
  refreshProfile: () => Promise<void>
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextValue | null>(null)

export function useAuth(): AuthContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(AuthContext)
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useAuth must be used inside AuthProvider')
  return ctx
}

async function fetchProfile(token: string): Promise<{ displayName: string | null; avatarExt: string | null }> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${backendBase()}/api/user/me`, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    })
    if (!res.ok) return { displayName: null, avatarExt: null }
    const data = await res.json()
    return { displayName: data.displayName ?? null, avatarExt: data.avatarExt ?? null }
  } catch {
    return { displayName: null, avatarExt: null }
  }
}

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<AuthUser | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [pendingTwoFactor, setPendingTwoFactor] = useState<PendingTwoFactor | null>(null)
  const logoutTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)
  const lastActivity = useRef(Date.now())

  function resetLogoutTimer() {
    if (logoutTimer.current) clearTimeout(logoutTimer.current)
    const mins = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(SESSION_TIMEOUT_KEY) ?? '0')
    if (!mins || mins <= 0) return
    logoutTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      clearToken(); setUser(null)
    }, mins * 60 * 1000)
  }

  // Track user activity
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return
    resetLogoutTimer()
    const events = ['mousemove', 'keydown', 'click', 'touchstart', 'scroll']
    const onActivity = () => {
      const now = Date.now()
      if (now - lastActivity.current > 10000) {  // debounce 10s
        lastActivity.current = now
        resetLogoutTimer()
      }
    }
    events.forEach(e => window.addEventListener(e, onActivity, { passive: true }))
    return () => {
      events.forEach(e => window.removeEventListener(e, onActivity))
      if (logoutTimer.current) clearTimeout(logoutTimer.current)
    }
  }, [user]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  useEffect(() => {
    const token = getToken()
    if (token) {
      const payload = decodeToken(token)
      if (payload && payload.exp * 1000 > Date.now()) {
        setUser({ uid: payload.uid, username: payload.username, role: payload.role, displayName: null, avatarExt: null })
        fetchProfile(token).then(profile => {
          setUser(u => u ? { ...u, ...profile } : u)
        })
      } else {
        clearToken()
      }
    }
    setLoading(false)
  }, [])

  async function signIn(username: string, password: string) {
    const res = await fetch(`${backendBase()}/api/login`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ username, password }),
    })
    const data = await res.json()
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(apiErrorMessage(data, 'Login failed'))

    if (data.requiresTwoFactor) {
      setPendingTwoFactor({
        tempToken: data.tempToken,
        username: data.username ?? username,
        methods: data.methods ?? { totp: true, webauthn: false },
      })
      return
    }

    setToken(data.token)
    const payload = decodeToken(data.token)!
    const profile = await fetchProfile(data.token)
    setUser({ uid: payload.uid, username: payload.username, role: payload.role, ...profile })
  }

  // Passwordless first-factor sign-in: no username/password involved at all.
  // Requests an authentication challenge with an empty allow-list so the platform
  // authenticator (Windows Hello) offers a picker over its own discoverable/resident
  // credentials; the server resolves which user it belongs to from credential_id alone.
  async function signInWithWebAuthn() {
    const origin = window.location.origin

    const optRes = await fetch(`${backendBase()}/api/auth/webauthn/login-options`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ origin }),
    })
    const options = await optRes.json()
    if (!optRes.ok) throw new Error(apiErrorMessage(options, 'Login failed'))
    const { flowId, ...optionsJSON } = options

    const response = await startAuthentication({ optionsJSON })

    const res = await fetch(`${backendBase()}/api/auth/webauthn/login-verify`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ flowId, response }),
    })
    const data = await res.json()
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(apiErrorMessage(data, 'Login failed'))

    setToken(data.token)
    const payload = decodeToken(data.token)!
    const profile = await fetchProfile(data.token)
    setUser({ uid: payload.uid, username: payload.username, role: payload.role, ...profile })
  }

  async function completeTwoFactor(code: string) {
    if (!pendingTwoFactor) throw new Error('No pending verification request')
    const res = await fetch(`${backendBase()}/api/2fa/verify`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ tempToken: pendingTwoFactor.tempToken, code }),
    })
    const data = await res.json()
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(apiErrorMessage(data, 'Verification failed'))
    setPendingTwoFactor(null)
    setToken(data.token)
    const payload = decodeToken(data.token)!
    const profile = await fetchProfile(data.token)
    setUser({ uid: payload.uid, username: payload.username, role: payload.role, ...profile })
  }

  async function completeTwoFactorWebAuthn() {
    if (!pendingTwoFactor) throw new Error('No pending verification request')
    const { tempToken } = pendingTwoFactor
    const origin = window.location.origin

    const optRes = await fetch(`${backendBase()}/api/2fa/webauthn/login-options`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ tempToken, origin }),
    })
    const options = await optRes.json()
    if (!optRes.ok) throw new Error(apiErrorMessage(options, 'Verification failed'))

    const response = await startAuthentication({ optionsJSON: options })

    const res = await fetch(`${backendBase()}/api/2fa/webauthn/login-verify`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ tempToken, response }),
    })
    const data = await res.json()
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(apiErrorMessage(data, 'Verification failed'))

    setPendingTwoFactor(null)
    setToken(data.token)
    const payload = decodeToken(data.token)!
    const profile = await fetchProfile(data.token)
    setUser({ uid: payload.uid, username: payload.username, role: payload.role, ...profile })
  }

  function cancelTwoFactor() { setPendingTwoFactor(null) }

  function signOut() { clearToken(); setUser(null) }

  const refreshProfile = useCallback(async () => {
    const token = getToken()
    if (!token) return
    const profile = await fetchProfile(token)
    setUser(u => u ? { ...u, ...profile } : u)
  }, [])

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, loading, pendingTwoFactor, signIn, signInWithWebAuthn, completeTwoFactor, completeTwoFactorWebAuthn, cancelTwoFactor, signOut, refreshProfile }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  )
}

const DICT: Record<Lang, Translations> = { zh, en }

interface LangCtx {
  lang: Lang
  t: Translations
  setLang: (l: Lang) => void
  syncLangFromPrefs: () => Promise<void>
}

const LangContext = createContext<LangCtx>({ lang: 'zh', t: zh, setLang: () => {}, syncLangFromPrefs: async () => {} })

function detectLang(): Lang {
  const stored = localStorage.getItem('nas_lang')
  if (stored === 'zh' || stored === 'en') return stored
  return navigator.language.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh' : 'en'
}

export function LangProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [lang, setLangState] = useState<Lang>(detectLang)

  function setLang(l: Lang) {
    setLangState(l)
    localStorage.setItem('nas_lang', l)
    savePrefs({ language: l }).catch(() => {})
  }

  const syncLangFromPrefs = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const prefs = await loadPrefs()
      if (prefs.language && (prefs.language === 'zh' || prefs.language === 'en')) {
        setLangState(prefs.language)
        localStorage.setItem('nas_lang', prefs.language)
      }
    } catch { /* offline or not logged in — keep localStorage value */ }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.lang = lang === 'zh' ? 'zh-TW' : 'en'
  }, [lang])

  return (
    <LangContext.Provider value={{ lang, t: DICT[lang], setLang, syncLangFromPrefs }}>
      {children}
    </LangContext.Provider>
  )
}

export function useLang() { return useContext(LangContext) }

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/lib/api.ts
import { notifyLoadError } from './notify'

const DEFAULT_BACKEND = import.meta.env.VITE_BACKEND_URL
const BACKEND_KEY = 'nas_backend'   // QuickConnect override (VaultixID → resolved URL)

const TOKEN_KEY = 'nas_jwt'

// Active backend base URL: a QuickConnect-resolved override wins, else the build-time default.
export function backendBase(): string {
  return localStorage.getItem(BACKEND_KEY) || DEFAULT_BACKEND
}

export function setBackend(url: string) {
  localStorage.setItem(BACKEND_KEY, url)
}

export function clearBackend() {
  localStorage.removeItem(BACKEND_KEY)
}

// Resolve a VaultixID (QuickConnect ID) to its NAS backend URL + owning username.
// Always queries the build-time default backend (acts as the directory/broker).
export async function resolveVaultixId(id: string): Promise<{ backendUrl: string; username: string }> {
  const res = await fetch(`${DEFAULT_BACKEND}/api/vaultix/resolve?id=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`)
  const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}))
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(apiErrorMessage(data, `找不到此 Vaultix ID`))
  return data as { backendUrl: string; username: string }
}

export function getToken(): string {
  return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY) ?? ''
}

export function setToken(token: string) {
  localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token)
}

export function clearToken() {
  localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY)
}

// Backend error responses come from FastAPI (server.js was fully retired 2026-08-01) —
// HTTPException(status, detail) serializes as { detail: "..." }, not { error: "..." }.
// Check both so real backend messages surface instead of falling back to a generic string.
export function apiErrorMessage(data: unknown, fallback: string): string {
  const d = data as { error?: string; detail?: string } | null | undefined
  return d?.error ?? d?.detail ?? fallback
}

export async function apiFetch(url: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
  let res: Response
  try {
    res = await fetch(`${backendBase()}${url}`, {
      ...options,
      headers: {
        ...(options.headers ?? {}),
        Authorization: `Bearer ${getToken()}`,
      },
    })
  } catch (err) {
    notifyLoadError()
    throw err
  }
  if (res.status === 401) {
    clearToken()
    window.location.href = '/login'
  } else if (res.status >= 500) {
    notifyLoadError()
  }
  return res
}

export async function apiJson<T>(url: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
  const res = await apiFetch(url, options)
  if (!res.ok) {
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}))
    throw new Error(apiErrorMessage(data, `HTTP ${res.status}`))
  }
  return res.json() as Promise<T>
}

export function apiUpload(
  url: string,
  body: FormData,
  onProgress: (pct: number) => void
): { promise: Promise<void>; abort: () => void } {
  let xhr!: XMLHttpRequest
  const promise = new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    xhr = new XMLHttpRequest()
    xhr.open('POST', `${backendBase()}${url}`)
    xhr.setRequestHeader('Authorization', `Bearer ${getToken()}`)
    xhr.upload.onprogress = e => {
      if (e.lengthComputable) onProgress(Math.round((e.loaded / e.total) * 100))
    }
    xhr.onload = () => {
      if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) resolve()
      else {
        const data = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText || '{}')
        reject(new Error(apiErrorMessage(data, 'Upload failed')))
      }
    }
    xhr.onerror = () => { notifyLoadError(); reject(new Error('Connection dropped — check Pi disk space or file size')) }
    xhr.onabort = () => {
      const err = new Error('canceled')
      err.name = 'AbortError'
      reject(err)
    }
    xhr.send(body)
  })
  return { promise, abort: () => xhr.abort() }
}

export function apiDownload(
  url: string,
  filename: string,
  onProgress: (pct: number) => void
): { promise: Promise<void>; abort: () => void } {
  let xhr!: XMLHttpRequest
  const promise = new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    xhr = new XMLHttpRequest()
    xhr.open('GET', url)
    xhr.responseType = 'blob'
    xhr.onprogress = e => {
      if (e.lengthComputable) onProgress(Math.round((e.loaded / e.total) * 100))
    }
    xhr.onload = () => {
      if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
        const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(xhr.response as Blob)
        const a = document.createElement('a')
        a.href = blobUrl
        a.download = filename
        document.body.appendChild(a)
        a.click()
        document.body.removeChild(a)
        setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl), 5000)
        resolve()
      } else {
        reject(new Error(`Download failed HTTP ${xhr.status}`))
      }
    }
    xhr.onerror = () => { notifyLoadError(); reject(new Error('Network error')) }
    xhr.onabort = () => {
      const err = new Error('canceled')
      err.name = 'AbortError'
      reject(err)
    }
    xhr.send()
  })
  return { promise, abort: () => xhr.abort() }
}

export function downloadUrl(filePath: string): string {
  return `${backendBase()}/api/files/download?path=${encodeURIComponent(filePath)}&token=${getToken()}`
}

// Playback progress ("resume where I left off") — shared backend for both
// VideoPlayer.tsx and music.tsx, keyed by (user, file path), backed by the
// playback_progress table (see websites/backend/player.py). Server-side
// (not localStorage) so it survives across devices/browsers.
export interface PlaybackProgress {
  position: number | null
  duration: number | null
  updatedAt: string | null
}

export async function getPlaybackProgress(path: string): Promise<PlaybackProgress> {
  try {
    return await apiJson<PlaybackProgress>(`/api/player/progress?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}`)
  } catch {
    return { position: null, duration: null, updatedAt: null }
  }
}

export async function savePlaybackProgress(
  path: string,
  mediaType: 'video' | 'audio',
  position: number,
  duration?: number
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await apiFetch('/api/player/progress', {
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ path, mediaType, position, duration }),
    })
  } catch { /* best-effort, never block playback on a save failure */ }
}

export async function clearPlaybackProgress(path: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await apiFetch(`/api/player/progress?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}`, { method: 'DELETE' })
  } catch { /* best-effort */ }
}

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/lib/fileTypes.ts
export type FileCategory =
  | 'image' | 'video' | 'audio'
  | 'pdf' | 'doc' | 'sheet' | 'slide'
  | 'archive' | 'code' | 'text'
  | 'folder' | 'other'

export type OfficeCategory = Extract<FileCategory, 'doc' | 'sheet' | 'slide'>

const EXT_MAP: Record<string, FileCategory> = {
  jpg: 'image', jpeg: 'image', png: 'image', gif: 'image', webp: 'image',
  svg: 'image', bmp: 'image', ico: 'image', heic: 'image', heif: 'image', avif: 'image',
  mp4: 'video', mkv: 'video', avi: 'video', mov: 'video', wmv: 'video',
  webm: 'video', m4v: 'video', flv: 'video', ts: 'video',
  mp3: 'audio', wav: 'audio', flac: 'audio', aac: 'audio',
  ogg: 'audio', m4a: 'audio', opus: 'audio', wma: 'audio',
  pdf: 'pdf',
  doc: 'doc', docx: 'doc',
  xls: 'sheet', xlsx: 'sheet',
  ppt: 'slide', pptx: 'slide',
  zip: 'archive', rar: 'archive', '7z': 'archive',
  tar: 'archive', gz: 'archive', bz2: 'archive', xz: 'archive',
  js: 'code', jsx: 'code', tsx: 'code',
  py: 'code', sh: 'code', bash: 'code',
  html: 'code', css: 'code', json: 'code', xml: 'code',
  yaml: 'code', yml: 'code', toml: 'code',
  go: 'code', rs: 'code', java: 'code', kt: 'code',
  c: 'code', cpp: 'code', h: 'code', cs: 'code',
  php: 'code', rb: 'code', swift: 'code', dart: 'code',
  sql: 'code', dockerfile: 'code',
  txt: 'text', md: 'text', log: 'text', lrc: 'text',
  ini: 'text', conf: 'text', env: 'text', csv: 'text',
}

// Well-known media folders live on disk under Chinese names; show English labels
// in the English UI. zh UI keeps the original disk name.
const FOLDER_EN: Record<string, string> = {
  '音樂': 'Music', '影片': 'Videos', '圖片': 'Pictures', '照片': 'Photos',
  '文件': 'Documents', '文檔': 'Documents', '下載': 'Downloads', '桌面': 'Desktop',
}

export function folderDisplayName(name: string, lang: 'zh' | 'en'): string {
  return lang === 'en' ? (FOLDER_EN[name] ?? name) : name
}

export function getCategory(name: string, isFolder: boolean): FileCategory {
  if (isFolder) return 'folder'
  const ext = name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? ''
  return EXT_MAP[ext] ?? 'other'
}

export function isViewable(cat: FileCategory): boolean {
  return ['image', 'video', 'audio', 'text', 'code', 'pdf'].includes(cat)
}

export function isEditable(cat: FileCategory): boolean {
  return cat === 'text' || cat === 'code'
}

export function isOfficeCategory(cat: FileCategory): cat is OfficeCategory {
  return cat === 'doc' || cat === 'sheet' || cat === 'slide'
}

// Coarse grouping used by the file-list category filter (doc/image/video/audio/archive/other).
export type FilterGroup = 'all' | 'doc' | 'image' | 'video' | 'audio' | 'archive' | 'other'

export function filterGroupOf(cat: FileCategory): Exclude<FilterGroup, 'all'> {
  if (cat === 'image' || cat === 'video' || cat === 'audio' || cat === 'archive') return cat
  if (cat === 'pdf' || cat === 'doc' || cat === 'sheet' || cat === 'slide' || cat === 'text' || cat === 'code') return 'doc'
  return 'other'
}

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/lib/mailApi.ts
import { getToken } from './api'

// Mail's actual IMAP/SMTP + storage logic lives in frontend-py (a separate
// FastAPI service, websites/frontend-py/mail.py) — not this React app, not
// the main NAS backend. This file only knows how to reach *that* service
// directly over fetch, cross-origin, authenticating with the same JWT this
// app already has (see admin_shell.token() on the frontend-py side for the
// matching Bearer-header support + app.py's CORSMiddleware for the origin
// allowlist that makes this legal from a browser).
const MAIL_API_BASE = (
  (import.meta.env.VITE_MAIL_API_URL as string | undefined) ?? 'https://raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net:8444'
).replace(/\/+$/, '')

export function mailApiBase(): string {
  return MAIL_API_BASE
}

function mailErrorMessage(data: unknown, fallback: string): string {
  const d = data as { error?: string; detail?: string } | null | undefined
  return d?.error ?? d?.detail ?? fallback
}

export async function mailFetch(path: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
  return fetch(`${MAIL_API_BASE}${path}`, {
    ...options,
    headers: {
      ...(options.headers ?? {}),
      Authorization: `Bearer ${getToken()}`,
      'X-CSRF': '1',
    },
  })
}

export async function mailJson<T>(path: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
  let res: Response
  try {
    res = await mailFetch(path, options)
  } catch {
    throw new Error('無法連線到 Mail 服務 (frontend-py)')
  }
  const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}))
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(mailErrorMessage(data, `HTTP ${res.status}`))
  return data as T
}

export async function downloadMailAttachment(url: string, filename: string): Promise<void> {
  const res = await mailFetch(url)
  if (!res.ok) {
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}))
    throw new Error(mailErrorMessage(data, `HTTP ${res.status}`))
  }
  const blob = await res.blob()
  const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
  const a = document.createElement('a')
  a.href = blobUrl
  a.download = filename
  document.body.appendChild(a)
  a.click()
  document.body.removeChild(a)
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl), 5000)
}

// websites/backend/scripts/setup_mailserver.py). Provisioning itself is

// sidecar — reachable here because it's exposed on the same MAIL_API_BASE
// host and its CORS allowlist already includes this site's origin.
export interface MailboxStatus {
  provisioned: boolean
  domain: string
  localPart?: string
  address?: string
  enabled?: boolean
}

  return mailJson<MailboxStatus>('/api/mail/mailbox')
}

  return mailJson('/api/mail/mailbox', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ local_part: localPart, password }),
  })
}

export async function disableMailbox(): Promise<{ ok: boolean }> {
  return mailJson('/api/mail/mailbox', { method: 'DELETE' })
}

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/lib/mediaMeta.ts
import { apiJson } from './api'

export const CATEGORIES = ['Landscape', 'Portrait', 'Travel', 'Food', 'Life', 'Animals', 'Architecture', 'Festival', 'Sports', 'Other'] as const
export type MediaCategory = typeof CATEGORIES[number] | ''

export interface FileMeta {
  tags: string[]
  location: string
  category: MediaCategory
  note: string
}

export const EMPTY_META: FileMeta = { tags: [], location: '', category: '', note: '' }

export async function getMeta(filePath: string): Promise<FileMeta | null> {
  try {
    const d = await apiJson<{ meta: FileMeta | null }>(`/api/media/meta?path=${encodeURIComponent(filePath)}`)
    return d.meta
  } catch { return null }
}

export async function saveMeta(filePath: string, meta: FileMeta): Promise<void> {
  await apiJson('/api/media/meta', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ path: filePath, ...meta }),
  })
}

export async function searchByMeta(params: {
  q?: string; tags?: string; category?: string; location?: string
}) {
  const qs = new URLSearchParams(
    Object.entries(params).filter(([, v]) => v) as [string, string][]
  )
  return apiJson<{ items: Array<{ path: string; name: string; type: string; meta: FileMeta }> }>(
    `/api/media/search?${qs}`
  )
}

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/lib/notify.ts
// System-level (OS) notifications for load/connection errors.
// Routed through the Service Worker registration so it shows as a real OS
// notification on installed/standalone PWAs (Android + iOS 16.4+), not just
// an in-page toast. Falls back to the page-level Notification API if no
// service worker is available.

const MIN_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000
let lastFired = 0

function currentLang(): 'zh' | 'en' {
  const stored = localStorage.getItem('nas_lang')
  if (stored === 'zh' || stored === 'en') return stored
  return navigator.language.startsWith('zh') ? 'zh' : 'en'
}

export function notificationsSupported(): boolean {
  return typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'Notification' in window
}

export function notificationPermission(): NotificationPermission | 'unsupported' {
  return notificationsSupported() ? Notification.permission : 'unsupported'
}

// Must be invoked directly inside a user gesture (click) — iOS Safari silently
// denies permission requests that aren't triggered synchronously by user interaction.
export async function requestNotifyPermission(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!notificationsSupported()) return false
  if (Notification.permission === 'granted') return true
  const perm = await Notification.requestPermission()
  return perm === 'granted'
}

async function getSwRegistration(timeoutMs = 3000): Promise<ServiceWorkerRegistration | null> {
  if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator)) return null
  try {
    return await Promise.race([
      navigator.serviceWorker.ready,
      new Promise<null>(resolve => setTimeout(() => resolve(null), timeoutMs)),
    ])
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

// Fire a system notification for a load/connection failure. Throttled to at
// most once per minute so a burst of failed requests doesn't spam the phone.
export async function notifyLoadError(detail?: string) {
  if (!notificationsSupported() || Notification.permission !== 'granted') return
  const now = Date.now()
  if (now - lastFired < MIN_INTERVAL_MS) return
  lastFired = now

  const zh = currentLang() === 'zh'
  const title = zh ? 'Vaultix NAS 連線失敗' : 'Vaultix NAS connection error'
  const body = detail ?? (zh ? '無法載入資料，請檢查網路或 NAS 狀態' : 'Failed to load data — check your network or NAS status')
  const options: NotificationOptions = {
    body,
    icon: '/icon.png',
    badge: '/icon.png',
    tag: 'vaultix-load-error',
  }

  const reg = await getSwRegistration()
  if (reg) {
    try {
      await reg.showNotification(title, options)
      return
    } catch { /* fall through to page-level Notification */ }
  }
  try { new Notification(title, options) } catch { /* unsupported in this context — give up quietly */ }
}

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/lib/prefs.ts
import { apiJson } from './api'

export interface SavedDevice {
  id: string
  name: string
  ip: string
  port: string
  scheme: 'http' | 'https'
  note: string
  addedAt: number
}

export interface VaultixPrefs {
  locker_path?: string
  reels_path?: string
  reels_liked?: string[]
  reels_collected?: string[]
  telegram_path?: string
  telegram_liked?: string[]
  telegram_collected?: string[]
  favorites?: string[]
  home_bg_css?: string | null
  bg_path?: string | null
  saved_devices?: SavedDevice[]
  language?: 'zh' | 'en'
}

// Fallback key — only used when offline
const FB_KEY = 'vaultix_prefs_fb'

function readFallback(): VaultixPrefs {
  try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FB_KEY) ?? '{}') } catch { return {} }
}

function writeFallback(patch: Partial<VaultixPrefs>) {
  const merged = { ...readFallback(), ...patch }
  localStorage.setItem(FB_KEY, JSON.stringify(merged))
}

export async function loadPrefs(): Promise<VaultixPrefs> {
  try {
    const data = await apiJson<VaultixPrefs>('/api/user/prefs')
    writeFallback(data) // keep local fallback in sync
    return data
  } catch {
    return readFallback()
  }
}

export async function savePrefs(patch: Partial<VaultixPrefs>): Promise<void> {
  writeFallback(patch) // update fallback immediately
  try {
    await apiJson('/api/user/prefs', {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(patch),
    })
  } catch { /* offline — fallback already updated */ }
}

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/main.tsx
import { StrictMode } from 'react'
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client'
import './index.css'
import App from './App'
import { AuthProvider } from './context/AuthContext'
import { LangProvider } from './context/LangContext'

document.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => e.preventDefault())

// Deter casual inspection: block common DevTools / view-source shortcuts.
// (Ctrl+Shift+C is intentionally NOT blocked — the terminal uses it to copy.)
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  const k = e.key?.toLowerCase() ?? ''
  if (
    e.key === 'F12' ||
    (e.ctrlKey && e.shiftKey && (k === 'i' || k === 'j')) ||
    (e.ctrlKey && k === 'u')
  ) {
    e.preventDefault()
  }
})

// Register the PWA service worker (enables install as a standalone OS window)
if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js').catch(() => {})
  })
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <StrictMode>
    <LangProvider>
      <AuthProvider>
        <App />
      </AuthProvider>
    </LangProvider>
  </StrictMode>,
)

<script>
const API = 'https://raspberrypi.tail8767da.ts.net'
const TOKEN_KEY = 'token'
function getToken() { return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY) }

async function apiFetch(path, opts = {}) {
  const token = getToken()
  const res = await fetch(`${API}${path}`, {
    ...opts,
    headers: { ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}), ...opts.headers },
  })
  if (!res.ok) {
    let b; try { b = await res.json() } catch { b = {} }
    throw new Error(b.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`)
  }
  return res.json()
}

async function startDownload(format = 'mp4') {
  const url  = document.getElementById('url-input').value.trim()
  const dest = document.getElementById('dest-select').value
  const msg  = document.getElementById('start-msg')
  const btns = ['btn-video','btn-image','btn-audio'].map(id => document.getElementById(id))
  if (!url) { showMsg(msg, '請貼上下載連結', 'red'); return }
  btns.forEach(b => b.disabled = true)
  msg.classList.add('hidden')
  try {
    await apiFetch('/api/ytdl/start', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ url, destPath: dest, format }),
    })
    showMsg(msg, '✓ 已加入下載佇列', 'green')
    document.getElementById('url-input').value = ''
    setTimeout(loadJobs, 800)
  } catch (e) {
    showMsg(msg, '錯誤：' + e.message, 'red')
  } finally {
    btns.forEach(b => b.disabled = false)
  }
}

let pollTimer = null
async function loadJobs() {
  try {
    const jobs = await apiFetch('/api/ytdl/jobs')
    renderJobs(jobs)
    const hasActive = jobs.some(j => j.status === 'running' || j.status === 'pending')
    clearInterval(pollTimer)
    if (hasActive) pollTimer = setInterval(loadJobs, 3000)
  } catch (e) {
    document.getElementById('jobs-list').innerHTML = `<div class="empty-jobs">載入失敗：${escHtml(e.message)}</div>`
  }
}

function renderJobs(jobs) {
  const list = document.getElementById('jobs-list')
  if (!jobs.length) { list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-jobs">尚無下載紀錄</div>'; return }
  list.innerHTML = jobs.map(j => {
    const badge = { running:'badge-running', done:'badge-done', error:'badge-error', pending:'badge-pending' }[j.status] ?? 'badge-pending'
    const label = { running:'下載中', done:'完成', error:'失敗', pending:'排隊中' }[j.status] ?? j.status
    const fmtIcon = { mp4:'🎬', mp3:'🎵', image:'🖼' }[j.format] ?? '📥'
    const logText = j.error || (j.output ?? '').trim().slice(-300)
    const log = logText ? `<div class="job-log">${escHtml(logText)}</div>` : ''
    return `<div class="job-card">
      <div class="job-header">
        <div class="job-url" title="${escHtml(j.url)}">${escHtml(j.url)}</div>
        <span class="badge ${badge}">${label}</span>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:12px;color:#4b5563">${fmtIcon} → ${escHtml(j.destPath ?? j.destDir ?? '')}</div>
      ${log}
      <div class="job-actions">
        <button class="btn btn-red btn-sm" onclick="deleteJob('${j.id}')">刪除</button>
      </div>
    </div>`
  }).join('')
}

async function deleteJob(id) {
  try { await apiFetch(`/api/ytdl/jobs/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' }); loadJobs() }
  catch (e) { alert('刪除失敗：' + e.message) }
}

async function loadCookieStatus() {
  try {
    const { exists } = await apiFetch('/api/ytdl/cookies')
    document.getElementById('cookie-dot').className = `dot ${exists ? 'dot-green' : 'dot-red'}`
    document.getElementById('cookie-status-text').textContent = exists ? 'Cookie 已設定' : '未設定 Cookie'
  } catch {}
}

async function saveTwitterCookie() {
  const auth_token = document.getElementById('auth-token-input').value.trim()
  const ct0        = document.getElementById('ct0-input').value.trim()
  const msg        = document.getElementById('cookie-msg')
  if (!auth_token || !ct0) { showMsg(msg, '請同時填入 auth_token 與 ct0', 'red'); return }
  try {
    await apiFetch('/api/ytdl/cookies/twitter', {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ auth_token, ct0 }),
    })
    document.getElementById('auth-token-input').value = ''
    document.getElementById('ct0-input').value = ''
    showMsg(msg, '✓ Cookie 已儲存', 'green')
    loadCookieStatus()
  } catch (e) { showMsg(msg, '儲存失敗：' + e.message, 'red') }
}

async function deleteCookie() {
  const msg = document.getElementById('cookie-msg')
  try {
    await apiFetch('/api/ytdl/cookies', { method: 'DELETE' })
    showMsg(msg, '✓ Cookie 已移除', 'green')
    loadCookieStatus()
  } catch (e) { showMsg(msg, '移除失敗：' + e.message, 'red') }
}

function showMsg(el, text, type) { el.textContent = text; el.className = `msg msg-${type}` }
function escHtml(s) {
  return String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;')
}

if (!getToken()) { window.location.href = '/' }
else { loadJobs(); loadCookieStatus() }
</script>
</body>

// Vaultix-NAS/websites/frontend/src/public/sw.js
// Vaultix NAS service worker — enables PWA install + offline app shell.
// Only the same-origin (Firebase-hosted) app shell is cached; the cross-origin
// Tailscale backend API is passed straight through (never cached).
const CACHE = 'vaultix-v2'

self.addEventListener('install', () => self.skipWaiting())

self.addEventListener('activate', event => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.keys()
      .then(keys => Promise.all(keys.filter(k => k !== CACHE).map(k => caches.delete(k))))
      .then(() => self.clients.claim()),
  )
})

self.addEventListener('fetch', event => {
  const url = new URL(event.request.url)
  // Passthrough: non-GET, or anything not on our own origin (e.g. the NAS backend).
  if (event.request.method !== 'GET' || url.origin !== self.location.origin) return

  event.respondWith(
    fetch(event.request)
      .then(res => {
        const copy = res.clone()
        caches.open(CACHE).then(c => c.put(event.request, copy)).catch(() => {})
        return res
      })
      .catch(() => caches.match(event.request).then(r => r || caches.match('/index.html'))),
  )
})

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/inject_music_api.py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Inject /api/music/metadata and /api/music/cover into Pi's server.js.

Usage (run on the Pi, or via SSH):
  python3 /home/roy/casaos-nas/inject_music_api.py

Before running, install the dependency:
  cd /home/roy/casaos-nas && npm install music-metadata
"""
import re, sys, shutil, datetime

SERVER = '/home/roy/casaos-nas/server.js'

NEW_ENDPOINTS = """
// --- Music metadata & cover (injected {date}) ---
app.get('/api/music/metadata', authenticate, async (req, res) => {{
  try {{
    const {{ parseFile }} = await import('music-metadata')
    const fp = safePath(req.user.username, req.query.path)
    const meta = await parseFile(fp)
    res.json({{
      title: meta.common.title || null,
      artist: meta.common.artist || null,
      album: meta.common.album || null,
      year: meta.common.year || null,
      genre: meta.common.genre?.[0] || null,
    }})
  }} catch (e) {{ res.status(500).json({{ error: e.message }}) }}
}})

app.get('/api/music/cover', authenticate, async (req, res) => {{
  try {{
    const {{ parseFile }} = await import('music-metadata')
    const fp = safePath(req.user.username, req.query.path)
    const meta = await parseFile(fp, {{ skipCovers: false }})
    const pic = meta.common.picture?.[0]
    if (!pic) return res.status(404).json({{ error: 'no cover' }})
    res.set('Content-Type', pic.format)
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=86400')
    res.send(Buffer.from(pic.data))
  }} catch (e) {{ res.status(500).json({{ error: e.message }}) }}
}})
// --- end injected ---

""".format(date=datetime.date.today())

with open(SERVER, 'r') as f:
    code = f.read()

if '/api/music/metadata' in code:
    print('Already injected, skipping.')
    sys.exit(0)

matches = list(re.finditer(r'\b(app|server)\.listen\(', code))
if not matches:
    print('ERROR: cannot find listen() call in server.js')
    sys.exit(1)

# Backup before modifying
shutil.copy(SERVER, SERVER + '.bak')
print(f'Backup saved: {SERVER}.bak')

pos = matches[-1].start()
code = code[:pos] + NEW_ENDPOINTS + code[pos:]

with open(SERVER, 'w') as f:
    f.write(code)

print('Injected successfully. Now run: pm2 restart casaos-nas --update-env')

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/remote_desktop.py
# Vaultix Remote Desktop Agent — runs ON the machine you want to control (goal_desktop),
# not on the Pi backend. Install deps then run directly on that machine:
#   pip install fastapi "uvicorn[standard]" jinja2 bcrypt PyJWT python-multipart mss pyautogui Pillow
#   python remote_desktop.py         # listens on 0.0.0.0:8765
# Expose it over HTTPS/WSS so https://vaultix-nas.web.app can reach it without a mixed-content
# block, same trick already used for raspberrypi/royhomenas in this project — Tailscale Serve:
#   tailscale serve --bg --https=8765 http://127.0.0.1:8765
from __future__ import annotations

import _tkinter as tk
import bcrypt
import jwt
import sqlite3

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from fastapi import FastAPI, Form, Request, Response
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, RedirectResponse
from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates

import asyncio
import io
import json
import os
import socket

import mss
import pyautogui
from fastapi import HTTPException, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from PIL import Image
from starlette.requests import HTTPConnection

BASE = Path(__file__).parent
DB_PATH = BASE / "login_example.db"
JWT_SECRET = "CHANGE_ME_TO_A_RANDOM_SERECT"
JWT_ALGO = "HS256"
JWT_DAYS = 7
COOKIE_NAME = "nas_jwt"

app = FastAPI(title="Login(web + hashing)")

# 遠端控制電腦
goal_desktop = ""
# 快捷鍵
# left_shift and right_shift 可以直接切換到 goal_desktop 的中/英文
# win + shift + S 可以讓 goal_desktop 螢幕截圖
# remote_desktop 可以選擇顯示的螢幕比例
def login():
    ac = input("請輸入您的帳戶")
    pwd = input("請輸入您的密碼")
    with _db() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM operators WHERE account = ?", (ac,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        choice = input(f"帳號 {ac} 不存在，是否建立為新的操作員帳號？(y/N) ")
        if choice.strip().lower() == "y":
            with _db() as db:
                db.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO operators (account, password_hash) VALUES (?, ?)",
                    (ac, _hash_password(pwd)),
                )
                db.commit()
            print(f"已建立操作員帳號：{ac}，之後可在 vaultix-nas.web.app 的 Remote Desktop 用這組帳密連線 {goal_desktop}。")
        else:
            print("已取消")
        return
    if _verify_password(pwd, row["password_hash"]):
        print(f"登入成功，歡迎 {ac}")
    else:
        print("帳號或密碼錯誤")


# 遠端控制電腦：goal_desktop 預設是這台機器自己的名稱 (可用 GOAL_DESKTOP_NAME
# 環境變數覆寫)，用來讓瀏覽器那端知道現在連到的是哪一台。
goal_desktop = os.environ.get("GOAL_DESKTOP_NAME") or socket.gethostname()

# 讓 https://vaultix-nas.web.app 這個不同網域的前端可以直接呼叫這支跑在
# goal_desktop 上的 agent。不使用 cookie 做跨網域驗證，一律靠 Bearer/?token=，
# 所以這裡不需要 allow_credentials。
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=False,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)


# ── 操作員帳號 (bcrypt + JWT + sqlite，沿用 login() 既有架構) ────────────────
def _db() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS operators ("
        "  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,"
        "  account TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,"
        "  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,"
        "  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP"
        ")"
    )
    conn.commit()
    return conn


def _hash_password(plain: str) -> str:
    return bcrypt.hashpw(plain.encode(), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode()


def _verify_password(plain: str, hashed: str) -> bool:
    return bcrypt.checkpw(plain.encode(), hashed.encode())


def _create_jwt(account: str) -> str:
    exp = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=JWT_DAYS)
    return jwt.encode({"account": account, "exp": exp}, JWT_SECRET, algorithm=JWT_ALGO)


def _decode_jwt(token: str) -> str | None:
    try:
        return jwt.decode(token, JWT_SECRET, algorithms=[JWT_ALGO]).get("account")
    except Exception:
        return None


def _token_from_request(conn: HTTPConnection) -> str | None:
    # HTTPConnection is the common base of both Request and WebSocket in Starlette,
    # so this same helper covers the REST endpoints and the /ws/remote handshake.
    auth = conn.headers.get("authorization", "")
    if auth.lower().startswith("bearer "):
        return auth[7:]
    return conn.query_params.get("token") or conn.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)


def _require_account(request: Request) -> str:
    token = _token_from_request(request)
    account = _decode_jwt(token) if token else None
    if not account:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="not authenticated")
    return account


# ── 快捷鍵動作：由瀏覽器觸發，實際效果發生在 goal_desktop 這台機器上 ──────────
# pyautogui 在 Windows 上會把 'shiftleft'/'shiftright' 對應到不同的虛擬鍵碼
# (VK_LSHIFT / VK_RSHIFT)，剛好對上 Windows 語言列「按左/右 Shift 切換中英文」
# 的按鍵設定，原樣轉發不需要額外邏輯。
pyautogui.FAILSAFE = False
pyautogui.PAUSE = 0


def switch_ime_language(side: str = "left") -> None:
    """left_shift and right_shift 可以直接切換到 goal_desktop 的中/英文"""
    key = "shiftright" if side == "right" else "shiftleft"
    pyautogui.keyDown(key)
    pyautogui.keyUp(key)


def trigger_snipping_tool() -> None:
    """win + shift + S 可以讓 goal_desktop 螢幕截圖"""
    pyautogui.hotkey("winleft", "shift", "s")


# ── 螢幕比例：remote_desktop 可以選擇顯示的螢幕比例 ──────────────────────────
SCALE_OPTIONS = (1.0, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25)
current_scale = 1.0

# 目前有幾個瀏覽器正在連線 (/ws/remote)。給 remote_desktop_tray.py 的系統匣圖示
# 拿來顯示「執行中／有人連線中」的狀態用，跟 server.js 那邊 ufwWidget 綠燈/灰燈
# 的概念一樣，純粹是狀態指示，不影響任何驗證邏輯。
active_connections = 0


def set_scale(value: float) -> float:
    global current_scale
    current_scale = min(SCALE_OPTIONS, key=lambda opt: abs(opt - value))
    return current_scale


# ── 螢幕擷取 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
JPEG_QUALITY = 60
TARGET_FPS = 10


def _primary_monitor_size() -> tuple[int, int]:
    with mss.mss() as sct:
        mon = sct.monitors[1]
        return mon["width"], mon["height"]


def _capture_frame(scale: float) -> bytes:
    with mss.mss() as sct:
        shot = sct.grab(sct.monitors[1])
    img = Image.frombytes("RGB", shot.size, shot.bgra, "raw", "BGRX")
    if scale != 1.0:
        w, h = img.size
        img = img.resize((max(1, int(w * scale)), max(1, int(h * scale))), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    img.save(buf, format="JPEG", quality=JPEG_QUALITY)
    return buf.getvalue()


# ── HTTP API ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
@app.get("/", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def root():
    return HTMLResponse(f"<pre>Vaultix Remote Desktop Agent\ngoal_desktop: {goal_desktop}\nstatus: ready</pre>")


@app.post("/api/register")
async def api_register(account: str = Form(...), password: str = Form(...)):
    # 只在完全沒有操作員帳號時開放註冊 (首次設定用)，避免變成公開註冊端點。
    with _db() as db:
        count = db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM operators").fetchone()["n"]
    if count > 0:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "已有操作員帳號，請直接登入或請管理員建立帳號"}, status_code=403)
    account = account.strip()
    if len(account) < 2 or len(password) < 4:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "帳號至少 2 碼，密碼至少 4 碼"}, status_code=400)
    with _db() as db:
        db.execute("INSERT INTO operators (account, password_hash) VALUES (?, ?)", (account, _hash_password(password)))
        db.commit()
    return JSONResponse({"ok": True})


@app.post("/api/login")
async def api_login(response: Response, account: str = Form(...), password: str = Form(...)):
    with _db() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM operators WHERE account = ?", (account.strip(),)).fetchone()
    if not row or not _verify_password(password, row["password_hash"]):
        return JSONResponse({"error": "帳號或密碼錯誤"}, status_code=401)
    token = _create_jwt(row["account"])
    response.set_cookie(COOKIE_NAME, token, max_age=JWT_DAYS * 86400, httponly=True, samesite="lax", path="/")
    w, h = _primary_monitor_size()
    return JSONResponse({
        "ok": True, "token": token, "goal_desktop": goal_desktop,
        "screen_width": w, "screen_height": h,
        "scale": current_scale, "scale_options": list(SCALE_OPTIONS),
    })


@app.post("/api/logout")
async def api_logout(response: Response):
    response.delete_cookie(COOKIE_NAME, path="/")
    return JSONResponse({"ok": True})


@app.get("/api/info")
async def api_info(request: Request):
    _require_account(request)
    w, h = _primary_monitor_size()
    return JSONResponse({
        "goal_desktop": goal_desktop, "screen_width": w, "screen_height": h,
        "scale": current_scale, "scale_options": list(SCALE_OPTIONS),
    })


@app.post("/api/scale")
async def api_scale(request: Request, value: float = Form(...)):
    _require_account(request)
    return JSONResponse({"ok": True, "scale": set_scale(value)})

    return JSONResponse({"ok": True})


# ── WebSocket：畫面串流 + 滑鼠/鍵盤控制 ──────────────────────────────────────
JS_CODE_TO_KEY: dict[str, str] = {
    "ShiftLeft": "shiftleft", "ShiftRight": "shiftright",
    "ControlLeft": "ctrlleft", "ControlRight": "ctrlright",
    "AltLeft": "altleft", "AltRight": "altright",
    "MetaLeft": "winleft", "MetaRight": "winright",
    "CapsLock": "capslock", "Tab": "tab", "Enter": "enter", "Escape": "esc",
    "Space": "space", "Backspace": "backspace", "Delete": "delete",
    "Insert": "insert", "Home": "home", "End": "end",
    "PageUp": "pageup", "PageDown": "pagedown",
    "ArrowUp": "up", "ArrowDown": "down", "ArrowLeft": "left", "ArrowRight": "right",
    "Minus": "-", "Equal": "=", "BracketLeft": "[", "BracketRight": "]",
    "Backslash": "\\", "Semicolon": ";", "Quote": "'", "Comma": ",",
    "Period": ".", "Slash": "/", "Backquote": "`",
    "NumpadAdd": "add", "NumpadSubtract": "subtract", "NumpadMultiply": "multiply",
    "NumpadDivide": "divide", "NumpadEnter": "enter", "NumpadDecimal": "decimal",
}
for _i in range(1, 13):
    JS_CODE_TO_KEY[f"F{_i}"] = f"f{_i}"
for _c in "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ":
    JS_CODE_TO_KEY[f"Key{_c}"] = _c.lower()
for _d in range(10):
    JS_CODE_TO_KEY[f"Digit{_d}"] = str(_d)
    JS_CODE_TO_KEY[f"Numpad{_d}"] = f"num{_d}"


def _apply_control_message(data: dict, screen_size: tuple[int, int]) -> None:
    kind = data.get("type")
    if kind == "mousemove":
        w, h = screen_size
        pyautogui.moveTo(int(data.get("x", 0) * w), int(data.get("y", 0) * h))
    elif kind == "mousedown":
        pyautogui.mouseDown(button=data.get("button", "left"))
    elif kind == "mouseup":
        pyautogui.mouseUp(button=data.get("button", "left"))
    elif kind == "wheel":
        pyautogui.scroll(int(-data.get("deltaY", 0) / 2))
    elif kind in ("keydown", "keyup"):
        key = JS_CODE_TO_KEY.get(data.get("code", ""))
        if key:
            (pyautogui.keyDown if kind == "keydown" else pyautogui.keyUp)(key)
    elif kind == "screenshot":
        trigger_snipping_tool()
    elif kind == "ime_toggle":
        switch_ime_language(data.get("side", "left"))
    elif kind == "set_scale":
        set_scale(float(data.get("value", 1.0)))


@app.websocket("/ws/remote")
async def ws_remote(websocket: WebSocket):
    token = _token_from_request(websocket)
    if not (token and _decode_jwt(token)):
        await websocket.close(code=4401)
        return
    await websocket.accept()
    global active_connections
    active_connections += 1
    screen_size = _primary_monitor_size()
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()

    async def sender():
        while True:
            frame = await loop.run_in_executor(None, _capture_frame, current_scale)
            await websocket.send_bytes(frame)
            await asyncio.sleep(1 / TARGET_FPS)

    async def receiver():
        while True:
            raw = await websocket.receive_text()
            try:
                _apply_control_message(json.loads(raw), screen_size)
            except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
                pass

    send_task = asyncio.ensure_future(sender())
    recv_task = asyncio.ensure_future(receiver())
    try:
        await asyncio.wait({send_task, recv_task}, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
    finally:
        active_connections -= 1
        send_task.cancel()
        recv_task.cancel()
        for t in (send_task, recv_task):
            if t.done() and not t.cancelled():
                t.exception()
        try:
            await websocket.close()
        except Exception:
            pass

    uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=8765)

# Vaultix-NAS/websites/remote_desktop_tray.py
# Vaultix Remote Desktop — background tray launcher for remote_desktop.py.
#
# remote_desktop.py alone is just the FastAPI agent — someone has to keep a
# terminal window open running "python remote_desktop.py". This file turns it
# into an actual piece of software: a background app with a system tray icon
# (status + quit) that can be packaged into a single .exe and set to launch
# automatically whenever goal_desktop's owner logs in.
#
# Dev run (from websites/, with requirements-agent.txt installed):
#   python remote_desktop_tray.py
#
# Packaged .exe: see build_agent_exe.ps1 in this same folder.
#
# Why NOT a real Windows Service: a Windows Service runs in Session 0, which
# since Windows Vista has no access to the interactive desktop — mss/pyautogui
# would not be able to see the real screen or move the real mouse from there.
# "Start with Windows" below instead adds a per-user autostart entry (HKCU
# Run key), which launches inside the logged-in user's own desktop session —
# the only place screen capture + input injection actually work. This is the
# same approach TeamViewer/AnyDesk-style "unattended access" tools use.
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
import threading
import time
import webbrowser

import pystray
import uvicorn
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

import remote_desktop as agent
from remote_desktop import app as fastapi_app

HOST = "0.0.0.0"
PORT = 8765
APP_NAME = "VaultixRemoteDesktop"
RUN_KEY = r"Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run"


# ── Windows 開機自動啟動 (HKCU Run key，跑在使用者自己的桌面 session) ────────
def _autostart_command() -> str:
    if getattr(sys, "frozen", False):
        # Packaged by PyInstaller — sys.executable IS VaultixRemoteDesktop.exe.
        return f'"{sys.executable}"'
    return f'"{sys.executable}" "{os.path.abspath(__file__)}"'


def is_autostart_enabled() -> bool:
    if os.name != "nt":
        return False
    import winreg
    try:
        with winreg.OpenKey(winreg.HKEY_CURRENT_USER, RUN_KEY, 0, winreg.KEY_READ) as key:
            winreg.QueryValueEx(key, APP_NAME)
            return True
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return False


def set_autostart(enabled: bool) -> None:
    if os.name != "nt":
        return
    import winreg
    with winreg.OpenKey(winreg.HKEY_CURRENT_USER, RUN_KEY, 0, winreg.KEY_SET_VALUE) as key:
        if enabled:
            winreg.SetValueEx(key, APP_NAME, 0, winreg.REG_SZ, _autostart_command())
        else:
            try:
                winreg.DeleteValue(key, APP_NAME)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass


# ── 系統匣圖示：綠色 = 有人連線中，灰色 = 待機中 ─────────────────────────────
def _tray_image(active: bool) -> Image.Image:
    color = (45, 212, 191, 255) if active else (107, 114, 128, 255)
    img = Image.new("RGBA", (64, 64), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    ImageDraw.Draw(img).ellipse((8, 8, 56, 56), fill=color)
    return img


def _status_text(item=None) -> str:
    n = agent.active_connections
    return f"{n} connection(s) active" if n else "Waiting for connection"


def _open_status_page(icon, item):
    webbrowser.open(f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/")


def _quit(icon, item):
    server.should_exit = True
    icon.stop()


config = uvicorn.Config(fastapi_app, host=HOST, port=PORT, log_level="warning")
server = uvicorn.Server(config)


def main():
    threading.Thread(target=server.run, daemon=True).start()

    icon = pystray.Icon(
        APP_NAME,
        _tray_image(False),
        f"Vaultix Remote Desktop — {agent.goal_desktop}",
        menu=pystray.Menu(
            pystray.MenuItem(f"goal_desktop: {agent.goal_desktop}", None, enabled=False),
            pystray.MenuItem(_status_text, None, enabled=False),
            pystray.Menu.SEPARATOR,
            pystray.MenuItem("Start with Windows", lambda i, it: set_autostart(not is_autostart_enabled()),
                              checked=lambda item: is_autostart_enabled()),
            pystray.MenuItem("Open local status page", _open_status_page),
            pystray.Menu.SEPARATOR,
            pystray.MenuItem("Quit", _quit),
        ),
    )

    def refresh_loop():
        last_active = None
        while True:
            active = agent.active_connections > 0
            if active != last_active:
                icon.icon = _tray_image(active)
                last_active = active
            icon.update_menu()
            time.sleep(2)

    threading.Thread(target=refresh_loop, daemon=True).start()
    icon.run()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

// Vocabulary-Libry/script.js
// 預設儲存檔案名稱
const LS_KEY = 'wordbook.v1';

/** @type {{word:string, meaning:string, patterns:string[], fav:boolean}[]} */
// 儲存單字
let words = [];
// 預設單字
const defaults = [
    {word: 'significant', meaning: '重要的；顯著的', pos: 'adjective', synonym: 'important', antonym: 'insignificant', derivatives: 'significance', phrases: 'none', patterns: ['a significant increase in ~', 'be significant to sb/sth'], fav:true},
    {word: 'approach', meaning: '方法；接近', pos:"noun", synonym: 'method', antonym: 'none', derivatives: 'none', phrases: 'none', patterns: ['an approach to ~', 'approach + O(及物)'], fav:false},
    {word: 'despite', meaning: '儘管(介系詞)', pos: "preposition", synonym: 'none', antonym: 'none', derivatives: 'none', phrases: 'none', patterns: ['despite + N/V-ing', 'Despite the rain, ...'], fav:false},
    {word: 'participate', meaning: '參加；參與(不及物 + in)', pos: "verb", synonym: 'none', antonym: 'none', derivatives: 'none', phrases: 'none', patterns: ['participate in ~', 'be willing to participate in~'], fav:true},
];
function LiveABC(event){
    event.preventDefault();
    const LiveABC = document.getElementById("Live-ABC-TUEE");
    LiveABC.style.display = (LiveABC.style.display === "block") ? "none" : "block";
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const select = document.getElementById('Live-ABC-TUEE');
    select.addEventListener('change', async(e) => {
        const value = e.target.value;
        if(!value) return;
        const url = `json/The-Unified-Entrance-Exam/${value}.json`;

        try{
            const response = await fetch(url);
            if(!response.ok) throw new Error(`讀取失敗:${response.status}`);
            const data = await response.json();
            words = data;
            save();
            renderList();
        }catch(error){
            console.error('讀取 JSON 發生錯誤:', error);
        }
    });
});

// 載入檔案
function load(){
    try{
        words = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY) || '[]');
    }
    catch{
        words = [];
    }
    if(!Array.isArray(words) || words.length === 0){
        words = defaults;
        save();
    }
}
// 儲存功能紐
function save(){
    localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify(words));
}
// 功能表按鈕
const panels = {
    library: document.getElementById('panel-library'),
    type: document.getElementById('panel-type'),
    add: document.getElementById('panel-add'),
    quiz: document.getElementById('panel-quiz'),
    settings: document.getElementById('panel-settings')
};

function showPanel(name){
    for(const k in panels){
        panels[k].classList.toggle('hidden', k !== name);
    }
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.toggle('active', t.dataset.panel === name));
}

document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.addEventListener('click', () => showPanel(t.dataset.panel)));

const listEl = document.getElementById('list');
const searchEl = document.getElementById('search');
const filterFavEl = document.getElementById('filterFav');

function renderList(){
    const q = searchEl.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const onlyFav = filterFavEl.value === 'fav';
    const filtered = words.filter(Boolean).filter(w => {
        if(onlyFav && !w.fav) return false;
        if(!q) return true;
        const hay = [w.word, w.pos, w.meaning, (Array.isArray(w.synonym) ? w.synonym.map : []), w.derivatives, w.phrases, ...(Array.isArray(w.patterns) ? w.patterns : [])].join('\n').toLowerCase();
        return hay.includes(q);
    });
    listEl.innerHTML = filtered.map((w, i) => itemHTML(w, i)).join('') || '<div class="muted">沒有資料，請新增或放寬篩選</div>';

    listEl.querySelectorAll('[data-idx]').forEach(el => {
        const i = +el.dataset.idx;
        el.querySelector('.star').addEventListener('click', () => toggleFav(i));
        el.querySelector('.btn-add-pattern').addEventListener('click', () => addPattern(i));
    });
}
// 顯示單字
function itemHTML(w, i){
    const patterns = w.patterns && w.patterns.length ? w.patterns.map(p => `<div>${p}</div>`).join('') : '';

    return `
    <div class="word" data-idx="${i}">
        <div class="top">
            <strong>${(w.word)}</strong>
            <span class="pos">${w.pos || '未知詞性'}</span>
            <span class="star ${w.fav ? 'fav' : ''}"title="收藏">★</span>
        </div>
        <div class="synonym">${w.synonym || 'unknow'}</div>
        <div class="antonym">${w.antonym || 'unknow'}</div>
        <div class="derivatives">${w.derivatives || 'unknow'}</div>
        <div class="phrases">${w.phrases || 'unknow'}</div>
        <div class="muted">${escapeHtml(w.meaning || '')}</div>
        <div>${patterns || '<span class="muted">(尚無例句)</span>'}</div>
        <div class="flex">
            <input class="pattern-input" placeholder="新增例句/句型...(Enter)">
            <button class="btn-add-pattern ghost">新增</button>
            </div>
        <div class="actions">
                <button class="btn-sepak" data-word="${escapeHtml(w.word)}">🔊朗讀</button>
                <button class="btn-check" data-word="${escapeHtml(w.word)} onclick="speahWord(document).getElement"">🎤檢查口說</button>
            </div>
        <div class="recognition-result"></div>
        </div>
    `;
    
}

// 朗讀功能
function speakWord(word){
    if(!('speechSynthesis' in window)){
        alert('您的瀏覽器不支援語音功能');
        return;
    }
    const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(word);
    utterance.lang = 'en-US';
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

// 語音識別功能
function startSpeechRecognition(word, buttonElement){
    if(!('webkitSpeechRecognition' in window || 'SpeechRecognition' in window)){
        alert('您的瀏覽器不支援語音識別功能');
        return;
    }
    const card = buttonElement.closest('.word') || buttonElement.closest('.card');
    if(!card){
        console.err('找不到卡片容器');
        return;
    }
        const SpeechRecognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
        const recognition = new SpeechRecognition();
        recognition.lang = 'en-US';
        recognition.interimResults = false;
        recognition.maxAlternatives = 1;
        
        // const card = buttonElement.closest('.card');
        const resultDiv = card.querySelector('.recognition-result');

        resultDiv.textContent = '請開始說單字...';

        recognition.start();

        recognition.onresult = (event) => {
            const spoken = event.results[0][0].transcript.trim().toLowerCase();
            resultDiv.textContent = `你說了:${spoken}`;
        
            if(spoken === word.toLowerCase()){
                resultDiv.textContent = '🎉正確!';
            }else{
            resultDiv.textContent = '❌不正確，請在試一次!';
            }
        };
        recognition.onerror = (event) => {
            if(resultDiv){
                recognitionResult.textContent = '語音識別錯誤:' + event.error;
            }else{
                console.error('找不到結果顯示的元素');
            }
        };
    }

    function toggleFav(i){
    words[i].fav = !words[i].fav;
    save();
    renderList();
}

function addPattern(i){
    const card = listEl.querySelector(`[data-idx="${i}"]`);
    const inp = card.querySelector('.pattern-input');
    const v = (inp.value || '').trim();
    if(!v) return;
    words[i].patterns = words[i].patterns || [];
    words[i].patterns.push(v);
    inp.value = '';
    save();
    renderList();
}
